description: Generated from apps/docs pages, demos/*/meta.ts, demo Vue sources, reference JSON, and @astryx-vue/core exports. Do not edit by hand.

en: Import each component from its own subpath. That entry loads the matching structural styles.
`@astryx-vue/core` peers on `vue: ^3.5.0`. The theme package depends on `@fontsource/figtree` and `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono` for the body and monospace faces. Both packages publish ESM only.

Subpaths and the package root export the same components. Docs and examples use subpaths so the import says which component it is, and so only that component's structural sheet loads. Importing `useClipboard` from the package root can pull other component modules along if the bundler does not drop unused re-exports. Prefer a subpath when you only need a component.

These styles do not require UnoCSS. The docs site uses UnoCSS only so example classes such as `i-carbon-*` can draw icons. That is the icon approach, not a styling dependency. See [Icons](/en/guide/icons).
zh: 组件从自己的子路径引入。那个入口会带上对应的结构样式。
`@astryx-vue/core` 的 peer 依赖是 `vue: ^3.5.0`。主题包依赖 `@fontsource/figtree` 和 `@fontsource/jetbrains-mono`，用来提供正文和等宽字体。两个包都只发布 ESM。
子路径和包根导出的是同一批组件。文档和示例使用子路径，这样意图更清楚，也只加载该组件那份结构样式。从包根引入 `useClipboard` 这类函数时，打包器若不能摇掉未使用的重导出，可能会把其他组件模块一起算进去。只使用组件时，优先写子路径。
这套样式不要求 UnoCSS。文档站用 UnoCSS 只为了给示例里的 `i-carbon-*` 类提供图标，那是图标方案，不是组件样式的依赖。见 [图标](/guide/icons)。

summary.en: `Button` triggers an action. Set `label` to name the action.
summary.zh: `Button` 用来触发界面中的各类操作，保存、删除、提交这些动作都可以交给它。每个按钮都必须通过 `label` 指定操作名称，它既是默认的可见文字，也是屏幕阅读器朗读的无障碍标签。没有默认插槽时，按钮直接显示 `label`：

usage.en:
`Button` triggers an action. Set `label` to name the action.

Without a default slot, the button displays `label`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Save changes" variant="primary" />
</template>
```

Use the dedicated [ButtonGroup](/en/components/button-group) and [IconButton](/en/components/icon-button) components when you need connected actions or an explicit icon-only button.

The `icon` slot sits in a sized box before the label, and the `end` slot mirrors it. Put an [Icon](/en/components/icon) there and leave its `size` unset; the slot already decides the box:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Upload file">
    <template #icon>
      <Icon name="carbon:upload" />
    </template>
  </Button>
  <Button label="Continue" variant="secondary">
    <template #end>
      <Icon name="carbon:chevron-right" />
    </template>
  </Button>
</template>
```

A CSS icon class still works in the slot if you already generate one. UnoCSS is not required.
usage.zh:
`Button` 用来触发界面中的各类操作，保存、删除、提交这些动作都可以交给它。每个按钮都必须通过 `label` 指定操作名称，它既是默认的可见文字，也是屏幕阅读器朗读的无障碍标签。没有默认插槽时，按钮直接显示 `label`：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="保存更改" variant="primary" />
</template>
```

- 需要把一组相关操作并排放在一起时，使用 [ButtonGroup](/components/button-group)。
- 操作只需要一个图标时，使用 [IconButton](/components/icon-button)。

`icon` 插槽位于文字之前，放在一个已经定好尺寸的盒子里，`end` 插槽与之对称。放一个 [Icon](/components/icon)，不要再设 `size`，盒子由槽决定：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="上传文件">
    <template #icon>
      <Icon name="carbon:upload" />
    </template>
  </Button>
  <Button label="继续" variant="secondary">
    <template #end>
      <Icon name="carbon:chevron-right" />
    </template>
  </Button>
</template>
```

槽里仍然可以放 CSS 图标类，前提是你的构建会生成这个类。不必为了按钮去装 UnoCSS。

en.text: Reserve primary for the single most important action in the view. Use secondary or ghost for everything else based on emphasis.
Write labels that describe the action ("Save changes", "Delete account", "Send invite"), not vague labels like "OK" or "Click here".
Show a loading state for actions that take time, like saving or submitting, so the user knows it is working.
Always provide a label for icon-only buttons so screen readers can announce what the button does. Add a tooltip for sighted users.
For a dedicated icon-only button, use IconButton from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'. It is a separate component, not exported from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'.
Place more than one primary button in the same view; this dilutes the visual hierarchy.
Use the destructive variant without a confirmation step for irreversible actions like deleting data.
Use a button for navigation. If it only takes the user to another page, use a link instead. Buttons are for actions like saving, deleting, or submitting.

zh.text: 把 primary 留给视图中最重要的那个操作，其余操作按强调程度依次使用 secondary 或 ghost，视觉层级会更清晰。
按钮文字直接描述将要发生的操作，例如 “Save changes”、“Delete account”、“Send invite”。避免使用 “OK” 或 “Click here” 这类看不出后果的模糊文字。
保存、提交等耗时操作应显示加载状态，让用户明确知道请求正在处理，而不是对着没反应的界面重复点击。
纯图标按钮也必须提供文字标签，屏幕阅读器依赖它来播报按钮用途；面向普通用户时，可以再用 tooltip 给出视觉提示。
需要独立的纯图标按钮时，从 `@astryx-vue/core/IconButton` 导入 IconButton。它是独立组件，不从 `@astryx-vue/core/Button` 导出。
避免在同一视图中放置多个 primary 按钮，多个主按钮会互相争抢注意力，反而削弱视觉层级。
避免让 destructive 按钮直接执行删除数据这类不可撤销的操作。应先提供确认步骤，给使用者一次反悔的机会。
避免用按钮做纯粹的页面跳转：跳转请使用链接，按钮留给保存、删除、提交这类会改变状态的操作。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 操作名称，同时作为按钮的无障碍名称。没有默认插槽时，它就是按钮上可见的文字。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 按钮的外观风格，用来表达操作的强调程度与类型。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 按钮尺寸，决定点击区域的大小。

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: 独立浮动按钮的静止阴影深度；放入 ButtonGroup 后由组统一控制。

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: 原生 button 元素的类型，常用于表单内的提交与重置。

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: 表单提交时携带的名称。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: 表单提交时随名称一并提交的值。

rows.name: `form`
rows.description: 要关联的表单 ID。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 是否禁用，禁用后不再响应交互。存在 tooltip 时改用 aria-disabled，让按钮保留焦点。

rows.name: `isLoading`
rows.description: 是否显示加载状态：展示加载图标并设置 aria-busy，同时默认阻止重复操作。

rows.name: `isInterruptible`
rows.description: 加载期间是否允许再次触发 clickAction。

rows.name: `clickAction`
rows.description: 点击时执行的动作。返回 Promise 时，组件自动进入并退出加载状态。

rows.name: `isIconOnly`
rows.description: 是否只显示 icon 插槽的内容，操作名称仍由 label 提供给辅助技术。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 按钮宽度。数字按像素处理，CSS 字符串按原样使用。

rows.name: `loadingLabel`
rows.description: 加载文字，用于加载图标与实时区域，建议按应用语言本地化。

rows.name: `tooltip`
rows.description: 补充提示，悬停或键盘聚焦时显示。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 存在且未禁用时，根元素渲染为链接。

rows.name: `as`
rows.description: href 模式下使用的自定义 Vue 链接组件，可同时接收 href 和 to。

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: 链接的浏览上下文，如 `_blank`。

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: 链接的关系属性。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Optional visible-content override. label remains the stable accessible name.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Decorative icon before the label.

rows.name: `end`
rows.description: Short trailing decoration such as a badge or icon. Ignored in icon-only mode.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 可选的默认内容，用来覆盖 label 渲染的可见文字；无障碍名称仍由 label 提供。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 渲染在标签前的装饰图标。

rows.name: `end`
rows.description: 渲染在标签后的徽标、图标等简短装饰内容，纯图标模式下不显示。

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: Cancellable Vue component event. It is not emitted while disabled, non-interruptible loading, or deduplicated.

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: 可取消的点击事件。按钮处于禁用状态，或加载期间阻止重复操作时，不会触发。

en.heading: Async actions
en.text:
- `@click` runs before `clickAction`.
- If `@click` calls `event.preventDefault()`, the component skips `clickAction`.
- If `clickAction` returns a Promise, the component enters the loading state.
- When the Promise fulfills or rejects, the component clears the loading state.
- The application must catch errors inside `clickAction`.

en.heading: Repeated activation
en.text:
- If `isInterruptible` is `false`, loading blocks another activation.
- If `isInterruptible` is `true`, loading permits another activation.
- Repeated activation runs multiple actions concurrently.
- The component does not cancel earlier Promises.

To cancel an earlier network request, call `AbortController.abort()` in the application.

en.heading: Template ref
en.text:
`Button` exposes `element`.
Its type is `HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLElement | null`.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

zh.heading: 异步操作
zh.text:
`clickAction` 让组件感知异步流程：

- `@click` 始终先于 `clickAction` 触发。
- 在 `@click` 中调用 `event.preventDefault()` 时，组件会跳过 `clickAction`，适合用它拦截操作。
- `clickAction` 返回 Promise 时，组件立即进入加载状态。
- Promise 成功或失败后，组件自动清除加载状态。
- 错误处理交给应用：`clickAction` 中产生的异常需要由应用自行捕获。

zh.heading: 重复触发
zh.text:
- `isInterruptible` 默认为 `false`，加载期间的再次点击会被忽略。
- 设为 `true` 后，加载期间可以继续触发，多个操作并行执行。
- 组件不会取消之前尚未完成的 Promise；如果需要取消旧请求，请在应用侧调用 `AbortController.abort()`。

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
`Button` 公开 `element`。
类型为 `HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLElement | null`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

en.title: Floating
en.description: A floating action button raised with elevation="med". Use elevation for buttons that hover above content, like a FAB.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const variants = [
  { variant: 'primary' as const, label: 'Primary' },
  { variant: 'secondary' as const, label: 'Secondary' },
  { variant: 'ghost' as const, label: 'Ghost' },
  { variant: 'destructive' as const, label: 'Destructive' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="4">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Floating action buttons — raised above content with `elevation="med"`
    </Text>
    <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
      <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" elevation="med">
        <template #icon>
          <Icon icon="i-heroicons-plus" />
        </template>
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>

en.title: Sizes
en.description: Small, medium, and large buttons side by side. Use small in dense UIs like toolbars, medium for most cases, and large for prominent CTAs.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const sizes = [
  { size: 'sm' as const, label: 'Small' },
  { size: 'md' as const, label: 'Medium' },
  { size: 'lg' as const, label: 'Large' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="4">
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Primary
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in sizes" :key="item.size" :label="item.label" variant="primary" :size="item.size" />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Secondary
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in sizes" :key="item.size" :label="item.label" variant="secondary" :size="item.size" />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>

en.title: Variants
en.description: All 4 button variants in default, disabled, and loading states. Use primary for the main action, secondary for most others, ghost for low-emphasis, and destructive for dangerous actions.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const variants = [
  { variant: 'primary' as const, label: 'Primary' },
  { variant: 'secondary' as const, label: 'Secondary' },
  { variant: 'ghost' as const, label: 'Ghost' },
  { variant: 'destructive' as const, label: 'Destructive' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="4">
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Default
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Disabled
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" is-disabled />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Loading
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" is-loading />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>

en.title: End slot
en.description: Buttons with a trailing badge showing a count or status. Use for notification counts, unread messages, or any button that needs a visual indicator.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Badge } from '@astryx-vue/core/Badge'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="4">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Trailing badges for counts or status
    </Text>
    <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
      <Button label="Messages" variant="primary">
        <template #end>
          <Badge variant="info">
            3
          </Badge>
        </template>
      </Button>
      <Button label="Notifications" variant="secondary">
        <template #end>
          <Badge variant="warning">
            12
          </Badge>
        </template>
      </Button>
      <Button label="Updates" variant="ghost">
        <template #end>
          <Badge variant="neutral">
            New
          </Badge>
        </template>
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>

en.title: Icon

en.code:

    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Icons reinforce the action
    </Text>
    <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
      <Button label="New item" variant="primary">
        <template #icon>
          <Icon icon="i-heroicons-plus" />
        </template>
      </Button>
      <Button label="Edit" variant="secondary">
        <template #icon>

        </template>
      </Button>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>

zh.title: 变体
zh.description: 四种变体的默认、禁用和加载状态。primary 留给主操作，secondary 用于多数操作，ghost 表示低强调，destructive 表示危险操作。
zh.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const variants = [
  { variant: 'primary' as const, label: 'Primary' },
  { variant: 'secondary' as const, label: 'Secondary' },
  { variant: 'ghost' as const, label: 'Ghost' },
  { variant: 'destructive' as const, label: 'Destructive' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="4">
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Default
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Disabled
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" is-disabled />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Loading
      </Text>
      <Stack align="center" direction="horizontal" :gap="3">
        <Button v-for="item in variants" :key="item.variant" :label="item.label" :variant="item.variant" is-loading />
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
  </Stack>
</template>

zh.title: 图标

import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'

        <template #icon>
          <Icon icon="i-heroicons-plus" />
        </template>

en.name: Icon
en.description: A leading icon that reinforces the label, like a trash icon on a Delete button.

en.name: Label
en.description: The visible text describing the action. Also used as the accessible name.

en.name: End content
en.description: A trailing badge or icon after the label, like a notification count or dropdown arrow.

en.name: Spinner
en.description: Replaces the icon during loading to show the action is in progress.

zh.name: 图标
zh.description: 强化标签的前导图标，比如删除按钮上的垃圾桶。

zh.name: 标签
zh.description: 说明这个操作的可见文字，同时也是无障碍名称。

zh.name: 尾部内容
zh.description: 标签后面的徽章或图标，比如通知数或下拉箭头。

zh.name: 转圈
zh.description: 加载时替换图标，表示操作还在进行。

en.name: Text label
en.description: Button text must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the button background in every state. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

en.name: Essential icon or spinner arc
en.description: An icon used instead of text must have at least 3:1 contrast with the button background. The moving spinner arc must also meet 3:1. An icon beside a visible label does not need its own check.

en.name: Badge text
en.description: Badge text inside a button must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the Badge background. Check all 14 built-in Badge colors in Rest, Hover, and Pointer down on page and surface backgrounds. This covers 336 pairs per mode. Check custom end content separately.

en.name: Visible control boundary
en.description: The button edge needs 3:1 contrast only when users need it to see the control. A text-only button can rely on its label.

en.name: Keyboard focus indicator
en.description: The focus outline needs at least 3:1 contrast with the area around the button. Check every style. Destructive buttons use a red outline.

en.name: Disabled appearance
en.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.

zh.name: 文字
zh.description: 按钮文字和按钮底在每个状态都要至少 4.5:1。悬停和按下，量的是叠层加上去之后的最终底色。

zh.name: 代替文字的图标或转圈弧线
zh.description: 用来代替文字的图标，和按钮底至少 3:1。转动的那截弧线也要达到 3:1。图标旁边已经有可见文字时，图标不用单独量。

zh.name: 徽章文字
zh.description: 按钮里的徽章文字和徽章底至少 4.5:1。14 种内置徽章颜色，都要在静止、悬停、按下，以及页面底和表面底上各量一遍。每种模式一共 336 对。自己放进尾部的内容另外量。

zh.name: 看得出的控件边界
zh.description: 只有使用者必须靠这条边才看得出这是控件时，边才需要 3:1。只有文字的按钮可以靠文字本身。

zh.name: 键盘焦点指示
zh.description: 焦点轮廓和按钮周围至少 3:1。每种样式都要量。destructive 用的是红色轮廓。

zh.name: 禁用外观
zh.description: 禁用的控件不用达到这些对比度。

summary.en: `ButtonGroup` connects related buttons into one group. Buttons have no gap. Separators distinguish adjacent buttons:
summary.zh: `ButtonGroup` 把一组相关的按钮连接成一个整体，适合复制、剪切、粘贴这类作用于同一对象的操作。组内按钮之间没有间距，用分隔线区分相邻按钮：

usage.en:
`ButtonGroup` connects related buttons into one group. Buttons have no gap. Separators distinguish adjacent buttons:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/ButtonGroup'
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonGroup label="Editing actions">
    <Button label="Copy" />
    <Button label="Cut" />
    <Button label="Paste" />
  </ButtonGroup>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ButtonGroup` 把一组相关的按钮连接成一个整体，适合复制、剪切、粘贴这类作用于同一对象的操作。组内按钮之间没有间距，用分隔线区分相邻按钮：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { ButtonGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/ButtonGroup'
</script>

<template>
  <ButtonGroup label="编辑操作">
    <Button label="复制" />
    <Button label="剪切" />
    <Button label="粘贴" />
  </ButtonGroup>
</template>
```

en.text: Group buttons that perform related actions on the same object, like copy, cut, paste on selected text.
Use the same variant for all buttons in a group so they look like a single connected unit.
Keep groups small (2–4 buttons). For more actions, use a Toolbar or DropdownMenu instead.

zh.text: 将作用于同一对象的相关操作放入一组，例如针对选中文本的复制、剪切、粘贴，让用户一眼看出这些操作彼此关联。
组内所有按钮使用相同的变体，它们在视觉上才能连成一体。
保持按钮组小巧，建议只放 2 到 4 个操作。数量更多时改用 Toolbar 或 DropdownMenu 收纳，避免一排按钮挤占界面。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the group.

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: Connected direction and arrow-key navigation axis.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Default inherited by child buttons. An explicit child size wins.

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: Shadow depth for the connected surface.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables every Button and IconButton in the group.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 按钮组的无障碍名称，供屏幕阅读器在组内导航时播报。

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: 按钮的排列方向，组内方向键沿此方向移动焦点。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 组内按钮继承的默认尺寸；子按钮设置了自己的 size 时优先使用。

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: 整个按钮组的静止阴影强度；放入组内的按钮不再单独显示阴影。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 是否禁用组内全部 Button 和 IconButton。

en.heading: Slot
en.text: ButtonGroup receives Button or IconButton through its required default slot.

en.heading: Keyboard navigation
en.text:
- Keyboard navigation skips disabled buttons.
- Right-to-left horizontal layouts reverse the Left and Right Arrow behavior.

- Left and Right Arrow: Left and Right Arrow
- Up and Down Arrow: Up and Down Arrow
- `Home`: `Home`
- `End`: `End`

en.heading: Template ref
en.text:
`ButtonGroup` exposes `element`.
Its type is `HTMLDivElement | null`.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: ButtonGroup 通过必需的默认插槽接收 Button 或 IconButton。

zh.heading: 键盘导航
zh.text:
- 键盘导航跳过禁用按钮。
- 从右到左的水平布局会交换左右方向键的行为。

- 左右方向键: 左右方向键
- 上下方向键: 上下方向键
- `Home`: `Home`
- `End`: `End`

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
`ButtonGroup` 公开 `element`。
类型为 `HTMLDivElement | null`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

summary.en: `ContextMenu` gives one region of the interface its own actions: a right-click inside the trigger area — or the keyboard's context-menu key, or a long press on touch — opens a menu at the pointer. It fits list rows, canvases, file nodes, and table cells: places where the actions belong to a specific object and a permanent row of buttons would only add clutter. Each row behaves like a menu row, with an icon, a description, a shortcut hint, or a disabled state.
summary.zh: `ContextMenu` 为某一块界面提供上下文操作：用户在触发器区域内点右键（或按下键盘的菜单键、在触屏上长按），菜单就在指针位置展开。它适合列表行、画布、文件节点、表格单元格这类「操作属于某个具体对象、又不想为每个对象摆一排按钮」的场景。菜单里的每一行和普通菜单一样可以带图标、说明、快捷键位和禁用状态。

usage.en: `ContextMenu` gives one region of the interface its own actions: a right-click inside the trigger area — or the keyboard's context-menu key, or a long press on touch — opens a menu at the pointer. It fits list rows, canvases, file nodes, and table cells: places where the actions belong to a specific object and a permanent row of buttons would only add clutter. Each row behaves like a menu row, with an icon, a description, a shortcut hint, or a disabled state. The pointer position is converted into the trigger's own coordinates and materialized as a zero-size anchor, so the panel is positioned relative to the trigger rather than the viewport. It follows the content when the page scrolls, flips above the pointer near the bottom edge, and never leaves the screen. There are two ways to describe the content. The data-driven one hands the rows to `items`: ```vue ``` An entry can be an action, a divider, a section, a checkbox row, or a radio group. An action that also carries nested entries becomes a submenu. A checkbox row carries whether it is on and a change callback, and toggling it leaves the menu open. A radio group carries the current value and its options, and choosing one closes the menu. When the menu is composed by hand, those rows go in the content slot under the context menu's own names, and they behave like the dropdown menu's rows. Put the built-in icon in the icon slot and pass its name. When the menu needs to be composed by hand, use the `content` slot with the exported menu components instead. Both styles share one keyboard model: ```vue ``` Open state is managed for you: a right-click opens the menu, and a click outside, Escape, or Tab closes it. Every change is reported through the `openChange` event. Bind `v-model:is-open` when something outside the component should decide, and the menu renders exactly the bound value. Focus lands on the first available row when the menu opens. The arrow keys move between rows and wrap at both ends, Home and End jump to the first and last row, PageDown and PageUp move by a screenful, and typing letters jumps to the next row whose label starts with them — pressing the same letter again cycles through the matches. Enter and Space activate the focused row, Escape closes the menu and returns focus to whatever was focused before it opened, and Tab closes the menu while letting the browser move focus on from there. A disabled row is marked `aria-disabled`, leaves the tab order, and is skipped by both the arrow keys and typeahead. The surface is `role="menu"`, rows are `role="menuitem"`, sections are `role="group"`, and dividers are `role="separator"`. A submenu flies out beside its row on a wide screen. On a compact touch surface the next level replaces the current rows and adds a Back row. It can also be forced to always fly out or always replace the rows. While the next level is loading, the caret can become a spinner. `isDisabled` stops the component intercepting the right-click, so the browser's own menu still appears and people keep their spell-check, copy, and inspect tools. `triggerAs` decides whether the trigger renders as a block `div` or an inline `span`; the inline form lets a word inside running prose own a context menu without breaking the layout. The panel is at least 160px wide and grows with its rows unless `menuWidth` pins a width; either way it is capped to the viewport, and content taller than 300px scrolls inside it. `size` changes only the rows' block padding, from `sm` to `lg`.
usage.zh: `ContextMenu` 为某一块界面提供上下文操作：用户在触发器区域内点右键（或按下键盘的菜单键、在触屏上长按），菜单就在指针位置展开。它适合列表行、画布、文件节点、表格单元格这类「操作属于某个具体对象、又不想为每个对象摆一排按钮」的场景。菜单里的每一行和普通菜单一样可以带图标、说明、快捷键位和禁用状态。 指针位置会被换算成触发器内部的坐标，并落在一个零尺寸的锚点上，因此菜单是相对触发器定位而不是相对视口定位的：页面滚动时它跟着内容走，靠近视口下缘时会自动翻到上方，而不会跑出屏幕。 内容有两种写法。数据驱动的方式把菜单项交给 `items`： ```vue ``` 数组里的元素可以是动作、分隔线、分组、勾选行或单选组。动作再带上下一级条目就会变成子菜单。勾选行用当前是否选中和变更回调描述，点一下默认不关闭菜单；单选组用当前值和选项列表描述，选中一项后默认关闭。自己组合菜单时，这些行写进内容插槽，组件名是上下文菜单自己的，行为和上面的下拉菜单相同。图标放进图标插槽，使用内置图标并传入图标名。 菜单内容需要自己组合时，改用 `content` 插槽，并用导出的菜单组件搭出结构。两种写法共用同一套键盘行为： ```vue ``` 开关状态默认由组件自己管理：右键打开，点击菜单外部、按 Escape、按 Tab 都会关闭。每次开关都会通过 `openChange` 事件报告新状态。需要由外部决定是否展开时，用 `v-model:is-open` 绑定状态，此时组件完全跟随绑定的值。 打开后焦点会落到第一个可用的条目上。上下方向键在条目之间移动并在两端循环，Home/End 跳到首尾，PageDown/PageUp 按一屏翻动，直接键入字母会跳到标签以这些字母开头的条目（反复按同一个字母会在匹配项之间轮转）。Enter 和空格执行当前条目，Escape 关闭菜单并把焦点交还给打开菜单前聚焦的元素，Tab 则关闭菜单并让浏览器继续从那里往后移动焦点。被禁用的条目会带 `aria-disabled`、退出 Tab 顺序，同时被方向键和键入跳转跳过。菜单本身是 `role="menu"`，条目是 `role="menuitem"`，分组是 `role="group"`，分隔线是 `role="separator"`。 子菜单在宽屏上向旁边展开。在紧凑触控界面上，下一级会换掉当前面板里的行，并在顶部给出返回。也可以强制始终飞出或始终钻入。行还在加载时，箭头可以换成转圈。 `isDisabled` 会让组件不再拦截右键：原生浏览器菜单照常出现，这样用户可以复制文字或使用浏览器自带的功能。`triggerAs` 决定触发器渲染成块级 `div` 还是行内 `span`，后者让一段行文中的词也能拥有自己的上下文菜单而不破坏排版。 菜单面板的宽度默认至少 160px 并随内容伸缩，`menuWidth` 可以给出确定宽度；无论哪种方式，面板都不会超出视口，超长内容会换行并被限制在最高 300px 的滚动区域内。`size` 只改变条目的上下内边距，`sm`、`md`、`lg` 依次更宽松。

en.text: Name what happens in each row. "Rename" and "Copy link" are understood; "Action" and "More" are not.
Group related actions with sections and dividers once a menu holds more than a handful of rows.
Offer a visible route to the same actions. Not everyone knows to right-click, and screen reader users need to be told the menu exists.
Keep destructive actions at the bottom of the menu and mark them `variant="destructive"`.
Use `triggerAs="span"` when a word inside running prose needs the menu, so no block element lands inside a paragraph.
Make the context menu the only way to reach important actions. Both the right-click and the long press are hidden gestures.
Stack more than ten or so rows without grouping them. Long menus are slow to scan and hard to reach the end of.
Put a multi-step form inside a menu. A dialog or its own page is the right home for that.

zh.text: 菜单项用动词短语写清楚会发生什么，「重命名」「复制链接」比「操作」「更多」更容易被理解。
条目较多时用分组和分隔线分区，一块区域只放同一类操作。
所有操作同时提供可见入口。并非所有人都知道可以右键，屏幕阅读器用户也需要能被提示。
危险操作放在菜单最下方，用 `variant="destructive"` 标出。
行文中的词需要上下文菜单时使用 `triggerAs="span"`，避免在段落里插入块级元素。
把上下文菜单当作访问重要功能的唯一方式。移动端的长按和桌面端的右键都是隐式手势，容易被漏掉。
在单个菜单里堆超过十来个条目而不分组。菜单越长越难扫，也很难在视线范围内读完。
用菜单承载需要输入多步的表单。复杂流程应改用对话框或独立页面。

en.heading: Sub-components
en.text:
Compound mode and data mode render the same row components, so their styling, keyboard behavior, and theme variables cannot drift apart.

- `ContextMenuItem`: `ContextMenuItem`
- `ContextMenuDivider`: `ContextMenuDivider`
- `ContextMenuGroup`: `ContextMenuGroup`
- `ContextMenuCheckboxItem`: `ContextMenuCheckboxItem`
- `ContextMenuRadioGroup`: `ContextMenuRadioGroup`
- `ContextMenuRadioItem`: `ContextMenuRadioItem`
- `ContextMenuSubMenu`: `ContextMenuSubMenu`

en.heading: Theming
en.text:
```css
.my-context-menu {
  --astryx-context-menu-background: #ffffff;
  --astryx-context-menu-item-focus-background: #0536590c;
}
```

- `--astryx-context-menu-background`: panel background.
- `--astryx-context-menu-foreground`: panel text color.
- `--astryx-context-menu-shadow`: panel shadow.
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-foreground`: row text color.
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-focus-background`: background of the highlighted row, for both hover and keyboard focus.
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-pressed-background`: background of a row while a mouse holds it down, painted only where hover exists.
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-description-foreground`: row description color.
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-error-foreground`: label and icon color of a `variant="destructive"` row.
- `--astryx-context-menu-section-foreground`: section heading color.
- `--astryx-context-menu-block-cap`: maximum panel height, resolved against the viewport; the default takes the smaller of 300px and the viewport height.
- `--astryx-spacing-1`, `--astryx-radius-container`, `--astryx-text-label-size`: padding, radius, and type reuse the global tokens.

The neutral theme adapts to light and dark mode on its own.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is the trigger: a `<div>`, or a `<span>` with `triggerAs="span"`.

The following go to the trigger element:

- HTML attributes such as `id` or `data-*`.
- `aria-*` attributes.

`class` and `style`, on the other hand, go to the menu panel: the panel is the painted, themeable surface (the `astryx-context-menu` class), which mirrors how upstream hands `className` and `style` to the menu.

The trigger itself carries no `role`, `aria-haspopup`, or `aria-expanded`: it is not a button, the right-click is a system-level gesture, and the menu is named by its own `label` only while it is open. The menu panel is teleported to `document.body`, so it inherits nothing from the trigger; the panel carries its own `data-size`, `data-placement`, `data-overflow`, `data-width`, and `data-astryx-menu-press` for styling and tests.

zh.heading: 子组件
zh.text:
复合模式与数据模式共用同一批行组件，行样式、键盘行为和主题变量完全一致。

- `ContextMenuItem`: `ContextMenuItem`
- `ContextMenuDivider`: `ContextMenuDivider`
- `ContextMenuGroup`: `ContextMenuGroup`
- `ContextMenuCheckboxItem`: `ContextMenuCheckboxItem`
- `ContextMenuRadioGroup`: `ContextMenuRadioGroup`
- `ContextMenuRadioItem`: `ContextMenuRadioItem`
- `ContextMenuSubMenu`: `ContextMenuSubMenu`

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
```css
.my-context-menu {
  --astryx-context-menu-background: #ffffff;
  --astryx-context-menu-item-focus-background: #0536590c;
}
```

- `--astryx-context-menu-background`：面板背景。
- `--astryx-context-menu-foreground`：面板文字颜色。
- `--astryx-context-menu-shadow`：面板投影。
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-foreground`：条目文字颜色。
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-focus-background`：条目被高亮（悬停或键盘聚焦）时的背景。
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-pressed-background`：鼠标按住条目时的背景，仅在支持悬停的设备上出现。
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-description-foreground`：条目次要说明文字颜色。
- `--astryx-context-menu-item-error-foreground`：`variant="destructive"` 条目的文字与图标颜色。
- `--astryx-context-menu-section-foreground`：分组标题颜色。
- `--astryx-context-menu-block-cap`：面板最高高度，默认取 300px 与视口高度中较小者。
- `--astryx-spacing-1`、`--astryx-radius-container`、`--astryx-text-label-size`：内边距、圆角与字号沿用全局 token。

Neutral 主题自动适配明暗模式。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素是触发器（默认 `<div>`，`triggerAs="span"` 时为 `<span>`）。

以下内容传入触发器元素：

- HTML 属性（例如 `id`、`data-*`）。
- `aria-*` 属性。

`class` 与 `style` 则作用于菜单面板：面板才是可主题化的绘制表面（对应 `astryx-context-menu` 这个 CSS 类），与上游把 `className`、`style` 交给菜单面板的做法一致。

触发器本身不携带 `role`、`aria-haspopup` 或 `aria-expanded`：它不是按钮，右键是系统级手势，菜单只在打开时以自己的 `label` 命名。菜单面板被传送到 `document.body`，因此不会继承触发器上的属性；面板自身带有 `data-size`、`data-placement`、`data-overflow`、`data-width`、`data-astryx-menu-press` 供样式与测试使用。

      </Text>
      <Text as="div" color="secondary" type="supporting">

      </Text>

    <template #content>
      <ContextMenuCheckboxItem v-model="pinned" label="Pin to top">
        <template #icon>
          <Icon name="carbon:pin" />
        </template>
      </ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
      <ContextMenuCheckboxItem v-model="muted" label="Mute">
        <template #icon>
          <Icon name="carbon:volume-mute" />
        </template>
      </ContextMenuCheckboxItem>
      <ContextMenuDivider />
      <ContextMenuRadioGroup v-model="density" label="Density">
        <ContextMenuRadioItem value="compact" label="Compact" />
        <ContextMenuRadioItem value="comfortable" label="Comfortable" />
      </ContextMenuRadioGroup>
    </template>
  </ContextMenu>
</template>

summary.en: `DropdownMenu` turns a button into the entry point for a small set of actions. The button stays quiet; the menu appears next to it when opened, closes as soon as an action is picked, and gives focus back to the button. It is the right shape for "what do I do next" — rename, duplicate, archive, delete — when the actions are one flat level deep.
summary.zh: `DropdownMenu` 把一个按钮变成一组操作的入口。按钮本身很轻，真正的菜单在点击后才出现，浮在触发按钮旁边，选完一项就收起，焦点回到按钮上。它适合放“下一步要做什么”——重命名、复制、归档、删除这类只有一层的动作。

usage.en:
`DropdownMenu` turns a button into the entry point for a small set of actions. The button stays quiet; the menu appears next to it when opened, closes as soon as an action is picked, and gives focus back to the button. It is the right shape for "what do I do next" — rename, duplicate, archive, delete — when the actions are one flat level deep.

The shortest form is an `items` array, where each entry is one action:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DropdownMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu
    :button="{ label: 'Actions' }"
    :items="[
      { label: 'Edit project', icon: 'i-carbon-tools', onClick: () => edit() },
      { label: 'Duplicate project', icon: 'i-carbon-copy', onClick: () => duplicate() },
      { label: 'Delete project', icon: 'i-carbon-trash-can', variant: 'destructive', onClick: () => remove() },
    ]"
  />
</template>
```

An entry can be an action, a divider, a titled group, a checkbox row, or a radio group. An action says what happens next. A checkbox row carries whether it is on. A radio group carries the selected value and lists its options. Those rows are also documented on their own pages: [Dropdown Menu Checkbox Item](/en/components/dropdown-menu-checkbox-item), [Dropdown Menu Radio Group](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group), and [Dropdown Menu Radio Item](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-item). When the rows follow page state, or you want to lay them out yourself, use the default slot and the matching row components. Both forms draw the same structure. In a template, put the built-in icon in the icon slot and pass its name. In the data array, pass an icon component or a CSS icon class.

The trigger is the design system's `Button` by default. Pass its props through `button` (`variant`, `size`, `isIconOnly`, …); `size` also sets the height of the menu rows, so a `size="sm"` button goes with a compact menu. When the trigger is not a plain button — an icon button, an avatar, a row in a list — use the `trigger` slot instead and `v-bind` everything the slot hands you onto your own control. The menu then hangs off that control and takes its name from it.

```vue
<template>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <template #trigger="triggerProps">
      <IconButton v-bind="triggerProps" icon="i-carbon-overflow-menu-horizontal" label="More actions" />
    </template>

    <DropdownMenuItem icon="i-carbon-tools" label="Edit project" @click="edit" />
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
```

Once open, the menu owns the keyboard. The arrow keys move between rows and wrap at both ends, `Home` and `End` jump to the first and last row, `PageUp` and `PageDown` page through a long menu, and typing a letter jumps to the next row that starts with it (pressing the same letter again cycles through the matches). `Enter` and Space run the highlighted row, `Escape` or a press outside closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger, and `Tab` closes the menu as well so the browser keeps its own tab order. Moving the pointer over a row moves focus to it, so keyboard and pointer share one highlight and two rows are never lit at once.

Where the menu opens differs by how it was opened. A keyboard open puts focus on the first row (or the last one for `ArrowUp`); a pointer open only focuses the menu itself, so no row reads as already selected.

The panel places itself: it opens below the trigger, aligned to its start, and flips to the other side when there is no room — `placement` and `alignment` select among above/below/start/end and start/center/end. The width matches the trigger up to a 320px cap, or follows `menuWidth` (a length, or an intrinsic keyword such as `max-content`). The height is capped at 300px and scrolls past that; `menuMaxHeight` raises the cap in pixels for a menu that must fit all of its rows.

Use a two-way binding on the open state when something outside the menu drives it. A menu that is mounted already open does not move focus — nobody asked for that open, and pulling focus out of the page loses the user's place.

A checkbox row toggles one view setting. Activating it flips the state and leaves the menu open, so several settings can change in one visit. Radio rows belong in a radio group, and only one of them can be selected. Choosing one closes the menu, because the choice is made. Arrow keys still move across these rows, and Space or Enter toggles the highlighted one. A disabled row stays in the menu, but the arrows skip it and a click does not change it. The check mark and the radio dot are decorative; the whole row is the control. On a coarse pointer the mark moves to the end of the row.

Content that is not an option can sit above or below the rows: a filter field, or a button that creates something. It is drawn in the same frame and is not part of the menu. Typing there does not jump to a row by its first letter. The menu itself is one tab stop in that frame. Shift+Tab from a row skips the menu element and lands on the last focusable control above it. Tab onward from the last control below, or Shift+Tab from the first control above, closes the menu. A pointer open does not paint a focus ring on the menu; the ring appears once keyboard focus later tabs onto it.

A submenu flies out beside its row on a wide screen. On a compact touch surface the next level replaces the current rows and adds a Back row at the top, named after the parent. That choice is made when the menu opens and does not change while it stays open. A submenu can also be forced to always fly out, or always replace the rows. While its children are still loading, the caret can become a spinner, and the submenu can still be opened. A flyout is at least about 160 pixels wide unless a width is set, and it never grows past the viewport.
usage.zh:
`DropdownMenu` 把一个按钮变成一组操作的入口。按钮本身很轻，真正的菜单在点击后才出现，浮在触发按钮旁边，选完一项就收起，焦点回到按钮上。它适合放“下一步要做什么”——重命名、复制、归档、删除这类只有一层的动作。

最小用法只需要一个 `items` 数组，每一项就是一条动作：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DropdownMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu
    :button="{ label: '操作' }"
    :items="[
      { label: '编辑项目', icon: 'i-carbon-tools', onClick: () => edit() },
      { label: '复制项目', icon: 'i-carbon-copy', onClick: () => duplicate() },
      { label: '删除项目', icon: 'i-carbon-trash-can', variant: 'destructive', onClick: () => remove() },
    ]"
  />
</template>
```

数组里可以放动作、分隔线、带标题的分组，也可以放勾选行和单选组。动作行写出要做的事；勾选行带着当前是否选中；单选组带着当前选中的值，里面再列各个选项。这几类行也有各自的页面：[下拉菜单勾选项](/components/dropdown-menu-checkbox-item)、[下拉菜单单选组](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group)、[下拉菜单单选项](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-item)。菜单要跟着页面状态变，或者想自己排版时，改用默认插槽写对应的行组件，两种写法画出来的结构一致。自己写行时，把内置图标放进图标插槽并传入图标名；数据数组里则传入一个图标组件，或一个 CSS 图标类。

触发按钮默认由设计系统的 `Button` 渲染，通过 `button` 传入它的属性（`variant`、`size`、`isIconOnly` 等）；`size` 会同时决定菜单行的高度，所以 `size="sm"` 的按钮配一组紧凑的菜单行。当触发按钮不是普通按钮时——比如一个纯图标按钮、一个头像、列表里的一行——改用 `trigger` 插槽，并把插槽给出的属性整个 `v-bind` 到自己的控件上，菜单就会挂在这个控件旁边，并用它的名字作为无障碍名称。

```vue
<template>
  <DropdownMenu>
    <template #trigger="triggerProps">
      <IconButton v-bind="triggerProps" icon="i-carbon-overflow-menu-horizontal" label="更多操作" />
    </template>

    <DropdownMenuItem icon="i-carbon-tools" label="编辑项目" @click="edit" />
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
```

打开之后，菜单接管键盘：上下方向键在动作之间移动并循环，`Home` 和 `End` 跳到首尾，`PageUp`/`PageDown` 翻一屏，直接键入字母会跳到以该字母开头的下一行（连续按同一个字母会在多个匹配项之间轮换），`Enter` 和空格执行当前这一行，`Escape` 或点击菜单外部收起菜单并把焦点还给触发按钮，`Tab` 也会收起菜单，然后按浏览器的顺序继续往后走。鼠标划过某一行时焦点会跟到那一行，所以键盘高亮和鼠标高亮永远是同一个，不会同时亮两行。

用键盘打开和用鼠标打开有一个区别：键盘打开会把焦点放在第一行（按 `ArrowUp` 打开则放在最后一行），鼠标打开只把焦点放在菜单本身，不预选任何一行——否则用户会以为那一行已经被选中了。

弹层会自己找位置：默认开在触发按钮下方左对齐，空间不够时翻到上方；`placement` 和 `alignment` 可以改成上/下/左/右和起点/居中/终点。菜单宽度默认与触发按钮齐平并封顶在 320px，`menuWidth` 可以给定宽度或 `max-content` 之类的关键字宽度；高度默认封顶 300px，超出就滚动，`menuMaxHeight` 可以按像素把上限抬高到刚好放下所有行。

需要外部控制开关时用双向绑定菜单的展开状态。菜单在挂载时就处于打开状态的话，不会抢走焦点——这不是用户要求的打开动作，把焦点从页面里拽走会让人丢失位置。

勾选行用来开关一项视图设置。点一下只翻转状态，菜单保持打开，方便连续改好几项。单选行必须放在单选组里，一组里一次只能选中一个；选完菜单收起，因为这次选择已经确定。方向键仍然在这些行之间移动，空格和回车会切换当前这一行。禁用的行留在菜单里，方向键会跳过它，点击也不会改变状态。勾选标记和单选圆点只是装饰，整行才是可操作的控件。粗指针设备上，标记会挪到行的末尾。

菜单上方和下方可以放不属于选项的内容，比如一个筛选框，或一个新建按钮。它们画在同一个框里，但不算菜单项：在里面打字不会按字母跳行。菜单本身是这一段里的一个 Tab 停靠点。从某一行按 Shift+Tab，会跳过菜单元素，落到上方最后一个可聚焦控件；从下方最后一个控件继续往后 Tab，或从上方第一个控件往前 Tab，菜单就会收起。用指针打开时，菜单上不会先画出焦点环；之后用键盘 Tab 到菜单上，焦点环才出现。

子菜单在宽屏上向旁边展开。在紧凑的触控界面上，同一级内容会换掉当前菜单里的行，并在顶部给出返回，返回文案会带上父级的名字。这个选择在菜单打开时定下来，打开期间不会再变。也可以强制始终旁边展开，或强制始终在原处替换。子菜单的行还在加载时，行尾的箭头可以换成转圈，菜单仍然能打开。飞出的面板默认至少大约 160 像素宽，也可以单独指定宽度，并且不会超出视口。

en.text: Write row labels as short verb phrases, so one glance tells the user what the row does.
Use groups and dividers to cluster related actions once a menu grows past five or six rows.
Mark dangerous rows with `variant="destructive"` and keep them near the bottom of the menu.
Put a shortcut hint in the `endContent` slot, usually a `Kbd`, instead of spelling the keys into the label.
Use checkbox rows for view toggles and leave the menu open. Use a radio group for one choice among several, and let it close.
Put a filter or a create action above or below the rows, not inside the list of options.
Spread the whole trigger-slot object onto a custom control. Taking only part of it drops the expanded state or the control relationship, and a screen reader then cannot tell whether the menu is open.
Use a dropdown menu for navigation. A menu performs an action; navigation belongs to a navigation component.
Put a dozen rows in one menu without grouping them. Nobody finds anything, and the later options go unread.
Use the menu as a form. Anything that needs typing or multiple choices belongs in a dialog or a dedicated control.

zh.text: 用动词开头的短句写动作名，让用户扫一眼就知道每一项会做什么。
动作超过五六项时用分组和分隔线把它们分簇，一簇里放同一类事情。
危险的动作用 `variant="destructive"` 标成错误色，并且放在菜单更靠下的位置。
需要提示快捷键时，把提示放进 `endContent` 插槽（通常是一个 `Kbd`），不要拼进 `label` 文本里。
视图开关用勾选行，并让菜单保持打开；互斥的一项选择用单选组，选完即收起。
筛选和新建这类不属于选项的控件放在菜单上方或下方，不要塞进行列里。
触发控件不是普通按钮时用触发器插槽，并把插槽给出的属性整份绑到控件上；只取其中一部分会让展开状态或控制关系丢掉，屏幕阅读器就不知道菜单开没开。
用下拉菜单做页面导航。菜单是“做一件事”，导航该用导航组件。
在同一个菜单里塞十几项而不分组。用户找不到东西，也会漏看后面的选项。
把菜单当作表单。需要输入或选择多项时，用对话框或专门的表单控件。

rows.name: `button`
rows.description: Props for the trigger button — every `Button` prop except `clickAction`, which would compete with the menu for the same click. `size` also sets the height of the menu rows.

rows.name: `items`
rows.description: Data-mode menu content. Each entry is an action, a divider, a titled group, a checkbox row (`type: 'checkbox'`, with `checked` and `onChange`), or a radio group (`type: 'radio'`, with `value`, `label`, `items`, and `onChange`). Mutually exclusive with the default slot; `items` wins when both are given.

rows.name: `isMenuOpen`
rows.description: Controlled open state, paired with `v-model:is-menu-open`. Left out, the menu manages its own state. A menu mounted already open does not move focus.

rows.name: `menuWidth`
rows.description: Minimum width of the menu. A length grows for its content; an intrinsic keyword such as `max-content` becomes the preferred width. Every form is capped to the viewport. Defaults to the trigger's width, capped at 320px.

rows.name: `menuMaxHeight`
rows.description: Maximum height in pixels, for a menu that must fit all of its rows. This lifts the default 300px cap; the viewport still bounds the real height.

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: Where the menu opens relative to the trigger. It flips to the opposite side when there is no room.

rows.name: `alignment`
rows.description: How the menu aligns with the trigger along the placement axis.

rows.name: `hasChevron`
rows.description: Whether the trigger button shows a trailing chevron. An icon-only button never shows it.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Primary text of the row. Use the `label` slot for rich content.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Secondary line below the label. Use the `description` slot for rich content.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon before the label: a CSS icon class (an UnoCSS class such as `i-carbon-copy`, or one of your own), or a component that draws the SVG. astryx-vue ships no icons. Use the `icon` slot for arbitrary content.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables the row. A disabled row is skipped by the arrow keys and by typeahead, and it does not respond to clicks.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Visual variant. `destructive` recolors the label, description, and icon in the error color for dangerous actions such as Delete. The hover highlight stays the shared neutral, so it still matches every other row.

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: Whether activating the row closes the menu. Set it to `false` for an action that reports its result on the row itself, such as a copy row.

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: Address the row navigates to. The row then renders as one anchor carrying `role="menuitem"`, so a ⌘/Ctrl-click and a middle click keep the browser's meaning.

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: Link target. Only used with `href`.

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: Link relationship. Only used with `href`. `noopener` and `noreferrer` are added for `target="_blank"`.

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: Called when the row is activated. On a link row it runs before the browser navigates, and it is skipped for a modified click, which the browser owns.

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: Heading shown above the group's rows and used as the group's accessible name. Omit it for an unnamed group.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: Whether the row is checked. Pair it with `v-model`. The data array uses `checked` instead.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Primary text. Use the `label` slot for rich content.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Secondary line under the label.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon before the label: a CSS icon class, or a component that draws one. Use the `icon` slot for anything else. The examples use the built-in icon component.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables the row. It stays in the accessibility tree, the arrows skip it, and a click does not toggle it.

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: Whether toggling closes the menu. Checkbox rows stay open.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: The selected value. Pair it with `v-model`. Leave it unset when nothing is selected yet. The data array uses `value` as well.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the group, so the options are announced as one set.

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: Whether choosing a value closes the menu. A radio group closes.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: The value this option represents. The item must sit inside a radio group; otherwise it throws while it is set up.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Primary text.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Secondary line under the label.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon before the label. Use the `icon` slot for anything else.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables this option. It stays in the group and cannot be selected.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: The row's text, and the parent name used by the Back row of the next level.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Secondary line under the label.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon before the label.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: The row cannot open the next level.

rows.name: `hasSpinner`
rows.description: Replaces the caret with a spinner while the next level is loading. The spinner is decorative and does not block opening.

rows.name: `menuWidth`
rows.description: Width of the flyout. A number is pixels, used as a minimum and capped to the viewport. An intrinsic keyword becomes the preferred width. Unused while drilled in.

rows.name: `presentation`
rows.description: How the next level appears: beside the row, in place of the current rows, or chosen when the menu opens from whether the surface is a compact touch screen.

rows.name: `button`
rows.description: 触发按钮的属性，等同于 `Button` 的属性（其中 `clickAction` 除外，避免和菜单抢同一次点击）。`size` 会同时决定菜单行的高度。

rows.name: `items`
rows.description: 数据式菜单内容。每条可以是一条动作、一条分隔线、一个分组、一条勾选行（`type: 'checkbox'`，用 `checked` 和 `onChange`），或一组单选（`type: 'radio'`，用 `value`、`label`、`items` 和 `onChange`）。与默认插槽互斥，同时给出时以 `items` 为准。

rows.name: `isMenuOpen`
rows.description: 受控的展开状态，配 `v-model:is-menu-open` 使用。留空时菜单自己管理开关。挂载时即为 `true` 不会移动焦点。

rows.name: `menuWidth`
rows.description: 菜单的最小宽度。长度值可以随内容变宽；`max-content` 之类的固有尺寸关键字则作为首选宽度。所有写法都会受视口限制。留空时与触发按钮齐平，并封顶在 320px。

rows.name: `menuMaxHeight`
rows.description: 菜单的最大高度，单位为像素，用于必须放下所有行的菜单。它会抬高默认的 300px 上限，但视口仍然限住实际高度。

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: 菜单相对触发按钮的位置。空间不足时自动翻到相反方向。

rows.name: `alignment`
rows.description: 菜单沿位置方向与触发按钮的对齐方式。

rows.name: `hasChevron`
rows.description: 是否在触发按钮尾部显示箭头。纯图标按钮不会显示。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 行内的主要文字。需要富文本时改用 `label` 插槽。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 标签下方的次要说明文字。需要富文本时改用 `description` 插槽。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 标签前的图标：一个 CSS 图标类（例如 UnoCSS 的 `i-carbon-copy`，也可以是你自己的类名），或一个绘制 SVG 的组件。astryx-vue 不自带图标。想放任意内容时改用 `icon` 插槽。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用这一行。禁用的行会被方向键和字母跳转跳过，并且不响应点击。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 视觉变体。`destructive` 会把标签、说明和图标一起换成错误色，用于删除这类危险动作。悬停底色仍是共用的中性色，与其他行一致。

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: 激活这一行后是否收起菜单。像“复制”这种在行内回报结果的动作可以设为 `false`。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 这一行要跳转的地址。给出后整行就是一个带 `role="menuitem"` 的链接，所以 ⌘/Ctrl 点击和中键点击仍然保持浏览器原本的含义。

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: 链接的打开方式，仅在给出 `href` 时使用。

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: 链接关系，仅在给出 `href` 时使用。`target="_blank"` 时会自动加上 `noopener` 和 `noreferrer`。

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: 激活这一行时调用。链接行会在浏览器跳转前调用；带修饰键的点击交给浏览器处理，不调用它。

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: 分组上方的标题，同时作为这一组的无障碍名称。留空时分组没有名字。

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: 是否选中，配合 `v-model` 使用。数据数组里对应字段是 `checked`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 行内的主要文字。需要富文本时改用 `label` 插槽。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 标签下方的次要说明。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 标签前的图标：一个 CSS 图标类，或一个绘制图标的组件。任意内容改用 `icon` 插槽，文档示例使用内置图标组件。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用这一行。行仍留在无障碍树里，方向键会跳过它，点击不会切换。

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: 切换后是否收起菜单。勾选行默认保持打开。

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: 当前选中的值，配合 `v-model` 使用。留空表示还没有选中。数据数组里字段名同样是 `value`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 这一组的无障碍名称。选项会作为同一组被朗读。

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: 选中一项后是否收起菜单。单选默认收起。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: 这个选项代表的值。必须放在单选组里面，否则组件会在初始化时抛出错误。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 行内的主要文字。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 标签下方的次要说明。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 标签前的图标。任意内容改用 `icon` 插槽。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用这个选项。它仍留在组里，但不能被选中。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 这一行的文字，也是下一级返回按钮里提到的父级名字。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 标签下方的次要说明。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 标签前的图标。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 禁用后这一行不能打开下一级。

rows.name: `hasSpinner`
rows.description: 用转圈代替行尾箭头，表示下一级还在加载。转圈是装饰，不阻止打开。

rows.name: `menuWidth`
rows.description: 飞出面板的宽度。数字按像素处理，作为最小宽度并限制在视口内。固有尺寸关键字则作为首选宽度。钻入时不使用。

rows.name: `presentation`
rows.description: 下一级怎么出现。旁边飞出、在原菜单里替换当前行，或在菜单打开时按是否为紧凑触控界面决定。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Menu content written by hand: action rows, checkbox rows, radio groups, groups, dividers, and submenus. Mutually exclusive with `items`.

rows.name: `trigger`
rows.description: A custom control for the trigger. The slot props carry `id`, `aria-haspopup`, `aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`, `onClick` and `onKeyDown`; spread all of them onto the control.

rows.name: `icon` (`DropdownMenuItem`)
rows.description: Arbitrary leading content, replacing the `icon` prop.

rows.name: `label` / `description` (`DropdownMenuItem`)
rows.description: Rich content replacing the prop of the same name.

rows.name: `endContent` (`DropdownMenuItem`)
rows.description: Trailing content, such as a `Kbd` shortcut hint.

rows.name: `title` / `default` (`DropdownMenuGroup`)
rows.description: A rich heading for the group, and the group's rows.

rows.name: `header`
rows.description: Content above the rows and outside the menu, such as a filter. Typing there does not move by letter.

rows.name: `footer`
rows.description: Content below the rows and outside the menu, such as a create button.

rows.name: `icon` / `label` / `description` / `endContent` (checkbox and radio rows)
rows.description: The same rich-content positions as an action row. The check mark and radio dot are drawn by the row and do not use these slots.

rows.name: `default` (radio group, submenu)
rows.description: Radio options inside a group, or the next level's rows inside a submenu.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 自己写菜单内容时使用，包括动作行、勾选行、单选组、分组、分隔线和子菜单。与 `items` 互斥。

rows.name: `trigger`
rows.description: 自定义触发控件时使用。插槽参数包含 `id`、`aria-haspopup`、`aria-expanded`、`aria-controls`、`onClick` 和 `onKeyDown`，请整份 `v-bind` 到控件上。

rows.name: `icon`（`DropdownMenuItem`）
rows.description: 代替 `icon` 属性的任意起始内容。

rows.name: `label` / `description`（`DropdownMenuItem`）
rows.description: 代替同名属性的富文本内容。

rows.name: `endContent`（`DropdownMenuItem`）
rows.description: 行尾内容，例如一个 `Kbd` 快捷键提示。

rows.name: `title` / `default`（`DropdownMenuGroup`）
rows.description: 分组的富文本标题，以及组内的行。

rows.name: `header`
rows.description: 菜单上方、选项之外的内容，例如筛选框。不参与字母跳转。

rows.name: `footer`
rows.description: 菜单下方、选项之外的内容，例如新建按钮。

rows.name: `icon` / `label` / `description` / `endContent`（勾选行、单选行）
rows.description: 与动作行相同的富文本位置。勾选标记和单选圆点由组件自己绘制，不占用这些插槽。

rows.name: `default`（单选组、子菜单）
rows.description: 单选组里放单选项；子菜单里放下一级的行。

rows.name: `update:isMenuOpen`
rows.description: The open state changed; drives `v-model:is-menu-open`.

rows.name: `openChange`
rows.description: Fired together with `update:isMenuOpen` when the open state changes.

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: Fired when the trigger is activated, for both opening and closing.

rows.name: `click` (`DropdownMenuItem`)
rows.description: Fired when the row is activated.

rows.name: `update:modelValue` / `change` (checkbox row, radio group)
rows.description: The selection changed. A checkbox row reports the next boolean; a radio group reports the next string. `v-model` listens to `update:modelValue`.

rows.name: `openChange` (`DropdownMenuSubMenu`)
rows.description: Fired when the flyout or the drilled view opens or closes.

rows.name: `update:isMenuOpen`
rows.description: 展开状态发生变化，配合 `v-model:is-menu-open` 使用。

rows.name: `openChange`
rows.description: 展开状态发生变化时触发，与 `update:isMenuOpen` 同时发出。

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: 触发按钮被激活时触发（打开和收起都会触发）。

rows.name: `click`（`DropdownMenuItem`）
rows.description: 这一行被激活时触发。

rows.name: `update:modelValue` / `change`（勾选行、单选组）
rows.description: 选中状态变化。勾选行给出下一个布尔值，单选组给出下一个字符串。双向绑定听的是 `update:modelValue`。

rows.name: `openChange`（`DropdownMenuSubMenu`）
rows.description: 飞出面板或钻入视图打开、关闭时触发。

en.heading: DropdownMenuGroup
en.text: `DropdownMenuDivider` takes no props. It renders a separator, so it is never a stop in the arrow-key order.

en.heading: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
en.text: The row's role is menuitemcheckbox, and the checked state is aria-checked. The mark is decorative and does not take the click.

en.heading: DropdownMenuRadioItem
en.text: The row's role is menuitemradio.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: Apart from the props above, native attributes fall through to the menu panel element: - HTML and data-* attributes. - aria-* attributes. - class and style. The panel carries a generated id that the trigger's aria-controls points at. Passing id explicitly replaces both that generated id and the value of aria-controls, so the two cannot drift apart. Passing aria-label or aria-labelledby overrides the menu's default name, which comes from the trigger button's label, or from the control itself when the trigger slot is used. The trigger button carries aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls. It sits inside a span.astryx-dropdown-menu-trigger that anchors the panel.

zh.heading: DropdownMenuGroup
zh.text: `DropdownMenuDivider` 没有属性，它渲染一条分隔线，因此永远不会成为方向键的一站。

zh.heading: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
zh.text: 行的角色是 menuitemcheckbox，选中状态写在 aria-checked 上。勾选标记是装饰，不单独接收点击。

zh.heading: DropdownMenuRadioItem
zh.text: 行的角色是 menuitemradio。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text: 除下表列出的属性外，其余原生属性会落到菜单浮层元素上： - HTML 属性、data-* 属性。 - aria-* 属性。 - class、style。 菜单元素默认带一个生成的 id，触发按钮的 aria-controls 指向它。显式传入 id 会同时替换这个生成的 id 和 aria-controls 的值，两者不会脱节。传入 aria-label 或 aria-labelledby 会覆盖菜单默认的名称（默认取自触发按钮的文字，自定义触发控件时则指向控件自身）。 触发按钮上会带上 aria-haspopup="menu"、aria-expanded 和 aria-controls；触发按钮外层是一个用于定位的 span.astryx-dropdown-menu-trigger。

en.title: Header and footer
en.description: The filter sits above the rows and the create button sits below. Typing in the filter narrows the labels and does not jump to a row.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const query = ref('')
const labels = ref(['Bug', 'Design', 'Docs'])

const visible = computed(() => labels.value.filter(label => label.toLowerCase().includes(query.value.trim().toLowerCase())))

function createLabel(): void {
  const name = query.value.trim()
  if (name === '' || labels.value.includes(name))
    return
  labels.value = [...labels.value, name]
  query.value = ''
}
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :button="{ label: 'Labels' }" menu-width="240px">
    <template #header>
      <TextInput v-model="query" label="Filter labels" placeholder="Filter" size="sm" />
    </template>
    <DropdownMenuItem v-for="label in visible" :key="label" :label="label">
      <template #icon>
        <Icon name="carbon:tag" />
      </template>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem v-if="visible.length === 0" is-disabled label="No matches" />
    <template #footer>
      <Button label="Create label" variant="ghost" @click="createLabel">
        <template #icon>
          <Icon name="carbon:add" />
        </template>
      </Button>
    </template>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>

zh.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const query = ref('')
const labels = ref(['Bug', 'Design', 'Docs'])

const visible = computed(() => labels.value.filter(label => label.toLowerCase().includes(query.value.trim().toLowerCase())))

function createLabel(): void {
  const name = query.value.trim()
  if (name === '' || labels.value.includes(name))
    return
  labels.value = [...labels.value, name]
  query.value = ''
}
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :button="{ label: 'Labels' }" menu-width="240px">
    <template #header>
      <TextInput v-model="query" label="Filter labels" placeholder="Filter" size="sm" />
    </template>
    <DropdownMenuItem v-for="label in visible" :key="label" :label="label">
      <template #icon>
        <Icon name="carbon:tag" />
      </template>
    </DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem v-if="visible.length === 0" is-disabled label="No matches" />
    <template #footer>
      <Button label="Create label" variant="ghost" @click="createLabel">
        <template #icon>
          <Icon name="carbon:add" />
        </template>
      </Button>
    </template>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>

summary.en: `IconButton` displays one icon. The icon must clearly identify the action. Set `label` to provide an accessible name:
summary.zh: `IconButton` 是一个只含图标的方形按钮，适合工具栏、列表操作等空间紧凑、含义明确的场景。由于按钮没有可见文字，必须通过 `label` 提供无障碍名称，辅助技术才能识别它的用途：

usage.en:
`IconButton` displays one icon. The icon must clearly identify the action. Set `label` to provide an accessible name:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { IconButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'
</script>

<template>
  <IconButton label="Search">
    <Icon name="carbon:search" />
  </IconButton>
</template>
```

[Icon](/en/components/icon) fills the square the button already sizes. Leave `size` unset. A CSS icon class still works in the slot when your build generates it; UnoCSS is not required.

Use a text-bearing [Button](/en/components/button) when the action is not immediately clear.
usage.zh:
`IconButton` 是一个只含图标的方形按钮，适合工具栏、列表操作等空间紧凑、含义明确的场景。由于按钮没有可见文字，必须通过 `label` 提供无障碍名称，辅助技术才能识别它的用途：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { IconButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'
</script>

<template>
  <IconButton label="搜索">
    <Icon name="carbon:search" />
  </IconButton>
</template>
```

[Icon](/components/icon) 会铺满按钮已经定好的方框，不要再设 `size`。构建里已经会生成的 CSS 图标类仍然可以放进这个槽，不必为此安装 UnoCSS。

如果操作的含义无法凭图标一眼看出，请改用带文字的 [Button](/components/button)。

en.text: Make the aria-label specific: a trash icon labeled "Delete conversation" is clearer than just "Delete" for screen readers.
Add a tooltip: even a gear icon can mean Settings, Preferences, or Configure.
Use ghost in toolbars and dense areas to reduce visual clutter.
Use IconButton if the action isn't obvious from the icon alone; use Button with text.
Skip the tooltip; label only reaches screen readers, sighted users need the hover hint.

zh.text: 让 `label` 尽量具体：标有 “Delete conversation” 的垃圾桶图标，比只写 “Delete” 更便于屏幕阅读器用户理解按钮的作用。
为按钮加上提示框。即便是常见的齿轮图标，在不同产品中也可能表示 Settings、Preferences 或 Configure，悬停提示能减少用户的猜测。
在工具栏和紧凑区域使用 ghost 变体，视觉重量更轻，不会干扰旁边的正文内容。
避免在操作含义不直观时仍然只放图标：用户看不出按钮能做什么，这类操作应改用带文字的 Button。
避免省略提示框：`label` 只供屏幕阅读器使用，普通用户还需要悬停或键盘聚焦时的文字提示。

en.heading: IconButton Props
en.text: IconButton inherits most Button props but does not expose isIconOnly, because it is always icon-only. These props are also inherited. See [Button props](/en/components/button/props) for their definitions. - `type`. - `name`. - `value`. - `form`. - `loadingLabel`. - `as`. - `target`. - `rel`.

en.heading: Slot
en.text:
- The default slot is required.
- The default slot must contain one icon that represents the action.
- `IconButton` does not display text.
- `IconButton` does not provide an `end` slot.

:::warning Accessible name
Provide an accurate `label`. Without it, assistive technology cannot identify the button's purpose.

`tooltip` provides additional information. Do not use it instead of `label`.

en.heading: Events
en.text: The `click` event passes a `MouseEvent`.

en.heading: Template ref
en.text:
`IconButton` exposes `element`.
Its type is `HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLElement | null`.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

zh.heading: IconButton Props
zh.text: IconButton 继承 Button 的大部分属性，但不提供 isIconOnly，因为它始终是纯图标模式。 其他继承属性如下。完整说明见 [Button 属性](/components/button/props)。 - `type`。 - `name`。 - `value`。 - `form`。 - `loadingLabel`。 - `as`。 - `target`。 - `rel`。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽为必需项。
- 默认插槽必须提供一个表示操作的图标。
- `IconButton` 不提供可见文字。
- `IconButton` 不提供 `end` 插槽。

:::warning 无障碍名称
必须提供准确的 `label`。缺少 `label` 时，辅助技术无法确定按钮用途。

`tooltip` 提供补充说明。不得用 `tooltip` 代替 `label`。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: `click` 事件的参数类型为 `MouseEvent`。

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
`IconButton` 公开 `element`。
类型为 `HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLElement | null`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

en.title: Loading state
en.description: Icon buttons that show a loading spinner on click for async feedback.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { IconButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const loadingId = ref<string | null>(null)

function handleClick(id: string) {
  loadingId.value = id
  setTimeout(() => {
    loadingId.value = null
  }, 1500)
}
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="2">
    <IconButton label="Copy" variant="primary" :is-loading="loadingId === 'copy'" @click="handleClick('copy')">
      <Icon icon="i-heroicons-document-duplicate" color="inherit" />
    </IconButton>
    <IconButton label="Search" :is-loading="loadingId === 'search'" @click="handleClick('search')">
      <Icon icon="i-heroicons-magnifying-glass" color="inherit" />
    </IconButton>
    <IconButton label="Close" variant="ghost" :is-loading="loadingId === 'close'" @click="handleClick('close')">
      <Icon icon="i-heroicons-x-mark" color="inherit" />
    </IconButton>
  </HStack>
</template>

usage.en:
`Link` navigates inside the app or out of it. With `href` it renders an anchor. Pass `as` to use a router link or another component; that component receives both `href` and `to`. Without `href` it renders a button. A disabled link stays a plain anchor and does not use the custom root. `size` and `weight` follow the same steps as body text, and `maxLines` limits how many lines stay visible.

Import the component from its dedicated entry. Structural styles are loaded automatically.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Link } from '@astryx-vue/core/Link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link href="/docs">
    Documentation
  </Link>
  <Link href="https://github.com" is-external-link>
    GitHub
  </Link>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Link` 用于在应用内部或外部之间建立导航。有 `href` 时默认渲染为 `<a>`，也可以用 `as` 换成路由链接或其他组件，组件会同时收到 `href` 和 `to`。没有 `href` 时降级为 `<button>`。禁用后仍是普通锚点，不再使用自定义根。`size` 和 `weight` 跟正文同一套字号和字重，`maxLines` 限制可见行数。从独立入口导入后，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Link } from '@astryx-vue/core/Link'
</script>

<template>
  <Link href="/docs">
    文档
  </Link>
  <Link href="https://github.com" is-external-link>
    GitHub
  </Link>
</template>
```

en.text: Use link text that describes the destination, e.g. "View docs" or "Contact us". Avoid "click here".
Use `isExternalLink` for off-site links to add `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
Use `color="secondary"` to reduce visual weight in groups of links or paragraphs.
Make every piece of text a link; it weakens link discoverability.
Make a critical action only a link. Important actions should use Button.

zh.text: 链接文字应直接描述目标，例如“查看文档”“联系我们”，避免使用“点击这里”这类含糊表达。
跳转到站外的链接使用 `isExternalLink`，组件会自动添加 `target="_blank"` 和 `rel="noopener noreferrer"`，并给出外部标识。
在一组链接或长段落中，使用 `color="secondary"` 降低视觉噪音，让真正的重点操作更突出。
避免把页面上的大量文字都做成链接：过多的下划线或强调色会削弱链接本身的可发现性。
避免把关键操作只做成链接。保存、删除、提交等核心操作应使用 `Button`，让用户明确感知这是一个动作。
