summary.en: `MoreMenu` is an overflow menu behind a `⋯` trigger. It holds the actions that do not need to stay visible: secondary actions in a table row, a card header, or a toolbar. The trigger is an icon-only button; everything it offers lives in the menu it opens.
summary.zh: `MoreMenu` 是一个以 `⋯` 图标为触发器的溢出菜单，用来收纳那些不需要一直显示的操作：表格行、卡片标题、工具栏的次要动作。触发器本身只是一个纯图标按钮，动作都在它展开的菜单里。

usage.en:
`MoreMenu` is an overflow menu behind a `⋯` trigger. It holds the actions that do not need to stay visible: secondary actions in a table row, a card header, or a toolbar. The trigger is an icon-only button; everything it offers lives in the menu it opens.

The menu's content is described by an `items` array. A plain entry is one action, `type: 'divider'` is a hairline between groups, and `type: 'section'` is a titled group:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MoreMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/MoreMenu'

const items = [
  { label: 'Rename', onClick: () => rename() },
  { label: 'Duplicate', onClick: () => duplicate() },
  { type: 'divider' },
  { label: 'Move to trash', variant: 'destructive', onClick: () => remove() },
]
</script>

<template>
  <MoreMenu :items="items" label="File actions" />
</template>
```

The trigger is icon-only, so `label` is its accessible name, the name of the menu itself, and the text of its tooltip. The default, `More options`, fits most interfaces; when the menu holds the actions of one specific thing, a more concrete phrase such as "Project actions" reads better. Use the `icon` slot to replace the three-dot artwork.

Where focus lands when the menu opens depends on how it was opened. A keyboard open (`Enter`, `Space`, `ArrowDown`, or `ArrowUp` on the trigger) lands on the first or the last row; a pointer open puts focus on the menu container and pre-highlights nothing, so no row reads as already selected. Once open, `ArrowDown` and `ArrowUp` move between rows and wrap at both ends, `Home` and `End` jump to the ends, typing a letter jumps to the next row starting with it, `Enter` and `Space` run the focused row, `Escape` closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger, and `Tab` closes the menu and lets the browser move on from the trigger. Disabled rows are skipped and stay out of the keyboard path.

Mouse and touch behave differently on purpose. With a mouse, the highlight follows the pointer while it is held and the release decides which row acts; releasing outside the menu dismisses it. With a finger, a release off the menu leaves it open, because the highlight is following the finger — the gesture ends when a row is picked, the trigger is tapped, or `Escape` is pressed. The `placement` and `alignment` props place the anchored menu beside the trigger and flip it when there is no room; an overflow menu usually wants `alignment="end"`, so the menu lines up with the trigger's trailing edge.

`presentation` decides the shape the actions arrive in. `popover` (the default) is the anchored surface; `bottom-sheet` is a modal panel at the bottom of the screen, sized for a thumb; `adaptive` keeps the anchored menu on pointer-driven layouts and uses the bottom panel at 768px and below when the primary pointer is coarse. Inside the bottom panel a submenu does not open a second panel: the view is replaced, its title becomes the submenu's own label, a back button appears, and `Escape` leaves the submenu before it closes the panel.

The open state can belong to the component or to you. Pass `isMenuOpen` to control it, usually with `v-model:isMenuOpen`; `openChange` fires every time an open or close is requested.
usage.zh:
`MoreMenu` 是一个以 `⋯` 图标为触发器的溢出菜单，用来收纳那些不需要一直显示的操作：表格行、卡片标题、工具栏的次要动作。触发器本身只是一个纯图标按钮，动作都在它展开的菜单里。

菜单的内容由 `items` 数组描述。普通项就是一次操作，`type: 'divider'` 是一条分隔线，`type: 'section'` 是一个带标题的分组：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MoreMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/MoreMenu'

const items = [
  { label: 'Rename', onClick: () => rename() },
  { label: 'Duplicate', onClick: () => duplicate() },
  { type: 'divider' },
  { label: 'Move to trash', variant: 'destructive', onClick: () => remove() },
]
</script>

<template>
  <MoreMenu :items="items" label="File actions" />
</template>
```

触发器只有图标，所以 `label` 就是它的无障碍名称，同时也是菜单本身的名字，以及悬停时的提示文字。默认值 `More options` 在大多数界面里都够用；当菜单里装的是特定对象的操作时，换成更具体的说法（例如“项目操作”）会更好。想换掉三点图标，用 `icon` 插槽。

菜单打开的瞬间，焦点落在哪里取决于你是用什么方式打开的：键盘打开（在触发器上按 `Enter`、`Space`、`ArrowDown`、`ArrowUp`）落在第一项或最后一项上；鼠标点击打开则挂在菜单容器上，不预先高亮任何一行，避免看起来像是已经选中了什么。打开之后 `ArrowDown` 和 `ArrowUp` 在各项之间移动并首尾相接，`Home` 和 `End` 跳到首尾，输入字母会跳转到以该字母开头的下一项，`Enter` 和 `Space` 执行当前项，`Escape` 关闭并把焦点交回触发器，`Tab` 关闭菜单后让浏览器继续往后移动焦点。禁用项会被跳过，也不会进入键盘路径。

鼠标的按下与抬起是被区分的：按住鼠标时高亮跟着指针走，抬起的落点决定执行哪一项；如果抬起时指针在菜单之外，菜单就关闭。触摸设备上的行为不同——手指松开不会关闭菜单，因为高亮正在跟着手指移动，只有点中某一项、点中触发器或按下 `Escape` 才算结束。点开菜单时用的如果是鼠标，菜单与触发器之间的距离和方向由 `placement` 与 `alignment` 决定，空间不足时会自动翻到另一侧；溢出菜单通常希望 `alignment="end"`，让菜单和触发器的尾部对齐。

`presentation` 决定动作以什么形态出现：`popover`（默认）是锚定在触发器旁边的浮层；`bottom-sheet` 是从底部弹出的模态面板，适合手指操作；`adaptive` 在“主指针为粗略指针且宽度不超过 768px”时用底部面板，其余情况用浮层。底部面板里子菜单不是飞出的小面板，而是就地换一个视图，面板中间的标题会跟着变成该子菜单的名字，左上角出现返回按钮，`Escape` 先退出子菜单再关闭整个面板。

打开状态既可以由组件自己管理，也可以由你管理。传入 `isMenuOpen` 就进入受控模式，配合 `v-model:isMenuOpen` 使用；`openChange` 在每次请求打开或关闭时触发。

en.text: Keep it for secondary actions. A primary action belongs in the open, where people can see it; hiding it in a menu makes it hard to find.
With many entries, group them with dividers or sections — and keep destructive actions last and marked `variant="destructive"`.
Give similar rows a `description`, so near neighbours such as "Export" and "Publish" can be told apart at a glance.
Use `alignment="end"` when the trigger sits at the end of a table row or toolbar, so the menu lines up with the trigger instead of covering the content.
Use `presentation="adaptive"` for interfaces used mostly on phones, where a thumb reaches the actions on a bottom panel.
Vague names, such as a "More" entry inside a "More" menu. The trigger needs a `label` that says what the menu is for.
Piling a dozen actions into one menu. Past a screenful, the reader has to open, scroll, and pick — worse than showing the actions directly.
Keying data or navigation off whether the menu happens to be open. A menu is a temporary surface; its state belongs in your own data.

zh.text: 只用来收纳次要操作。主要动作应该直接出现在界面上，藏进菜单会让人找不到。
项目多的时候用分隔线或分组整理：破坏性操作单独放在最后，并设为 `variant="destructive"`。
给每行图标都补上 `description`，让“导出”和“发布”这类相近的动作一眼能分清。
触发器位于表格行或工具栏末尾时，用 `alignment="end"` 让菜单与触发器的尾部对齐，避免菜单盖住内容。
移动端为主的界面用 `presentation="adaptive"`，手指能直接够到底部面板上的操作。
把名称写得含糊，例如“更多”里再放一个“更多”。触发器需要一个能说清用途的 `label`。
一次塞进十几个动作。超过一屏时用户要点开、滚动、再挑选，代价已经高于直接把操作摆出来。
依赖菜单是否打开来保存数据或做导航。菜单是一个临时的浮层，状态应写在你的数据里。

rows.name: `items`
rows.description: What the menu holds: actions (`MoreMenuItem`), hairlines (`{ type: 'divider' }`), and groups (`{ type: 'section', title, items }`). Required.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: The trigger's accessible name, which is also the name of the menu itself and the text of its tooltip.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Visual variant of the trigger button: primary, secondary, ghost, or destructive.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Size of the trigger button: sm, md, or lg. The density of every menu row follows it.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Whether the trigger is disabled. A disabled trigger is dimmed, announces itself as disabled, and opens nothing from a click or the keyboard.

rows.name: `placement`
rows.description: Where the anchored surface sits relative to the trigger. The direction is logical: start and end resolve against the menu's own direction, so RTL mirrors them. The surface flips when there is no room.

rows.name: `alignment`
rows.description: Alignment along the placement axis. An overflow menu usually wants end, so the surface lines up with the trigger's trailing edge.

rows.name: `presentation`
rows.description: Shape the actions arrive in. popover anchors the surface to the trigger; bottom-sheet is a modal panel at the bottom of the screen; adaptive uses the bottom panel at 768px and below when the primary pointer is coarse, and the anchored surface otherwise.

rows.name: `isMenuOpen`
rows.description: Controlled open state, meant for `v-model:isMenuOpen`. Leave it unbound to let the component own its state.

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: Renders the surface in place instead of moving it to the top of the document. It then flows with the page and is not positioned against the viewport. Intended for documentation previews and for surfaces that must not escape their container.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: The row's primary text. Required.

rows.name: `id`
rows.description: Stable identity of the row within its level. Omit it and the row is matched by position; set it when `items` can reorder, filter, or grow, so a row keeps its DOM node — and its keyboard focus — as the array changes.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Icon shown before the label: a CSS icon class (an UnoCSS class such as `i-carbon-copy`, or one of your own), or a component that draws the SVG. astryx-vue ships no icons.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: A supporting line below the label, for telling near neighbours apart.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Whether the row is unavailable. A disabled row is dimmed, announces itself as disabled, and is skipped by the arrow keys and by type-ahead.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: destructive paints the label, description, and icon in the error color for dangerous actions such as deletion.

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: Address the row navigates to. With it the row is a real link, so a modified click and a middle click keep their browser meaning, such as opening a new tab.

rows.name: `target`
rows.description: Where the link opens. Only used with `href`.

rows.name: `rel`
rows.description: Link relationship tokens. `noopener noreferrer` is added when `target` is `_blank`.

rows.name: `endContent`
rows.description: Trailing content of the row, such as a shortcut hint.

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: Whether activating the row closes the menu. Set it to false for an action that reports its result on the row itself, such as a copy row that swaps to "Copied".

rows.name: `items`
rows.description: Nested entries. With them the row becomes a submenu entry: it opens a flyout on a pointer layout and shows its own view in the bottom panel.

rows.name: `onClick`
rows.description: The row's action. On a link row it runs before the browser navigates, and is skipped for a modified click, which belongs to the browser.

rows.name: `element`
rows.description: The trigger button element.

rows.name: `focus`
rows.description: Moves focus onto the trigger button.

rows.name: `blur`
rows.description: Removes focus from the trigger button.

rows.name: `items`
rows.description: 菜单内容：动作（`MoreMenuItem`）、分隔线（`{ type: 'divider' }`）和分组（`{ type: 'section', title, items }`）。必填。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 触发按钮的无障碍名称，同时也是菜单本身的名字和悬停时的提示文字。

rows.description: 沿放置轴的对齐方式。溢出菜单通常用 end，让菜单与触发器的尾部边缘对齐。

rows.name: `presentation`
rows.description: 动作的呈现形态。popover 是锚定在触发器旁的浮层；bottom-sheet 是底部的模态面板；adaptive 在主指针为粗略指针且宽度不超过 768px 时使用底部面板，其余情况使用浮层。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: destructive 用错误色绘制文字、说明与图标，用于删除这类危险操作。

rows.name: `href`
rows.description: 这一行跳转的地址。给出后该行是一个真正的链接，因此带修饰键的点击和中键点击保持浏览器原本的含义（例如新标签页打开）。

rows.name: `endContent`

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`
rows.description: 激活这一行后是否关闭菜单。把结果报告在行自身上的操作（例如复制后变成“已复制”）可以设为 false。

rows.name: `items`

rows.name: `element`
rows.description: 触发按钮的 DOM 元素。

rows.name: `focus`

rows.name: `blur`
rows.description: 移除触发按钮上的焦点。

rows.name: `icon`

rows.name: `icon`

rows.name: `openChange`

summary.en: `SegmentedControl` lays a small set of mutually exclusive options out in one row, with exactly one of them selected at all times. It looks like a tab bar but behaves like a radio group: the choice is a value or a mode, not a page. Because every option is visible at once, the user can compare them without opening anything first.
summary.zh: `SegmentedControl` 把少量互斥的选项排成一行，用户始终选中其中的一个。它看起来像标签栏，行为却是单选组：选择的结果是一个值或一种模式，而不是切换页面。因为所有选项都同时可见，用户不必先展开再比较。

usage.en:
`SegmentedControl` lays a small set of mutually exclusive options out in one row, with exactly one of them selected at all times. It looks like a tab bar but behaves like a radio group: the choice is a value or a mode, not a page. Because every option is visible at once, the user can compare them without opening anything first.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/SegmentedControl'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const view = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <SegmentedControl v-model="view" label="Workspace view">
    <SegmentedControlItem label="Overview" value="overview" />
    <SegmentedControlItem label="Activity" value="activity" />
    <SegmentedControlItem label="Members" value="members" />
  </SegmentedControl>
</template>
```

The selection is bound two ways with `v-model`. The control renders as a `role="radiogroup"` container, and `label` goes to `aria-label` — it names the group for screen readers and is never drawn on screen. Each `SegmentedControlItem` renders as a `role="radio"` button whose `aria-checked` reports whether it is the selected one.

Keyboard behavior follows the radio group convention: the left and right arrows move between segments, `Home` and `End` jump to the first and last enabled segment, and movement wraps at the ends. Selection follows focus, so the segment the arrow keys land on becomes the selected one. Only one segment is in the tab order at a time (a roving tabindex), so Tab moves past the whole control instead of stopping on every segment. Disabled segments are skipped by both the arrow keys and the tab order.

`size` offers `sm`, `md`, and `lg`, defaulting to `md`. `layout` defaults to `hug`, where the control and each segment take their content width and never exceed the container: when the container is too narrow the labels truncate with an ellipsis instead of pushing the control past the edge. Switch it to `fill` and the segments share the full width evenly, which suits a narrow card.

`isDisabled` disables the whole control: no segment can be selected and the control leaves the tab order. When you also need to say why, use `disabledMessage` rather than wrapping the control in a `Tooltip` — a disabled control swallows the pointer events an external tooltip needs. With a message the control stays reachable through `aria-disabled`, so both mouse and keyboard users can discover the reason, while selection stays blocked. To disable one segment on its own, set `isDisabled` on that `SegmentedControlItem`.

A segment can show an icon before its label by putting it in the `#icon` slot; the icon follows the size of the control. Set `isLabelHidden` to show the icon alone, and the `label` becomes the segment's `aria-label` so its name is not lost.
usage.zh:
`SegmentedControl` 把少量互斥的选项排成一行，用户始终选中其中的一个。它看起来像标签栏，行为却是单选组：选择的结果是一个值或一种模式，而不是切换页面。因为所有选项都同时可见，用户不必先展开再比较。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SegmentedControl, SegmentedControlItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/SegmentedControl'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const view = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <SegmentedControl v-model="view" label="Workspace view">
    <SegmentedControlItem label="Overview" value="overview" />
    <SegmentedControlItem label="Activity" value="activity" />
    <SegmentedControlItem label="Members" value="members" />
  </SegmentedControl>
</template>
```

选中项通过 `v-model` 双向绑定。控件本身渲染为一个 `role="radiogroup"` 的容器，`label` 会写进 `aria-label`，只在屏幕阅读器中起作用，页面上不会出现可见的组标题。每个 `SegmentedControlItem` 渲染成一个 `role="radio"` 的按钮，`aria-checked` 反映它是否被选中。

键盘操作遵循单选组的惯例：左右方向键在分段之间移动，`Home` 和 `End` 跳到第一个和最后一个可用分段，越界时循环；焦点移动到哪个分段，选中就跟着落到哪个分段。整个控件在同一时刻只有一个 Tab 停靠点（roving tabindex），按 Tab 会直接穿过控件而不是逐个分段停留。禁用的分段会从方向键的行走顺序和 Tab 顺序里被跳过。

`size` 提供 `sm`、`md`、`lg` 三档，默认 `md`。`layout` 默认是 `hug`，控件和每个分段都按内容取宽，并且不会超出所在容器：容器太窄时标签会以省略号截断，而不是把控件挤出边界；改成 `fill` 后，分段会平均分摊整行宽度，适合放在窄卡片里。

`isDisabled` 会禁用整个控件，此时所有分段都不能选择，控件也退出 Tab 顺序。如果还想说明禁用的原因，请使用 `disabledMessage`（而不是把控件包进 Tooltip）：禁用控件会吞掉外部 Tooltip 需要的指针事件，而 `disabledMessage` 会让控件保持可获得焦点，把原因同时呈现给鼠标和键盘用户，选择仍然被阻止。单独禁用某一个分段则用 `SegmentedControlItem` 自己的 `isDisabled`。

分段可以在标签前面放一个图标，把图标写进 `#icon` 插槽即可；图标会跟随控件的尺寸。只显示图标时设置 `isLabelHidden`，此时 `label` 会转成 `aria-label`，分段的无障碍名称不会丢失。

en.text: Use it to switch between two to five mutually exclusive views or modes where every option should be visible at once.
Always set `label` to say in a sentence what the group controls, such as "Workspace view". Screen reader users need it to know what they are choosing between.
Keep the labels short. Labels truncate in narrow containers, and two or three words stay readable on a phone.
Explain a disabled control with `disabledMessage`, so keyboard users can read the reason too.
Use it for page-level navigation. That is what `TabList` is for: a tab list switches a content region, while a segmented control is an input that always has exactly one selected option.
Use it for a simple on/off state. A switch is toggled independently, whereas a segmented control enforces one selection from a group.
Wrap a disabled segmented control in a `Tooltip`. A disabled control does not emit the pointer events the wrapper listens for; use `disabledMessage` instead.
Cram in more than five segments, or mix labels of very different lengths. The more options there are, the more the user has to read before choosing.

zh.text: 用在 2 到 5 个互斥的视图或模式之间切换，并且希望所有选项同时可见的场合。
始终给出 `label`，用一句话说明这组选项在控制什么，比如「Workspace view」。屏幕阅读器用户需要它才能知道当前在选什么。
标签尽量短。窄容器里标签会截断，两三个词的标签在手机上也能完整读出。
禁用整个控件时用 `disabledMessage` 说明原因，键盘用户同样能读到这条信息。
用它做页面级导航。那是 `TabList` 的职责：`TabList` 切换的是内容区域，`SegmentedControl` 是一个输入，任何时候都必须有一个选中项。
用它表达简单的开与关。开关有独立状态，分段控件则强制单选，语义不同。
把禁用的分段控件包进 `Tooltip`。禁用控件不会触发外部 Tooltip 需要的指针事件，请改用 `disabledMessage`。
放进超过 5 个分段，也避免让标签长度差得很悬殊。选项一多，用户就要逐个读完才能比较。

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: The selected segment's value. Required, and bound with `v-model`. The segment whose `value` matches it is the selected one.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the radio group, applied as `aria-label`. Never rendered visually. Required.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Size of the control, which sets the height of every segment. Optional: `sm`, `md`, `lg`.

rows.name: `layout`
rows.description: How the segments spend the available width. `hug` sizes to content, capped at the container so narrow labels truncate; `fill` stretches the segments equally across the container.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Whether the entire control is disabled. No segment can be selected, and the control leaves the tab order.

rows.name: `disabledMessage`
rows.description: Why the control is disabled, shown in a tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus. Together with `isDisabled` the control keeps `aria-disabled` instead of dropping out of the tab order, so the reason reaches keyboard and assistive technology while selection stays blocked. Use it instead of wrapping a disabled control in a Tooltip.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: Unique value for this segment, matched against the control's `v-model`. Required.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: The segment's name, rendered as its visible text and used as the accessible name when the label is hidden. Required.

rows.name: `isLabelHidden`
rows.description: Whether the label is visually hidden, leaving only the icon. The label still becomes `aria-label`.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Whether this single segment is disabled. It keeps its place in the row but cannot be selected, and the arrow keys and tab order skip it.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: 当前选中分段的取值，必填，支持 `v-model`。与它相等的那个分段就是选中项。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 单选组的无障碍名称，写入 `aria-label`，不在页面上渲染，必填。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 控件尺寸，决定每个分段的高度，可选 sm、md、lg。

rows.name: `layout`
rows.description: 分段占用宽度的方式。hug 按内容取宽并受容器限制，标签过窄时截断；fill 让分段平均分摊容器宽度。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 是否禁用整个控件。所有分段都不能被选择，控件退出 Tab 顺序。

rows.name: `disabledMessage`
rows.description: 禁用原因，在悬停和键盘聚焦时以提示气泡显示。与 isDisabled 一起使用时，控件保持 `aria-disabled` 而不是完全不可聚焦，让原因能被键盘和辅助技术读到，选择仍然被阻止。请用它代替把禁用控件包进 Tooltip。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: 该分段的唯一取值，与控件的 `v-model` 比较，相等即为选中项，必填。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 分段名称，渲染为可见文字；隐藏标签时作为无障碍名称，必填。

rows.name: `isLabelHidden`
rows.description: 是否在视觉上隐藏标签，只显示图标。标签仍会写入 `aria-label`。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 是否禁用这单独一个分段。它仍占据原来的位置，但不能被选择，方向键和 Tab 顺序都会跳过它。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The `SegmentedControlItem` children, in the order they appear.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Artwork shown before the label, usually an icon class or your own SVG. It is hidden from assistive technology, since the segment already carries a name.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 放置 `SegmentedControlItem` 的默认插槽，顺序即分段的显示顺序。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 显示在标签前的图标，通常是一个图标类或你自己的 SVG。它对辅助技术隐藏（分段自身已经提供了名称）。

rows.name: `update:modelValue`
rows.description: Fired when the selection changes, backing the `v-model` binding. Clicking the already selected segment does not fire it.

rows.name: `change`
rows.description: Fired when the selection changes, for work that follows a switch such as loading data.

rows.name: `update:modelValue`
rows.description: 选中项变化时触发，用于 `v-model` 的双向绑定。点击已经选中的分段不会触发。

rows.name: `change`
rows.description: 选中项变化时触发，适合在切换后执行加载数据等操作。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The root element is a `div`, and each segment is a `button`. The following go to the root element: - HTML attributes. - `aria-*` attributes (aria-label, aria-disabled, and aria-describedby are derived from `label` and `isDisabled` and cannot be overridden). - `data-*` attributes. - `class`. - `style`. A `class` on `SegmentedControlItem` is merged with the component's own class names. `role`, `aria-checked`, `aria-disabled`, `aria-label` (written only when `isLabelHidden` is set), `tabindex`, and `data-value` are computed by the component and override native attributes of the same name.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `div`，每个分段为 `button`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性（`aria-label`、`aria-disabled`、`aria-describedby` 由组件根据 `label` 和 `isDisabled` 推导，不可覆盖）。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`SegmentedControlItem` 上的 `class` 会与组件自身的类名合并。`role`、`aria-checked`、`aria-disabled`、`aria-label`、`tabindex` 和 `data-value` 由组件计算（`aria-label` 只在 `isLabelHidden` 时写入 `label`），并覆盖同名的原生属性。

en.name: Text label
en.description: Each label must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with its segment background. Check unselected, Hover, Pointer down, and selected colors as they appear on screen. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

summary.en: `ToggleButton` is a button with a pressed and an unpressed state. It stands for a lasting choice — bold text, a view mode, a favorite, a running recording — rather than a one-off action. It reuses the look, the sizes, and the async action machinery of `Button`, and adds the pressed state, the `aria-pressed` semantics, and the icon and weight shift that come with it.
summary.zh: `ToggleButton` 是一个带“按下 / 未按下”状态的按钮。它表示一个持续生效的选择，比如加粗、切换视图、收藏、开始录音，而不是一次性的动作。它复用 `Button` 的外观、尺寸和异步动作机制，只额外补上按下状态、`aria-pressed` 语义，以及按下时的图标与字重变化。

usage.en:
`ToggleButton` is a button with a pressed and an unpressed state. It stands for a lasting choice — bold text, a view mode, a favorite, a running recording — rather than a one-off action. It reuses the look, the sizes, and the async action machinery of `Button`, and adds the pressed state, the `aria-pressed` semantics, and the icon and weight shift that come with it.

On its own, the pressed state is bound to the component:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const isPinned = shallowRef(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButton v-model:is-pressed="isPinned" label="Pin to top" />
</template>
```

A click emits `pressedChange` first, carrying the next state and the originating click event, and then writes `v-model:is-pressed`. Calling `event.preventDefault()` in that handler means you own the toggle: the component neither changes the state nor runs `pressedChangeAction`. With nothing bound at all, the button keeps the pressed state itself.

When the toggle has to wait for a request or a route, use `pressedChangeAction` instead of hand-written loading state. While the action is pending the button shows the next state and a spinner, and it stays clickable: a second click reverses the toggle that has not settled yet instead of being dropped.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const isShared = shallowRef(false)

async function shareWithTeam(next: boolean) {
  await api.setShared(boardId, next)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButton
    v-model:is-pressed="isShared"
    label="Share with team"
    :pressed-change-action="shareWithTeam"
  />
</template>
```

Related toggles belong in a `ToggleButtonGroup`, so a screen reader announces them as one set:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const view = ref<string | null | string[]>('board')
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButtonGroup v-model:value="view" label="View mode">
    <ToggleButton value="list" label="List" />
    <ToggleButton value="board" label="Board" />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>
</template>
```

A group is single-select by default: one member is pressed, and clicking it again clears the selection (the value becomes `null`). With `type="multiple"` each member switches on its own, which suits filters and column pickers. The group size reaches every member unless the member sets its own; a disabled group disables all of them, while a member that disables itself stays disabled even in an enabled group. The group owns the pressed state of its members, so a member's own `isPressed`, `pressedChange` and `pressedChangeAction` are ignored.

For an icon-only toggle set `isIconOnly`: the button becomes square, `label` becomes the accessible name, and `tooltip` supplies the hover hint. To swap in a filled glyph while pressed, put it in the `pressedIcon` slot; the slot falls back to `icon` when it is empty.
usage.zh:
`ToggleButton` 是一个带“按下 / 未按下”状态的按钮。它表示一个持续生效的选择，比如加粗、切换视图、收藏、开始录音，而不是一次性的动作。它复用 `Button` 的外观、尺寸和异步动作机制，只额外补上按下状态、`aria-pressed` 语义，以及按下时的图标与字重变化。

独立使用时，把按下状态绑到组件上即可：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const isPinned = shallowRef(false)
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButton v-model:is-pressed="isPinned" label="Pin to top" />
</template>
```

点击时组件先发出 `pressedChange` 事件（携带下一个状态和原始的点击事件），再写入 `v-model:is-pressed`。回调里调用 `event.preventDefault()` 就表示这次切换由你自己处理，组件不会改写状态，也不会运行 `pressedChangeAction`。如果完全不绑定按下状态，按钮会自己管理它。

按下状态需要等待接口或路由时，用 `pressedChangeAction` 代替手写 loading 状态。动作执行期间按钮显示下一个状态和一个加载指示，并且仍然可以点击：后一次点击会反转上一次尚未完成的选择，而不是被丢掉。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const isShared = shallowRef(false)

async function shareWithTeam(next: boolean) {
  await api.setShared(boardId, next)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButton
    v-model:is-pressed="isShared"
    label="Share with team"
    :pressed-change-action="shareWithTeam"
  />
</template>
```

相关的开关应该放进 `ToggleButtonGroup`，让屏幕阅读器把它们读成一个整体：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const view = ref<string | null | string[]>('board')
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButtonGroup v-model:value="view" label="View mode">
    <ToggleButton value="list" label="List" />
    <ToggleButton value="board" label="Board" />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>
</template>
```

分组默认是单选：只有一个成员处于按下状态，再次点击当前项会取消选择（值为 `null`）。改成 `type="multiple"` 后每个成员各自开关，适合筛选器、列显示这类多选工具栏。分组的 `size` 会传给所有成员，成员自己设置 `size` 时以成员的为准；分组的 `isDisabled` 会禁用全部成员，而成员自己禁用自己时，分组无法把它重新启用。作为分组一员的按钮由分组决定按下状态，它自己的 `isPressed`、`pressedChange` 和 `pressedChangeAction` 都不再生效。

图标按钮请用 `isIconOnly`：按钮变成正方形，`label` 转为无障碍名称，鼠标悬停的文字提示由 `tooltip` 提供。按下时想换成实心图标，就把另一张图放进 `pressedIcon` 插槽；它留空时会退回 `icon`。

en.text: Show the pressed state with a filled or colored icon, such as a microphone that becomes a solid square, so the current state is obvious at a glance.
Keep the label text identical in both states and let the background, the weight, and the icon carry the difference.
Wrap related toggles in a `ToggleButtonGroup` with a `label`, so a screen reader announces them as one set.
Reach for `pressedChangeAction` when a request backs the toggle; the button then previews the next state and shows the spinner for you.
Use it for one-time actions such as "Submit" or "Delete"; those are plain `Button`s.
Mix regular `Button`s into a `ToggleButtonGroup`; a group holds `ToggleButton`s only.
Use it for a setting that persists across sessions; `Switch` reads as a setting, a toggle reads as an action on the current content.

zh.text: 按下状态用一个实心或带颜色的图标表示，例如麦克风换成实心方块，让用户一眼看出当前状态。
按下与未按下时保持标签文字不变，让背景、字重和图标去表达状态的差别。
把相关的开关放进带 `label` 的 `ToggleButtonGroup`，屏幕阅读器才会把它们播报成一组。
需要请求后端时用 `pressedChangeAction`，按钮会自动显示按下预览和加载指示，不必自己维护 loading 状态。
用它做一次性的动作，例如“提交”“删除”，那些是 `Button` 的职责。
在同一个 `ToggleButtonGroup` 里混用普通 `Button`，组内只应该放 `ToggleButton`。
用它表示需要长期保存的开关设置，这类语义应该交给 `Switch`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the button. It names the control when the default slot supplies visible content, doubles as `aria-label` in icon-only mode, and is the visible text when nothing else is provided.

rows.name: `isPressed`
rows.description: Whether the button is pressed, bound with `v-model:is-pressed`. Leave it unbound and the button owns the pressed state, starting unpressed. Inside a ToggleButtonGroup the group owns it and this prop is ignored.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Button size. It falls back to the size of the enclosing group, then to `md`.

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: Resting shadow depth for floating (FAB-style) toggles, matching Button. A grouped button keeps its own elevation.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables interaction. A disabled group disables every member, and an enabled group never re-enables a member that disabled itself. With a tooltip the button switches to `aria-disabled` so focus stays available to read the reason.

rows.name: `isLoading`
rows.description: Shows the loading state: the content gives way to a spinner and `aria-busy` is set.

rows.name: `isIconOnly`
rows.description: Renders a square, icon-only button that uses label as its accessible name; no label text and no width reservation are rendered.

rows.name: `pressedChangeAction`
rows.description: Action for an API- or navigation-backed toggle. It runs after `pressedChange` unless that handler prevents the click default. While it is pending the button previews the next state with a spinner and stays clickable, so another click reverses the unsettled toggle. Ignored for a group member with a value.

rows.name: `tooltip`
rows.description: Text shown on hover and keyboard focus, usually to name an icon-only toggle.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: Value identifier inside a ToggleButtonGroup; the group uses it to decide the pressed state. It is not a form value.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the group, rendered as `aria-label` on the `role="group"` container.

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: Selection mode. `single` keeps one member pressed and clears on a second click; `multiple` lets members switch on their own.

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: The current selection, bound with `v-model:value`. A string or `null` in single mode, an array of strings in multiple mode (an empty array when none is pressed).

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: Layout direction of the members. A vertical group stretches each member to the full width.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Size the members inherit; a member with its own `size` wins.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables every member. A member that disables itself stays disabled as well.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 按钮的无障碍名称。有默认插槽内容时它是无障碍名称，纯图标模式下同时是 `aria-label`；两者都没有时它是可见文字。

rows.name: `isPressed`
rows.description: 是否处于按下状态，用 `v-model:is-pressed` 绑定。不绑定该属性时按钮自己管理按下状态，初始为未按下。放入 ToggleButtonGroup 后由分组接管，该属性失效。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 按钮尺寸。留空时沿用所在分组的 size，分组也没有则回退到 `md`。

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: 静止状态下的阴影强度，用于悬浮样式的切换按钮，取值与 Button 一致。放入分组后每个成员仍保留自己的阴影。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 是否禁用。分组的 isDisabled 会禁用全部成员；成员自己禁用自己时，启用中的分组不会把它重新启用。带 tooltip 时改用 `aria-disabled`，按钮仍可获得焦点以读出禁用原因。

rows.name: `isLoading`
rows.description: 是否显示加载状态。同时设置 `aria-busy`，内容隐藏并显示转圈指示。

rows.name: `isIconOnly`
rows.description: 渲染为正方形纯图标按钮，用 label 作为无障碍名称，不渲染标签文字和占位元素。

rows.name: `pressedChangeAction`
rows.description: 由接口或路由支撑的切换动作。在 `pressedChange` 之后执行，除非该回调阻止了默认行为；执行期间按钮显示下一个状态和加载指示，并允许再次点击来反转尚未完成的选择。分组中带 value 的成员会忽略它。

rows.name: `tooltip`
rows.description: 悬停和键盘聚焦时显示的文字提示，纯图标按钮常用它补足含义。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: 在 ToggleButtonGroup 中标识自己的值，分组用它判断按下状态；独立使用时不参与表单提交。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 分组的无障碍名称，渲染为 `role="group"` 容器上的 `aria-label`。

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: 选择模式。`single` 只允许一个成员按下，再次点击当前项会取消选择；`multiple` 允许多个成员同时按下。

rows.name: `value`
rows.description: 当前选中的值，用 `v-model:value` 绑定。单选模式是字符串或 `null`，多选模式是字符串数组（默认空数组）。

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: 成员的排列方向。垂直时成员拉伸为整行宽度。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 成员继承的默认尺寸，成员自己设置 `size` 时以成员为准。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 是否禁用全部成员。成员自己设置 `isDisabled` 时同样保持禁用。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Visible content. It replaces label as the visible text while label stays the accessible name; with nothing in it, label is rendered.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: Decorative icon before the label, or the only content of an icon-only button. Put an icon class in a sized element, such as `<span class="i-carbon-filter" style="width: 16px; height: 16px" />`, so it matches the button's icon box.

rows.name: `pressedIcon`
rows.description: Icon shown while pressed, typically a filled version of `icon`. Falls back to `icon` when empty. The artwork owns its own color, so pass an element that already carries it, such as `<span class="i-carbon-stop-filled" style="color: var(--astryx-icon-error-foreground)" />`.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The ToggleButton members. Each one needs its own `value`.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 可见内容，会取代 label 作为可见文字，无障碍名称仍然取自 label。留空时渲染 label。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 标签前的装饰图标；纯图标模式下它是唯一内容。把图标类放进一个有尺寸的元素，例如 `<span class="i-carbon-filter" style="width: 16px; height: 16px" />`，以匹配按钮的图标盒子。

rows.name: `pressedIcon`
rows.description: 按下时显示的图标，通常换成一枚实心图标。留空时退回 `icon`。图形的颜色由元素自己决定，所以要传入已经着色的元素，例如 `<span class="i-carbon-stop-filled" style="color: var(--astryx-icon-error-foreground)" />`。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 组内的 ToggleButton 成员，每个成员都需要自己的 `value`。

rows.name: `pressedChange`
rows.description: The state the click asks for, with the originating click event. Call `event.preventDefault()` to own the toggle: the component then neither changes the state nor runs `pressedChangeAction`.

rows.name: `update:isPressed`
rows.description: Backs `v-model:is-pressed`. It is not emitted when the handler prevents the click default.

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: The originating click, forwarded after the toggle has been requested. It is not emitted while the button is disabled.

rows.name: `change`
rows.description: The group selection: a string or `null` in single mode, an array in multiple mode.

rows.name: `pressedChange`
rows.description: 点击要求切换到的状态和原始的点击事件。在回调里调用 `event.preventDefault()` 表示这次切换由你处理，组件不改写状态，也跳过 `pressedChangeAction`。

rows.name: `update:isPressed`
rows.description: 供 `v-model:is-pressed` 使用。回调阻止默认行为时不会发出。

rows.name: `click`
rows.description: 透传的点击事件，在切换请求之后发出。按钮被禁用时不会发出。

rows.name: `change`
rows.description: 分组的选择结果：单选模式是字符串或 `null`，多选模式是数组。

en.heading: Slots
en.text: ToggleButtonGroup takes its members through the default slot:

en.heading: Keyboard
en.text:
The group does not take over the arrow keys: each member is its own tab stop, so `Tab` walks them one by one and the arrow keys do not move focus between members — unlike `ButtonGroup`. Disabled members are skipped, while a disabled member that carries a tooltip stays focusable so its reason can be read.

- `Tab`: `Tab`
- `Enter` / `Space`: `Enter` / `Space`

en.heading: Template ref
en.text:
`ToggleButton` exposes:

- `element`: `HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLElement | null`.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`: focuses the button.
- `blur()`: removes focus from the button.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is `<button type="button">`.

It receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

The component sets `aria-pressed` from the pressed state, and uses `data-pressed`, `data-variant="ghost"`, and `data-size` for theming; leave those to the component. In icon-only mode `aria-label` comes from `label`.

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: ToggleButtonGroup 通过默认插槽接收 ToggleButton：

zh.heading: 键盘
zh.text:
分组本身不拦截方向键：每个成员都是独立的 tab 停靠点，`Tab` 逐个经过，方向键不会在成员之间移动焦点（这一点与 `ButtonGroup` 不同）。禁用的成员会被跳过，带 tooltip 的禁用成员仍可获得焦点以便读出禁用原因。

- `Tab`: `Tab`
- `Enter` / `Space`: `Enter` / `Space`

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
`ToggleButton` 公开以下内容：

- `element`：`HTMLButtonElement | HTMLAnchorElement | HTMLElement | null`。
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`：聚焦按钮。
- `blur()`：移除按钮焦点。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<button type="button">`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

`aria-pressed` 由组件根据按下状态设置，`data-pressed`、`data-variant="ghost"` 和 `data-size` 供主题选择器使用，不要覆盖。`aria-label` 在纯图标模式下取自 `label`。

en.title: Color
en.description: Toggle buttons with colored icons in the pressed state. Shows accent-colored toolbar formatting and semantic reaction colors.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ToggleButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { reactive } from 'vue'

const toolbar = reactive({ bold: true, italic: false, underline: true, strikethrough: false, link: false })
const reactions = reactive({ star: false, heart: false, bookmark: true, bell: false })

function toggleToolbar(key: keyof typeof toolbar) {
  toolbar[key] = !toolbar[key]
}
function toggleReaction(key: keyof typeof reactions) {
  reactions[key] = !reactions[key]
}
</script>

<template>
  <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="4">
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Toolbar
      </Text>
      <Stack direction="horizontal" :gap="1">
        <ToggleButton label="Bold" :is-pressed="toolbar.bold" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleToolbar('bold')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-bold" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-bold" color="accent" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Italic" :is-pressed="toolbar.italic" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleToolbar('italic')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-italic" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-italic" color="accent" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Underline" :is-pressed="toolbar.underline" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleToolbar('underline')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-underline" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-underline" color="accent" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Strikethrough" :is-pressed="toolbar.strikethrough" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleToolbar('strikethrough')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-strikethrough" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-strikethrough" color="accent" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Link" :is-pressed="toolbar.link" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleToolbar('link')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-link" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-link" color="accent" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
      </Stack>
    </Stack>
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">
      <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
        Reactions
      </Text>
      <Stack direction="horizontal" :gap="1">
        <ToggleButton label="Star" :is-pressed="reactions.star" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleReaction('star')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-star" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-star-solid" color="yellow" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Like" :is-pressed="reactions.heart" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleReaction('heart')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-heart" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-heart-solid" color="red" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Save" :is-pressed="reactions.bookmark" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleReaction('bookmark')">
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-bookmark" color="secondary" />
          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-bookmark-solid" color="blue" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton label="Follow" :is-pressed="reactions.bell" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleReaction('bell')">
          <template #icon>

          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>

const toolbar = reactive({ bold: true, italic: false, underline: true, strikethrough: false, link: false })
const reactions = reactive({ star: false, heart: false, bookmark: true, bell: false })

function toggleToolbar(key: keyof typeof toolbar) {

}

          </template>
          <template #pressedIcon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-strikethrough" color="accent" />
          </template>

        <ToggleButton label="Link" :is-pressed="toolbar.link" is-icon-only @update:is-pressed="toggleToolbar('link')">

          <template #pressedIcon>

        Reactions

          <template #pressedIcon>

en.name: Icon
en.description: A leading icon that represents the toggle action, like a star for favorite or bold "B" for formatting.

en.name: Pressed icon
en.description: An alternate icon shown when pressed: typically a filled version of the default icon to reinforce the active state.

en.name: Label
en.description: The visible text or accessible name. For icon-only toggles, used as the aria-label and auto-tooltip.

en.name: Spinner
en.description: Replaces the icon during async operations triggered by pressedChangeAction.

zh.name: 图标
zh.description: 表示这个切换做什么的前导图标，比如收藏用的星，或加粗用的 B。

zh.name: 按下时的图标
zh.description: 按下时显示的另一枚图标，一般是默认图标的实心版，用来强化已经按下。

zh.name: 标签
zh.description: 可见文字或无障碍名称。只有图标的切换用它做 aria-label，并自动作为提示。

zh.name: 转圈
zh.description: pressedChangeAction 触发的异步操作期间，替换图标。

en.name: Text label
en.description: The label must have at least 4.5:1 contrast with the button background when selected and unselected. For Hover and Pointer down, measure the final background after the overlay is applied.

en.name: Essential icon or spinner arc
en.description: An icon-only ToggleButton must have at least 3:1 contrast between its icon and button background. The moving spinner arc must also meet 3:1. An icon beside a visible label does not need its own check.

en.name: Selected state indicator
en.description: The selected background must reach 3:1 only when users need it to tell selected from unselected. Label weight or a changed icon can also show selection.

en.name: Visible control boundary
en.description: The button edge needs 3:1 contrast only when users need it to see the control. A visible label or icon can show the control instead.

en.name: Keyboard focus indicator
en.description: The focus outline must have at least 3:1 contrast with the area around the button. Check both selected and unselected states.

en.name: Disabled appearance
en.description: Disabled controls do not need to meet these contrast ratios.

zh.name: 文字
zh.description: 选中和未选中时，文字和按钮底都要至少 4.5:1。悬停和按下，量的是叠层加上去之后的最终底色。

zh.name: 代替文字的图标或转圈弧线
zh.description: 只有图标的 ToggleButton，图标和按钮底至少 3:1。转动的那截弧线也要达到 3:1。图标旁边已经有可见文字时，图标不用单独量。

zh.name: 选中指示
zh.description: 只有使用者必须靠选中底才能分出选中和未选中时，这块底才要达到 3:1。字重或换过的图标也可以表示选中。

zh.name: 看得出的控件边界
zh.description: 只有使用者必须靠这条边才看得出这是控件时，边才需要 3:1。看得见的文字或图标也可以把控件标出来。

zh.name: 键盘焦点指示
zh.description: 焦点轮廓和按钮周围至少 3:1。选中和未选中都要量。

zh.name: 禁用外观
zh.description: 禁用的控件不用达到这些对比度。

summary.en: `Toolbar` is a `role="toolbar"`. `label` is required. `start`, `center`, and `end` are three groups. Arrow keys move focus across them, and Home and End jump to the ends. While an input is being edited, arrows stay with the caret until it reaches the edge of the field.
summary.zh: `Toolbar` 是 `role="toolbar"`。`label` 必填。`start`、`center`、`end` 分成三组，方向键在组与组之间移动焦点，Home 和 End 跳到两端。焦点在输入框里时，方向键先留给输入框，直到光标顶到边界。

usage.en:
`Toolbar` is a `role="toolbar"`. `label` is required. `start`, `center`, and `end` are three groups. Arrow keys move focus across them, and Home and End jump to the ends. While an input is being edited, arrows stay with the caret until it reaches the edge of the field.

Hand overflow to `OverflowList`. Extra actions go into a More menu. The toolbar itself does not measure width.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Toolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toolbar'
</script>

<template>
  <Toolbar label="Formatting">
    <template #start>
      <button type="button">
        Bold
      </button>
      <button type="button">
        Italic
      </button>
    </template>
  </Toolbar>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Toolbar` 是 `role="toolbar"`。`label` 必填。`start`、`center`、`end` 分成三组，方向键在组与组之间移动焦点，Home 和 End 跳到两端。焦点在输入框里时，方向键先留给输入框，直到光标顶到边界。

放不下的操作交给 `OverflowList`，多出来的项收进「更多」菜单。工具栏自己不测量宽度。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Toolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toolbar'
</script>

<template>
  <Toolbar label="格式">
    <template #start>
      <button type="button">
        加粗
      </button>
      <button type="button">
        斜体
      </button>
    </template>
  </Toolbar>
</template>
```

en.text: Name the toolbar for its job, for example “Formatting”.
Put a long set of actions in an `OverflowList` instead of letting buttons wrap out of the bar.
Do not nest a toolbar inside a toolbar. Arrow keys stop at the inner boundary.

zh.text: 给工具栏一个能说明用途的 `label`，例如「格式」。
项很多时把它们放进 `OverflowList`，不要让按钮换行挤出容器。
不要在工具栏里再套一个工具栏。方向键会停在内层边界上。

summary.en: `ToggleButtonGroup` keeps the pressed state of its `ToggleButton` children. Each child needs a `value`. The group's `v-model:value` replaces that button's own pressed state.
summary.zh: `ToggleButtonGroup` 管里面 `ToggleButton` 的按下状态。每个按钮都要有 `value`。组的 `v-model:value` 会盖过按钮自己的按下状态。

usage.en:
`ToggleButtonGroup` keeps the pressed state of its `ToggleButton` children. Each child needs a `value`. The group's `v-model:value` replaces that button's own pressed state.

`type="single"` keeps one button pressed. Pressing it again clears the selection, and the value is `null`. `type="multiple"` presses buttons independently, and the value is a list. `orientation` is `horizontal` or `vertical`. `label` is the group's accessible name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const view = ref<string | null>('grid')
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButtonGroup v-model:value="view" label="View mode">
    <ToggleButton label="List" value="list" />
    <ToggleButton label="Grid" value="grid" />
    <ToggleButton label="Board" value="board" />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ToggleButtonGroup` 管里面 `ToggleButton` 的按下状态。每个按钮都要有 `value`。组的 `v-model:value` 会盖过按钮自己的按下状态。

`type="single"` 同时只按下一个。再点一次会清空，值变成 `null`。`type="multiple"` 每个按钮各自按下，值是数组。`orientation` 是 `horizontal` 或 `vertical`。`label` 是这一组的无障碍名称。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ToggleButton, ToggleButtonGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/ToggleButton'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const view = ref<string | null>('grid')
</script>

<template>
  <ToggleButtonGroup v-model:value="view" label="View mode">
    <ToggleButton label="List" value="list" />
    <ToggleButton label="Grid" value="grid" />
    <ToggleButton label="Board" value="board" />
  </ToggleButtonGroup>
</template>
```

en.title: Group

        <ToggleButton value="grid" label="Grid view" is-icon-only>

        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton value="table" label="Table view" is-icon-only>

    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="1">

        Multiple selections

      <ToggleButtonGroup v-model:value="formats" type="multiple" label="Text formatting">
        <ToggleButton value="bold" label="Bold" is-icon-only>
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-bold" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton value="italic" label="Italic" is-icon-only>
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-italic" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton value="underline" label="Underline" is-icon-only>
          <template #icon>
            <Icon icon="i-heroicons-underline" />
          </template>
        </ToggleButton>
        <ToggleButton value="strikethrough" label="Strikethrough" is-icon-only>
          <template #icon>

          </template>

    </Stack>
  </Stack>

summary.en: `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` is one checkable row inside a [Dropdown Menu](/en/components/dropdown-menu). Its role is `menuitemcheckbox`. It toggles its own boolean and leaves the menu open, so several settings can change in one visit. A one-of-N choice belongs in a [Dropdown Menu Radio Group](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group).
summary.zh: `DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` 是 [下拉菜单](/components/dropdown-menu) 里的一行可勾选操作，角色是 `menuitemcheckbox`。它切换自己的布尔值，并保持菜单打开，方便一次改好几项设置。多选一的场景用 [下拉菜单单选组](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group)。

usage.en:
`DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` is one checkable row inside a [Dropdown Menu](/en/components/dropdown-menu). Its role is `menuitemcheckbox`. It toggles its own boolean and leaves the menu open, so several settings can change in one visit. A one-of-N choice belongs in a [Dropdown Menu Radio Group](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group).

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const archived = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :button="{ label: 'View' }">
    <DropdownMenuCheckboxItem v-model="archived" label="Show archived" />
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
```

The mark is decorative. The whole row is the control, and the checked state is `aria-checked`. A disabled row stays in the menu, the arrow keys skip it, and a click does not toggle it.
usage.zh:
`DropdownMenuCheckboxItem` 是 [下拉菜单](/components/dropdown-menu) 里的一行可勾选操作，角色是 `menuitemcheckbox`。它切换自己的布尔值，并保持菜单打开，方便一次改好几项设置。多选一的场景用 [下拉菜单单选组](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group)。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuCheckboxItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const archived = ref(false)

<template>
```

勾选标记是装饰，整行才是控件，选中状态写在 `aria-checked` 上。禁用的行仍留在菜单里，方向键会跳过它，点击也不会切换。

summary.en: `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` is a single-select set of radio rows inside a [Dropdown Menu](/en/components/dropdown-menu). Its role is `group`, and each option is a [Dropdown Menu Radio Item](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-item) with role `menuitemradio`. The group owns the selected value and lays the options out with the menu's own gap. Choosing one closes the menu, because the choice is made.
summary.zh: `DropdownMenuRadioGroup` 是 [下拉菜单](/components/dropdown-menu) 里的一组单选行。组的角色是 `group`，每个选项是角色为 `menuitemradio` 的 [下拉菜单单选项](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-item)。组自己持有当前选中的值，并按菜单原有的行间距排列选项。选中一项后菜单收起，因为选择已经完成。

usage.en:
`DropdownMenuRadioGroup` is a single-select set of radio rows inside a [Dropdown Menu](/en/components/dropdown-menu). Its role is `group`, and each option is a [Dropdown Menu Radio Item](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-item) with role `menuitemradio`. The group owns the selected value and lays the options out with the menu's own gap. Choosing one closes the menu, because the choice is made.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const sort = ref('newest')
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :button="{ label: 'Sort' }">
    <DropdownMenuRadioGroup v-model="sort" label="Sort by">
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="newest" label="Newest" />
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="oldest" label="Oldest" />
    </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
```

`label` is the accessible name of the set, so the options are announced together. Leave the value unset when nothing is selected yet.
usage.zh:
`DropdownMenuRadioGroup` 是 [下拉菜单](/components/dropdown-menu) 里的一组单选行。组的角色是 `group`，每个选项是角色为 `menuitemradio` 的 [下拉菜单单选项](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-item)。组自己持有当前选中的值，并按菜单原有的行间距排列选项。选中一项后菜单收起，因为选择已经完成。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/DropdownMenu'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const sort = ref('newest')
</script>

<template>
  <DropdownMenu :button="{ label: '排序' }">
    <DropdownMenuRadioGroup v-model="sort" label="排序方式">
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="newest" label="最新" />
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="oldest" label="最早" />
    </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
```

`label` 是这一组的无障碍名称，选项会作为同一组被朗读。还没有选中任何一项时，把值留空。

rows.name: `label`

rows.description: Whether choosing a value closes the menu. A radio group closes.

rows.name: `label`

rows.name: `hasCloseOnSelect`

en.heading: Props

zh.heading: 属性

summary.en: `DropdownMenuRadioItem` is one option in a [Dropdown Menu Radio Group](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group). Its role is `menuitemradio`. It has to sit inside that group. The group's value matches this option's `value` to decide which row is checked.
summary.zh: `DropdownMenuRadioItem` 是 [下拉菜单单选组](/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group) 里的一个选项，角色是 `menuitemradio`。它必须放在这个组里面。组的当前值与这一项的 `value` 相同，这一行才是选中的。

usage.en:
`DropdownMenuRadioItem` is one option in a [Dropdown Menu Radio Group](/en/components/dropdown-menu-radio-group). Its role is `menuitemradio`. It has to sit inside that group. The group's value matches this option's `value` to decide which row is checked.

```vue
  </DropdownMenu>
</template>
```

The radio dot is decorative. The whole row is the control. A disabled option stays in the group and cannot be selected.
usage.zh:

summary.en: The chat display is a set of pieces that stack into a transcript: a scrolling layout, a message log, rows for each sender, bubbles, tool calls, a reasoning disclosure, a typing line, and an unread rule. Message bodies are slots. This suite does not render Markdown; pass plain text, or bring your own renderer.
summary.zh: 对话展示是一组可以叠成会话记录的部件：滚动布局、消息列表、不同发送者的消息行、气泡、工具调用、推理折叠、正在输入，以及未读分隔。消息正文走插槽。这套组件不渲染 Markdown，正文用纯文本，或者换成你自己的渲染器。

usage.en:
The chat display is a set of pieces that stack into a transcript: a scrolling layout, a message log, rows for each sender, bubbles, tool calls, a reasoning disclosure, a typing line, and an unread rule. Message bodies are slots. This suite does not render Markdown; pass plain text, or bring your own renderer.

`ChatLayout` is a column. The transcript grows, and the composer stays pinned to the bottom over a frosted scrim. By default the layout itself scrolls. Pass `scrollRef` when an ancestor should scroll instead, and the dock switches from sticky to fixed.

While the reader is at the bottom, new text keeps the view pinned there. Scrolling up lets go immediately and reveals the scroll-to-bottom button. If messages arrive while the view is unlocked, the button label changes to the localized “New messages” string, a live region announces it, and `ChatUnreadDivider` can mark the boundary. `ChatLayout` wires this through `useChatStreamScroll` and `useChatNewMessages`. Set `showScrollButton` to `false` to hide the built-in button, or replace it with the `scrollButton` slot.

The field is ChatComposer, placed in the layout's composer slot. The shell owns the draft, send, and stop. The default editor accepts chips, sends on Enter, and inserts a newline on Shift+Enter. The attachment drawer, header, and footer are slots. Dictation uses the browser's speech recognition, and the microphone stays hidden when that API is missing.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatComposer, ChatLayout, ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

function onSubmit(value: string) {
  console.log(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ChatLayout>
    <ChatMessageList>
      <ChatMessage sender="user">
        <ChatMessageBubble>
          Check the release notes for me.
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
      <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
        <ChatMessageBubble name="Assistant">
          The notes are in the docs.
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
    </ChatMessageList>
    <template #composer>
      <ChatComposer placeholder="Type a message…" @submit="onSubmit" />
    </template>
  </ChatLayout>
</template>
```

`ChatMessageList` is a `role="log"`. Pass `isStreaming` while an assistant reply is still growing, so a screen reader waits and announces the finished message once. `scrollToTopAction` runs when the top sentinel enters the scroll parent, and a spinner stays up until the promise settles.

`ChatMessage` is an article. `sender` is `user`, `assistant`, or `system`. A system row is centered and ignores the avatar, name, and metadata slots. Put the visible name on `ChatMessageBubble` when the body starts with a bubble, so the name lines up with the bubble padding.

`ChatToolCalls` takes the tool list an assistant turn already produced. One call is a single row. Several calls collapse behind a header; `label` replaces the localized count while the group is open. A call with `detail`, or the `detail` slot, can expand on its own. `v-model:is-expanded` controls the group.

`ChatReasoning` is the same kind of disclosure for a thinking trace. It starts collapsed. A plain-text default slot is reused as the one-line preview. `isStreaming` shimmers the label and hides both the preview and `duration`.

`ChatTypingIndicator` draws three dots. Pass `names` and it writes a sentence for one person, two people, or a named person plus a count. The root is `role="status"`, and that region is the only announcement. `ChatUnreadDivider` marks the first unread message, and new rows go below it.

The examples start with the composer beside the transcript, then follow layout, scroll button, message, bubble, list, metadata, system message, and tool calls.
usage.zh:
对话展示是一组可以叠成会话记录的部件：滚动布局、消息列表、不同发送者的消息行、气泡、工具调用、推理折叠、正在输入，以及未读分隔。消息正文走插槽。这套组件不渲染 Markdown，正文用纯文本，或者换成你自己的渲染器。

`ChatLayout` 是一列。记录区往上长，输入区贴在底部，下面有一层磨砂。默认由布局自己滚动。外面已经有滚动容器时传入 `scrollRef`，底部停靠会从 sticky 改成 fixed。

阅读位置在底部时，新文字会把视图继续贴在底部。一旦向上滚，贴底立刻停下，并出现回到底部的按钮。没贴底时又来了新消息，按钮文案会换成当前语言的「有新消息」，屏幕阅读器也会播报，`ChatUnreadDivider` 用来标出分界。`ChatLayout` 内部用 `useChatStreamScroll` 和 `useChatNewMessages` 串起这件事。`showScrollButton` 设为 `false` 可以拿掉内置按钮，也可以用 `scrollButton` 插槽换成自己的。

输入区用 ChatComposer，放进布局的 composer 插槽。外壳管草稿、发送和停止。默认输入框能插入标记，回车发送，Shift 加回车换行。附件抽屉、顶栏和底栏都是插槽。语音听写走浏览器自己的语音识别，没有识别能力时麦克风不出现。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ChatComposer, ChatLayout, ChatMessage, ChatMessageBubble, ChatMessageList } from '@astryx-vue/core/Chat'

function onSubmit(value: string) {
  console.log(value)
}
</script>

<template>
  <ChatLayout>
    <ChatMessageList>
      <ChatMessage sender="user">
        <ChatMessageBubble>
          帮我看一下发布说明。
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
      <ChatMessage sender="assistant">
        <ChatMessageBubble name="助手">
          说明在文档里。
        </ChatMessageBubble>
      </ChatMessage>
    </ChatMessageList>
    <template #composer>
      <ChatComposer placeholder="输入消息……" @submit="onSubmit" />
    </template>
  </ChatLayout>
</template>
```

`ChatMessageList` 是 `role="log"`。助手回复还在增长时传入 `isStreaming`，屏幕阅读器会等这段结束再读一次。`scrollToTopAction` 在顶部哨兵进入滚动容器时执行，Promise 结束前顶部一直显示加载指示。

`ChatMessage` 是一条 `article`。`sender` 取 `user`、`assistant` 或 `system`。系统消息居中，头像、名字和元信息插槽都不会渲染。正文以气泡开头时，把可见名字放在 `ChatMessageBubble` 上，名字才能和气泡内边距对齐。

`ChatToolCalls` 接收一轮回复里已经有的工具调用。只有一条时就是一行。多条收在一个标题后面；展开时 `label` 会替换掉按数量生成的文案。某条带了 `detail`，或者提供了 `detail` 插槽，这一行自己还能再展开。分组用 `v-model:is-expanded` 控制。

`ChatReasoning` 是同样的折叠，用来放推理过程，默认收起。默认插槽如果是纯文本，会同时当作收起时的一行预览。`isStreaming` 会让标题闪动，并藏起预览和 `duration`。

`ChatTypingIndicator` 画三个点。传入 `names` 后，一个人、两个人、以及「某人和其他几人」各有一句文案。根节点是 `role="status"`，由它播报这一句。`ChatUnreadDivider` 标出第一条未读消息，新到的内容放在它下面。

下面先看输入套件和消息列表放在一起的样子，再按布局、回到底部、消息、气泡、列表、元信息、系统消息、工具调用往下排。

en.text: Keep the transcript in the message list and the composer in the bottom slot, so the frosted dock and the scroll button stay aligned.
Set `isStreaming` for the whole time an assistant body is growing, and clear it when the message is complete.
Use `ChatUnreadDivider` at the first message the reader has not seen. The scroll button’s “New messages” label is the announcement; the divider is the visible mark.
Put plain text, citations, or your own renderer in the bubble slot. The bubble only supplies the surface.
Render a second scroll parent inside the layout. One element should own the transcript scroll, either the layout or the element passed as `scrollRef`.
Announce every streamed token yourself. The typing indicator speaks once through its own `role="status"`, and the new-message label speaks through the layout live region.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Spacing, bubble width, and the frosted dock. Messages can override it.

rows.name: `scrollRef`
rows.description: Element that scrolls instead of the layout. Leave it unset and the layout scrolls itself. The dock is sticky for self scroll and fixed for an external scroller.

rows.name: `showScrollButton`
rows.description: Renders the built-in scroll-to-bottom button. Set `false` when the `scrollButton` slot replaces it, or when the button should be absent.

rows.name: `isVisible`
rows.description: Whether the pill is shown. A hidden pill stays mounted so it can fade, and is marked `inert`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Widens the pill. Omit it for the icon-only down arrow. The accessible name falls back to “Scroll to bottom”.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Passed to messages that do not set their own.

rows.name: `gap`
rows.description: Gap between top-level rows, on the spacing scale. Overrides the density gap without changing padding.

rows.name: `scrollToTopAction`
rows.description: Loads older messages when the top sentinel intersects the scroll parent. A spinner shows while the promise is pending. A second intersection is ignored until it settles.

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: Sets `aria-busy` while an assistant message is still streaming.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the log.

rows.name: `sender`
rows.description: Who the row is from. `system` is centered and ignores avatar, name, and metadata.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Plain sender name. Prefer the bubble `name` when the body starts with a bubble.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Density for this row only.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: `filled` paints the sender surface. `ghost` drops the background and the block padding so mixed content still lines up.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Sender name aligned to the bubble padding.

rows.name: `group`
rows.description: Tightens a corner when several bubbles stack. Leave it unset for a standalone bubble.

rows.name: `timestamp`
rows.description: Short time text. The `timestamp` slot replaces it.

rows.name: `footer`
rows.description: Secondary text, such as a model name. The `footer` slot replaces it.

rows.name: `status`
rows.description: Delivery state. The row renders nothing when timestamp, footer, and status are all absent.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: `default` is a centered line. `divider` draws a rule on each side. The root is `role="status"`.

rows.name: `calls`
rows.description: Tool calls from one assistant turn. An empty array renders nothing. Each item may set `name`, `status`, `target`, `duration`, `node`, `additions`, `deletions`, `stats`, `errorMessage`, `key`, and `detail`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Summary shown while a group is expanded.

rows.name: `v-model:isExpanded`
rows.description: Controlled expanded state of a multi-call group.

rows.name: `defaultIsExpanded`
rows.description: Initial state while `isExpanded` is unbound.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Header label.

rows.name: `duration`
rows.description: Shown after the label once streaming has finished, such as `12s`.

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: Shimmers the label and hides the preview and the duration.

rows.name: `v-model:isExpanded`
rows.description: Controlled expanded state.

rows.name: `defaultIsExpanded`
rows.description: Initial state while `isExpanded` is unbound.

rows.name: `names`
rows.description: People currently typing. Empty names are dropped. No names leaves the dots only. One, two, and three or more each get their own sentence.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Short label at the end of the rule. The accessible name is “{label} messages below”.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: Controlled draft, bound with `v-model`. Omit it and the shell keeps the draft.

rows.name: `placeholder`
rows.description: Shown while the draft is empty.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables editing and send. Stop stays clickable when it is shown.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: Padding inside the body. Spacious uses the same spacing as balanced.

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: Low deepens on hover and focus. None is flat and uses a border. The focus ring appears only when the keyboard focuses the editor.

rows.name: `isStopShown`
rows.description: Shows stop instead of send.

rows.name: `status`
rows.description: Error uses alert. Warning uses status.

rows.name: `statusPosition`
rows.description: Places the bar above or below the body, tucked behind the radius.

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: Controlled draft. Inside a shell, an omitted value follows the shell.

rows.name: `placeholder`
rows.default: The shell or the localized placeholder
rows.description: Hint on the empty editor.

rows.name: `maxRows`
rows.description: The editor scrolls after this many lines. A line is 22px.

rows.name: `triggers`
rows.description: A trigger character at a word boundary opens suggestions. The editor becomes a combobox.

rows.name: `debounceMs`
rows.description: Delay for an async search. Sync results are immediate, and the first async search starts at once.

rows.name: `hasHistory`
rows.description: Arrow Up at the start recalls the previous submission. Arrow Down at the end steps forward.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name of the editor.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Disables editing.

rows.name: `pasteAsToken`
rows.default: Pastes longer than 200 characters become a chip
rows.description: Pass false to insert the text as-is.

rows.name: `pasteAction`
rows.description: First chance at a plain-text paste. Return true and the input will not insert it.

rows.name: `count`
rows.description: Enables collapse and appears in the default summary.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Used in the summary and in the expand and collapse names.

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: Controlled collapsed state, bound with `v-model:is-collapsed`.

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: Initial state while unbound.

rows.name: `isStopShown`
rows.description: Stop is secondary. Send is primary. Stop ignores disabled.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.default: The draft is empty or the shell is disabled
rows.description: Disables send only.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Button size. The shell rounds it to the outer radius.

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 间距、气泡宽度和底部磨砂。单条消息可以自己覆盖。

rows.name: `scrollRef`
rows.description: 代替布局自己滚动的元素。不传时由布局滚动。自己滚动时底部停靠是 sticky，外部滚动时改成 fixed。

rows.name: `showScrollButton`
rows.description: 是否渲染内置的回到底部按钮。用 `scrollButton` 插槽替换，或者根本不需要这个按钮时设为 `false`。

rows.name: `isVisible`
rows.description: 胶囊是否可见。隐藏时仍挂在树上，方便淡出，并带 `inert`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 把胶囊拉宽。不传时只有向下的图标。无障碍名称回退到「滚动到底部」。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 传给没有自己设置密度的消息。

rows.name: `gap`
rows.description: 顶层行之间的间距，走间距刻度。只改间距，不改内边距。

rows.name: `scrollToTopAction`
rows.description: 顶部哨兵进入滚动容器时加载更早的消息。Promise 结束前显示加载指示。上一次还没结束时，再次进入不会重复触发。

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: 助手消息还在增长时设置 `aria-busy`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 日志的无障碍名称。

rows.name: `sender`
rows.description: 这条消息是谁发的。`system` 居中，头像、名字和元信息都忽略。

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: 纯文本名字。正文以气泡开头时，更适合把名字放在气泡上。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 只作用于这一行的密度。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: `filled` 有发送者底色。`ghost` 去掉背景和上下内边距，混排内容仍然对齐。

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: 与气泡内边距对齐的名字。

rows.name: `group`
rows.description: 多条气泡叠在一起时收紧一角。单独一条不用传。

rows.name: `timestamp`
rows.description: 时间等短文本。`timestamp` 插槽会替换它。

rows.name: `footer`
rows.description: 次要文字，例如模型名。`footer` 插槽会替换它。

rows.name: `status`
rows.description: 投递状态。时间、补充文字和状态都没有时，这一行不渲染。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: `default` 是居中的一行。`divider` 两侧各有一条线。根节点是 `role="status"`。

rows.name: `calls`
rows.description: 一轮回复里的工具调用。空数组不渲染。每项可以带 `name`、`status`、`target`、`duration`、`node`、`additions`、`deletions`、`stats`、`errorMessage`、`key`、`detail`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.default: 本地化的「{count} 个工具调用」
rows.description: 分组展开时的标题。

rows.name: `v-model:isExpanded`
rows.description: 多条调用这一组的受控展开状态。

rows.name: `defaultIsExpanded`
rows.description: `isExpanded` 未绑定时的初始状态。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 标题。

rows.name: `duration`
rows.description: 流式结束后跟在标题后面，例如 `12s`。

rows.name: `isStreaming`
rows.description: 标题闪动，并藏起预览和耗时。

rows.name: `v-model:isExpanded`
rows.description: 受控展开状态。

rows.name: `defaultIsExpanded`
rows.description: `isExpanded` 未绑定时的初始状态。

rows.name: `names`
rows.description: 正在输入的人。空字符串会被丢掉。不传名字时只有三个点。一个人、两个人、三个及以上各有一句文案。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 线末端的短标签。无障碍名称是「{label}以下是未读消息」。

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: 受控草稿，用 `v-model` 绑定。不传时由外壳自己保存。

rows.name: `placeholder`
rows.description: 草稿为空时的占位文字。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 停用编辑和发送。正在生成时如果显示停止，停止按钮仍然可以点。

rows.name: `density`
rows.description: 外壳内边距。宽松和均衡用同一套间距。

rows.name: `elevation`
rows.description: 低阴影在悬停和焦点时加深。none 是平的，靠边框区分。只有键盘把焦点放进编辑器时才画出焦点环。

rows.name: `isStopShown`
rows.description: 用停止代替发送。

rows.name: `status`
rows.description: 错误用 alert，警告用 status。

rows.name: `statusPosition`
rows.description: 状态条贴在外壳上方或下方，并伸进圆角后面。

rows.name: `modelValue`
rows.description: 单独受控时使用。放在外壳里且不传时，跟外壳的草稿走。

rows.name: `placeholder`
rows.default: 外壳或当前语言的占位

rows.description: 光标在开头时上方向键取回上一条已发送草稿，在末尾时下方向键往回走。

rows.name: `label`
rows.default: 当前语言的「消息输入框」
rows.description: 编辑器的无障碍名称。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 停用编辑。

rows.name: `pasteAsToken`
rows.description: 传 false 时长文本按原文插入。

rows.name: `pasteAction`
rows.description: 纯文本粘贴的第一站。返回 true 时输入框不再自己插入。

rows.name: `count`
rows.description: 传入后才能折叠，并显示在默认摘要里。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 摘要和展开、折叠的无障碍名称都用它。

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: 受控折叠，用 `v-model:is-collapsed`。

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: 未绑定时的初始状态。

rows.name: `isStopShown`
rows.description: 停止用次要按钮，发送用主要按钮。停止不受停用影响。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 只停用发送。

rows.description: 按钮尺寸。外壳会把圆角收成和外边框同心的圆形。

rows.name: `composer`
