summary.en: `Code` marks a short technical reference inside a sentence, such as a function name, a prop, a file path, or a command-line flag. It renders a semantic `<code>` element in a monospace font on a muted background, and it wraps long identifiers instead of pushing the surrounding paragraph wider.
summary.zh: `Code` 用来标注句子里的短技术引用，例如函数名、属性名、文件路径或者命令行参数。它渲染的是语义化的 `<code>` 元素，等宽字体配浅色底，长标识符会折行，而不会把整段文字撑宽。

usage.en: `Code` marks a short technical reference inside a sentence, such as a function name, a prop, a file path, or a command-line flag. It renders a semantic `` element in a monospace font on a muted background, and it wraps long identifiers instead of pushing the surrounding paragraph wider. `CodeBlock` presents a read-only snippet of one or more lines. It adds the parts a snippet needs to stand on its own: a header with a title and the language, a copy button, optional line numbers, optional highlighted lines, optional syntax highlighting, a bounded scroll area, and an optional collapse control. Both components are exported from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`. ```vue ``` The `language` prop selects the tokenizer. The built-in set covers `typescript`, `javascript`, `tsx`, `jsx`, `ts`, `js`, `json`, `html`, `xml`, `svg`, `css`, `scss`, `less`, `python`, `py`, `bash`, `sh`, `zsh`, `shell`, `php`, `hack`, `yaml`, `yml`, `markdown`, and `md`. Anything else, including `plaintext`, renders the code exactly as written without tokens, and `plaintext` also hides the language label because it says nothing the reader needs. A language the tokenizer does not know is not an error: you can also pass your own `tokenizer` function that returns tokens with absolute offsets, and it will be painted while the displayed and copied text stays the source string. The header appears when there is a title or a visible language label, and it is where the copy button lives. When neither exists, the copy button floats at the top end of the block instead, so copying stays available without a header. `hasLanguageLabel` turns the label off while keeping the header a title-only bar. Line numbers are off by default. Turn them on with `hasLineNumbers`; the gutter is sized to the widest line number so the code column starts at a stable offset. `highlightLines` takes one-indexed line numbers and tints those lines to draw attention to them. Set `isWrapped` when long lines should wrap rather than scroll sideways, and `maxHeight` to bound the height before the code scrolls vertically; `0` is a valid bound and means the body is fully collapsed to its header height. The block is as wide as its longest line by default: `width="fit-content"` keeps a short snippet compact with a floor, while `width="100%"` fills the parent. `container="section"` drops the border, radius, and background so a block sits inside a card or panel without painting a second surface. A long block can collapse. Set `isCollapsible` and the header becomes a disclosure control once the header is visible and the code reaches `collapsibleThreshold` lines, which is 10 by default. The block starts expanded, reports its state through `aria-expanded`, and points at the region it controls through `aria-controls`. While collapsed, that region stays mounted but `inert`, so the code is out of the tab order and out of the accessibility tree instead of sitting there invisibly. If the control disappears, for example because the title is removed, the block expands again on its own. The copy button writes the exact `code` string, so what a reader pastes always matches the source even when the display is tokenized, numbered, or wrapped. After a successful write the control name changes to `Copied`, the icon flips from a copy glyph to a check, and a polite live region announces the same word; the hover hint keeps reading `Copy code`, because the icon flip is the confirmation. A rejected clipboard write keeps the control in its resting state and emits nothing. `copyLabel`, `copiedLabel`, and `codeLabel` carry the English defaults and exist so an application can localize those strings. The code viewport is a named `role="group"` with a keyboard stop, so a keyboard user can scroll a snippet that overflows. The copy control and the collapse control are separate siblings, each with its own accessible name, so activating one never triggers the other. Syntax colors come from the `--astryx-code-syntax-*` tokens, and `highlightMode` chooses how they are painted: `auto` uses the CSS Custom Highlight API when the browser supports it well and falls back to spans, `ranges` paints through the API without adding any element to the code text, and `spans` wraps every token in an element. The text, the semantics, and the copy output are the same in all three.
usage.zh: `Code` 用来标注句子里的短技术引用，例如函数名、属性名、文件路径或者命令行参数。它渲染的是语义化的 `` 元素，等宽字体配浅色底，长标识符会折行，而不会把整段文字撑宽。 `CodeBlock` 用来展示一行或多行只读代码。它补齐了一段代码独立出现时需要的部分：带标题和语言名的头部、复制按钮、可选的行号、可选的高亮行、可选的语法着色、限高的滚动区域，以及可选的折叠控件。两个组件都从 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 导出。 ```vue ``` `language` 决定用哪套分词器。内置支持 `typescript`、`javascript`、`tsx`、`jsx`、`ts`、`js`、`json`、`html`、`xml`、`svg`、`css`、`scss`、`less`、`python`、`py`、`bash`、`sh`、`zsh`、`shell`、`php`、`hack`、`yaml`、`yml`、`markdown` 和 `md`。其他取值（包括 `plaintext`）都会原样显示，不做任何着色；`plaintext` 同时会隐藏语言标签，因为这个标签不提供任何信息。语言不认识不算错误：你也可以传入自己的 `tokenizer` 函数，返回带绝对偏移的 token，它只影响着色，显示和复制的文本始终是原始字符串。 标题或者可见的语言标签存在时会出现头部，复制按钮就放在头部里。两者都没有时，复制按钮会浮在代码块的右上角，所以没有头部也照样能复制。`hasLanguageLabel` 可以关掉语言标签，只留下标题。 行号默认关闭，用 `hasLineNumbers` 打开；行号栏的宽度按最大行号计算，所以代码列的起点是稳定的。`highlightLines` 接收从 1 开始的行号，把这些行加上底色以引起注意。长行不希望横向滚动时用 `isWrapped` 让它折行；用 `maxHeight` 限制高度，超出后纵向滚动，`0` 是合法取值，表示把正文收成和头部一样高。默认宽度贴着最长的一行：`width="fit-content"` 会让短代码保持紧凑（有一个最小宽度下限），`width="100%"` 则撑满父容器。`container="section"` 会去掉边框、圆角和背景，让代码块嵌在卡片或面板里时不再多画一层底色。 较长的代码块可以折叠。设置 `isCollapsible` 之后，只要头部可见并且代码行数达到 `collapsibleThreshold`（默认 10 行），头部就会变成折叠控件。代码块初始是展开的，通过 `aria-expanded` 报告状态，通过 `aria-controls` 指向被它控制的内容区域。折叠时这块区域仍然挂载，但会被设为 `inert`：它既不在 Tab 顺序里，也不在无障碍树上，不会变成一个看不见却能被键盘碰到的地方。如果控件消失了（例如标题被移除），代码块会自己重新展开。 复制按钮写入的是 `code` 原字符串，所以读者粘贴出来的内容和源码一致，不受着色、行号或者折行影响。写入成功后控件名称变为 `Copied`，图标从复制变成对勾，同时有一个礼貌的 live region 读出同一个词；悬停提示一直保持 `Copy code`，因为真正的确认是对勾。写入被拒绝时控件保持原状，也不触发任何事件。`copyLabel`、`copiedLabel`、`codeLabel` 带着英文默认值，用来做本地化。 代码视口是一个有名字的 `role="group"`，并且可以聚焦，键盘用户因此能滚动溢出的代码。复制按钮和折叠控件是并列的兄弟节点，各自有自己的无障碍名称，按下一个不会连带触发另一个。语法颜色来自 `--astryx-code-syntax-*` 这一组 token，`highlightMode` 决定着色方式：`auto` 在浏览器支持良好时使用 CSS Custom Highlight API，否则回退到 span；`ranges` 完全通过该 API 着色，代码文本里不会多出任何元素；`spans` 则把每个 token 包进一个元素。三种方式的文本、语义和复制结果完全相同。

en.text: Use `Code` for short references inside prose, such as a property name or a flag, and `CodeBlock` for anything that stands on its own or spans more than one line.
Set `language` to match the snippet so the tokens are accurate, and add a `title` when the code is a file. The title tells readers where the snippet came from.
Use `size="inherit"` on inline code inside larger or smaller text so the code matches the line it sits in.
Reach for `maxHeight` or `isCollapsible` on long snippets instead of nesting the block in your own scroll container.
Turn on line numbers for a two-line snippet. They add clutter without helping anyone find a line.
Put a paragraph of prose inside a `CodeBlock`, or use `Code` for a whole file. Each component has one job.
Rely on syntax colors alone to carry meaning. Tokens paint the code; they do not explain it.

zh.text: 只出现在句子里的短引用用 `Code`，能独立成立或者超过一行的代码用 `CodeBlock`。
让 `language` 和代码内容一致，着色才准确；代码来自某个文件时给一个 `title`，读者才知道它的出处。
行内代码出现在更大或更小的文字里时，用 `size="inherit"` 让它跟随所在行的大小。
长代码用 `maxHeight` 或者 `isCollapsible` 处理，不要再把它塞进自己的滚动容器里。
给两行的代码打开行号。它只会增加噪音，没有人需要靠它找第几行。
把整段说明文字放进 `CodeBlock`，或者用 `Code` 展示整个文件。每个组件只做一件事。
指望颜色单独说明含义。着色只是把代码染上颜色，它不做解释。

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: Text color of the inline code: `primary`, `secondary`, or `inherit` for the surrounding text color.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Font size. Omit it to use the code type scale, or set `inherit` to adopt the surrounding font size and line height.

rows.name: `code`
rows.description: The read-only code to display. This exact string is what the copy button writes, whatever the block paints.

rows.name: `language`
rows.description: Language used for syntax highlighting. An unknown language renders without tokens, and `plaintext` also hides the language label.

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: Filename or label shown in the header bar. A title alone creates the header.

rows.name: `hasLanguageLabel`
rows.description: Whether the language name appears in the header. It is never shown for `plaintext`.

rows.name: `hasLineNumbers`
rows.description: Whether to draw a line number gutter. The gutter is sized to the widest number.

rows.name: `highlightLines`
rows.description: One-indexed line numbers to emphasize with an accent background. Out-of-range numbers have no effect.

rows.name: `hasCopyButton`
rows.description: Whether to show the copy button, in the header when there is one and floating at the top end otherwise.

rows.name: `isWrapped`
rows.description: Whether long lines wrap instead of scrolling horizontally.

rows.name: `maxHeight`
rows.description: Maximum height before the code body scrolls vertically. Numbers are pixels, so `0` is a valid zero-pixel bound.

rows.name: `isCollapsible`
rows.description: Whether the header collapses the body. The control only appears when the header is visible and the code reaches `collapsibleThreshold` lines.

rows.name: `collapsibleThreshold`
rows.description: Number of lines a block needs before the collapse control appears.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Text size variant. `md` uses the code type scale and `sm` the supporting size.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Any CSS width value. `fit-content` shrinks to the longest line with a floor so a short snippet still reads as a block; `100%` fills the parent.

rows.name: `container`
rows.description: Container presentation. `card` paints a border, radius, and background; `section` drops all three so the block blends into the surface it sits in.

rows.name: `tokenizer`
rows.description: Custom tokenizer for a language the built-in one does not cover. Tokens use absolute offsets. It changes paint only, never the displayed or copied text.

rows.name: `highlightMode`
rows.description: How syntax tokens are painted. `auto` prefers the CSS Custom Highlight API and falls back to span elements.

rows.name: `copyLabel`
rows.description: Accessible name and hover hint of the copy button before a copy.

rows.name: `copiedLabel`
rows.description: Name of the copy button and text of the polite announcement after a successful copy.

rows.name: `codeLabel`
rows.description: Accessible name of the code viewport, and of a collapsible header that has no visible title or language label.

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: 行内代码的文字颜色：`primary`、`secondary`，或者 `inherit`（跟随周围文字）。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 字号。不传时使用代码字阶，传 `inherit` 则跟随周围的字号和行高。

rows.name: `code`
rows.description: 要展示的只读代码。无论代码块怎样着色，复制按钮写入的都是这个原字符串。

rows.name: `language`
rows.description: 着色使用的语言。不认识的语言不做着色，`plaintext` 还会隐藏语言标签。

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: 显示在头部栏的文件名或标签。只给标题也会生成头部。

rows.name: `hasLanguageLabel`
rows.description: 是否在头部显示语言名。语言为 `plaintext` 时始终不显示。

rows.name: `hasLineNumbers`
rows.description: 是否显示行号栏。行号栏宽度按最大行号计算。

rows.name: `highlightLines`
rows.description: 要从 1 开始高亮的行号，这些行会加上底色。超出范围的行号没有效果。

rows.name: `hasCopyButton`
rows.description: 是否显示复制按钮。有头部时放在头部，没有头部时浮在右上角。

rows.name: `isWrapped`
rows.description: 长行是否折行，而不是横向滚动。

rows.name: `maxHeight`
rows.description: 超过这个高度后代码正文纵向滚动。数字按像素处理，所以 `0` 是合法的零像素高度。

rows.name: `isCollapsible`
rows.description: 是否可以从头部折叠正文。只有头部可见并且行数达到 `collapsibleThreshold` 时才会出现折叠控件。

rows.name: `collapsibleThreshold`
rows.description: 出现折叠控件所需的行数。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 文字大小。`md` 使用代码字阶，`sm` 使用辅助文字字号。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 任意 CSS 宽度取值。`fit-content` 贴着最长一行（带一个最小宽度下限，短代码也仍然像一块代码），`100%` 撑满父容器。

rows.name: `container`
rows.description: 容器样式。`card` 带边框、圆角和背景；`section` 三者都去掉，让代码块融入所在的表面。

rows.name: `tokenizer`
rows.description: 内置分词器不覆盖的语言可以用它自定义。token 使用绝对偏移。它只影响着色，不会改变显示或复制的文本。

rows.name: `highlightMode`
rows.description: 语法着色的实现方式。`auto` 优先使用 CSS Custom Highlight API，不支持时回退到 span 元素。

rows.name: `copyLabel`
rows.description: 复制前复制按钮的无障碍名称和悬停提示。

rows.name: `copiedLabel`
rows.description: 复制成功后复制按钮的名称，以及礼貌播报的文本。

rows.name: `codeLabel`
rows.description: 代码视口的无障碍名称；当可折叠的头部没有可见标题和语言标签时，也用它作为头部的名称。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Inline code content for `Code`. `CodeBlock` takes its content from the `code` prop and renders no slot.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: `Code` 的行内代码内容。`CodeBlock` 的内容来自 `code` 属性，不渲染插槽。

rows.name: `copy`
rows.description: Emitted after the code string was written to the clipboard. A rejected write emits nothing.

rows.name: `copy`
rows.description: 代码字符串写入剪贴板之后触发。写入失败时不触发。

en.heading: Exports
en.text:
These are exported from `@astryx-vue/core/Code` beside `Code`, `CodeBlock`, and `SyntaxTheme`:

- `tokenize`: `(code, language) => TokenLine[]`
- `tokenizeAsync`: `(code, language, signal?) => Promise<TokenLine[]>`
- `flatTokensToLines`: `(tokens, code) => TokenLine[]`
- `applyHighlightRanges`: `(element, tokenLines) => () => void`
- `useCopyToClipboard`: `(options?) => { copy, isCopied }`
- `SYNC_TOKENIZE_THRESHOLD`: `number`
- `HIGHLIGHTED_TOKEN_TYPES`: `readonly string[]`
- `SyntaxTheme`: `component`

en.heading: CSS variables
en.text:
The block reads these tokens, which the neutral theme defines:

- `--astryx-font-family-code`: Monospace font stack for inline code, the block, and the header.
- `--astryx-text-code-size`: Font size of inline code and of an `md` block.
- `--astryx-code-background`: Background of inline code.
- `--astryx-code-block-background`: Background of the block and its sticky header. A `section` container sets it to transparent.
- `--astryx-code-block-border`: Border of a `card` container, the header divider, and the line number rule.
- `--astryx-code-block-focus`: Focus ring of the collapsible header control.
- `--astryx-code-block-highlight-background`: Background of a line listed in `highlightLines`.
- `--astryx-code-syntax-*`: Token colors: keyword, string, comment, number, function, type, variable, operator, constant, tag, attribute, property, and punctuation.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element of `Code` is a `<code>`, and the root element of `CodeBlock` is a `<pre>`.

The following go to that root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` and `style` are composed with the component's own, and a `width` in `style` wins over the `width` prop. The copy button, the code viewport, and the collapse region are internal elements with their own accessible names, so they are not addressed through the root.

zh.heading: 导出
zh.text:
除 `Code`、`CodeBlock` 和 `SyntaxTheme` 外，这些也从 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 导出：

- `tokenize`: `(code, language) => TokenLine[]`
- `tokenizeAsync`: `(code, language, signal?) => Promise<TokenLine[]>`
- `flatTokensToLines`: `(tokens, code) => TokenLine[]`
- `applyHighlightRanges`: `(element, tokenLines) => () => void`
- `useCopyToClipboard`: `(options?) => { copy, isCopied }`
- `SYNC_TOKENIZE_THRESHOLD`: `number`
- `HIGHLIGHTED_TOKEN_TYPES`: `readonly string[]`
- `SyntaxTheme`: `component`

zh.heading: 主题变量
zh.text:
代码块读取以下 token，neutral 主题已经给出默认值：

- `--astryx-font-family-code`: 行内代码、代码块和头部的等宽字体栈。
- `--astryx-text-code-size`: 行内代码和 `md` 代码块的字号。
- `--astryx-code-background`: 行内代码的背景色。
- `--astryx-code-block-background`: 代码块和吸顶头部的背景色。`section` 容器会把它设成透明。
- `--astryx-code-block-border`: `card` 容器的边框、头部下边框和行号分界线的颜色。
- `--astryx-code-block-focus`: 可折叠头部控件的焦点环颜色。
- `--astryx-code-block-highlight-background`: `highlightLines` 中列出的行的背景色。
- `--astryx-code-syntax-*`: 语法着色：keyword、string、comment、number、function、type、variable、operator、constant、tag、attribute、property、punctuation。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`Code` 的根元素是 `<code>`，`CodeBlock` 的根元素是 `<pre>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 和 `style` 会与组件自身的合并，`style` 里的 `width` 优先于 `width` 属性。复制按钮、代码视口和折叠区域是内部元素，各自有自己的无障碍名称，不通过根元素设置。

en.title: Text sizes
en.description: Inline code rendered inside heading, body, supporting, and label text. Code automatically matches the font size of its parent text element.

en.title: Inline
en.description: Inline code references mixed within a paragraph of body text. Use Code to mark up function names, hooks, or API terms so they stand out from surrounding prose.

en.title: Content types
en.description: Inline code used for variables, terminal commands, CSS properties, file paths, and keyboard shortcuts. Shows how Code adapts to different kinds of technical content.

zh.title: 字号
zh.description: 标题、正文、辅助文字和标签里的行内代码。代码会自动跟上父级文字的字号。

zh.title: 行内
zh.description: 正文段落里夹着的行内代码。用 Code 标出函数名、hook 或 API 术语，让它们从周围文字里跳出来。

zh.title: 内容类型
zh.description: 变量、终端命令、CSS 属性、文件路径和快捷键都可以放进行内代码，展示 Code 如何适应不同的技术内容。

en.name: Container
en.description: The semantic code element that contains the inline code content and paints the background, typography, padding, and radius.

zh.name: 容器
zh.description: 装着行内代码的 code 元素，负责背景、字体、内边距和圆角。

summary.en: `EmptyState` fills a region that has no content yet: a search that returned nothing, a list that is still empty, a page the user is visiting for the first time. It carries three things that a bare "No data" line does not — why the region is empty now, what will live there, and what the user can do about it.
summary.zh: `EmptyState` 用来占据一块暂时没有内容的区域：搜索没有结果、列表里还没有数据、用户第一次进入某个页面。它比一句干巴巴的“暂无数据”多给出三件事——这块区域现在为什么是空的、将来会有什么、用户此刻可以做什么。

usage.en:
`EmptyState` fills a region that has no content yet: a search that returned nothing, a list that is still empty, a page the user is visiting for the first time. It carries three things that a bare "No data" line does not — why the region is empty now, what will live there, and what the user can do about it. The component has four parts: an icon or illustration, a title, a description, and actions. Only `title` is required: ```vue ``` astryx-vue ships no icons of its own: what goes into the `icon` slot is yours. Put a CSS icon class there (an UnoCSS class such as `i-carbon-search`, for instance), or your own component or inline drawing. UnoCSS's icon preset makes the glyph fill its container, so give the element that carries the class a size; the example does it with an inline style, and a size class of your own works just as well. The icon or illustration goes into the `icon` slot. That slot sits inside an `aria-hidden="true"` wrapper, because the artwork only supports the text and should not be announced on its own; an icon placed there therefore needs no `label`. `title` renders as a heading, `h3` by default. `headingLevel` changes only the tag itself (h1–h6) so the title joins the document outline, and the title's size stays the same at every level — choosing `h2` does not make it larger. `description` takes a string, or richer content through the slot of the same name. It renders as a `
` rather than a `

`, so the slot can hold block content such as a list or a link: ```vue ``` Actions go into the `actions` slot, usually one or two of them, and they give the user a clear next step. Just like the title and the description, `title` and `description` also each have a slot of the same name that overrides the plain text passed as a prop. In tight places such as cards and sidebars, `isCompact` reduces the spacing and the text sizes, and stacks the actions in a column. The component carries `role="status"`, so when it appears after data finishes loading a screen reader announces it. Attributes you pass — `class`, `style`, `data-*`, and the rest — land on the root element, and an explicit `role` overrides that default.
usage.zh:
`EmptyState` 用来占据一块暂时没有内容的区域：搜索没有结果、列表里还没有数据、用户第一次进入某个页面。它比一句干巴巴的“暂无数据”多给出三件事——这块区域现在为什么是空的、将来会有什么、用户此刻可以做什么。 组件由四部分组成：图标或插图、标题、说明文字和操作按钮。其中只有 `title` 是必填的： ```vue ``` astryx-vue 不自带图标：`icon` 插槽里放什么由你决定，可以是图标库的 CSS 类（例如 UnoCSS 的 `i-carbon-search`），也可以是你自己的 SVG 组件或内联画。注意 UnoCSS 的图标预设会让图形铺满容器，所以要给承载类名的元素一个尺寸；上例用内联样式给出 24px，换成你自己的尺寸类也可以。 图标或插图放进 `icon` 插槽。插槽外面套了一层 `aria-hidden="true"` 的容器，因为插图只是文字的补充，不必让屏幕阅读器单独读出来；放在这里的图标因此也不需要设置 `label`。 `title` 会渲染成一个标题元素，默认是 `h3`。`headingLevel` 只改变标签本身（h1–h6），让标题能接上页面的文档大纲；标题的字号在任何级别下都相同，不会因为选择 `h2` 而变大。 `description` 可以传字符串，也可以用同名插槽传入更富的内容。它渲染成 `
` 而不是 `

`，所以插槽里可以放列表、链接这类块级内容： ```vue ``` 操作按钮放进 `actions` 插槽，通常是一到两个，给用户一个明确的下一步。与标题、说明一样，`title` 和 `description` 也都各有一个同名插槽，用来覆盖属性传入的纯文本。 在卡片、侧边栏这类空间有限的地方，加上 `isCompact` 会同时收紧间距和字号，操作按钮也从一行改为竖排。 组件自带 `role="status"`，当它在数据加载完成之后才出现时，屏幕阅读器会把内容读出来。传进来的 `class`、`style`、`data-*` 等属性会落到根元素上；显式给出的 `role` 会覆盖默认值。

en.text: Offer a clear next step next to the title, so the user knows what to do from here.
Use an icon or illustration that fits the situation, so the missing content is obvious at a glance.
Set `isCompact` inside cards and sidebars, where space is limited.
Leave the empty state without guidance. Always say what happened and what the user can do about it.
Write a generic message such as "No data". Be specific about what is empty and why.
Use an empty state for an error that needs immediate attention; use a [Banner](/components/banner) instead.

zh.text: 除了标题，再给出一个明确的下一步操作，让用户知道接下来能做什么。
用与场景相符的图标或插图，让人一眼看出缺的是什么内容。
卡片、侧边栏等空间有限的地方使用 `isCompact`。
只放一个空状态却不给任何指引；一定要说明发生了什么，以及用户可以做什么。
使用“暂无数据”这类宽泛的文案；要具体说明哪里是空的、为什么是空的。
用空状态承载需要用户立即处理的错误；那种情况应该改用 [Banner](/components/banner)。

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: The primary message, rendered as the heading of the empty state. Say what is empty ("No projects yet") instead of something generic like "No data".

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Secondary text below the title that explains why the area is empty or what the user can do next. Rendered as a `<div>`.

rows.name: `headingLevel`
rows.description: The semantic level of the title. It controls only the rendered HTML tag (h1–h6) so the title fits the document outline; the visual size of the title is the same at every level.

rows.name: `isCompact`
rows.description: Reduces the spacing and the text sizes for constrained areas such as cards and sidebars, and stacks the actions in a column.

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: 主要信息，渲染为空状态里的标题元素。要写清“什么是空的”，例如 “No projects yet”，避免 “No data” 这类宽泛说法。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 标题下方的辅助文字，解释这块区域为什么是空的，或者用户接下来可以做什么。渲染为 `<div>`。

rows.name: `headingLevel`
rows.description: 标题的语义级别，只决定渲染的 HTML 标签（h1–h6），使标题能接上文档大纲。标题的视觉大小在任何级别下都相同。

rows.name: `isCompact`
rows.description: 启用紧凑变体：收紧间距和文字大小，适用于卡片、侧边栏等空间受限的区域，操作按钮也会改为竖排。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: The icon or illustration above the title. Its wrapper carries `aria-hidden="true"`, so an icon placed here needs no `label`.

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: Rich content for the title. Overrides the `title` prop, for example to place a link inside the heading.

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: Rich content for the description. Overrides the `description` prop; because it renders as a `<div>`, it can hold block content such as a list.

rows.name: `actions`
rows.description: The actions below the text, usually one or two buttons. They sit in a row that wraps, and become a column when `isCompact` is true.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 标题上方的图标或插图。外层容器带有 `aria-hidden="true"`，因此放在这里的图标不需要设置 `label`。

rows.name: `title`
rows.description: 标题的富内容，会覆盖 `title` 属性，例如在标题里放一个链接。

rows.name: `description`
rows.description: 说明文字的富内容，会覆盖 `description` 属性。因为渲染为 `<div>`，这里可以放列表、链接等块级元素。

rows.name: `actions`
rows.description: 说明文字下方的操作按钮，通常是一到两个。默认横向排列并自动换行，`isCompact` 为 true 时改为竖向排列。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

The root element carries `role="status"` by default, and an explicit `role` overrides it.

en.text:
`packages/themes/neutral/empty-state.css` provides these tokens, which a theme can override:

- `--astryx-empty-state-title-foreground`: `--astryx-empty-state-title-foreground`
- `--astryx-empty-state-description-foreground`: `--astryx-empty-state-description-foreground`
- `--astryx-empty-state-text-width`: `--astryx-empty-state-text-width`

根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- `--astryx-empty-state-text-width`: `--astryx-empty-state-text-width`

en.title: Actions
en.description: Full empty state with icon, message, and action buttons. Use when a search returns no results, a filter clears all items, or a list has been emptied. The buttons give the user a way forward.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { EmptyState } from '@astryx-vue/core/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <EmptyState
    title="No results found"
    description="Try adjusting your search terms or clearing filters to see more results."
  >
    <template #icon>
      <Icon icon="i-heroicons-magnifying-glass" size="lg" />
    </template>
    <template #actions>
      <Button label="Go back" variant="secondary" />
      <Button label="Clear filters" variant="primary" />
    </template>
  </EmptyState>
</template>

en.title: Compact
en.description: Smaller empty state with reduced spacing for constrained areas. Use inside sidebar panels, card widgets, or notification drawers where a full-size empty state would overwhelm the layout.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { EmptyState } from '@astryx-vue/core/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>

<template>
  <EmptyState
    title="No notifications"
    description="You're all caught up. New notifications will appear here."
    is-compact
  >
    <template #icon>
      <Icon icon="i-heroicons-inbox" size="lg" />
    </template>
    <template #actions>
      <HStack :gap="2">
        <Button label="Settings" variant="secondary" size="sm" />
        <Button label="Refresh" variant="primary" size="sm" />
      </HStack>
    </template>
  </EmptyState>
</template>

en.title: Container
en.description: Empty state wrapped in a Card for first-time setup or onboarding. Use when the user has not created any items yet, like a project list that will fill once they take action.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { EmptyState } from '@astryx-vue/core/EmptyState'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Card>
    <EmptyState
      title="No projects yet"
      description="Create your first project to start organizing your work. You can invite team members after."
    >
      <template #icon>
        <Icon icon="i-heroicons-folder-plus" size="lg" />
      </template>
      <template #actions>
        <Button label="Import" variant="secondary" />
        <Button label="Create project" variant="primary" />
      </template>
    </EmptyState>
  </Card>
</template>

zh.title: 操作
zh.description: 带图标、说明和操作按钮的完整空状态。搜索没有结果、筛选清空列表，或列表被清空时使用。按钮给用户下一步。

    </template>

      <Button label="Go back" variant="secondary" />

        <Button label="Refresh" variant="primary" size="sm" />

zh.description: 放在 Card 里的空状态，适合首次设置或引导。用户还没创建任何内容时使用，例如项目列表。
zh.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'

en.name: Icon
en.description: A visual cue above the title that reinforces the context, like a search icon for no results.

en.name: Title
en.description: Primary message explaining what is empty: "No projects yet" not "No data".

en.name: Description
en.description: Additional context explaining why it is empty or what the user can do.

en.name: Actions
en.description: One or two buttons guiding the user to a next step, like "Create project" or "Clear filters".

zh.name: 图标
zh.description: 标题上方的视觉提示，用来强化语境，比如没有结果时的搜索图标。

zh.name: 标题
zh.description: 说明空的是什么。写「还没有项目」，不要写「没有数据」。

zh.name: 说明
zh.description: 补充为什么是空的，或者用户可以做什么。

zh.name: 操作

summary.en: Choose `level` to match the document outline; avoid skipping levels.
summary.zh: `Heading` 用于渲染页面和区块的标题：`level` 决定语义层级（h1–h6），`type` 可以在不改变语义的前提下调整视觉样式，两者搭配能同时照顾文档结构与视觉设计。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

usage.en:
Import the component from its dedicated entry. Structural styles are loaded automatically.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
</script>

<template>
  <Heading :level="1">
    Page title
  </Heading>
  <Heading :level="2" type="display-2">
    Overview
  </Heading>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Heading` 用于渲染页面和区块的标题：`level` 决定语义层级（h1–h6），`type` 可以在不改变语义的前提下调整视觉样式，两者搭配能同时照顾文档结构与视觉设计。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
</script>

<template>
  <Heading :level="1">
    页面标题
  </Heading>
  <Heading :level="2" type="display-2">
    数据概览
  </Heading>
</template>
```

en.text: Choose `level` to match the document outline; avoid skipping levels.
Use `type="display-*"` for marketing or large callouts while keeping the semantic `level`.
Use `color="secondary"` for lower-emphasis headings.
Pick a `level` purely for visual size. Use `type` for visuals and `level` for semantics.
Put long paragraphs inside headings. Keep headings short.

zh.text: 按文档大纲选择 `level`，保持层级连贯、不跳级，屏幕阅读器和搜索引擎才能正确理解页面结构。
需要营销页或大号展示效果时，用 `type="display-*"` 覆盖视觉样式，同时保留语义正确的 `level`。
层级较低的次要标题可以使用 `color="secondary"`，让它在视觉上退后一步，主要标题更突出。
为了视觉大小而选用与页面结构不符的 `level`：视觉样式交给 `type` 控制，语义层级仍由 `level` 决定。
在标题中塞入长段落：标题应简短概括内容，详细说明放到正文里。

rows.name: `display`

rows.name: `textWrap`

rows.name: `level`

rows.description: 视觉类型变体，可选 display-1、display-2、display-3、body、large、label、supporting。

rows.name: `color`

rows.name: `weight`

rows.name: `display`

rows.name: `accessibilityLevel`
rows.description: 和视觉 `level` 不同时，读屏使用的大纲级别。元素仍是 `h{level}`。

rows.name: `textWrap`
rows.description: CSS `text-wrap`。

rows.name: `wordBreak`

summary.en: `Kbd` presents a keyboard shortcut as a small group of painted key badges, such as `⌘K` or `⇧↵`. It belongs next to the action it triggers — on the right of a menu item, inside a tooltip, or at the end of a line of help text — so you can mention the shortcut without writing out "hold Command and press K".
summary.zh: `Kbd` 把一段键盘快捷键画成一组按键徽章，例如 `⌘K`、`⇧↵`。它常出现在菜单项、工具提示和帮助文字里，让你在说明某个操作时顺带告诉用户它的快捷方式，而不必用一句“先按住 Command 再按 K”来描述。

usage.en:
`Kbd` presents a keyboard shortcut as a small group of painted key badges, such as `⌘K` or `⇧↵`. It belongs next to the action it triggers — on the right of a menu item, inside a tooltip, or at the end of a line of help text — so you can mention the shortcut without writing out "hold Command and press K".

Pass the shortcut as one string and separate the keys with `+`:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Kbd } from '@astryx-vue/core/Kbd'
</script>

<template>
  <Kbd keys="mod+k" />
</template>
```

Every segment becomes its own badge, so `mod+k` paints two keys. Whitespace around a segment is ignored and the case does not matter, which makes `mod + K` and `mod+k` the same shortcut. Anything the component does not recognize is uppercased as written, so `f1` shows as `F1`.

`mod` is the one key that follows the platform: it reads as `⌘` on Apple platforms and as `Ctrl` everywhere else. Reach for `mod` when you describe a shortcut that works across platforms, and use `ctrl` only when the shortcut really is bound to the Control key. The other named keys have a fixed glyph:

`esc` is an alias for `escape`, and `return` is an alias for `enter`; an alias paints and is announced exactly like the key it names. Because `+` separates the keys, write `plus` for the plus key itself, as in `shift+plus`.

To a screen reader the whole group is one image named "Command + K"; the glyphs inside the badges are hidden because `⌘` and `⇧` are announced as nothing useful. The keys are spoken as words instead. Note that `Kbd` only presents a shortcut: it does not listen for keystrokes, and the shortcut still has to be implemented by the product.
usage.zh:
`Kbd` 把一段键盘快捷键画成一组按键徽章，例如 `⌘K`、`⇧↵`。它常出现在菜单项、工具提示和帮助文字里，让你在说明某个操作时顺带告诉用户它的快捷方式，而不必用一句“先按住 Command 再按 K”来描述。

快捷键用字符串传入，按键之间用 `+` 分隔：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Kbd } from '@astryx-vue/core/Kbd'
</script>

<template>
  <Kbd keys="mod+k" />
</template>
```

每个分段都会得到一枚独立的徽章，所以 `mod+k` 会画出两枚按键。分段周围的空格会被忽略，大小写也不敏感，`mod + K` 和 `mod+k` 完全等价；无法识别的分段会原样转成大写，例如 `f1` 显示为 `F1`。

`mod` 是唯一会随平台变化的按键：在 Apple 平台上它显示为 `⌘`，在其他平台上显示为 `Ctrl`。因此描述跨平台快捷键时优先写 `mod`，只有快捷键确实固定在某一侧修饰键上时才写 `ctrl`。其余具名按键都有固定的字形：

`esc` 是 `escape` 的别名，`return` 是 `enter` 的别名，两者的渲染和朗读完全一致。由于 `+` 本身是分隔符，要表示加号键请写 `plus`，例如 `shift+plus`。

对屏幕阅读器来说，整组按键是一个名为 “Command + K” 的整体，徽章里的图形字符不会被逐个朗读——`⌘`、`⇧` 这类字形读出来没有意义，所以组件改用 `Command`、`Shift` 这样的词来描述这组快捷键。这也意味着 `Kbd` 只负责提示，它不会真的监听键盘，快捷键本身需要在产品里真正实现。

en.text: Place the shortcut next to the action it triggers: on the right of a menu item, in a tooltip, or straight after the wording it belongs to.
Describe a cross-platform shortcut with `mod` rather than `ctrl` or `cmd`, so macOS users read `⌘` and everyone else reads `Ctrl`.
Only mention shortcuts that exist and can actually be pressed in the current context. A wrong hint is worse than no hint.
Spell shortcuts the same way as the rest of the product, so documentation and settings never disagree.
Treat `Kbd` as the only way to discover an action. Shortcuts supplement visible controls, they do not replace them.
Scatter shortcut hints across a screen. They are supporting information; in bulk they drown out the content.
Hand-write `⌘` or `⇧` characters instead of using the component. Hand-written glyphs do not follow the platform, and screen readers cannot announce what they mean.

zh.text: 把快捷键放在它触发的操作旁边：菜单项右侧、工具提示里，或紧跟在说明文字之后。
用 `mod` 而不是 `ctrl` 或 `cmd` 描述跨平台快捷键，让 macOS 用户看到 `⌘`，其他用户看到 `Ctrl`。
只提示已经实现、并且在当前上下文里真的能按下的快捷键。错误的提示比没有提示更让人受挫。
快捷键的写法与产品文档、设置页保持一致，避免同一个操作出现两种写法。
把 `Kbd` 当作发现操作的唯一途径。快捷键是可见控件的补充，不是替代品。
在一个界面里堆满快捷键提示。这类提示属于次要信息，出现得太频繁就会盖过正文。
为了省事手写 `⌘`、`⇧` 等字符代替组件。手写的字符不会随平台切换，屏幕阅读器也读不出它们的含义。

rows.description: Required. The keyboard shortcut to present, with the keys separated by `+`, such as `"mod+k"` or `"shift+plus"`. Each segment paints one key badge; whitespace around a segment is ignored, and an unrecognized segment is uppercased.

en.heading: Key names
en.text:
A segment that is not in this table is painted uppercased as written and spoken as that same text, so `f1` paints as `F1`.

- `mod`: `mod`
- `ctrl`: `ctrl`
- `alt`: `alt`
- `shift`: `shift`
- `enter` / `return`: `enter` / `return`
- `backspace`: `backspace`
- `tab`: `tab`
- `escape` / `esc`: `escape` / `esc`
- `up`: `up`
- `down`: `down`
- `left`: `left`
- `right`: `right`
- `plus`: `plus`

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text: The root element carries `role="img"` and an `aria-label` assembled from the spoken key names, so `keys="mod+k"` is announced as "Control + K". The badges themselves are `aria-hidden="true"`, because the glyphs they paint mean nothing to assistive technology. `role` and `aria-label` are computed by the component, and a consumer value for either is ignored; every other `aria-*` attribute passes through.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<span>`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes, except `role` and `aria-label` (see the previous section).
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

zh.heading: 按键名称
zh.text:
表中没有列出的分段按大写原样显示，朗读时读同一段文字，例如 `f1` 显示为 `F1`。

- `mod`: `mod`
- `ctrl`: `ctrl`
- `alt`: `alt`
- `shift`: `shift`
- `enter` / `return`: `enter` / `return`
- `backspace`: `backspace`
- `tab`: `tab`
- `escape` / `esc`: `escape` / `esc`
- `up`: `up`
- `down`: `down`
- `left`: `left`
- `right`: `right`
- `plus`: `plus`

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text: 根元素带有 `role="img"`，它的 `aria-label` 由各按键的朗读词拼接而成，例如 `keys="mod+k"` 得到 “Control + K”。徽章本身带有 `aria-hidden="true"`，因为它们画出的字形对屏幕阅读器没有意义。`role` 和 `aria-label` 由组件计算，显式传入的同名属性会被忽略，其他 `aria-*` 属性可以正常传入。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<span>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性（`role` 和 `aria-label` 除外，见上一节）。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

summary.en: `Markdown` renders a Markdown source as prose. It covers headings, paragraphs, emphasis, links, inline code, code blocks, quotes, lists, task lists, tables, thematic breaks, and images. Tables, strikethrough, and task lists follow GFM. Angle-bracket URLs and emails are always links. A bare URL, a `www.` host, or a bare email becomes a link only when `autolink` is `gfm`. Trailing sentence punctuation stays outside the link.
summary.zh: `Markdown` 把 Markdown 源码渲染成正文。标题、段落、强调、链接、行内代码、代码块、引用、列表、任务列表、表格、分隔线和图片都可以用。表格、删除线和任务列表按 GFM 处理。尖括号里的网址和邮箱一直是链接。裸网址、`www.` 开头的主机名和裸邮箱，要等 `autolink` 设为 `gfm` 才变成链接。句末的标点留在链接外面。

usage.en:
`Markdown` renders a Markdown source as prose. It covers headings, paragraphs, emphasis, links, inline code, code blocks, quotes, lists, task lists, tables, thematic breaks, and images. Tables, strikethrough, and task lists follow GFM. Angle-bracket URLs and emails are always links. A bare URL, a `www.` host, or a bare email becomes a link only when `autolink` is `gfm`. Trailing sentence punctuation stays outside the link.

Import it from its own entry. Structural styles load with the component. Import the theme once in the application entry:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Markdown } from '@astryx-vue/core/Markdown'
</script>

<template>
  <Markdown content="## Title\n\nA **note**." />
</template>
```

When `content` is omitted, text in the default slot is the source. The slot reads text only. It does not accept nodes that are already rendered.

Links have control characters removed. `javascript:`, `vbscript:`, and `data:text/html` do not become clickable targets; the link text stays. Images also reject every `data:` URL. Raw HTML is never executed. Tags are shown as text.

Code blocks go through the existing `CodeBlock`, quotes through `Blockquote`, headings through `Heading`, and links through `Link`. Lists and tables use semantic elements, because the existing `List` component and the table export are interface controls rather than prose.

`components` replaces the renderer for one kind of node. A custom component receives the node data as props and, when the node has content, that content as the default slot.

`plugins` run on the parsed tree. `transform` receives the root and returns the next one. Return the same root when nothing changed, so a streaming render can keep settled blocks. `render` draws an `extension` node whose `plugin` equals that name. `inlinePlugins` match ordinary text nodes. `pattern` needs the `g` flag. Earlier plugins match first, and the first plugin wins when two matches overlap. Inline code and fenced code are left alone. `replace` returns the node that takes the match, or `null` to skip it. An extension node is drawn by the plugin `render` of the same `name`. A `link` node uses the normal link renderer.

`defineMarkdownPlugin` returns the plugin object unchanged, which narrows the type. `isMarkdownExtensionNode` checks that a node belongs to a plugin.

With `sources`, `[id]` and `【id】` render as citation chips. `citationStyle` defaults to `label`, which shows the source title. `number` shows a compact badge, and the same id keeps the same number.

A fence info string of `diff` or `diff-ts` turns the diff layer on for the built-in code block. A custom `components.code` still receives the info string as written.

`isStreaming` turns on streaming. While content is only appended, a block that has already closed keeps its rendered node, and only the last unfinished block is parsed again. New text fades in with `--astryx-duration-fast-max`. When the system prefers reduced motion, the fade is skipped.

`isStreaming` does not reveal the string character by character. Use `useStreamingText` for that, then pass its string as `content`. Markdown does not smooth that string again. To simulate a model, pass the accumulated source as `content` and leave `isStreaming` on until the reply is finished.

This version does not render math.
usage.zh:
`Markdown` 把 Markdown 源码渲染成正文。标题、段落、强调、链接、行内代码、代码块、引用、列表、任务列表、表格、分隔线和图片都可以用。表格、删除线和任务列表按 GFM 处理。尖括号里的网址和邮箱一直是链接。裸网址、`www.` 开头的主机名和裸邮箱，要等 `autolink` 设为 `gfm` 才变成链接。句末的标点留在链接外面。

从独立入口导入，结构样式会随组件加载。主题在应用入口引入一次：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Markdown } from '@astryx-vue/core/Markdown'
</script>

<template>
  <Markdown content="## 标题\n\n一段 **说明**。" />
</template>
```

`content` 没传时，默认插槽里的文本会当作源码。插槽只读取文本，不接受已经渲染好的节点。

链接会去掉控制字符。`javascript:`、`vbscript:` 和 `data:text/html` 不会变成可点击的地址，只留下链接文字。图片另外拒绝所有 `data:` 地址。原始 HTML 不会执行，标签会按普通文字显示。

代码块交给已有的 `CodeBlock`，引用交给 `Blockquote`，标题交给 `Heading`，链接交给 `Link`。列表和表格用语义元素，因为现有的 `List` 和表格组件是界面控件，不是正文排版。

`components` 可以换掉某一类节点的渲染。自定义组件通过 props 拿到节点数据，有内容的节点还会收到默认插槽。

`plugins` 挂在解析之后的语法树上。`transform` 拿到根节点，返回下一棵树；没有改动时把原来的根返回去，流式渲染才能继续复用已经稳定的块。`render` 画出 `type` 为 `extension`、并且 `plugin` 等于这个名字的节点。`inlinePlugins` 只在普通文本里做匹配，`pattern` 要带 `g`。列表里靠前的先匹配，同一位置重叠时前面的赢。行内代码和围栏代码不会被碰到。`replace` 返回替换进去的节点，返回 `null` 就跳过这次匹配。扩展节点如果带了 `name`，就由同名插件的 `render` 来画；返回一个普通的 `link` 节点时，走原来的链接渲染。

`defineMarkdownPlugin` 把插件对象原样返回，用来收窄类型。`isMarkdownExtensionNode` 用来确认一个节点是不是某个插件的扩展节点。

传入 `sources` 后，正文里的 `[id]` 和 `【id】` 会画成引用芯片。`citationStyle` 默认 `label`，芯片上是来源标题。设成 `number` 后变成带序号的小徽章，同一个 id 共用一个序号。

围栏信息是 `diff` 或 `diff-ts` 这种时，默认的代码块会打开差异层。换掉 `components.code` 时，语言字符串仍原样传进去。

`isStreaming` 打开流式模式。内容只在末尾追加时，已经闭合的块保持原来的节点，只重新解析最后一个还没写完的块。新出现的文字用 `--astryx-duration-fast-max` 淡入。系统开启「减少动态效果」时不播放淡入。

`isStreaming` 不做逐字平滑。字符级揭示用 `useStreamingText`，再把返回的字符串交给 `content`。组件不会把这段字符串再平滑一次。模拟模型输出时，把累积的原文交给 `content`，并在输出结束前保持 `isStreaming` 即可。

这一版不渲染数学公式。

en.text: Use it for model replies, documentation excerpts, and explanatory prose.
While streaming, only append text, and set `isStreaming` back to `false` when the reply is done.
For a character reveal, call `useStreamingText` once and pass the result as `content`. `isStreaming` handles block parsing and the fade, and does not smooth again.
Set `contentWidth` when the line length should be capped. Without it, prose uses the container width.
Put user-supplied HTML in the source and expect it to run. The component shows it as text.
Replace the whole source while `isStreaming` is `true`. The cache assumes the text only grows at the end.

zh.text: 用它排模型回复、文档摘录和说明文字。
流式输出时只追加文本，结束时把 `isStreaming` 设回 `false`。
需要逐字揭示时，只调用一次 `useStreamingText`，把结果交给 `content`。`isStreaming` 负责分块解析和淡入，不会再平滑。
需要限制行宽时设置 `contentWidth`。不设置时正文跟容器一样宽。
把用户提供的 HTML 塞进源码，指望它被执行。组件会把它当成文字。
在 `isStreaming` 为 `true` 时整段替换已经显示的内容。缓存按「只追加」设计。

en.heading: Composable
en.text:
`useStreamingText(targetText, isStreaming?, options?)` turns a growing string into a steady reveal. `options.speed` is `natural`, `fast`, or `instant`. When streaming is off, or the user prefers reduced motion, the full source is returned.

Character smoothing stays in this composable. Pass its result to `Markdown` as `content`, and set `isStreaming` for block parsing and the fade. Do not wrap that result in `useStreamingText` again.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
A block root is a `<div role="document">`. An inline root is a `<span>`.

The following are passed to the root:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

A provided `role` is used as given.

zh.heading: 组合式函数
zh.text:
`useStreamingText(targetText, isStreaming?, options?)` 把一段不断变长的文本平滑成稳定的揭示。`options.speed` 可以是 `natural`、`fast` 或 `instant`。未在流式输出，或用户偏好减少动态效果时，直接返回全文。

字符级平滑只放在这一层。把返回值交给 `Markdown` 的 `content`，并用 `isStreaming` 打开分块解析和淡入。不要在 `Markdown` 外面再套一次 `useStreamingText`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
块级渲染的根元素是 `<div role="document">`，行内渲染是 `<span>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

传入 `role` 时使用传入的值。

en.title: Markdown — Plugins
en.description: A block plugin turns a Note paragraph into a callout, an inline plugin turns @name into a link, and autolink links the bare URL.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { MarkdownInlinePlugin, MarkdownPlugin } from '@astryx-vue/core/Markdown'
import { Markdown } from '@astryx-vue/core/Markdown'
import { defineComponent, h } from 'vue'

const NoteCallout = defineComponent({
  name: 'NoteCallout',
  props: {
    value: { type: String, default: '' },
  },
  setup(props) {
    return () => h('p', { class: 'markdown-plugin-note' }, props.value)
  },
})

const plugins: MarkdownPlugin[] = [{
  name: 'note',
  transform(root) {
    const children = (root.children ?? []).map((node) => {
      const text = node.children?.[0]
      if (node.type !== 'paragraph' || text?.type !== 'text' || !text.value?.startsWith('Note: '))
        return node
      return {
        type: 'extension',
        plugin: 'note',
        name: 'callout',
        display: 'block' as const,
        value: text.value.slice('Note: '.length),
      }
    })
    return { ...root, children }
  },
  render(node) {
    return h(NoteCallout, { value: node.value ?? '' })
  },
}]

const inlinePlugins: MarkdownInlinePlugin[] = [{
  name: 'mention',
  pattern: /@([A-Z]+)/gi,
  replace(match) {
    const name = match[1] ?? ''
    return {
      type: 'link',
      url: `https://example.com/people/${name}`,
      children: [{ type: 'text', value: `@${name}` }],
    }
  },
}]

const content = [
  'Note: a bare URL keeps its trailing period outside the link.',
  '',
  'Ask @Ada, then read https://example.com/notes.',
].join('\n')
</script>

<template>
  <Markdown
    :content="content"
    autolink="gfm"
    :inline-plugins="inlinePlugins"
    :plugins="plugins"
  />
</template>

<style scoped>
.markdown-plugin-note {
  margin: 0;
  padding-inline-start: 12px;
  border-inline-start: 2px solid var(--astryx-color-border, #ebebeb);
  color: var(--astryx-color-text-secondary, #525252);
}
</style>

summary.en: Use `type` for semantic hierarchy: `large` for emphasis, `supporting` for hints, `label` for form labels.
summary.zh: `Text` 用于渲染正文、辅助说明、表单标签等文字内容，`type` 提供了一套预设的字号、字重和行高组合，让整站文字风格保持一致。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

usage.en:
Import the component from its dedicated entry. Structural styles are loaded automatically.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <Text type="body">
    Body content
  </Text>
  <Text type="supporting">
    Supporting details
  </Text>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Text` 用于渲染正文、辅助说明、表单标签等文字内容，`type` 提供了一套预设的字号、字重和行高组合，让整站文字风格保持一致。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <Text type="body">
    正文内容
  </Text>
  <Text type="supporting">
    辅助说明
  </Text>
</template>
```

en.text: Use `type` for semantic hierarchy: `large` for emphasis, `supporting` for hints, `label` for form labels.
Set `as="p"` or `display="block"` when you need block-level layout.
Use `maxLines` to clamp long text to a fixed number of lines.
Use `Text` in place of `Heading`. Headings should use the `Heading` component for correct semantics.
Mix too many `type` and `size` combinations in the same short passage.

zh.text: 通过 `type` 表达文字的语义层级：`large` 用于强调性内容，`supporting` 用于辅助说明，`label` 用于表单标签。
需要块级布局时，把 `as` 设为 `p` 或将 `display` 设为 `block`，默认的行内元素不利于控制间距。
对可能超出容器的长文本设置 `maxLines`，超出部分会自动截断并显示省略号，避免撑破布局。
用 `Text` 充当标题：标题请使用 `Heading` 组件，才能保证文档大纲对辅助技术可见。
在同一小段文字中混用过多 `type` 和 `size`：样式变化过多会打断阅读节奏。

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: Semantic text type. Determines default size, weight, and line-height. Optional: body, large, label, supporting, code, display-1, display-2, display-3.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Explicit font size override. Optional: sm, md, lg, xl.

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: Text color. Optional: primary, secondary, accent, disabled, placeholder, inherit.

rows.name: `weight`
rows.description: Font weight override. Optional: regular, normal, medium, semibold, bold. normal is the same weight as regular.

rows.name: `textWrap`
rows.description: Wrapping behavior: wrap, nowrap, balance, or pretty.

rows.name: `wordBreak`
rows.description: How a long unbroken string breaks: normal, break-word, or break-all.

rows.name: `hasStrikethrough`
rows.description: Draws a line through the text.

rows.name: `hasTabularNumbers`
rows.description: Uses tabular figures so digits line up across rows.

rows.name: `display`
rows.description: Display type: `inline` or `block`.

rows.name: `as`
rows.description: HTML element to render. Optional: span, p, div, label.

rows.name: `justify`
rows.description: Text alignment. `start` and `end` follow the writing direction.

rows.name: `hasTruncateTooltip`
rows.description: Puts the full text in a tooltip after truncation. `false` turns it off. It stays closed when the text fits.

rows.name: `maxLines`
rows.description: Maximum lines before truncation. 0 means no truncation. A positive value forces block layout so the ellipsis has a width.

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: 语义文本类型，可选 body、large、label、supporting、code、display-1、display-2、display-3。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 显式字号覆盖，可选 sm、md、lg、xl。

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: 文字颜色，可选 primary、secondary、accent、disabled、placeholder、inherit。

rows.name: `weight`
rows.description: 字重覆盖，可选 regular、normal、medium、semibold、bold。normal 与 regular 相同。

rows.name: `textWrap`
rows.description: 换行方式，可选 wrap、nowrap、balance、pretty。

rows.name: `wordBreak`
rows.description: 长词如何断开，可选 normal、break-word、break-all。

rows.name: `hasStrikethrough`
rows.description: 给文字加删除线。

rows.name: `hasTabularNumbers`
rows.description: 使用等宽数字，方便多行数字对齐。

rows.name: `display`
rows.description: 显示类型：`inline` 或 `block`。

rows.name: `as`
rows.description: 实际渲染的 HTML 元素，可选 span、p、div、label。

rows.name: `justify`
rows.description: 对齐方式。`start` 和 `end` 跟随书写方向。

rows.name: `hasTruncateTooltip`
rows.description: 截断之后要不要把全文放进提示。`false` 关掉。没被截断时不会弹出。

rows.name: `maxLines`
rows.description: 最大显示行数，超出部分截断并显示省略号，0 表示不截断。大于 0 时会改成块级，省略号才有宽度可用。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is determined by `as`, defaulting to `<span>`.

The following are passed to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素由 `as` 决定，默认为 `<span>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

summary.en: `Thumbnail` is a 64px preview. With no `src` it shows a placeholder. `isLoading` without `src` is a skeleton. `isLoading` with `src` covers the image with a spinner. Listen for `click` to make the preview a button, and for `remove` to show the dismiss control.
summary.zh: `Thumbnail` 是 64px 的预览。没有 `src` 时是占位图。只有 `isLoading`、没有 `src` 时是骨架。两者都有时，图片上盖一层加载指示。监听 `click` 后，预览变成按钮。监听 `remove` 后，出现关闭按钮。

usage.en:
`Thumbnail` is a 64px preview. With no `src` it shows a placeholder. `isLoading` without `src` is a skeleton. `isLoading` with `src` covers the image with a spinner. Listen for `click` to make the preview a button, and for `remove` to show the dismiss control.

`showRemoveOn` is `hover` by default. The control also appears on keyboard focus, and it stays visible for a coarse pointer. `always` keeps it visible. `isDisabled` fades the thumbnail and ignores both events.

`label` is the accessible name. It is not drawn on the thumbnail. It is used by the tooltip and by the remove button.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Thumbnail } from '@astryx-vue/core/Thumbnail'
</script>

<template>
  <Thumbnail src="/photo.jpg" alt="Snowy mountain peaks" label="snowy-peaks.jpg" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Thumbnail` 是 64px 的预览。没有 `src` 时是占位图。只有 `isLoading`、没有 `src` 时是骨架。两者都有时，图片上盖一层加载指示。监听 `click` 后，预览变成按钮。监听 `remove` 后，出现关闭按钮。

`showRemoveOn` 默认是 `hover`。键盘焦点时也会出现，粗指针设备上则一直可见。`always` 让它一直可见。`isDisabled` 会把缩略图调淡，并忽略点击和移除。

`label` 是无障碍名称，不会画在方块上。提示和移除按钮都会用到它。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Thumbnail } from '@astryx-vue/core/Thumbnail'
</script>

<template>
  <Thumbnail src="/photo.jpg" alt="雪山" label="snowy-peaks.jpg" />
</template>
```

en.text: Give `alt` what the image shows, and `label` the file name a person would use to remove it.
Use `showRemoveOn="always"` when the pointer may be coarse, or when removal is the main action.
Keep a placeholder until a file has a preview, then pass `src`.
Put the file name in the visible square. The tooltip already carries `label`.
Attach `click` and expect it to fire while `isDisabled` or `isLoading` is set.

rows.name: `src`
rows.description: Image URL. A failed load falls back to the placeholder for that `src`.

rows.name: `alt`
rows.description: Alternative text for the image.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name. Not drawn. Used by the tooltip and the remove button.

rows.name: `isLoading`
rows.description: Skeleton when there is no `src`. Spinner over the image when there is one.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Fades the thumbnail and ignores click and remove.

rows.name: `showRemoveOn`
rows.description: When the remove button is visible. `hover` also reveals it on keyboard focus, and keeps it visible for a coarse pointer.

rows.name: `src`
rows.description: 图片地址。加载失败时，这一张回退到占位图。

rows.name: `alt`
rows.description: 图片的替代文字。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 无障碍名称，不画出来。提示和移除按钮都会用到。

en.description: A row of clickable thumbnails with labels that open a detail view. Use for image attachment lists where users need to preview and manage uploads.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ThumbnailScene } from './images'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Thumbnail } from '@astryx-vue/core/Thumbnail'
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { thumbnailScenes } from './images'

const items = ref<ThumbnailScene[]>([...thumbnailScenes])
const selected = ref<string | null>(null)

function remove(id: number) {
  items.value = items.value.filter(item => item.id !== id)
}

    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">

        :key="item.id"
        :src="item.src"
        :alt="item.alt"
        :label="item.label"
        show-remove-on="always"
        @click="selected = item.label"
        @remove="remove(item.id)"
      />
    </Stack>
    <Text v-if="selected" type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Selected: {{ selected }}
    </Text>
  </Stack>
</template>

summary.en: `Timestamp` renders one instant in a `<time>` element. `value` is an ISO string or a unix timestamp in seconds. The default format is `auto`: a relative phrase while the instant is inside `autoThreshold` (seven days), then `date_time`.
summary.zh: `Timestamp` 用 `<time>` 画出一个时刻。`value` 是 ISO 字符串，或按秒计的 unix 时间。默认格式是 `auto`：在 `autoThreshold`（七天）以内用相对时间，更早的用 `date_time`。

usage.en:
`Timestamp` renders one instant in a `<time>` element. `value` is an ISO string or a unix timestamp in seconds. The default format is `auto`: a relative phrase while the instant is inside `autoThreshold` (seven days), then `date_time`.

`hasTooltip` is on by default and opens a hover card that can be copied. Pass `tooltipEntries` to list the same instant in several zones or formats. `isTimezoneShown` appends a short zone name to `date_time` and `time`. `isLive` refreshes a relative reading on a short interval.

Relative text keeps a long zone name in `aria-label`, so the accessible name does not depend on the tooltip.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Timestamp } from '@astryx-vue/core/Timestamp'
</script>

<template>
  <Timestamp value="2026-03-25T12:00:00Z" color="primary" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Timestamp` 用 `<time>` 画出一个时刻。`value` 是 ISO 字符串，或按秒计的 unix 时间。默认格式是 `auto`：在 `autoThreshold`（七天）以内用相对时间，更早的用 `date_time`。

`hasTooltip` 默认打开，悬停卡片里的时间可以复制。`tooltipEntries` 把同一个时刻列成几种时区或格式。`isTimezoneShown` 在 `date_time` 和 `time` 后面加上短时区名。`isLive` 按较短的间隔刷新相对时间。

相对格式会把带长时区名的说法放进 `aria-label`，不依赖提示卡片也能读出绝对时间。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Timestamp } from '@astryx-vue/core/Timestamp'
</script>

<template>
  <Timestamp value="2026-03-25T12:00:00Z" color="primary" />
</template>
```

en.text: Use `auto` in feeds and comments. Recent events stay relative, older ones become a full date.
Use `system_date`, `system_date_time`, and `system_time` in logs, with `type="code"`.
Pass `tooltipEntries` when a reader must compare the local zone with the zone where an event happened.
Turn the tooltip off for a relative format unless something else nearby states the absolute time.
Append a zone to a system format. Those strings stay machine-readable.

usage.en: `Token` is an interactive chip. It can be removed, clicked, or used as a link, for a selected value or a filter. `Badge` is a static status or count marker. Typeahead, Multi Selector, and Tokenizer use `Token` internally, and a chat composer can use it for an attachment or a mention. `removable` shows a focusable remove button. Click, `Backspace`, and `Delete` all emit `remove`. `disabled` ignores that action. `#icon` sits before the text and is the place for a type icon. `href` renders a link. When a remove button is also present, the link and the button are siblings, so the button is not nested inside the link. ```vue ``` The remove button’s accessible name defaults to `Remove Design review`. `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` switches it to Chinese.

summary.en: `CodeBlock` shows a read-only snippet. Import it from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`, next to inline `Code`. The `code` string is what the reader sees and what the copy button writes.
summary.zh: `CodeBlock` 展示一段只读代码。从 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 引入，和行内的 `Code` 在一起。`code` 字符串既是读者看到的内容，也是复制按钮写下的内容。

usage.en:
`CodeBlock` shows a read-only snippet. Import it from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`, next to inline `Code`. The `code` string is what the reader sees and what the copy button writes.

`language` selects the tokenizer. `title` adds a filename in the header. `hasLineNumbers` draws a gutter. `highlightLines` takes one-indexed line numbers and tints those lines. `maxHeight` bounds the body before it scrolls. `hasCopyButton` stays available in the header, or floats at the top end when there is no header.

`isDiff` paints the snippet as a unified diff. A leading `+` marks an added line, `-` a removed line, and `@@` a hunk header. A `--- ` line, a `+++ ` line, and an `@@` line in that order are a file header. The glyph sits in its own column, and the rest of the line keeps the `language` syntax colors. The copy button still writes the original string, glyphs included. The header and the viewport name read `diff`, or `typescript diff` when a language is set. A highlighted line replaces the diff tint. The colors are `--astryx-code-syntax-added`, `--astryx-code-syntax-removed`, `--astryx-code-syntax-diff-header`, plus the `added-marker` and `removed-marker` slots, the same `--astryx-code-syntax-*` scheme as the other syntax colors.

`SyntaxTheme` sets the syntax custom properties for the blocks inside it. `githubDark` is the dark preset shipped with the package. Wrap a bash block in it when the snippet should read as a terminal on a light page. `defineSyntaxTheme` builds another preset from the same token names.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock, githubDark, SyntaxTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const commands = `$ astryx init --features agents`
</script>

<template>
  <SyntaxTheme :theme="githubDark">
    <CodeBlock :code="commands" language="bash" has-copy-button width="100%" />
  </SyntaxTheme>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`CodeBlock` 展示一段只读代码。从 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 引入，和行内的 `Code` 在一起。`code` 字符串既是读者看到的内容，也是复制按钮写下的内容。

`language` 选择分词器。`title` 在顶栏写上文件名。`hasLineNumbers` 画出行号槽。`highlightLines` 接收从 1 开始的行号，给这些行铺一层底色。`maxHeight` 限制正文高度，超出后纵向滚动。`hasCopyButton` 在有顶栏时放在顶栏里，没有顶栏时浮在右上角。

`isDiff` 按 unified diff 给整行上色。行首 `+` 是新增，`-` 是删除，`@@` 是差异头。`---` 后面带空格、下一行是带空格的 `+++`、再下一行是 `@@` 时，前两行也是文件头。符号单独占一列，其余文本仍按 `language` 高亮。复制下去的还是原来的整段，符号也在里面。顶栏和视口名称会写成 `diff`，有语言时写成 `typescript diff` 这种。高亮行会盖住差异底色，不和它叠在一起。颜色用 `--astryx-code-syntax-added`、`--astryx-code-syntax-removed`、`--astryx-code-syntax-diff-header`，标记用对应的 `added-marker` 和 `removed-marker`，和其它语法色是同一套名字。

`SyntaxTheme` 给内部的代码块写入语法颜色变量。包里带的深色预设是 `githubDark`。浅色页面上的命令要读起来像终端时，用它包住 bash 代码块。`defineSyntaxTheme` 用同一组 token 名字再做一个预设。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock, githubDark, SyntaxTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const commands = `$ astryx init --features agents`
</script>

<template>
  <SyntaxTheme :theme="githubDark">
    <CodeBlock :code="commands" language="bash" has-copy-button width="100%" />
  </SyntaxTheme>
</template>
```

en.text: Set `language` to the snippet, and add `title` when the code is a file.
Leave line numbers off for a one-line command, and turn them on when a reader must point at a line.
Use `highlightLines` for the lines a tutorial just changed. When the text is already a diff, use `isDiff` instead of painting those lines by hand.
Reach for `githubDark` through `SyntaxTheme` when a command should look like a terminal.
Paint a dark box with one-off CSS. A preset keeps the token colors and the border together.
Put a paragraph of prose in a code block.

en.heading: SyntaxTheme
en.text:
The default slot is the content that should pick up those colors, usually one or more `CodeBlock`s.

`githubDark` sets `--astryx-code-syntax-*` and `--astryx-code-block-background`. A dark background also sets `--astryx-code-block-border` to white at 12% opacity. Diff colors are optional slots in that same list: `added`, `removed`, `diff-header`, `added-marker`, and `removed-marker`. When a syntax theme leaves them out, markers follow its punctuation color, the header row gets no extra paint, and the added and removed tints stay on the page theme's slots.

const code = `interface User {
  id: string;
  name: string;
}

export function useUser(id: string) {
  const [user, setUser] = useState<User>();
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUser(id).then(setUser);
  }, [id]);
  return user;
}`
</script>

en.title: Code — Diff
en.description: The same TypeScript snippet read as a diff. Added and removed rows are tinted, and the code after the glyph stays highlighted as tsx. File headers and @@ lines stay quiet.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const code = `--- a/useUser.ts
+++ b/useUser.ts
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 export function useUser(id: string) {
-  const [user, setUser] = useState<User>()
+  const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(null)
   useEffect(() => {
-    fetchUser(id).then(setUser)
+    void fetchUser(id).then(setUser)
   }, [id])
   return user
 }`
</script>

<template>
  <CodeBlock
    :code="code"
    language="tsx"
    title="useUser.ts"
    is-diff
    has-line-numbers
    width="100%"
  />
</template>

summary.en: `Timer` writes a running duration into a `<time>` element. `startTime` is unix milliseconds. Omit it and the count starts when this timer mounts. The text and `dateTime` are written on the element. The component does not re-render on every tick, and it does not use `aria-live`.
summary.zh: `Timer` 把一段正在增加的时长写进 `<time>`。`startTime` 是毫秒级 unix 时间。不传就从这次挂载开始计。文字和 `dateTime` 直接写在元素上。组件不会为每一次跳动重新渲染，也不使用 `aria-live`。

usage.en:
`Timer` writes a running duration into a `<time>` element. `startTime` is unix milliseconds. Omit it and the count starts when this timer mounts. The text and `dateTime` are written on the element. The component does not re-render on every tick, and it does not use `aria-live`.

`format="elapsed"` is the default. Under a minute it reads `Ns`. Under an hour it reads `Nm NNs`. At an hour and beyond it reads `Nh NNm` and drops seconds, both in the text and in `dateTime` (`PT{minutes * 60}S`). `format="clock"` stays on seconds: `m:ss`, or `h:mm:ss` past an hour, with `dateTime="PT{seconds}S"`.

The clock updates once a second until the elapsed format reaches an hour, then once a minute. If `startTime` is still in the future, the first change waits until one second after that start.

Typography matches `Timestamp`. `type` defaults to `supporting`, `color` to `secondary`. `type="inherit"` does not wrap the time in `Text`, so it takes the surrounding font. `color="disabled"` uses the disabled text color. `size` and `weight` override the type scale the same way they do on `Text`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Timer } from '@astryx-vue/core/Timer'
</script>

<template>
  <Text type="body" color="primary">
    Processing for <Timer type="inherit" color="inherit" />
  </Text>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Timer` 把一段正在增加的时长写进 `<time>`。`startTime` 是毫秒级 unix 时间。不传就从这次挂载开始计。文字和 `dateTime` 直接写在元素上。组件不会为每一次跳动重新渲染，也不使用 `aria-live`。

默认 `format="elapsed"`。不到一分钟显示 `Ns`，不到一小时显示 `Nm NNs`，满一小时显示 `Nh NNm`，文字和 `dateTime` 都不再带秒（存成 `PT{分钟数 × 60}S`）。`format="clock"` 始终精确到秒：不到一小时是 `m:ss`，超过则是 `h:mm:ss`，`dateTime` 为 `PT{秒数}S`。

未满一小时时大约每秒更新一次，elapsed 满一小时后改为每分钟一次。如果 `startTime` 还在未来，第一次变化会等到开始后再过一秒。

排版和 `Timestamp` 同一套。`type` 默认 `supporting`，`color` 默认 `secondary`。`type="inherit"` 不用 `Text` 包一层，字体跟周围走。`color="disabled"` 用禁用文字色。`size` 和 `weight` 的覆盖方式和 `Text` 一样。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Timer } from '@astryx-vue/core/Timer'
</script>

<template>
  <Text type="body" color="primary">
    Processing for <Timer type="inherit" color="inherit" />
  </Text>
</template>
```

en.text: Use `elapsed` next to a status word, and `clock` when the reader is watching seconds.
Pass the same `startTime` when two timers must agree.
Use `type="inherit"` inside a sentence so the duration matches the line.
Announce every tick. The time element updates in place and stays quiet.
Expect second precision from `elapsed` after one hour. That format switches to minutes on purpose.

rows.name: `startTime`
rows.description: Unix time in milliseconds when the operation began. Omit it to start at mount.

rows.name: `format`
rows.description: `elapsed` uses compact units and drops seconds after one hour. `clock` stays second-precise.

rows.name: `type`
rows.description: Semantic text type, matching Timestamp. `inherit` skips the Text wrapper.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Explicit font size. Overrides the size that comes from `type`.

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: Text color. `disabled` uses the disabled text token.

rows.name: `weight`
rows.description: Font weight override.

summary.en: `Icon` draws one icon from an Iconify collection. Pass the name. You do not import an icon component for each glyph.
summary.zh: `Icon` 按名字画一个图标。名字来自 Iconify 的集合，不需要为每个图形单独 import 一个组件。

usage.en:
`Icon` draws one icon from an Iconify collection. Pass the name. You do not import an icon component for each glyph.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
</template>
```

The name is `collection:icon`, the same id Iconify uses. `carbon-settings` is accepted too, once the `carbon` collection is registered. A collection whose own name contains a hyphen, such as `material-symbols`, should keep the colon: `material-symbols:home`.

Nothing in `@astryx-vue/core` bundles those drawings. Install the collection you actually use, then let the Vite plugin pull in only the icons your source names:

```bash
pnpm add -D @iconify-json/carbon
```

```ts
import { astryxIcons } from '@astryx-vue/core/icons'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue(), astryxIcons()],
})
```

`astryxIcons()` reads `@iconify-json/*` from the project's dependencies. A static `name="carbon:settings"` becomes a tiny module that registers that one icon. The rest of the Carbon set stays out of the bundle. Another set is the same step: install `@iconify-json/lucide` and write `name="lucide:settings"`. UnoCSS is not involved.

The plugin can only see names written in source. When the name is chosen at runtime, register the collection yourself. That ships the whole set:

```ts
import { addCollection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import carbon from '@iconify-json/carbon/icons.json'

addCollection(carbon)
```

Call `addCollection` before the icon renders, usually from the app entry. `addIcon('carbon:settings', data)` registers a single icon the same way.

Leave `size` off and the icon is `1em` square, painted with `currentColor`, so it follows the text around it. [Button](/en/components/button)'s `icon` and `end` slots, [IconButton](/en/components/icon-button), and a field's start and end slots already size that box. Put `Icon` in the slot and do not set `size` again.

```vue
<Button label="Settings">
  <template #icon>
    <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
  </template>
</Button>
```

A decorative icon is `aria-hidden`. Set `label` only when the icon is the only thing that carries the meaning, and the parent control does not already have a name.

`icon` still accepts a CSS class or your own component. Navigation `iconClass` is still a class. Those paths do not require UnoCSS either.
usage.zh:
`Icon` 按名字画一个图标。名字来自 Iconify 的集合，不需要为每个图形单独 import 一个组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
</script>

<template>
  <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
</template>
```

写法是 `集合:图标`，和 Iconify 的 id 相同。集合注册之后，`carbon-settings` 也指向 Carbon 的 settings。集合名本身带连字符时请保留冒号，例如 `material-symbols:home`，避免被拆错。

`@astryx-vue/core` 不打包这些图形。装你要用的集合，再用 Vite 插件只把源码里写到的图标打进去：

```bash
pnpm add -D @iconify-json/carbon
```

```ts
import { astryxIcons } from '@astryx-vue/core/icons'
import vue from '@vitejs/plugin-vue'
import { defineConfig } from 'vite'

export default defineConfig({
  plugins: [vue(), astryxIcons()],
})
```

`astryxIcons()` 会读取项目依赖里的 `@iconify-json/*`。源码里的 `name="carbon:settings"` 会变成一个很小的模块，只注册这一枚图标，Carbon 的其余部分不会进包。再换一套也一样：安装 `@iconify-json/lucide`，然后写 `name="lucide:settings"`。不需要装 UnoCSS。

插件只能看到写在源码里的名字。名字要到运行时才拼出来时，自己注册整套集合，这一整套都会进包：

```ts
import { addCollection } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import carbon from '@iconify-json/carbon/icons.json'

addCollection(carbon)
```

在图标渲染之前调用，一般放在应用入口。`addIcon('carbon:settings', data)` 用来注册单独的一枚。

不传 `size` 时，图标是 `1em` 见方，颜色用 `currentColor`，跟周围的文字走。[Button](/components/button) 的 `icon` 和 `end` 槽、[IconButton](/components/icon-button)，以及输入框开头和结尾的槽，盒子尺寸已经定好。把 `Icon` 放进去，不要再设 `size`。

```vue
<Button label="设置">
  <template #icon>
    <Icon name="carbon:settings" />
  </template>
</Button>
```

装饰性图标默认 `aria-hidden`。只有图标自己承载含义、旁边又没有文字时，才设置 `label`。父级按钮或链接已经有名字时不要再设。

`icon` 仍然可以收一个 CSS 类名，或你自己的组件。导航上的 `iconClass` 也还是类名。这些用法同样不要求 UnoCSS。

en.text: Use one collection inside a view. Mixing outline and filled drawings in the same row makes the row look unfinished.
Leave `size` unset inside a button or a field slot. The slot already decides the box, and `1em` fills it.
Set `label` when the icon stands alone and nothing next to it says what it means.
Install only the collections you reference. The plugin bundles the icons you name, not the whole set.
Import a component per icon. `name` is the API; the plugin does the lookup.
Set `label` on an icon inside a button or a link that already has a name. The name would be announced twice.
Rely on a name that is concatenated at runtime without `addCollection` or `addIcon`. The plugin never sees it, and the icon renders empty.

zh.text: 同一块界面里用同一套集合。线框和实心混在一行里，会显得没画完。
放进按钮或输入框的槽时不要再传 `size`。槽已经定好盒子，`1em` 会铺满它。
图标单独出现、旁边没有说明它是什么的文字时，设置 `label`。
只安装用到的集合。插件打包的是你写到的图标，不是整套。
每个图标 import 一个组件。对外的用法是 `name`，查找交给插件。
在已经有名字的按钮或链接里再给图标设 `label`。辅助技术会把名字读两遍。
运行时拼接名字，却不调用 `addCollection` 或 `addIcon`。插件看不到这个名字，图标会是空的。

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Iconify id, `collection:icon`. `carbon-settings` is the same as `carbon:settings` after the carbon collection is registered. Hyphenated collection names should keep the colon.

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: A semantic name, a CSS icon class, or your own component. A semantic name resolves to an Iconify id from the nearest theme, and falls back to the built-in glyph until that icon is registered. Ignored when `name` is set.

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: Sets the color the icon's `currentColor` resolves to. `inherit` keeps the surrounding text color.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 12px, 16px, 20px, or 24px at a 16px root. When omitted, a `name` icon is `1em`. Any other icon falls back to `md` unless a parent provides a size.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for a meaningful icon. Sets `role="img"` and `aria-label`. Omit it for decoration (`aria-hidden="true"`). An empty string stays decorative.

rows.name: `name`
rows.description: Iconify 的 id，格式是 `集合:图标`。carbon 集合注册之后，`carbon-settings` 与 `carbon:settings` 相同。集合名里带连字符时请保留冒号。

rows.name: `icon`
rows.description: 语义名、CSS 图标类，或你自己的组件。语义名由最近的主题换成 Iconify id；该图标尚未注册时用内置字形。设置了 `name` 时忽略它。

rows.name: `color`
rows.description: 决定图标里 `currentColor` 解析成哪种颜色。`inherit` 保持周围文字的颜色。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 根字号 16px 时分别是 12px、16px、20px、24px。不传时，`name` 图标是 `1em`。其他图标在没有父级尺寸时回退到 `md`。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 有含义的图标的无障碍名称。会设置 `role="img"` 和 `aria-label`。装饰性图标省略它，保持 `aria-hidden="true"`。空字符串仍按装饰处理。

en.heading: Semantic names
en.text:
Inside the components, a name is the job, not a file in one collection. Search, close, check, and the downward chevron are that kind of name. Each one points at the Lucide icon that does the same job. Until that collection is registered, the built-in glyph stays, so the icon is not a blank box.

To change the set, point those names at Iconify ids on the theme. A theme that extends another one only lists the names it changes. A direct icon still uses `name`, and that wins over a semantic name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
</script>

<template>
  <Theme
    :theme="defineTheme({
      name: 'withCarbon',
      icons: { search: 'carbon:search', close: 'carbon:close' },
    })"
  >
    <slot />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

The full list is on the props page. Read the current id with `useSemanticIcon`, exported from the same entry as `Icon`.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- With no `label`, the root is `aria-hidden="true"`. The SVG is hidden as well.
- A non-empty `label` sets `role="img"` and `aria-label`, and removes `aria-hidden`. Use it for a status glyph that has no adjacent text.
- An empty `label` stays decorative.
- Do not set `label` when a parent button or link already names the control.
- The drawing uses `currentColor`. A color that is only a hex on the element will not follow the theme; use the `color` prop.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - Default: SVG written inline, used when neither name nor icon is set.

en.heading: Registration
en.text:
- `astryxIcons()`: `@astryx-vue/core/icons`
- `addIcon(name, data)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`
- `addCollection(collection)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`

en.heading: Semantic names
en.text:
`defineTheme({ icons })` overrides by name. Entries merge shallowly with the theme this one extends, and this theme wins. A name that is not listed keeps the default id. The collection has to be registered, or the built-in glyph stays.

`useSemanticIcon(name)` comes from `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` and from the package root. An unknown string with no theme entry returns empty, so the caller can still treat it as a CSS class.

- `close`: `lucide:x`
- `chevronDown`: `lucide:chevron-down`
- `chevronLeft`: `lucide:chevron-left`
- `chevronRight`: `lucide:chevron-right`
- `chevronsLeft`: `lucide:chevrons-left`
- `chevronsRight`: `lucide:chevrons-right`
- `check`: `lucide:check`
- `success`: `lucide:circle-check`
- `error`: `lucide:circle-x`
- `warning`: `lucide:triangle-alert`
- `info`: `lucide:info`
- `calendar`: `lucide:calendar`
- `clock`: `lucide:clock`

- `menu`: `lucide:menu`

- `search`: `lucide:search`

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
Color follows the icon tokens. A theme replaces one by setting the variable on the theme root.

```css
.my-theme {
  --astryx-icon-accent-foreground: #0074e2;
}
```

- `--astryx-icon-primary-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-secondary-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-disabled-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-accent-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-success-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-error-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-warning-foreground`
- `--astryx-icon-blue-foreground`, and the same pattern for cyan, green, gray, orange, pink, purple, red, teal, and yellow.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The root is a `<span>`. Without `label` it is `aria-hidden="true"`. With a non-empty `label` it is `role="img"` and that string is the accessible name. The SVG inside is always `aria-hidden`.

`class` and `style` fall through to the root. `name` does not: it selects the icon.

zh.heading: 语义名
zh.text:
组件内部说的是用途，不是某一套图形的文件名。搜索、关闭、勾选、向下的箭头，都是这种名字。默认指向 Lucide 里做同一件事的图标。那一套还没注册时，页面上仍是内置字形，不会空出一块。

换一整套时，在主题里把语义名指到 Iconify 的 id。子主题只写要改的名字，其余沿用上一层。直接指定某一枚图标仍然用 `name`，它优先于语义名。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
</script>

<template>
  <Theme
    :theme="defineTheme({
      name: 'withCarbon',
      icons: { search: 'carbon:search', close: 'carbon:close' },
    })"
  >
    <slot />
  </Theme>
</template>
```

完整名单在属性页。读取当前 id 用 `useSemanticIcon`，它和 `Icon` 从同一个入口导出。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 不传 `label` 时，根元素是 `aria-hidden="true"`，里面的 SVG 也隐藏。
- `label` 非空时，根元素变为 `role="img"` 并带上 `aria-label`，同时去掉 `aria-hidden`。没有相邻文字的状态图标才需要它。
- 空字符串的 `label` 仍按装饰处理。
- 父级按钮或链接已经有名字时，不要再设 `label`。
- 图形使用 `currentColor`。只在元素上写死一个十六进制颜色，不会跟着主题走；要换色就用 `color`。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - 默认插槽：内联 SVG。在既没有 name 也没有 icon 时使用。

zh.heading: 注册
zh.text:
- `astryxIcons()`: `@astryx-vue/core/icons`
- `addIcon(name, data)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`
- `addCollection(collection)`: `@astryx-vue/core/Icon`

zh.heading: 语义名
zh.text:
`defineTheme({ icons })` 按名字覆盖。和被扩展的主题浅合并，当前这份优先。没写到的名字保持默认 id。集合要已经注册，否则仍画内置字形。

`useSemanticIcon(name)` 从 `@astryx-vue/core/Icon` 引入，也从包根导出。未知字符串、主题也没有覆盖时，返回空，调用方可以继续把它当 CSS 类。

颜色走图标令牌。主题在根上覆盖对应变量即可。

summary.en: Every status badge steals attention. Only badge states where the user needs to notice or act: errors, warnings, items requiring follow-up. If no action is needed, plain text is fine.
summary.zh: `Badge` 用于标记状态或类别，例如处理结果、优先级或团队归属，适合在列表、卡片和表格中快速扫读。徽标是静态的状态或类别标记，需要可移除、可点击的标签请用 Token。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

usage.en:
Import the component from its dedicated entry. The component loads its structural styles.

Import the theme in your application entry:


Component usage:


usage.zh:
`Badge` 用于标记状态或类别，例如处理结果、优先级或团队归属，适合在列表、卡片和表格中快速扫读。徽标是静态的状态或类别标记，需要可移除、可点击的标签请用 Token。从独立入口导入即可，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

主题在应用入口引入一次：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

组件用法：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
```
