</script>

<template>
  <Badge variant="success">
    已完成
  </Badge>
</template>
```

en.text: Every status badge steals attention. Only badge states where the user needs to notice or act: errors, warnings, items requiring follow-up. If no action is needed, plain text is fine.
Use success, warning, and error variants only for system status that demands attention: "Failed", "Degraded", "Action Required". These have bold solid backgrounds designed to stand out.
Use color variants (blue, purple, teal, etc.) for category tags that group or classify items: team names, content types, priority levels.
Keep labels to one or two words. If you need more detail, put it in surrounding text instead of the badge.
Add an icon when it helps identify the badge type quickly, but always include a text label alongside it.

Apply a "success" badge to every healthy/active/normal item. If all rows show green "Active" badges, none stand out; the badge adds noise, not information. Show only the states that need user attention (errors, warnings, pending actions).
Use badges for metadata. Durations ("6h window"), counts ("12 trigger types"), dates, and descriptions are not statuses or categories; use description text (Text with type="supporting") instead.
Use semantic status variants (success, warning, error, info) for categories or informational content. These are visually loud and should only indicate system state.

Repeat the same badge in every row of a table or list. If the same value appears in most rows, it's not adding information; use plain text for common states and reserve badges for the exceptional ones.
Make badges clickable; they are read-only indicators. Use a button or link if the user needs to take action.

zh.text: 每个状态徽标都会抢占注意力。只为用户需要注意或处理的状态使用徽标：错误、警告和待跟进的项目。无需处理时，普通文本即可。
仅对需要关注的系统状态使用 success、warning 和 error 变体，例如 “Failed”、“Degraded”、“Action Required”。这些变体使用醒目的实底背景。
对用于分组或分类的徽标，使用颜色变体（蓝色、紫色、青色等）。例如团队名称、内容类型、优先级。
徽标文字保持一到两个词。需要更多说明时，把说明放在徽标外的文字中。
图标有助于快速识别徽标类型时，添加图标。图标旁必须保留文字。
为每个健康、活跃或正常的项目都使用 success 徽标。若每行都是绿色的 “Active”，徽标就无法突出。徽标只显示需要用户关注的状态，如错误、警告和待处理操作。
用徽标展示元数据。时长（“6h window”）、数量（“12 trigger types”）、日期和描述都不是状态或分类。应改用描述文本（Text 组件，type="supporting"）。
用 success、warning、error、info 等语义状态变体表示分类或说明性内容。这些变体视觉强烈，只用于表示系统状态。
在表格或列表的每一行都重复同一个徽标。若多数行都有相同的值，徽标就不再传递信息。常见状态使用普通文本，徽标只留给例外情况。
让徽标可点击。徽标是只读指示器。用户需要操作时，使用按钮或链接。

usage.zh:
`Banner` 用于持续展示需要用户关注或处理的消息，例如功能更新、操作结果或需要解决的问题。与会自动消失的 Toast 不同，它会一直留在界面上，直到用户处理或主动关闭：

en.text: Pick a status that matches the message: info for updates, warning for caution, error for problems, success for confirmations.
Use the card container inside page content and the section container for full-width messages that span the entire page.
Make info and success banners dismissable. Keep error banners visible until the user fixes the issue.
Keep titles short and scannable: "Payment failed" not "There was a problem processing your most recent payment."
Use Banner for short-lived messages that disappear on their own; use Toast instead.
Stack multiple banners with the same status; combine related messages into one banner.

zh.text: 选择与消息相符的状态：更新用 info，注意事项用 warning，问题用 error，确认用 success。
页面内容中使用 card 容器。覆盖整页宽度的消息使用 section 容器。
info 和 success 提示条可以关闭。error 提示条必须保留，直到用户解决问题。
标题保持简短、便于扫读。例如用 “Payment failed”，不用 “There was a problem processing your most recent payment.”
用提示条展示会自动消失的短暂消息。应改用 Toast。
叠放同一状态的多条提示条。应把相关消息合并为一条。

en.heading: Usage guidance
en.text:
The `status` prop sets the tone of a banner, and picking the wrong one makes readers misjudge how urgent the message is. The list below covers which status fits which kind of message, plus two usages that are easy to overlook.

- Use `info` for general information and updates.
- Use `success` for the result of a successful action.
- Use `warning` for situations that call for caution.
- Use `error` for problems that block progress.
- Set `:collapsible="false"` for details that users must read, so those details stay visible and no click is needed to open them.
- Mount urgent messages when the user action that triggers them happens.

The status also decides the role the banner exposes to screen readers: `warning` and `error` use `role="alert"`, while `info` and `success` use `role="status"`. Note that messages already present in the initial page render may not be announced by screen readers, so the more urgent a message is, the better it works when mounted in response to a user action.

For a single field validation message, use [FieldStatus](/en/components/field-status).

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- Default: details below the header.
- `title`: replaces the visible title. The `title` prop remains required.
- `description`: replaces the supporting text.
- `icon`: replaces the decorative status icon.
- `end`: action buttons at the end of the header.

Title, description and detail slots accept block content.

en.heading: Expanding and collapsing
en.text:
- Detail content enables the expand button. - Details start collapsed by default. - `defaultIsOpen` sets the initial state only. - `v-model:isOpen` controls the current state. - `collapsible` set to `false` keeps details visible. - Collapsing unmounts the details. - If a parent closes focused details, focus returns to the expand button. ```vue

Review the updated settings before continuing.

 ```

en.heading: Dismissal
en.text:
- `isDismissable` shows a dismiss button.
- Clicking it hides the component.
- The component emits `dismiss`.
- Dismissal tries to restore focus to the element used before entering the banner.
- Remount the component or change its `key` to show it again.

en.heading: Events and template references
en.text:
- `update:isOpen(value)`: requests an expansion change.
- `dismiss()`: dismisses the banner.
- `element`: the root `HTMLDivElement | null`. It becomes `null` after dismissal.

en.heading: Localization
en.text:
Provide translated control labels:

- `dismissLabel`: dismiss button.
- `expandLabel`: expand button.
- `collapseLabel`: collapse button.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
```css
.my-banner {
  --astryx-banner-info-background: #ecfdf5;
  --astryx-banner-info-foreground: #065f46;
}
```

- `--astryx-banner-info-background`: information background.
- `--astryx-banner-info-foreground`: information text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-success-background`: success background.
- `--astryx-banner-success-foreground`: success text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-warning-background`: warning background.
- `--astryx-banner-warning-foreground`: warning text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-error-background`: error background.
- `--astryx-banner-error-foreground`: error text and icon.
- `--astryx-banner-content-background`: detail background.
- `--astryx-banner-border`: detail border.
- `--astryx-radius-container`: card corner radius.

Neutral follows the active light or dark mode.

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
提示条的语气由 `status` 决定，选错状态会让用户误判消息的紧迫程度。下面按消息的性质说明该选哪个状态，以及两个容易忽略的用法。

- 一般的信息和更新使用 `info`。
- 操作成功的结果使用 `success`。
- 需要提醒用户注意的情况使用 `warning`。
- 阻止用户继续操作的问题使用 `error`。
- 用户必须读到的详情传入 `:collapsible="false"`，这样详情会始终显示，不需要再点开。
- 用户操作之后才出现的紧急消息，在操作发生时动态挂载。

状态同时还决定组件向屏幕阅读器呈现的角色：`warning` 和 `error` 使用 `role="alert"`，`info` 和 `success` 使用 `role="status"`。需要注意的是，页面初次渲染时就已存在的消息不保证被屏幕阅读器播报，所以越紧急的消息，越适合在用户操作之后再挂载。

如果只是单个字段的校验消息，应改用 [FieldStatus](/components/field-status)。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽：标题区域下方的详情。
- `title`：替换标题的视觉内容。仍需提供 `title` 属性。
- `description`：替换说明文本。
- `icon`：替换状态图标。图标仅作装饰。
- `end`：标题区域末尾的操作按钮。

标题、说明和详情插槽可包含块级内容。

zh.heading: 展开与收起
zh.text:
- 默认插槽有内容时，组件显示展开按钮。 - 默认从收起状态开始。 - `defaultIsOpen` 只设置初始状态。 - `v-model:isOpen` 控制当前状态。 - `collapsible` 为 `false` 时，详情始终显示。 - 收起时，详情内容卸载。 - 父组件收起详情时，若焦点在详情内，焦点返回展开按钮。 ```vue

Review the updated settings before continuing.

 ```

zh.heading: 关闭
zh.text:
- `isDismissable` 显示关闭按钮。
- 点击关闭后，组件自行隐藏。
- 组件触发 `dismiss` 事件。
- 关闭时，组件尝试将焦点返回进入提示前的元素。
- 需要再次显示时，重新挂载组件或改变 `key`。

zh.heading: 事件与模板引用
zh.text:

- `dismiss()`：关闭提示。
- `element`：根元素的 `HTMLDivElement | null`。关闭后为 `null`。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
A progress bar has no focusable element, so screen reader users rely on the ARIA attributes the component exposes to learn the current progress. The component therefore puts `role="progressbar"` on the track and fills in the progress values and name, so assistive technologies can announce it accurately:

- The progress range is described by `aria-valuemin` and `aria-valuemax`, which the component sets automatically from `min` and `max`.
- The current progress is described by `aria-valuenow`, which is also set automatically.
- When `label` is provided, the label is linked to the track through `aria-labelledby`.
- When `description` is provided, the description is linked to the track through `aria-describedby`.

When `isIndeterminate` is true the progress is unknown, so the component removes `aria-valuenow` and screen readers announce the bar without a specific value.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
进度条没有可以聚焦的元素，屏幕阅读器用户只能靠组件暴露的 ARIA 属性了解当前进度。因此组件在轨道上设置了 `role="progressbar"`，并由它负责补全进度数值和名称，让辅助技术能够如实播报：

- 进度范围由 `aria-valuemin` 和 `aria-valuemax` 描述，组件会依据 `min` 和 `max` 自动设置。
- 当前进度由 `aria-valuenow` 描述，同样由组件自动设置。
- 传入 `label` 时，标签通过 `aria-labelledby` 关联到轨道。
- 传入 `description` 时，说明文字通过 `aria-describedby` 关联到轨道。

`isIndeterminate` 为真时进度未知，组件会移除 `aria-valuenow`，此时屏幕阅读器只播报这是一个进度条，不再给出具体数值。

en.text: Match the size and shape of the content being loaded to create a realistic placeholder.
Stagger multiple skeletons with the `index` prop for a natural wave animation.
Use when the content dimensions are unknown; use Spinner instead.
Combine with a Spinner on the same content area; pick one loading pattern.
Show skeletons indefinitely; if loading takes too long, show an error or empty state instead.

zh.text: 让占位块的尺寸和形状贴近最终内容，加载完成后布局才不会发生明显跳动。
为同一区域内的多个骨架屏依次设置 `index`，脉冲动画会按顺序错开，形成自然的波浪效果。
在内容尺寸未知时使用骨架屏，占位块无法模拟未知布局，这种情况改用 `Spinner` 更合适。
在同一内容区域混用 `Spinner` 和骨架屏，两种加载模式并存会让界面显得不一致，只选其中一种即可。
让骨架屏长时间停留，加载明显偏慢时应改显错误或空状态，让用户知道当前发生了什么。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- `Skeleton` sets `aria-hidden="true"` by default.
- Assistive technology does not read the default placeholders.
- Give the surrounding loading region an accessible name.
- Set `aria-busy="true"` on that region.
- If the system requests reduced motion, the pulse animation stops.
- In forced-colors mode, placeholders remain visible.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is `<div>`.

The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

An explicit `aria-hidden` value overrides the default.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- `Skeleton` 默认设置 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 辅助技术不会读取默认的占位块。
- 外围加载区域必须提供名称。
- 外围加载区域必须设置 `aria-busy="true"`。
- 系统启用「减少动态效果」时，脉冲动画停止。
- 系统启用强制颜色模式时，占位块保持可见。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

传入 `aria-hidden` 时，该值覆盖默认值。

en.text: Provide a meaningful label to describe what is loading for screen reader users.
Use the "onMedia" shade when placed on dark or accent-colored backgrounds.
Use for content areas with known dimensions; use Skeleton to preserve layout instead.
Stack multiple spinners in the same view; use one to represent the overall loading state.

zh.text: 通过 `label` 说明正在加载的内容，屏幕阅读器用户才能理解当前发生了什么。
在深色或强调色背景上使用时选择 `onMedia` 色调，保证圆环清晰可见。
在尺寸已知的内容区域只放 `Spinner`，它会撑开并挤压布局；改用 `Skeleton` 占位可以保持页面稳定。
在同一视图中堆叠多个 `Spinner`，会让加载状态显得混乱；用一个 `Spinner` 表示整体加载即可。

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: Ring diameter: 10px, 14px, 18px, or 28px.

rows.name: `shade`
rows.description: Color shade for light backgrounds, dark backgrounds, or inherited text color.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Text shown below the spinner. Also used as the accessible name.

rows.name: `size`
rows.description: 圆环的直径，sm 为 10px，md 为 14px，lg 为 18px，xl 为 28px。

rows.name: `shade`
rows.description: 圆环的配色层级，分别面向浅色背景、深色背景或继承周围文字颜色的场景。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 显示在加载态下方的文字，同时作为无障碍名称供屏幕阅读器播报。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
A `Spinner` has no visible text of its own, so its loading state reaches assistive technology entirely through ARIA attributes. The component sets these for you, and you normally do not need to manage them yourself; the list below covers the attributes it actually uses and what each one does.

- The root element carries `role="status"`, so assistive technology treats it as a status region.
- When you pass a string `label`, it shows as visible text below the spinner and provides the accessible name through `aria-labelledby`.
- Without a `label`, the accessible name defaults to `Loading`; pass `aria-label` to change it to something more specific to the context.
- The ring is `aria-hidden` and carries no text of its own, so it is not read out separately.
- With reduced motion enabled, the arc slows to a 3-second cycle.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `label`: rich content below the spinner. Replaces the `label` prop text. The default accessible name is `Loading`.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
```css
.my-spinner {
  --astryx-spinner-color-accent: #0074e2;
}
```

- `--astryx-spinner-diameter-{sm|md|lg|xl}`: ring diameter per size.
- `--astryx-spinner-stroke-width-{sm|md|lg|xl}`: stroke width per size.
- `--astryx-spinner-arc-fraction`: fraction of the ring covered by the moving arc.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-accent`: arc color for the `default` shade.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-subtle`: arc color for the `subtle` shade.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-track`: track color for the `default` and `subtle` shades.
- `--astryx-spinner-color-on-dark`: arc and track color for the `onMedia` shade.
- `--astryx-spinner-group-gap`: space between the ring and the label.
- `--astryx-spinner-label-color`: label text color.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
`Spinner` 本身没有可见文字，加载状态要依靠 ARIA 属性才能被辅助技术理解。这些属性都由组件自动设置，通常不需要你手动维护，下面说明组件实际用到的属性和它们各自的作用。

- 根元素带有 `role="status"`，辅助技术会把这块区域当作状态提示来处理。
- 传入字符串类型的 `label` 时，它会显示为加载态下方的可见文字，并通过 `aria-labelledby` 成为无障碍名称。
- 不传 `label` 时，无障碍名称默认为 `Loading`；这时传入 `aria-label` 就可以改成更贴合场景的说法。
- 圆环带有 `aria-hidden`，自身不含任何文字，因此它不会被单独读出。
- 开启「减少动态效果」时，圆弧放慢为 3 秒一圈。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `label`：加载态下方的富文本内容，会替代 `label` 属性的文字。未提供文字时，无障碍名称默认为 `Loading`。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
```css
.my-spinner {
  --astryx-spinner-color-accent: #0074e2;
}
```

- `--astryx-spinner-diameter-{sm|md|lg|xl}`：各尺寸的环直径。
- `--astryx-spinner-stroke-width-{sm|md|lg|xl}`：各尺寸的描边宽度。
- `--astryx-spinner-arc-fraction`：运动圆弧覆盖圆环的比例。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-accent`：`default` 色调的圆弧颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-subtle`：`subtle` 色调的圆弧颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-track`：`default` 和 `subtle` 色调的轨道颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-color-on-dark`：`onMedia` 色调的圆弧与轨道颜色。
- `--astryx-spinner-group-gap`：圆环与文字之间的间距。
- `--astryx-spinner-label-color`：文字颜色。

en.text: Always provide `label`; screen readers announce it via `aria-label`.
Use the dot as a supporting signal alongside a visible text label.
Use `isPulsing` for live, ongoing activity such as streaming or syncing.
Rely on color alone for critical status. Color is not perceivable by everyone.
Use many pulsing dots on the same screen; it creates visual noise.

zh.text: `label` 是必填项：状态点本身没有文字，屏幕阅读器用户依赖这个 `aria-label` 理解当前状态，描述应写清状态的含义。
把状态点当作辅助信号，和附近的文字标签搭配使用，用户不必辨认颜色也能读懂状态。
直播、同步、录制等正在进行的活动可以开启 `isPulsing`，脉冲动画能明确传达“进行中”的感觉。
仅用颜色传达关键状态：色觉障碍用户无法区分颜色，关键状态必须同时给出文字或图标说明。
在同一界面放置过多脉冲状态点：持续动画容易分散注意力，只给真正有活动的状态开启。

summary.en: `Calendar` shows one or two months and selects a day or a start and end. It opens on the requested month, or on the selected day, or on today when that day still falls inside the earliest and latest dates.
summary.zh: `Calendar` 用月历网格选日期。可以选一天，也可以选一段起止日期，并排显示一个月或两个月。打开时先落到指定的月份；没有指定时，落在已选日期或今天，并尽量落进最早和最晚日期之间。

usage.en:
`Calendar` shows one or two months and selects a day or a start and end. It opens on the requested month, or on the selected day, or on today when that day still falls inside the earliest and latest dates.

A day is unavailable when it is outside those bounds, when a predicate returns true, or when any constraint returns false. A range can also require a minimum and maximum length, counting both ends. Week numbers can sit beside each row. Days from the neighboring months can fill the grid, and they cannot be picked. The grid can shrink to the weeks the month needs, or stay six rows tall. The week can start on Sunday or on any other day, given as a number or a short name. A handle can move the visible month to a date and focus that day.

Arrow keys move by a day or a week, cross into the next month, and skip days that cannot be picked. Home and End move to the first and last available day of the week. Page Up and Page Down move by a month. Enter or Space picks the focused day. Escape cancels a range that has a start but no end yet. Each month is a grid named with that month. Selection, today, and unavailable days are exposed to assistive technology.

Bind a date:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Calendar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 9, 11))
</script>

<template>
  <Calendar v-model="date" label="Select a date" />
</template>
```

The value is a local `Date`. The month title and weekday names follow the active locale. Built-in labels are English unless the app calls `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`.
usage.zh:
`Calendar` 用月历网格选日期。可以选一天，也可以选一段起止日期，并排显示一个月或两个月。打开时先落到指定的月份；没有指定时，落在已选日期或今天，并尽量落进最早和最晚日期之间。

最早日期、最晚日期、返回真值的判断，以及一组返回假值的约束，都会让对应的日子不能选。范围还可以限制最短和最长天数，天数把两端都算进去。周数可以显示在每一行左侧。相邻月份的日期可以留在格子里，但不能选。行数可以按当月缩短，也可以固定六行。一周从哪一天开始，用数字或星期缩写指定。外面也可以拿到一个句柄，直接把月份翻到某一天并聚焦它。

方向键按天或按周移动，到头会翻月，并跳过不能选的日子。Home 和 End 移到这一周里能选的第一天和最后一天。PageUp 和 PageDown 翻一个月。Enter 或空格确认。范围还没选完时，Escape 取消。每个月是一块带月份名字的网格，今天、选中和禁用都能被读屏读到。

基本用法只需要绑定一个日期值：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Calendar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 9, 11))
</script>

<template>
  <Calendar v-model="date" label="选择日期" />
</template>
```

绑定值是原生 `Date`。通过 `min` 和 `max` 限制可选日期范围，通过 `isDateDisabled` 函数禁用特定日期。月份标题和星期名称跟随当前语言。组件自带文案默认是英文，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后改为中文。

en.title: Constraints
en.description: Only weekdays from January 10 through March 20, 2026 can be selected.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { provideAstryxLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Calendar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

provideAstryxLocale('en')

const value = ref<Date | null>(null)
const focusDate = new Date(2026, 0, 1)
const min = new Date(2026, 0, 10)
const max = new Date(2026, 2, 20)

function isWeekend(date: Date): boolean {
  const day = date.getDay()
  return day === 0 || day === 6
}
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="4" h-align="center">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Jan 10 – Mar 20, weekdays only
    </Text>
    <Calendar
      v-model="value"
      mode="single"
      :min="min"
      :max="max"
      :is-date-disabled="isWeekend"
      :focus-date="focusDate"
    />
  </VStack>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CalendarRangeValue } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CalendarHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Calendar'

en.text: Always provide a visible label so the user knows what they are toggling. Use isLabelHidden only when surrounding context makes it obvious.
Add a description for choices that need extra context, like explaining what "Share usage data" actually shares.
Use the indeterminate state for "select all" checkboxes when only some items in a group are selected.
Use a checkbox for mutually exclusive choices; use RadioList when only one option can be selected.
Use a checkbox for actions that take effect immediately; use a toggle switch or button instead.
Wrap a disabled checkbox in Tooltip to explain why it is disabled; disabled controls swallow the hover events the wrapper needs. Use the disabledMessage prop instead.

zh.text: 必须提供可见的标签，让用户知道自己在切换什么。只有上下文已经明确时，才使用 isLabelHidden 隐藏标签。
对需要额外说明的选项添加描述。例如解释 “Share usage data” 实际会共享哪些内容。
当一组中只选中部分项目时，“全选”复选框使用不确定状态（indeterminate）。
用复选框表示互斥的选项。只能选一项时，应使用 RadioList。
用复选框表示立即生效的操作。应使用开关或按钮。

en.heading: Keyboard and accessibility
en.text:
`CheckboxInput` renders a native `<input type="checkbox">`, so keyboard behaviour follows the browser defaults: press Tab to focus the checkbox, and press Space to toggle the selection.

The component wires the label, description and status message together through ARIA attributes, so assistive technology reads them as one unit:

- Always provide `label`; screen readers use it to describe what this option means. `isLabelHidden` only hides the visual label, and the label text still provides the accessible name.
- `aria-describedby` references the description and the status message, so both are announced on focus.
- The mixed state comes from the native `indeterminate` property, which browsers and assistive technology recognise directly.
- `isRequired` enables the browser's native required validation.
- When the status is an error, the component sets `aria-invalid`.

For a decorative selection mark on its own, use [CheckboxIndicator](/en/components/checkbox-indicator).

en.heading: Status messages
en.text:
`status` contains these fields:

- `type`: `'error'`, `'warning'` or `'success'`.
- `message`: optional message text.
- `messageId`: optional message ID.

Messages appear below the checkbox. Errors use assertive announcements. Warnings and successes use polite announcements.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`: emits a boolean after activation.
- `change(value, event)`: fires after the model update.
- `actionError(error, value, event)`: fires when an action rejects or throws.

`event` is a cancelable `CheckboxInputChangeEvent`.
`event.detail.originalEvent` contains the native event.
Call `event.preventDefault()` in `change` to skip `changeAction`.
This does not undo the model update.

en.heading: Async actions
en.text:
`changeAction(value, event)` receives the new value and component event.

- Returning a Promise shows the loading state.
- Pending actions block repeat activation.
- Explicit parent updates override the temporary selection.
- Loading clears after success or failure.
- Failures do not revert values written to `v-model`.
- Use `@action-error` to show failure information.
- Update the bound value in application code if you need a rollback.

en.heading: Native forms
en.text:
- `htmlName` or `name` sets the field name.
- Native `value` sets the submitted value. The default is `'on'`.
- `value` does not control selection. Use `v-model` for selection.
- Unchecked and indeterminate fields do not submit.
- Checked read-only fields submit.
- Disabled fields do not submit.
- Fields with a disabled reason use `aria-disabled` and have no native form owner.
- `isOptional` overrides `isRequired`. An explicit native `required` attribute still applies.

After `form.reset()`, the component restores the current `v-model`.
To clear the selection, update the bound value in the form's `reset` handler.

en.heading: Template references and attributes
en.text:
- `element`: `HTMLInputElement | null`.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`: focuses the input.
- `blur()`: removes input focus.
- `class` and `style` apply to the outer component.
- Undeclared native attributes and events pass to `input`.
- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` merge with internal IDs.
- The component owns `checked`, `indeterminate`, `type` and core ARIA states.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `labelIcon`: a decorative icon before the label. Overrides the `labelIcon` prop.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 键盘与无障碍
zh.text:
`CheckboxInput` 内部是原生的 `<input type="checkbox">`，键盘操作沿用浏览器的默认行为：按 Tab 聚焦复选框，按空格键切换选中状态。

标签、说明和状态消息由组件通过 ARIA 属性串联起来，辅助技术能把它们当成一个整体读出：

- 必须提供 `label`，屏幕阅读器靠它说明这个选项的含义；`isLabelHidden` 只隐藏视觉上的标签，标签文本仍然作为可访问名称提供。
- `description` 和状态消息关联到 `aria-describedby`，聚焦时会一并读出。
- 半选状态通过原生 `indeterminate` 属性提供，浏览器和辅助技术都能直接识别。
- `isRequired` 启用浏览器原生的必填校验。
- 出错时组件自动设置 `aria-invalid`。

如果只需要显示选中标记，请使用 [CheckboxIndicator](/components/checkbox-indicator)。

zh.heading: 状态消息
zh.text:
`status` 包含以下字段：

- `type`：`'error'`、`'warning'` 或 `'success'`。
- `message`：可选的消息文本。
- `messageId`：可选的消息 ID。

消息显示在复选框下方。错误使用 assertive 播报。警告和成功使用 polite 播报。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：用户切换后发出布尔值。
- `change(value, event)`：模型更新后触发。
- `actionError(error, value, event)`：异步操作拒绝或同步抛出错误时触发。

`event` 是可取消的 `CheckboxInputChangeEvent`。
`event.detail.originalEvent` 保留原生事件。
在 `change` 中调用 `event.preventDefault()` 可跳过 `changeAction`。
此操作不会撤销模型更新。

zh.heading: 异步操作
zh.text:
`changeAction(value, event)` 接收新值和组件事件。

- 操作返回 Promise 时，组件显示加载状态。
- 操作完成前，组件阻止重复切换。
- 父组件的新值优先于临时显示值。
- Promise 成功或失败后，组件清除加载状态。
- 失败时，组件不会撤销写入 `v-model` 的值。
- 使用 `@action-error` 显示失败信息。
- 需要回滚时，由业务层更新绑定值。

zh.heading: 原生表单
zh.text:
- `htmlName` 或 `name` 设置字段名。
- 原生 `value` 设置提交值。默认值是 `'on'`。
- `value` 不控制选中状态。选中状态由 `v-model` 控制。
- 未选和半选字段不参与提交。
- 只读字段在选中时参与提交。
- 禁用字段不参与提交。
- 带禁用原因的字段使用 `aria-disabled`，并脱离原生表单。
- `isOptional` 优先于 `isRequired`。单独传入的原生 `required` 仍生效。

原生 `form.reset()` 后，组件恢复当前 `v-model`。
需要清空选择时，在表单的 `reset` 事件中更新绑定值。

zh.heading: 模板引用与属性
zh.text:
- `element`：`HTMLInputElement | null`。
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`：聚焦输入元素。
- `blur()`：移除输入焦点。
- `class` 和 `style` 应用于组件外层。
- 未声明的原生属性和事件传入 `input`。
- `aria-labelledby` 和 `aria-describedby` 与组件内部 ID 合并。
- 组件管理 `checked`、`indeterminate`、`type` 和核心 ARIA 状态。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `labelIcon`：标签前的装饰图标。优先于 `labelIcon` 属性。

zh.heading: 主题

en.title: States
en.description: Checked, unchecked, disabled, and indeterminate, each with a description.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CheckboxValue } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxInput'
import { CheckboxInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxInput'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const checked = ref<CheckboxValue>(true)
const unchecked = ref<CheckboxValue>(false)
const disabled = ref<CheckboxValue>(false)
const indeterminate = ref<CheckboxValue>('indeterminate')

usage.en:
`CheckboxList` is a field around a list of `CheckboxListItem` rows. With `v-model`, the value is the array of checked item values.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxList, CheckboxListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxList'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const selected = shallowRef(['email'])
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxList v-model="selected" label="Notifications">
    <CheckboxListItem label="Email" value="email" />
    <CheckboxListItem label="SMS" value="sms" />
  </CheckboxList>
</template>
```

Omit the bound value when a row owns its own checked state, such as a select-all row. Compact density uses the small checkbox. A checked row uses the accent-muted background. Read-only and disabled rows drop that background.

A read-only group keeps the checks and does not dim, but the checks cannot change. Disabled wins when both are set. When the group is disabled and a reason is set, every row stays focusable, and hovering or keyboard focus shows the reason. A row that is loading, or whose change is still running, shows a spinner inside the checkbox and cannot be toggled.

全选这类行自己管勾选状态时，不要给列表绑值。那一行用自己的勾选状态。紧凑密度使用小号复选框。勾选的行使用强调色的浅底。只读和禁用时这层浅底会拿掉。

整组只读时，勾选状态还在，也不会变暗，但不能改。和禁用同时设置时按禁用处理。禁用并写上原因时，每一行仍可聚焦，悬停或用键盘停在上面能看到原因。某一行自己在加载，或者一次变更还没结束时，复选框里显示旋转指示，这一行不能再点。

en.title: Select all
en.description: Select all is indeterminate until every document is included.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxList, CheckboxListItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxList'
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const documents = [
  { id: 'transactions', label: 'Transaction history' },
  { id: 'statements', label: 'Account statements' },
  { id: 'tax', label: 'Tax documents' },
  { id: 'invoices', label: 'Invoices' },
]
const selected = shallowRef(['transactions'])
const allIds = documents.map(document => document.id)
const allChecked = computed(() => allIds.every(id => selected.value.includes(id)))
const selectAllState = computed(() => allChecked.value ? true : selected.value.length === 0 ? false : 'indeterminate' as const)

function toggleAll(checked: boolean): void {
  selected.value = checked ? [...allIds] : []
}

function toggle(id: string, checked: boolean): void {
  selected.value = checked ? [...selected.value, id] : selected.value.filter(value => value !== id)
}
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxList label="Include in export" has-dividers>
    <CheckboxListItem label="Select all" :is-checked="selectAllState" @check="toggleAll" />
    <CheckboxListItem
      v-for="document in documents"
      :key="document.id"
      :label="document.label"
      :is-checked="selected.includes(document.id)"
      @check="checked => toggle(document.id, checked)"
    />
  </CheckboxList>
</template>

summary.en: `DateInput` is a text field with a calendar button. People can type a date or open the calendar and pick a day.
summary.zh: `DateInput` 是一个日期输入组件，结合了文本输入框和日历弹出层。用户可以手动输入日期文本，也可以点击打开日历选择。

usage.en:
`DateInput` is a text field with a calendar button. People can type a date or open the calendar and pick a day.

Bind a date:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateInput v-model="date" />
</template>
```

The value is a local date. The field writes it back as a long date, such as March 21, 2026. It can also show a short date, a weekday, the system date, or custom text. A description can sit under the label, and validation can change the border or add a message under the field.

The calendar can open in a popover or a bottom sheet. The system date control can be used all the time, or only on a touch device. When nothing is specified, a mouse gets the popover and a coarse pointer gets the system control. While a change is saving, the field cannot be edited. The save runs after the new value is written. The label can carry a hint and mark the field optional or required. The popover can show two months, and the week can start on a chosen day.
usage.zh:
`DateInput` 是一个日期输入组件，结合了文本输入框和日历弹出层。用户可以手动输入日期文本，也可以点击打开日历选择。

基本用法只需要绑定一个日期值：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const date = ref(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateInput v-model="date" placeholder="选择日期" />
</template>
```

绑定值是本地日期。写回字段时默认排成完整日期，例如 March 21, 2026。也可以改成短日期、带星期、系统日期，或自己排版。标签下面可以放说明。校验可以只改边框，也可以在字段下面写出原因。

日历可以从弹出层或底部面板打开。系统日期控件可以一直用，也可以只在触摸设备上用。不指定时，鼠标走弹出层，触摸走系统控件。字段正在保存时不能改，保存会在新值写进去之后进行。标签可以带一条提示，并标明选填或必填。弹出的月历可以一次看两个月，一周从哪一天开始也能指定。

en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { provideAstryxLocale } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { DateInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateInput'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

provideAstryxLocale('en')

const value = ref<Date | null>(new Date(2026, 3, 6))

function iso(date: Date | null): string {
  if (!date)
    return ''
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`
}
</script>

      v-model="value"
      label="Event date"
      description="Pick a date for your event"
      placeholder="Select a date"
      clearable
    />
  </VStack>
</template>

      label="Follow-up"
      is-optional
      placeholder="Select a date"

summary.en: `DateRangeInput` selects a start date and an end date. The value is `{ start, end }` with ISO dates, or `null`.
summary.zh: `DateRangeInput` 选择开始日期和结束日期。值是 `{ start, end }`，两端都是 ISO 日期；没有选择时是 `null`。

usage.en:
`DateRangeInput` selects a start date and an end date. The value is `{ start, end }` with ISO dates, or `null`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateRange } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'
import { DateRangeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const range = shallowRef<DateRange | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateRangeInput v-model="range" label="Date range" />
</template>
```

The popover shows two months under one header. The first click sets the start. The second click commits the range when the span is allowed. Clicking the start again commits a single day when the shortest span is one day, and cancels the selection otherwise. The closed field omits the year when both ends are in the current year. Presets stay beside the calendars. When the two months no longer fit side by side, they wrap onto separate rows. A constraint can still turn individual days off. While a change is saving, the field cannot be edited.
usage.zh:
`DateRangeInput` 选择开始日期和结束日期。值是 `{ start, end }`，两端都是 ISO 日期；没有选择时是 `null`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

import { DateRangeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'

en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateRange } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'
import { DateRangeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateRangeInput'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

function isoDaysAgo(days: number): string {
  const date = new Date()
  date.setDate(date.getDate() - days)
  const month = String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')
  const day = String(date.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')
  return `${date.getFullYear()}-${month}-${day}`
}

const range = shallowRef<DateRange | null>(null)
const presets = [
  { label: 'Last 7 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(7), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
  { label: 'Last 14 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(14), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
  { label: 'Last 30 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(30), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
  { label: 'Last 90 days', getRange: () => ({ start: isoDaysAgo(90), end: isoDaysAgo(0) }) },
]
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="4" style="width: 240px; max-width: 100%">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      {{ range ? `${range.start} → ${range.end}` : 'No range selected' }}
    </Text>
    <DateRangeInput
      v-model="range"
      label="Report period"
      description="Use a preset or pick a custom range"
      :presets="presets"
    />
  </VStack>
</template>

usage.en:
`DateTimeInput` combines a date and a time. The value is `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM`, or `null` until both parts are set.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { DateTimeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/DateTimeInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const meeting = shallowRef<string | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <DateTimeInput v-model="meeting" label="Meeting time" has-clear />
</template>
```

The date uses the date field. The time uses the same field as the time input. The two fields stay side by side and shrink with the row. They wrap only when the row is narrower than 16rem. Clear removes both parts. The date half can show two months and can start the week on a chosen day. While a change is saving, neither field can be edited.

summary.en: `Field` provides structure around a control:
summary.zh: `Field` 为控件补齐完整的字段结构，包括标签、补充说明、必填或可选提示和状态消息。它适合包装原生输入框、自研控件或第三方组件，让这些控件拥有与样式输入框一致的字段外观和无障碍关联。`TextInput` 已内置 `Field`，使用 `TextInput` 时直接传入字段属性即可，无需额外包裹。

usage.en:
`Field` provides structure around a control:

- A label.
- A description.
- Required or optional indicators.
- A status message.

`TextInput` includes `Field`. Pass field props directly to `TextInput`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { shallowRef, useId } from 'vue'

const volume = shallowRef(50)
const inputId = `volume-${useId()}`
</script>

<template>
  <Field :input-id="inputId" label="Volume" description="Set playback volume.">
    <template #default="field">
      <input
        :id="field.inputId" v-model.number="volume" type="range"
        :aria-labelledby="field.labelId" :aria-describedby="field.describedBy"
      >
    </template>
  </Field>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Field` 为控件补齐完整的字段结构，包括标签、补充说明、必填或可选提示和状态消息。它适合包装原生输入框、自研控件或第三方组件，让这些控件拥有与样式输入框一致的字段外观和无障碍关联。`TextInput` 已内置 `Field`，使用 `TextInput` 时直接传入字段属性即可，无需额外包裹。

下面的示例用 `Field` 包装一个原生滑块，通过默认插槽提供的关联 ID 把标签和说明挂到控件上：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Field } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { shallowRef, useId } from 'vue'

const volume = shallowRef(50)
const inputId = `volume-${useId()}`
</script>

<template>
  <Field :input-id="inputId" label="Volume" description="Set playback volume.">
    <template #default="field">
      <input
        :id="field.inputId" v-model.number="volume" type="range"
        :aria-labelledby="field.labelId" :aria-describedby="field.describedBy"
      >
    </template>
  </Field>
</template>
```

en.text: Wrap custom controls, native inputs, or third-party widgets that need labeling, helper text, optional/required indicators, or validation status.
Always provide a label for accessibility, even if visually hidden with isLabelHidden.
Use inputID and descriptionID to connect the label and description to the inner control with htmlFor and aria-describedby.
Nest Field around styled inputs such as TextInput, Typeahead, Select, DateInput, or TextArea; those components already render their own Field shell.
Use the attached status variant on non-bordered controls such as sliders, switches, or checkboxes; use detached so the message does not overlap the control.
Set both isOptional and isRequired on the same field.
Hide the label without providing an alternative way for the user to understand the field purpose.

zh.text: 包裹需要标签、辅助文字、必填或可选标识，或校验状态的自定义控件、原生输入框或第三方组件。
必须提供标签以保证无障碍，即使用 isLabelHidden 将其隐藏。
使用 inputID 和 descriptionID，将标签和描述通过 htmlFor 与 aria-describedby 关联到内部控件。
在 TextInput、Typeahead、Select、DateInput 或 TextArea 等样式输入框外层嵌套 Field。这些组件已自带 Field 外壳。
在滑块、开关或复选框等无边框控件上使用 attached 状态变体。应使用 detached，使消息不与控件重叠。
在同一字段上同时设置 isOptional 和 isRequired。
隐藏标签，又不提供其他方式让用户理解字段用途。

en.heading: Association IDs
en.text:
The default slot provides:

- `inputId`: the control ID.
- `labelId`: the label ID.
- `descriptionId`: the description ID.
- `statusId`: the status message ID.
- `describedBy`: the description and status message IDs.

1. Pass `inputId` to the control's `id`.
2. Pass `labelId` to the control's `aria-labelledby`.
3. Pass `describedBy` to the control's `aria-describedby`.

`Field` does not modify controls in its slot automatically.

en.heading: Group labels
en.text:
1. Set `isGroupLabel` on `Field`.
2. Pass `labelId` to the group's `aria-labelledby`.

If the label is hidden, provide visible context that explains the field's purpose.

en.heading: Scope
en.text:
The application is responsible for:

- Validating control values.
- Submitting forms.
- Disabling controls.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
Field requires a default slot receiving the following properties:

```ts
interface FieldSlotProps {
  inputId: string
  labelId: string
  descriptionId?: string
  statusId?: string
  describedBy?: string
}
```

- `Field` and `FieldLabel` provide a `labelIcon` slot.
- The `labelIcon` slot overrides the matching prop.
- The icon is decorative.
- `FieldStatus` has no slots. Pass its text through `message`.

en.heading: Status messages
en.text:
```ts
interface FieldStatusInput {
  type: 'error' | 'warning' | 'success'
  message?: string
  messageId?: string
}
```

en.heading: Announcements
en.text:
- `error` uses an `aria-live="assertive"` region.
- `warning` uses an `aria-live="polite"` region.
- `success` uses an `aria-live="polite"` region.
- When the message changes, the component announces it again.
- An empty message clears the announcement region.
- The visual message does not duplicate `aria-live`.

en.heading: Message layout
en.text:
- `attached`: joins the message to the control. Place it beneath a bordered control inside `Field`.
- `detached`: separates the message from the control. The message includes a status icon.
- `Field` in `tooltip` mode: hidden text remains available for descriptions and announcements. The inner control supplies the tooltip button.

For a standalone `FieldStatus`, use `detached`.

en.heading: Events
en.text: These three components declare no custom events.

en.heading: Template refs
en.text:
Each component exposes `element`:

Before mounting, `element` is `null`.
Without a message, `FieldStatus.element` is `null`.

- The field's root `div`.: `Field`
- The label element or group `span`.: `FieldLabel`
- The visual message element.: `FieldStatus`

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
Pass these directly to the inner control:

- `name`.
- `required`.
- `disabled`.
- Control event listeners.

- `Field`: `Field`
- `FieldLabel`: `FieldLabel`
- `FieldStatus`: `FieldStatus`

en.heading: Imports
en.text:
```ts
import type { FieldProps, FieldSlotProps, FieldStatusInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { Field, FieldLabel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { FieldStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/FieldStatus'
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
- `--astryx-spacing-1`: spacing between field contents.
- `--astryx-spacing-2`: padding for detached status messages.
- `--astryx-radius-element`: status message corner radius.
- `--astryx-color-text-secondary`: supporting text color.
- `--astryx-text-label-size`: label font size.
- `--astryx-text-supporting-size`: description and status message font size.

Status colors use the `TextInput` variables. See [TextInput validation states](/en/components/text-input/props#validation-states) for the complete list.

zh.heading: 关联 ID
zh.text:
默认插槽提供以下参数：

- `inputId`：控件 ID。
- `labelId`：标签 ID。
- `descriptionId`：说明 ID。
- `statusId`：状态消息 ID。
- `describedBy`：说明与状态消息的 ID 列表。

1. 将 `inputId` 传给控件的 `id`。
2. 将 `labelId` 传给控件的 `aria-labelledby`。
3. 将 `describedBy` 传给控件的 `aria-describedby`。

`Field` 不会自动修改插槽中的控件。

zh.heading: 分组标签
zh.text:
1. 为 `Field` 设置 `isGroupLabel`。
2. 将 `labelId` 传给分组的 `aria-labelledby`。

隐藏标签时，界面必须提供说明字段用途的上下文。

zh.heading: 使用范围
zh.text:
应用负责以下行为：

- 校验控件的值。
- 提交表单。
- 禁用控件。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
Field 的 default 为必需插槽，接收以下参数：

```ts
interface FieldSlotProps {
  inputId: string
  labelId: string
  descriptionId?: string
  statusId?: string
  describedBy?: string
}
```

- `Field` 和 `FieldLabel` 提供 `labelIcon` 插槽。
- `labelIcon` 插槽覆盖同名属性。
- 图标只作装饰用途。
- `FieldStatus` 不提供插槽。文字通过 `message` 传入。

zh.heading: 状态消息
zh.text:
```ts
interface FieldStatusInput {
  type: 'error' | 'warning' | 'success'
  message?: string
  messageId?: string
}
```

zh.heading: 播报规则
zh.text:
- `error` 使用 `aria-live="assertive"` 区域。
- `warning` 使用 `aria-live="polite"` 区域。
- `success` 使用 `aria-live="polite"` 区域。
- 消息变化时，组件重新播报消息。
- 消息为空时，组件清空播报区域。
- 视觉消息不重复设置 `aria-live`。

zh.heading: 消息布局
zh.text:
- `attached`：消息紧贴控件。必须放在 `Field` 内有边框的控件下方。
- `detached`：消息与控件分离。消息包含状态图标。
- `Field` 的 `tooltip` 模式：隐藏文字仍用于描述和播报。内部控件负责提供提示按钮。

独立使用 `FieldStatus` 时，使用 `detached`。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text: 这三个组件不声明自定义事件。

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
每个组件都公开 `element`：

挂载前，`element` 为 `null`。
没有消息时，`FieldStatus.element` 为 `null`。

- `Field`: `Field`
- `FieldLabel`: `FieldLabel`
- `FieldStatus`: `FieldStatus`

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
以下内容必须直接传给内部控件：

- `name`。
- `required`。
- `disabled`。
- 控件事件监听器。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
- `Field`: `Field`
- `FieldLabel`: `FieldLabel`
- `FieldStatus`: `FieldStatus`

zh.heading: 导入
zh.text:
```ts
import type { FieldProps, FieldSlotProps, FieldStatusInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { Field, FieldLabel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Field'
import { FieldStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/FieldStatus'
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
- `--astryx-spacing-1`：字段内容间距。
- `--astryx-spacing-2`：分离状态消息的内边距。
- `--astryx-radius-element`：状态消息圆角。
- `--astryx-color-text-secondary`：辅助文字颜色。
- `--astryx-text-label-size`：标签字号。
- `--astryx-text-supporting-size`：说明与状态消息字号。

状态颜色与 `TextInput` 共用变量。完整列表见 [TextInput 校验状态](/components/text-input/props#校验状态)。

en.name: Label
en.description: Text identifying the field. Always rendered for accessibility, optionally hidden visually.

en.name: Description
en.description: Helper text between the label and input explaining what to enter.

en.name: Control slot
en.description: A custom, native, or third-party control that does not already render a field shell.

en.name: Status message
en.description: Inline validation feedback showing error, warning, or success with a message.

en.name: Optional/Required indicator
en.description: Badge next to the label showing whether the field is optional or required.

en.name: Label tooltip
en.description: Info icon at the end of the label with a tooltip explaining the field.

zh.name: 标签
zh.description: 标识字段的文字。为了无障碍始终渲染，也可以只在视觉上隐藏。

zh.name: 说明
zh.description: 标签和输入之间的辅助文字，说明该填什么。

zh.name: 控件插槽
zh.description: 还没有自己的字段外壳的自定义、原生或第三方控件。

zh.name: 状态消息
zh.description: 行内校验反馈，带上错误、警告或成功，以及一条消息。

zh.name: 可选或必填指示
zh.description: 标签旁边的徽章，表示字段是可选还是必填。

zh.name: 标签提示
zh.description: 标签末尾的信息图标，用提示说明这个字段。

summary.en: `FieldStatus` is the message already used inside `Field`. Import it on its own when a custom control needs the same error, warning, or success treatment.
summary.zh: `FieldStatus` 就是 `Field` 里面那条状态消息。自定义控件需要同样的错误、警告或成功样式时，单独引入它。

usage.en:
`FieldStatus` is the message already used inside `Field`. Import it on its own when a custom control needs the same error, warning, or success treatment.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">

summary.en: `InputGroup` joins a field with a prefix, a suffix, or a button so they read as one control. Use it for a unit, a protocol, or a short action.
summary.zh: `InputGroup` 将输入框与前缀、后缀、按钮等元素组合成一个整体，常用于需要添加说明标签、单位、操作按钮的场景。

usage.en:
`InputGroup` joins a field with a prefix, a suffix, or a button so they read as one control. Use it for a unit, a protocol, or a short action.

Put fixed text in the `before` and `after` slots:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { InputGroup, InputGroupText } from '@astryx-vue/core/InputGroup'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const domain = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <InputGroup label="Website">
    <template #before>
      <InputGroupText>https://</InputGroupText>
    </template>
    <TextInput v-model="domain" label="URL" is-label-hidden placeholder="example" />
    <template #after>
      <InputGroupText>.com</InputGroupText>
    </template>
  </InputGroup>
</template>
```

Once the group has a label, it is a field. The label, description, optional or required mark, and status come from the shared field shell, so do not wrap another field around it. A control inside the group keeps its own label for that cell, usually hidden. Fixed text in the addons uses the group text component, which shares the addon type size and color. Without a label, the group stays a joined control that can sit inside a field that already exists.
usage.zh:
`InputGroup` 将输入框与前缀、后缀、按钮等元素组合成一个整体，常用于需要添加说明标签、单位、操作按钮的场景。

基本用法通过 `before` 和 `after` 插槽添加前置或后置内容：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { InputGroup, InputGroupText } from '@astryx-vue/core/InputGroup'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const domain = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <InputGroup label="网站">
    <template #before>
      <InputGroupText>https://</InputGroupText>
    </template>
    <TextInput v-model="domain" label="网址" is-label-hidden placeholder="example" />
    <template #after>
      <InputGroupText>.com</InputGroupText>
    </template>
  </InputGroup>
</template>
```

写上标签之后，这一组就是一个字段：标签、说明、可选或必填、状态都由字段壳负责，不要在外面再包一层。组内输入框自己的标签继续说明这一格填什么，通常隐藏起来。前后缀里的固定文字用组内文本组件，它和前后缀共用同一套字号和颜色。没有标签时，组仍然只是一条连在一起的控件，方便嵌进已经有字段的表单。

summary.en: `MultiSelector` picks several values from a fixed list. Without a search field, the trigger is a combobox. The menu is a listbox with `aria-multiselectable`. Choosing an option leaves the menu open.
summary.zh: `MultiSelector` 从固定列表里选多项。触发器在没有搜索框时是 combobox，列表是 `aria-multiselectable` 的 listbox。选中一项不会关闭列表。

usage.en:
`MultiSelector` picks several values from a fixed list. Without a search field, the trigger is a combobox. The menu is a listbox with `aria-multiselectable`. Choosing an option leaves the menu open.

An option can be a string, an object with a description, a divider, or a labeled section. `selectAll` adds a row that toggles every enabled option and skips disabled ones. `searchable` filters that same list. It does not call a remote source.

`triggerDisplay` controls the closed trigger. `count` shows how many are selected, `labels` joins the text, and `badges` uses tokens. `maxBadges` limits how many are visible, and the rest collapse to `+N`. A narrower trigger collapses further.

Read-only keeps the selection, stays focusable, and still submits. It does not open, and it has no clear button or chevron. It does not dim. While loading, the trigger shows a spinner, the create row stays hidden, and the menu does not claim the list is empty.

A function can replace the closed text for the count and labels displays. Badges ignore it. An empty selection does not call it and keeps the placeholder.

Create works together with search. When the typed text matches no option label, ignoring case, the first row offers to create it. Choosing that row adds a description to the change event: the kind is create, and the text is the query. Add that option to the list in the same update. Without search, the create row never appears.

To open the menu from outside, pass the handle object itself from script. A template unwraps a ref, so pass a function that receives the handle. Open does nothing while the field is read-only or disabled.

Arrow keys move the highlight. Enter and Space toggle the highlighted option. Space inside the search field still types. Enter creates the current text when nothing is highlighted. Escape closes the menu. When the menu is closed and the user is not searching, Backspace clears the selection.
usage.zh:
`MultiSelector` 从固定列表里选多项。触发器在没有搜索框时是 combobox，列表是 `aria-multiselectable` 的 listbox。选中一项不会关闭列表。

选项可以是字符串、带说明的对象、分隔线，或带标题的分组。`selectAll` 在列表顶部加一行全选，禁用项不会被全选带上。`searchable` 会在列表里显示搜索框，只过滤当前列表，不请求远程数据。

`triggerDisplay` 决定关闭后怎么展示已选项：`count` 显示「已选 N 项」，`labels` 拼接文字，`badges` 用标签。`maxBadges` 限制露出的个数，放不下时末尾显示 `+N`。宽度更窄时还会再收一次。

只读时已选值还在，可以聚焦并提交，但打不开列表，也没有清除和展开箭头，外观不会变暗。加载时触发器显示旋转指示，这时不提供创建行，也不说没有选项。

关闭后的文字可以用函数改写，只对数量和标签两种展示生效，标签模式会忽略它。没有任何选中项时不调用，继续显示占位符。

和搜索一起打开创建后，输入的文字和任何选项标签都不相同（忽略大小写）时，列表第一行是创建。选中后，变更事件会多带一段描述，里面是创建和当时的文字。调用方要在同一次更新里把这个选项加进列表。没有搜索时不会出现创建行。

从外面开关列表时，在脚本里把句柄对象本身传进去。模板会把 ref 自动拆开，所以模板里要传一个接收句柄的函数。只读和禁用时，打开不会生效。

方向键移动高亮项，Enter 和空格切换选中。搜索框里的空格仍用于输入。没有高亮项时，Enter 会创建当前文字。Escape 关闭列表。关闭且没有在搜索时，Backspace 清空已选项。

en.text: Do
Do
Don't

zh.text: 选项不多、用户需要对照着勾选时用多选器。
已选项要在触发器里认出来时，用 `badges` 并加上 `+N`。
用多选器搜索远程数据。那种场景用标签输入框。

summary.en: `NumberInput` is a numeric field. People can type a number or use the up and down chevrons. `min` and `max` clamp the value, and `step` sets how much each click changes it.
summary.zh: `NumberInput` 是一个专门用于数字输入的组件，提供步进按钮、最小最大值限制、精度控制等功能。用户可以手动输入数字，也可以点击按钮增减。

usage.en:
`NumberInput` is a numeric field. People can type a number or use the up and down chevrons. `min` and `max` clamp the value, and `step` sets how much each click changes it.

Bind a number:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NumberInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/NumberInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const count = ref(0)
</script>

<template>
  <NumberInput v-model="count" :min="0" :max="100" />
</template>
```

Values outside `min` and `max` are pulled back into range. The stepper names are English unless the app calls `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`. When `label` is set, it is included in those names.
usage.zh:
`NumberInput` 是一个专门用于数字输入的组件，提供步进按钮、最小最大值限制、精度控制等功能。用户可以手动输入数字，也可以点击按钮增减。

基本用法只需要绑定一个数字值：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NumberInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/NumberInput'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const count = ref(0)
</script>

<template>
  <NumberInput v-model="count" :min="0" :max="100" />
</template>
```

通过 `min` 和 `max` 属性设置数值范围，`step` 设置每次增减的步长。超出范围的值会被限制在有效区间内。步进按钮使用向上和向下的箭头。按钮的无障碍名称默认是英文，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后改为中文；如果传了 `label`，名称里会带上它。

en.text: Do
Do
Do
Don't

zh.text: 为数值范围明确的场景设置 `min` 和 `max`。
根据实际需求设置合理的步长，如数量用 1，价格用 0.01。
在标签中说明单位（如"数量（件）"），而不是把单位放在输入框内。
对大范围数值使用过小的步长，会让用户点击按钮很多次。

summary.en: `Radio` represents a single option. It must be used inside a `RadioGroup`, which manages selection through `provide/inject`.

usage.en:
`Radio` represents a single option. It must be used inside a `RadioGroup`, which manages selection through `provide/inject`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/Radio'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const size = shallowRef('md')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroup v-model="size" label="Size">
    <Radio value="sm" label="Small" />
    <Radio value="md" label="Medium" />
    <Radio value="lg" label="Large" />
  </RadioGroup>
</template>
```
usage.zh:

<script setup lang="ts">
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@astryx-vue/core/Radio'

const size = shallowRef('md')

<template>
  <RadioGroup v-model="size" label="Size">

en.heading: Keyboard interactions
en.text:
Once focus enters a radio group, the options follow the browser's native radio keyboard behavior, so no extra key conventions are needed:

- Tab: focus the radio group. Focus lands on the currently selected option, and the whole group takes up a single stop in the tab order.
- Arrow keys: move the selection within the group.
- Space: select the option that currently has focus.

en.heading: Usage notes
en.text:
A radio group is meant for choosing one option out of a small, mutually exclusive set. Once that set grows larger, the pattern stops working well.

- When there are only a few mutually exclusive options, a radio group lets the user see every choice at a glance.
- When there are more than about 7 options, a select control takes up less space and is easier to scan.

Whatever the number of options, always provide a group `label`: it is the accessible name for the whole radio group, and screen readers rely on it when announcing the options.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `change(value, event)`: fired when the user selects this option.

When Radio is used inside RadioGroup, RadioGroup coordinates the change events.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `labelIcon`: decorative icon before the label.

en.heading: Usage constraint
en.text:
`Radio` depends on `RadioContext`. When used standalone, it falls back to a context-free state and renders a single radio button only.
Always use Radio as a child of RadioGroup or RadioList.

zh.heading: 键盘操作
zh.text:
焦点进入单选组之后，组内的选项沿用浏览器原生单选按钮的键盘行为，无需额外的按键约定：

- Tab：聚焦单选组，焦点落在当前选中的选项上。整组在 Tab 顺序中只占一个停留点。
- 方向键：在组内移动当前选中的选项。
- Space：选中当前聚焦的选项。

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
单选组适合让用户在少量互斥的选项之间做出一次选择。选项变多之后，这种形式就不再合适。

- 选项数量较少、彼此互斥时，使用单选组让用户一眼看清全部可选项。
- 选项超过 7 个左右时，改用下拉选择更省空间，也更便于扫读。

无论选项多少，都要提供组标签 `label`：它是整组单选按钮的无障碍名称，屏幕阅读器依赖它朗读。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `change(value, event)`：用户选择该选项时触发。

当 Radio 在 RadioGroup 内使用时，事件由 RadioGroup 统一管理。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `labelIcon`：标签前的装饰图标。

zh.heading: 使用约束
zh.text:
`Radio` 依赖 `RadioContext` 获取所在组的状态。脱离 RadioGroup 独立使用时，它会退化为无上下文状态，只能渲染一个孤零零的单选按钮。
因此建议始终把 Radio 作为 RadioGroup 或 RadioList 的子项使用。

en.heading: Keyboard and accessibility
en.text:
`RadioGroup` turns a set of mutually exclusive options into a single radio group, so assistive technology reads it as one control rather than a handful of unrelated buttons. The semantics and attributes below are handled by the component for you.

- The whole group renders as one container with `role="radiogroup"`, which screen readers announce with radio group semantics.
- `aria-labelledby` links the container to its label, so a group `label` is required — it is the accessible name of the whole group.
- The group sets `aria-invalid` automatically when it is in an error state.
- Setting `isRequired` shows the required hint and enables native required validation.

For the keyboard, every option in the group shares one `name`, so the browser treats them as a native radio group: pressing `Tab` moves into the group and lands on the selected option, and the arrow keys then move between options.

en.heading: Usage notes
en.text:
These two notes help you choose between `RadioGroup` and [RadioList](/en/components/radio-list). Both solve the same problem — picking one value from a group of mutually exclusive options — and they differ only in how much control you get over the option layout.

- Use `RadioGroup` with `Radio` children when you need a custom option layout or rendering.
- Use [RadioList](/en/components/radio-list) when the options are simple and array-based and you do not need to customize the layout.

en.heading: Status
en.text:
`status` has these fields:

- `type`: `'error'`, `'warning'`, or `'success'`.
- `message`: message text.
- `messageId`: message ID.

The default `statusVariant` is `detached`, so the message appears below the group.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`: emitted after the selected value changes.
- `change(value, event)`: fired after the model updates.

`event` is a cancellable `RadioChangeEvent`.
`event.detail.originalEvent` keeps the native event.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- `default`: Radio children. Alternative to `options`.
- `labelIcon`: decorative icon before the label. Overrides the `labelIcon` prop.

en.heading: Template ref
en.text: - `element`: `HTMLDivElement | null`.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`class` and `style` are applied to the outer wrapper.
Unrecognized native attributes and listeners are forwarded to the group container.

zh.heading: 键盘与无障碍
zh.text:
`RadioGroup` 把一组互斥的选项组织成一个单选组，辅助技术会把它当成一个整体朗读，而不是若干个互不相关的按钮。下面这些语义和属性都由组件自动处理，你不需要手动声明。

- 整组渲染为一个 `role="radiogroup"` 容器，屏幕阅读器按单选组语义朗读。
- 组标签通过 `aria-labelledby` 与容器关联，所以必须提供组 `label`，它就是整组的无障碍名称。
- 处于错误状态时，组会自动设置 `aria-invalid`。
- 设置 `isRequired` 会显示必填提示，并启用原生必填校验。

键盘方面，组内所有选项共享同一个 `name`，浏览器会把它们当成同一组原生单选按钮：按 `Tab` 键进入这一组时会落在当前选中项上，之后用方向键在选项之间切换。

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
下面两条建议用来帮你在 `RadioGroup` 和 [RadioList](/components/radio-list) 之间做选择。两者解决的问题相同——都是在一组互斥的选项里选出一个——区别只在于你对选项布局的控制程度。

- 需要自定义选项布局或渲染时，直接组合 `RadioGroup` 和 `Radio` 子项。
- 选项结构简单、不需要定制布局时，改用 [RadioList](/components/radio-list) 会更省事。

zh.heading: 状态消息
zh.text:
`status` 包含以下字段：

- `type`：`error`、`warning` 或 `success`。
- `message`：消息文本。
- `messageId`：消息 ID。

默认 `statusVariant` 为 `detached`，消息显示在组下方。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：选中值变化后发出。
- `change(value, event)`：模型更新后触发。

`event` 是可取消的 `RadioChangeEvent`。
`event.detail.originalEvent` 保留原生事件。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- `default`：Radio 子项。与 `options` 二选一。
- `labelIcon`：标签前的装饰图标。优先于 `labelIcon` 属性。

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text: - `element`：`HTMLDivElement | null`。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`class` 和 `style` 应用于组件外层。
未声明的原生属性和事件传入组容器。

summary.en: `Selector` opens a list when the trigger is clicked. Choosing one option closes the list. It can filter the list, clear the current value, and disable individual options.
summary.zh: `Selector` 是一个下拉选择器组件，用户点击后展开选项列表，选择一项后收起。它支持搜索过滤、清除选择、禁用选项等功能。

usage.en:
`Selector` opens a list when the trigger is clicked. Choosing one option closes the list. It can filter the list, clear the current value, and disable individual options.

Pass the options and bind the value:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Selector } from '@astryx-vue/core/Selector'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const selected = ref(null)
const options = [
  { value: 'apple', label: 'Apple' },
  { value: 'banana', label: 'Banana' },
  { value: 'cherry', label: 'Cherry' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Selector v-model="selected" :options="options" placeholder="Select a fruit" />
</template>
```

Each option has a `value` and a `label`. Set `disabled` to skip an option, or `description` to add a second line of text.

`searchable` shows a search field that filters the list. `clearable` adds a clear button next to the current value. The menu is at least as wide as the trigger, and grows when an option label is longer.

A read-only field keeps the current value, stays focusable, and still submits with the form. It does not open, and it has no clear button or chevron. It does not dim. Disabled wins when both are set. While loading, the trigger shows a spinner and the menu does not claim that nothing was found. An empty catalog and a search with no matches use different sentences. The check mark sits at the end of a selected row by default, and can move to the start. An unselected row does not reserve space for it.

Arrow keys move the highlight. Home and End jump to the ends. Enter selects the highlighted option, and Escape closes the list. Once the search field is open, the arrow keys and Enter apply there, and Space still types a character.

Built-in strings such as the placeholder and the empty state are English. Call `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` to use the Chinese strings.
usage.zh:
`Selector` 是一个下拉选择器组件，用户点击后展开选项列表，选择一项后收起。它支持搜索过滤、清除选择、禁用选项等功能。

基本用法只需要传入选项数组和绑定值：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Selector } from '@astryx-vue/core/Selector'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const selected = ref(null)
const options = [
  { value: 'apple', label: '苹果' },
  { value: 'banana', label: '香蕉' },
  { value: 'cherry', label: '樱桃' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Selector v-model="selected" :options="options" placeholder="选择水果" />
</template>
```

每个选项对象包含 `value`（唯一标识）和 `label`（显示文本）。可选的 `disabled` 属性可以禁用特定选项，`description` 可以添加辅助说明。

开启 `searchable` 属性后，选择器会显示搜索框，用户可以输入文字过滤选项。开启 `clearable` 后，已选中的值旁边会出现清除按钮。

只读时当前值还在，可以聚焦，也会随表单提交，但打不开列表，也没有清除和展开箭头，外观不会变暗。同时禁用时按禁用处理。加载时触发器里是旋转指示，列表在选项到达之前不说「没有结果」。没有任何选项，和搜索之后没有命中，是两句不同的话。选中标记默认画在行尾，也可以改到行首；没选中时标记不占位。

方向键上下移动高亮项，Home 和 End 跳到首尾，Enter 选中当前项，Escape 关闭列表。搜索框打开后，方向键和回车作用在搜索框上，空格仍用于输入。

菜单至少和触发器一样宽，选项更长时会跟着变宽。组件自带文案默认是英文，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后改为中文。文档页会按当前语言自动提供。

summary.en: Use `Slider` to choose a number or numeric range.
summary.zh: `Slider` 用于选择单个数值或数值区间。

usage.en:
Use `Slider` to choose a number or numeric range.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Slider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Slider'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const volume = shallowRef(50)
const budget = shallowRef<[number, number]>([20, 80])
</script>

<template>
  <Slider v-model="volume" label="Volume" />
  <Slider v-model="budget" label="Budget" value-display="text" />
</template>
```

Import the theme once in the application entry:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

en.text: Always provide a label, even if visually hidden, so the slider is accessible to screen readers.
Format values with meaningful units like "$50" or "75%" instead of raw numbers.
Use for precise numeric entry; pair with a text input or use NumberInput instead.
Set a step size so large that only a few positions are possible; use SegmentedControl or radio buttons instead.
Wrap a disabled slider in Tooltip to explain why it is disabled; disabled controls swallow the hover events the wrapper needs. Use the disabledMessage prop instead.

zh.text: 必须提供标签，即使将其隐藏，让屏幕阅读器用户也能理解滑块。
使用有意义的单位格式化数值，例如 “$50” 或 “75%”，避免只显示原始数字。
用于精确的数值输入。应搭配文本输入框，或使用 NumberInput。
把步长设得过大，导致只能选择少数几个位置。应改用 SegmentedControl 或单选按钮。
用 Tooltip 包裹禁用的滑块来解释禁用原因。禁用的控件会吞掉包裹层需要的悬停事件。应改用 disabledMessage 属性。

en.heading: Keyboard controls
en.text:
The slider is fully operable with the keyboard, so users never have to drag. Once a thumb has focus, these keys change its value:

- Tab moves focus to each thumb in turn.
- Left / Right move one step in the horizontal direction; the direction is reversed in right-to-left layouts.
- Up / Down increase or decrease the value by one step.
- PageUp / PageDown increase or decrease the value by ten steps.
- Home / End move to the allowed minimum or maximum.
- Escape closes the value tooltip or the disabled reason tooltip.

In range mode each thumb has its own name, taken from `minLabel` and `maxLabel`, so assistive technology can tell which bound is being adjusted. Each thumb's ARIA bounds also update when its sibling changes, so the range that is announced always matches the values the thumb can actually take.

en.heading: Usage guidance
en.text:
A slider suits choosing a value along a continuous range, not entering an exact number. Keep the following in mind:

- Provide a numeric input when exact entry matters.
- `isRequired` only provides a required description, so assistive technology knows the field is required.
- Validate accepted values in application code.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`: updates a number or range.
- `change(value)`: fires when the value changes.
- `changeEnd(value)`: fires after a drag, pointer cancellation or keyboard adjustment.

Each supported key press fires `changeEnd`.
An unchanged value at a boundary does not fire `change`.
Disabling the component during a drag cancels that drag.
This cancellation does not fire `changeEnd`.

en.heading: Ranges and steps
en.text:
- Use a `number` for single-value mode.
- Use `[number, number]` for range mode.
- Steps are relative to `min`.
- Minimum separation is `minStepsBetweenThumbs × step`.
- Thumbs cannot cross.
- Values outside the bounds display at the nearest bound.
- Input ranges display in ascending order.
- Display normalization does not update the bound model by itself.
- Non-positive steps use `1`.
- If `max` is below `min`, the interval collapses to `min`.

en.heading: Forms
en.text:
- Set `htmlName` to submit one hidden field for a single value.
- Ranges submit two hidden fields with the same name.
- Read ranges with `FormData.getAll(name)`.
- Disabled sliders do not submit values.
- Native form reset does not change `v-model`.
- Update the bound value in the form's `reset` handler to reset it.

en.heading: Template references and attributes
en.text:
- `element`: the control's `HTMLDivElement | null`.
- `focus(index = 0, options?)`: focuses the specified thumb.
- `blur()`: removes thumb focus.
- `class`, `style` and other attributes apply to the outer field.
- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` merge into each thumb.
- The component owns thumb roles, values, bounds and disabled states.
- The `labelIcon` slot replaces the label icon.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 键盘操作
zh.text:
滑块完全可以用键盘操作，不必依赖拖动。焦点落到滑块上之后，下面的按键会调整它的数值：

- Tab 依次把焦点移到每个滑块上。
- 左右方向键沿水平方向移动一步；在从右到左的布局里方向相反。
- 上下方向键增加或减少一步。
- PageUp / PageDown 增加或减少十步。
- Home / End 移动到允许的最小值或最大值。
- Escape 关闭数值提示或禁用原因提示。

区间模式下，每个滑块有独立名称，名称分别来自 `minLabel` 和 `maxLabel`，辅助技术据此分辨当前调整的是下限还是上限。每个滑块的 ARIA 边界也会随另一个滑块的值更新，所以读出的可调范围始终和实际可选取的值一致。

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
滑块适合在连续区间里挑选数值，不适合要求精确输入的场景。使用时注意以下几点：

- 需要精确输入时，另提供数值输入控件。
- `isRequired` 只提供必填说明，让使用辅助技术的用户知道这个字段是必填的。
- 业务层负责校验允许的数值范围。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：更新单值或区间。
- `change(value)`：数值改变时触发。
- `changeEnd(value)`：拖动结束、指针取消或键盘调整结束时触发。

键盘每次有效按键都触发 `changeEnd`。
到达边界后，值不变时不触发 `change`。
拖动过程中禁用组件会中止本次拖动。
中止时不触发 `changeEnd`。

zh.heading: 区间与步长
zh.text:
- 单值模式使用 `number`。
- 区间模式使用 `[number, number]`。
- 步长从 `min` 开始计算。
- 最小间隔为 `minStepsBetweenThumbs × step`。
- 两个滑块不能越过彼此。
- 越界的传入值按边界显示。
- 传入区间按从小到大显示。
- 组件不会因修正显示值而主动修改绑定值。
- 非正步长按 `1` 处理。
- `max` 小于 `min` 时，区间收缩到 `min`。

zh.heading: 表单
zh.text:
- 设置 `htmlName` 后，单值提交一个隐藏字段。
- 区间提交两个同名隐藏字段。
- 使用 `FormData.getAll(name)` 读取区间。
- 禁用滑块不提交值。
- 原生表单重置不会改变 `v-model`。
- 需要重置值时，在表单的 `reset` 事件中更新绑定值。

zh.heading: 模板引用与属性
zh.text:
- `element`：滑动区域的 `HTMLDivElement | null`。
- `focus(index = 0, options?)`：聚焦指定滑块。
- `blur()`：移除滑块焦点。
- `class`、`style` 和其他属性应用于字段外层。
- `aria-labelledby` 和 `aria-describedby` 合并到每个滑块。
- 组件管理滑块的角色、当前值、边界和禁用状态。
- `labelIcon` 插槽替换标签图标。

en.heading: Keyboard interactions
en.text:
`Switch` is built on a native checkbox, so its keyboard behaviour follows the browser's defaults and every action is reachable without a mouse. With focus on the switch, these keys apply:

- Tab moves focus to the switch.
- Space toggles the checked state.
- Escape closes the disabled-reason tooltip.

The disabled-reason tooltip only appears when the switch is disabled and a `disabledMessage` is provided, so Escape has an effect only in that case.

en.heading: Usage notes
en.text:
Use a switch for a two-state option that takes effect right away, such as turning notifications on or off. If an option only applies once the form is submitted, use a checkbox instead; otherwise users may assume the switch has already saved the change.

`isRequired` only shows the required indicator and sets `aria-required`; it does not perform validation or block form submission.

en.heading: Status
en.text:
`status` has these fields:

- `type`: `'error'`, `'warning'`, or `'success'`.
- `message`: message text.
- `messageId`: message ID.

The default `statusVariant` is `detached`, so the message appears below the switch.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`: emitted after the user toggles.
- `change(value, event)`: fired after the model updates.
- `actionError(error, value, event)`: emitted when the async action rejects or throws.

`event` is a cancellable `SwitchChangeEvent`.
`event.detail.originalEvent` keeps the native event.
Calling `event.preventDefault()` inside `change` skips `changeAction`.
It does not roll back the model update.

en.heading: Async action
en.text:
`changeAction(value, event)` receives the new value and the component event.

- The component shows a loading state while the Promise is pending.
- Repeated toggles are blocked until the Promise settles.
- The parent-bound value takes precedence over any temporary display value.
- The component clears the loading state after success or failure.
- Failed actions do not roll back the value written to `v-model`.
- Use `@action-error` to display failures.
- Roll back in application code when needed.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `labelIcon`: decorative icon before the label. Overrides the `labelIcon` prop.

en.heading: Template ref
en.text:
- `element`: `HTMLInputElement | null`.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`: focus the input.
- `blur()`: remove focus from the input.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`class` and `style` are applied to the outer wrapper.
Unrecognized native attributes and listeners are forwarded to the `input`.
The component manages `checked`, `type`, `role`, and core ARIA states.

zh.heading: 键盘操作
zh.text:
开关在底层是一个原生复选框，键盘行为沿用浏览器自带的规则，用户不用鼠标也能完成切换。焦点落在开关上之后，可以使用以下按键：

- 按 Tab 把焦点移到开关上。
- 按 Space 切换选中状态。
- 按 Escape 关闭禁用原因提示。

「禁用原因提示」只在开关被禁用、并且传入了 `disabledMessage` 时才会出现，所以 Escape 也只在那种情况下有效。

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
开关适合「改完立即生效」的二元选项，例如打开或关闭通知。如果一个选项要等提交表单才算确认，就应该改用复选框，否则用户会误以为开关已经保存了这次修改。

`isRequired` 只负责显示必填提示并设置 `aria-required`，不执行校验，也不会阻止表单提交。

zh.heading: 状态消息
zh.text:
`status` 包含以下字段：

- `type`：`error`、`warning` 或 `success`。
- `message`：消息文本。
- `messageId`：消息 ID。

默认 `statusVariant` 为 `detached`，消息显示在开关下方。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：用户切换后发出布尔值。
- `change(value, event)`：模型更新后触发。
- `actionError(error, value, event)`：异步操作拒绝或同步抛出错误时触发。

`event` 是可取消的 `SwitchChangeEvent`。
`event.detail.originalEvent` 保留原生事件。
在 `change` 中调用 `event.preventDefault()` 可跳过 `changeAction`。
此操作不会撤销模型更新。

zh.heading: 异步操作
zh.text:
`changeAction(value, event)` 接收新值和组件事件。

- 操作返回 Promise 时，组件显示加载状态。
- 操作完成前，组件阻止重复切换。
- 父组件的新值优先于临时显示值。
- Promise 成功或失败后，组件清除加载状态。
- 失败时，组件不会撤销写入 `v-model` 的值。
- 使用 `@action-error` 显示失败信息。
- 需要回滚时，由业务层更新绑定值。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `labelIcon`：标签前的装饰图标。优先于 `labelIcon` 属性。

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
- `element`：`HTMLInputElement | null`。
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`：聚焦输入元素。
- `blur()`：移除输入焦点。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`class` 和 `style` 应用于组件外层。
未声明的原生属性和事件传入 `input`。
组件管理 `checked`、`type`、`role` 和核心 ARIA 状态。

en.text: Provide a visible label so users know what to enter. If the label must be hidden, set isLabelHidden with a descriptive label for screen readers.
Set maxLength with a character counter when there is a defined limit; it helps users stay within bounds before they submit.
Use the status prop to surface validation feedback inline: show success when input is valid, warning for soft limits, and error for hard failures.
Add a description or placeholder to clarify expected content, like "Describe the issue in detail," but never rely on placeholder alone as the only label.
Avoid using TextArea for short, single-line values like names or emails; use TextInput instead.
Don't rely solely on placeholder text to communicate the purpose of the field; placeholders disappear on focus and are not accessible labels.
Don't show a status message without also setting the status type; the colored border and icon are what draw the user's attention to the message.
Don't wrap a disabled TextArea in Tooltip to explain why it's disabled; disabled controls swallow the hover events the wrapper needs. Use the disabledMessage prop instead.

zh.text: 提供可见的标签，让用户知道该输入什么。若必须隐藏标签，设置 isLabelHidden，并为屏幕阅读器提供描述性标签。
设有字数上限时，设置 maxLength 并显示字数统计。这能帮助用户在提交前控制字数。
使用 status 属性显示行内校验反馈：输入有效时用 success，软限制用 warning，硬错误用 error。
添加说明或占位文字，说明预期内容，例如 “Describe the issue in detail”。避免只用占位文字作为唯一标签。
用文本域输入名称或邮箱等单行短内容。应使用文本输入框。
只依赖占位文字说明字段用途。占位文字在获得焦点后会消失，且不是可访问的标签。
在未设置状态类型时显示状态消息。边框颜色和图标正是吸引用户注意消息的元素。
用 Tooltip 包裹禁用的文本域来解释禁用原因。禁用的控件会吞掉包裹层需要的悬停事件。应改用 disabledMessage 属性。

en.heading: Keyboard controls
en.text:
The control is a real `textarea`, so it keeps the browser's native key behaviour, and the component only adds handling on top of a few keys. Most keystrokes therefore behave exactly as they do in any other multi-line field:

- Tab moves focus into or out of the text area.
- Shift + Enter inserts a newline at the caret.
- Enter emits the `enter` event, so your handler can take over submit-like logic.
- Escape closes an open disabled reason tooltip or status tooltip.

When submit-on-Enter behaviour makes sense for your form, implement it in the `enter` handler.

en.heading: Usage guidance
en.text:
The text area does not constrain what users type, so length limits and validation belong to your application:

- When the expected length matters, state `minlength` and `maxlength` in the `description` so users know it before they submit.
- `isRequired` only shows the required indicator and sets the matching ARIA state; it does not run native validation.
- Whether the content meets your business rules is up to validation in application code.

en.heading: Events
en.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：update text content.
- `change(value, event)`：fired when content changes.
- `clear(event)`：fired when the clear button is clicked.
- `enter(event)`：fired on Enter. Shift + Enter does not fire it.
- `keydown(event)`：fired on any key press.
- `actionError(error, value, event)`：fired when changeAction throws.

When content changes, `update:modelValue` and `change` fire before `changeAction`.
Cancelling the `change` event prevents `changeAction` from running.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
- `class`, `style`, and other attributes are applied to the field wrapper.
- `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby` are merged into the native textarea.
- The component manages `disabled`, `readonly`, and `aria-invalid`.
- The `icon` slot shows a decorative icon on the left.
- The `end` slot shows extra content on the right.
- The `labelIcon` slot replaces the icon before the label.

en.heading: Theming

zh.heading: 键盘操作
zh.text:
文本域沿用浏览器原生 `textarea` 的按键行为，组件只在个别按键上追加了处理，因此大部分操作和系统里的其它多行输入框一致：

- 按 Tab 把焦点移入或移出文本域。
- 按 Shift + Enter 在光标处插入一个换行。
- 按 Enter 时组件触发 `enter` 事件，你可以在回调里处理提交等逻辑。
- 按 Escape 关闭已经打开的禁用原因提示或状态提示。

如果「按 Enter 提交」这类行为对你有意义，直接在 `enter` 事件里实现即可。

zh.heading: 使用建议
zh.text:
文本域不会限制用户输入什么，字数控制和内容校验都需要在你的应用里完成：

- 对字数有明确要求时，把 `minlength` 与 `maxlength` 写进 `description`，让用户在提交前就知道预期长度。
- `isRequired` 只负责显示必填提示并设置对应的 ARIA 状态，不会执行浏览器原生的必填校验。
- 输入内容是否符合业务规则，由应用层负责校验。

zh.heading: 事件
zh.text:
- `update:modelValue(value)`：更新文本内容。
- `change(value, event)`：内容变化时触发。
- `clear(event)`：点击清空按钮时触发。
- `enter(event)`：按 Enter 时触发。Shift + Enter 不触发。
- `keydown(event)`：按键时触发。
- `actionError(error, value, event)`：changeAction 抛出异常时触发。

内容变化时，`update:modelValue` 与 `change` 在 `changeAction` 之前触发。
取消 `change` 事件会阻止 `changeAction` 执行。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
- `class`、`style` 和其他属性应用于字段外层。
- `aria-labelledby` 与 `aria-describedby` 合并到原生 textarea。
- 组件管理 textarea 的 `disabled`、`readonly` 与 `aria-invalid`。
- `icon` 插槽在文本域左侧显示装饰图标。
- `end` 插槽在文本域右侧显示附加内容。
- `labelIcon` 插槽替换标签前的图标。

summary.en: `TextInput` accepts single-line text. The component includes `Field`.
summary.zh: `TextInput` 用于输入邮箱、姓名、搜索词等单行文本。标签、说明与校验消息由内置的 `Field` 自动关联，通过 `v-model` 管理输入值即可：

usage.en:
`TextInput` accepts single-line text. The component includes `Field`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const email = shallowRef('')
</script>

<template>
  <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" auto-complete="email" />
</template>
```

For a custom control, use [Field](/en/components/field). Import the theme once in your app entry:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```
usage.zh:
`TextInput` 用于输入邮箱、姓名、搜索词等单行文本。标签、说明与校验消息由内置的 `Field` 自动关联，通过 `v-model` 管理输入值即可：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const email = shallowRef('')
</script>

<template>
  <TextInput v-model="email" label="邮箱" type="email" auto-complete="email" />
</template>
```

自定义控件可使用 [Field](/components/field)。主题在应用入口引入一次：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

en.text: Always provide a visible label so users know what the field is for. Only hide the label when surrounding context makes it obvious, like a search bar with a magnifying-glass icon.
Use validation status with a message to explain what went wrong: "Email must include @" is better than just turning the border red.
Size the input to match the expected content length so users can gauge how much to type: small for zip codes, medium for names, large for URLs.
Add a clear button for search and filter inputs so users can quickly reset without selecting all text.

zh.text: 必须提供可见的标签，让用户知道该字段的用途。只有上下文已经明确时才隐藏标签，例如带放大镜图标的搜索框。
使用带消息的校验状态，说明出了什么问题。“邮箱必须包含 @” 比仅把边框变红更清楚。
输入框尺寸要与预期内容长度相符，让用户判断该输入多少内容。邮编用 small，姓名用 medium，URL 用 large。
为搜索和筛选输入框添加清除按钮，让用户无需全选文字即可快速重置。
