en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
A `label` is required. Screen readers rely on it to describe what the field is for, and a `placeholder` is only visible while the field is empty, so it cannot stand in for a label.

The component wires the label, description and status message together with ARIA attributes, so assistive technology reads them as one unit:

- `description` and `status.message` connect to `aria-describedby`.
- An error status sets `aria-invalid`.
- A required field sets `aria-required`.

`isRequired` renders the required indicator and sets the ARIA state. When you also need native browser validation — for example when you rely on form submission to block an incomplete field — pass `required` as well.

en.heading: Input methods
en.text:
While an input method such as Pinyin or Kana is composing a candidate, the characters the user has typed are not final yet. The component tracks that distinction so a half-finished value never reaches your state:

- The component does not update `v-model` while a candidate is still being composed, and the field keeps showing the composing text.
- Once `compositionend` fires — the moment the user picks a candidate — the component writes the final text to `v-model`.
- Enter used to confirm a candidate does not emit `enter`. The event fires normally when the user presses Enter again to submit the form.

This keeps validation and submit logic built on `v-model` from reacting to partial input.

en.heading: Status type
en.text:
```ts
interface TextInputStatus {
  type: 'error' | 'warning' | 'success'
  message?: string
  messageId?: string
}
```

en.heading: TextInputChangeEvent
en.text:
```ts
type TextInputChangeEvent = CustomEvent<{
  value: string
  originalEvent: Event
}>
```

- Native `input` events are usually not cancelable.
- `change` supplies a cancelable component event.
- `event.detail.value` contains the new value.
- `event.detail.originalEvent` contains the original event.
- `changeAction` and `actionError` receive the same component event.

The original event type depends on the action:

en.heading: Async actions
en.text:
`changeAction` receives the new value and component event. Returning a Promise displays a loading indicator.

- **Editing**: the input remains editable while saving. Clearing the value also runs `changeAction`.
- **Loading**: `aria-busy` stays `true` while any action is unfinished. It clears after all actions settle, including rejected actions.
- **Value updates**: new values from the parent take precedence over temporary display values.
- **Concurrent saves**: cancel older requests or check request versions in your application to prevent stale results from overwriting newer values.
- **Errors**: handle `@action-error` to show a message. To roll back, update the value bound with `v-model`.

en.heading: Template refs
en.text:
Template refs expose these properties and methods:

- `element: HTMLInputElement | null`: the native input element, or `null` before mounting.
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`: focuses the input.
- `blur()`: removes focus from the input.
- `select()`: selects all input text.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
- `maxlength`, `minlength`, `pattern`, `required`, `form`, `aria-*`, `data-*` and native event listeners are forwarded to the native `input`.
- `class` and `style` apply to the input wrapper; `width` applies to the whole `Field`.
- The component manages `value`, `type`, `disabled`, `readonly`, `autofocus` and core ARIA state. Use the corresponding component props.
- `aria-describedby` and `aria-labelledby` merge with the component's internal association IDs.

en.heading: Disabled and read-only states
en.text:
- **Disabled without a reason**: native `disabled` prevents editing, focus and submission of the field.
- **Disabled with `disabledMessage`**: `aria-disabled` and `readonly` preserve focus so the reason can be discovered. The component removes `name` and blocks edits and clearing.
- **Read-only**: the input remains focusable, allows copying and is included in `FormData`.
- Disabled takes precedence when both states are set.

en.heading: Theme
Appearance and size
en.text:
- `--astryx-input-background`: input background color.
- `--astryx-input-border`: default border color.
- `--astryx-input-focus`: focus border color when no validation status is set.
- `--astryx-radius-element`: input corner radius.
- `--astryx-input-height-sm`: small height; Neutral defaults to `28px`.
- `--astryx-input-height-md`: medium height; Neutral defaults to `32px`.
- `--astryx-input-height-lg`: large height; Neutral defaults to `36px`.

en.heading: Validation states
en.text:
Each state provides three variables for the border and icon, message text, and message background:

- **Error**: `--astryx-input-error`, `--astryx-input-error-foreground`, `--astryx-input-error-background`.
- **Warning**: `--astryx-input-warning`, `--astryx-input-warning-foreground`, `--astryx-input-warning-background`.
- **Success**: `--astryx-input-success`, `--astryx-input-success-foreground`, `--astryx-input-success-background`.

Override status variables on a parent containing the whole field to style both the input and its status message.

en.heading: Color mode
en.text:
- Neutral selects its colors from CSS `color-scheme`.
- Set `data-astryx-color-mode="light"` on the root element or theme container to use light mode.
- Set `data-astryx-color-mode="dark"` to use dark mode.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
`label` 是必填项。屏幕阅读器靠它说明这个字段是做什么的；`placeholder` 只在输入框为空时可见，用户一开始输入就消失，不能用它代替标签。

标签、说明和状态消息由组件通过 ARIA 属性串联起来，辅助技术能把它们当成一个整体读出：

- `description` 与 `status.message` 关联到 `aria-describedby`。
- 出错时自动设置 `aria-invalid`。
- 字段必填时自动设置 `aria-required`。

`isRequired` 负责显示必填提示并设置 ARIA 状态。如果还需要浏览器原生的必填校验——例如依赖表单提交来拦截未填写的字段——再额外传入 `required`。

zh.heading: 中文输入法
zh.text:
拼音、注音这类输入法在用户敲下字母时，文字还处在候选状态，选定候选词之后才算真正输入完成。组件会区分「正在组合」和「已经输入」，避免把半成品当成最终值：

- 候选词尚未确定时，组件不更新 `v-model`，输入框里显示的仍是组合中的文字。
- `compositionend` 触发后，也就是用户选定候选词的那一刻，组件才把最终文字同步到 `v-model`。
- 用 Enter 选定候选词不会触发 `enter` 事件；用户再次按下 Enter 提交表单时，`enter` 才正常触发。

这样，依赖 `v-model` 的校验和提交逻辑就不会在用户输入到一半时被提前打断。

zh.heading: 状态类型
zh.text:
```ts
interface TextInputStatus {
  type: 'error' | 'warning' | 'success'
  message?: string
  messageId?: string
}
```

zh.heading: TextInputChangeEvent
zh.text:
```ts
type TextInputChangeEvent = CustomEvent<{
  value: string
  originalEvent: Event
}>
```

- 原生 `input` 事件通常无法取消。
- `change` 提供可以取消的组件事件。
- `event.detail.value` 保存修改后的值。
- `event.detail.originalEvent` 保存原始事件。
- `changeAction` 和 `actionError` 接收同一个组件事件。

原始事件的类型取决于操作：

zh.heading: 异步操作
zh.text:
`changeAction` 接收修改后的值和组件事件。返回 Promise 时，组件会显示加载状态。

- **输入**：保存期间仍可编辑。清除内容也会运行 `changeAction`。
- **加载状态**：存在未完成的操作时，`aria-busy` 为 `true`。所有操作结束后清除加载状态，失败的操作也会计入。
- **值更新**：父组件传入的新值优先于组件临时显示的值。
- **并发保存**：由应用取消旧请求或检查请求序号，避免过期结果覆盖新值。
- **失败处理**：通过 `@action-error` 展示错误。需要回滚时，由应用更新 `v-model` 绑定值。

zh.heading: 模板引用
zh.text:
模板引用公开以下属性和方法：

- `element: HTMLInputElement | null`：原生输入元素。挂载前为 `null`。
- `focus(options?: FocusOptions)`：聚焦输入框。
- `blur()`：移除输入框焦点。
- `select()`：选中全部输入内容。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
- `maxlength`、`minlength`、`pattern`、`required`、`form`、`aria-*`、`data-*` 和原生事件监听器传入原生 `input`。
- `class` 和 `style` 作用于输入框外层。`width` 作用于整个 `Field`。
- `value`、`type`、`disabled`、`readonly`、`autofocus` 与核心 ARIA 状态由组件管理，请使用对应的组件属性。
- `aria-describedby` 和 `aria-labelledby` 会与组件内部的关联 ID 合并。

zh.heading: 禁用与只读
zh.text:
- **禁用且无原因说明**：使用原生 `disabled`，无法编辑、聚焦或提交该字段。
- **禁用且有 `disabledMessage`**：使用 `aria-disabled` 和 `readonly` 保留焦点，以便查看原因。同时移除 `name`，阻止修改和清除。
- **只读**：保留焦点，允许复制，值仍包含在 `FormData` 中。
- 同时设置禁用和只读时，禁用优先。

zh.heading: 主题
外观与尺寸
zh.text:
- `--astryx-input-background`：输入框背景色。
- `--astryx-input-border`：默认边框色。
- `--astryx-input-focus`：无校验状态时的焦点边框色。
- `--astryx-radius-element`：输入框圆角。
- `--astryx-input-height-sm`：小尺寸高度，Neutral 默认 `28px`。
- `--astryx-input-height-md`：中尺寸高度，Neutral 默认 `32px`。
- `--astryx-input-height-lg`：大尺寸高度，Neutral 默认 `36px`。

zh.heading: 校验状态
zh.text:
每种状态提供三个变量，分别控制边框与图标、消息文字、消息背景：

- **错误**：`--astryx-input-error`、`--astryx-input-error-foreground`、`--astryx-input-error-background`。
- **警告**：`--astryx-input-warning`、`--astryx-input-warning-foreground`、`--astryx-input-warning-background`。
- **成功**：`--astryx-input-success`、`--astryx-input-success-foreground`、`--astryx-input-success-background`。

在包含整个字段的父元素上覆盖状态变量，可同时调整输入框和状态消息。

zh.heading: 明暗模式
zh.text:
- Neutral 根据 CSS `color-scheme` 自动选择配色。
- 在根元素或主题容器上设置 `data-astryx-color-mode="light"`，可固定使用浅色模式。

summary.en: `TimeInput` edits a time of day. The value is an ISO time, `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`, or `null`.
summary.zh: `TimeInput` 编辑一天里的时间。值是 ISO 时间，`HH:MM` 或 `HH:MM:SS`，没有选择时是 `null`。

usage.en:
`TimeInput` edits a time of day. The value is an ISO time, `HH:MM` or `HH:MM:SS`, or `null`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TimeInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TimeInput'
import { shallowRef } from 'vue'

const time = shallowRef<string | null>('14:30')
</script>

<template>
  <TimeInput v-model="time" label="Time" />
</template>
```

The default hour format is 12-hour. Arrow keys step by `increment` minutes. On a fine pointer the field is typed text. On a coarse pointer, `adaptive-native` and `adaptive-bottom-sheet` use the platform time input, unless the field needs seconds or a step other than one minute. Placeholder and clear text follow the locale.

```vue
</script>

<template>

</template>
```

默认按 12 小时显示。方向键按 `increment` 分钟步进。细指针下是文本框。粗指针下，`adaptive-native` 和 `adaptive-bottom-sheet` 使用系统时间输入；需要秒，或步进不是 1 分钟时，仍保留文本框。占位符和清除文案跟随语言。

summary.en: `Tokenizer` collects search results into removable tokens. The source matches Typeahead: `createStaticSource` for local data, or a `search` function for a remote source. Selected items stay out of the menu.
summary.zh: `Tokenizer` 把多条搜索结果收成可删除的标签。数据源和自动补全相同，本地用 `createStaticSource`，远程实现 `search`。已选条目不会再次出现在列表里。

usage.en:
`Tokenizer` collects search results into removable tokens. The source matches Typeahead: `createStaticSource` for local data, or a `search` function for a remote source. Selected items stay out of the menu.

`creatable` turns the current text into a new token. `clearable` removes every token. When the input is empty, `Backspace` removes the last token. Arrow keys move focus between tokens, and `Backspace` or `Delete` removes the focused one.

`overflow` controls what happens when the tokens do not fit:

Width measurement uses `useOverflow`. The `#icon` slot sits at the start of the field. `#token` can replace each selected chip with a custom `Token`.
usage.zh:
`Tokenizer` 把多条搜索结果收成可删除的标签。数据源和自动补全相同，本地用 `createStaticSource`，远程实现 `search`。已选条目不会再次出现在列表里。

`creatable` 允许把当前输入收成一条新标签。`clearable` 一次清空。输入框为空时，`Backspace` 删掉最后一条。方向键可以在标签之间移动焦点，`Backspace` 或 `Delete` 删除当前标签。

`overflow` 控制放不下时的表现：

宽度测量复用 `useOverflow`。`#icon` 插槽放在输入区开头，每条标签也可以用 `#token` 换成自己的 `Token`。

summary.en: `Typeahead` is a single-select search field. The input is a combobox and the menu is a listbox. Use `createStaticSource` for local data, or implement `search` for a remote source.

usage.en:
`Typeahead` is a single-select search field. The input is a combobox and the menu is a listbox. Use `createStaticSource` for local data, or implement `search` for a remote source.

Local search matches the label and optional keywords. Set `debounceMs` to `0` to filter immediately:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createStaticSource } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Typeahead } from '@astryx-vue/core/Typeahead'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const selected = ref(null)
const source = createStaticSource([
  { id: 'apple', label: 'Apple' },
  { id: 'grape', label: 'Grape' },
], { keywords: item => item.id === 'grape' ? ['raisin'] : [] })
</script>

<template>
  <Typeahead v-model="selected" :search-source="source" label="Fruit" :debounce-ms="0" show-on-focus />
</template>
```

An async source returns a Promise. `useAsyncSource` waits until typing pauses, 150 milliseconds by default, then starts the request. A newer search cancels the previous one, and a stale response is dropped. An empty query uses `bootstrap` when it exists. Loading, no results, and a failed request each get their own row in the menu.

Arrow keys move the highlight, `Enter` selects it, and `Escape` closes the menu. While focus is in the input, `Home` and `End` move the caret. After a selection, the value collapses to a focusable token. Focusing it again returns to search.

Built-in strings are English. Call `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` for the Chinese strings.

summary.en: `ComplexSelector` is a field whose popup content you draw yourself. It owns the label, the trigger, the popover, focus return, and `changeAction`. The default slot owns the content: it receives `value`, `commit`, `close`, and `state`.
summary.zh: `ComplexSelector` 是一个弹层内容由你来画的字段。标签、触发器、弹出层、焦点归还和 `changeAction` 由它负责。默认插槽负责内容，参数是 `value`、`commit`、`close` 和 `state`。

usage.en:
`ComplexSelector` is a field whose popup content you draw yourself. It owns the label, the trigger, the popover, focus return, and `changeAction`. The default slot owns the content: it receives `value`, `commit`, `close`, and `state`.

`commit` writes the value and runs `changeAction` when one was provided. While that action is pending the trigger shows a spinner and the slot sees the value that was just committed. Arrow Down on the trigger opens the popup.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
</script>

<template>
  <ComplexSelector v-model="value" label="Deadline" :trigger-label="value">
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```

The popup stays open until the slot calls `commit`. A tree can use `TreeList`. `status`, `isDisabled`, `isRequired`, and `description` are the same field props as the other inputs.

`alignment` places the popup along its axis. `startIcon` draws an icon in the trigger. `variant="ghost"` drops the border so the trigger matches a toolbar button. `renderTrigger`, or the `trigger` slot, replaces the field: spread the bindings onto your own control. `handleRef` and a template `ref` both expose `open`, `close`, `toggle`, and `isOpen`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ComplexSelectorHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
const selector = shallowRef<ComplexSelectorHandle | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <button type="button" @click="selector?.open()">
    Open
  </button>
  <ComplexSelector
    ref="selector"
    v-model="value"
    label="Deadline"
    start-icon="calendar"
    :trigger-label="value"
    variant="ghost"
  >
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`ComplexSelector` 是一个弹层内容由你来画的字段。标签、触发器、弹出层、焦点归还和 `changeAction` 由它负责。默认插槽负责内容，参数是 `value`、`commit`、`close` 和 `state`。

`commit` 写入新值，并在提供了 `changeAction` 时执行它。动作还没结束时，触发器显示加载指示，插槽看到的是刚提交的值。在触发器上按 Arrow Down 会打开弹层。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ComplexSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/ComplexSelector'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('Today')
</script>

<template>
  <ComplexSelector v-model="value" label="Deadline" :trigger-label="value">
    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```

弹层会一直开着，直到插槽调用 `commit`。树可以用 `TreeList`。`status`、`isDisabled`、`isRequired` 和 `description` 与其他输入框的字段属性相同。

`alignment` 决定弹层沿打开方向怎么对齐。`startIcon` 在触发器开头放一个图标。`variant="ghost"` 去掉边框，触发器看起来像工具栏按钮。`renderTrigger` 或 `trigger` 插槽会换掉整个字段：把参数展开到你自己的控件上。`handleRef` 和模板 `ref` 都能调用 `open`、`close`、`toggle` 和 `isOpen`。

```vue
    variant="ghost"

    <template #default="{ commit, close }">
      <button type="button" @click="commit('Next week'); close()">
        Next week
      </button>
    </template>
  </ComplexSelector>
</template>
```

summary.en: Power Search splits a query into a field, an operator, and a value. Focusing the input lists the fields. Choosing one opens an editor when the operator still needs a value. A boolean field and a content search become a filter immediately. Each filter sits in the input as a token that can be opened again.
summary.zh: 结构化搜索把一条查询拆成字段、运算符和值。聚焦输入框会列出字段。选中之后，如果这个运算符还要填值，就打开编辑器；布尔值和全文搜索会直接变成一条条件。条件以标签的形式排在输入框里，点开可以修改。

usage.en:
Power Search splits a query into a field, an operator, and a value. Focusing the input lists the fields. Choosing one opens an editor when the operator still needs a value. A boolean field and a content search become a filter immediately. Each filter sits in the input as a token that can be opened again.

Backspace on an empty input removes the last token. The arrow keys move between tokens, Enter opens the focused one, and Backspace or Delete removes it. A read-only token cannot be edited or removed. Escape cancels the editor and returns focus.

The editor follows the width of the search field, from about 400 to 720. When the viewport cannot hold the minimum, the floor gives way. The editor hugs the side that opened it only after the maximum has squeezed it. The position is taken once, while it is open.

`createPowerSearchConfig` builds the operators from field definitions and returns `applyFilters`. That function filters rows on its own. It does not go through a table’s column filters. Time, relative dates, entities, and custom values keep every row unless the caller interprets them. A nested filter requires every child by default. An operator named or, or one whose name contains any, requires only one child.

Tokens can collapse to one line when the field loses focus. The inline mode expands in place. The layer mode floats over the field and leaves the content below where it is. A numeric result count is read with plural wording. A string is shown as given. Changes are announced politely, and the first paint is silent.

Pass a disabled reason together with the disabled state. The input stays focusable, and the reason appears on hover and keyboard focus. Do not wrap the field in another tooltip. A natively disabled control swallows the hover.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createPowerSearchConfig, PowerSearch } from '@astryx-vue/core/PowerSearch'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const people = [
  { name: 'Alice', active: true },
  { name: 'Bob', active: false },
]
const { config, applyFilters } = createPowerSearchConfig([
  { key: 'name', type: 'string', label: 'Name' },
  { key: 'active', type: 'boolean', label: 'Active' },
])
const filters = ref([])
const matched = computed(() => applyFilters(filters.value, people))
</script>

<template>
  <PowerSearch v-model:filters="filters" :config="config" :result-count="matched.length" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
结构化搜索把一条查询拆成字段、运算符和值。聚焦输入框会列出字段。选中之后，如果这个运算符还要填值，就打开编辑器；布尔值和全文搜索会直接变成一条条件。条件以标签的形式排在输入框里，点开可以修改。

输入为空时，退格键删掉最后一条。左右方向键在标签之间移动，回车打开当前标签，退格或删除键去掉它。只读的条件不能改，也不能删。按 Esc 会取消编辑并把焦点还回去。

编辑器的宽度跟搜索条走，最窄大约 400，最宽 720。窗口放不下一个最小宽度时，下限让给窗口。只有被最大宽度压窄时，编辑器才改贴打开它的那一侧。打开之后位置先定住，关掉之前不跟着搜索条挪。

`createPowerSearchConfig` 根据字段定义生成运算符，并返回一个独立的 `applyFilters`。它只负责把行滤出来，不经过表格自己的列过滤。时间、相对日期、实体和自定义值默认全部保留，调用方要自己解释。嵌套条件默认每一条都要满足；运算符名字里带 any，或者就是 or，则满足任意一条即可。

失焦时标签可以收成一行。`unfocused-inline` 在原处展开，`unfocused-layer` 浮在字段上，不把下面的内容往下推。结果数量是数字时会按单复数读出来，是字符串时原样显示。数量变化会礼貌地播报，第一次出现不播。

禁用原因和禁用一起用时，输入框仍然可以聚焦，悬停或键盘聚焦能看到原因。不要再在外面套一层提示，原生禁用会把悬停吃掉。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { createPowerSearchConfig, PowerSearch } from '@astryx-vue/core/PowerSearch'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const people = [
  { name: 'Alice', active: true },
  { name: 'Bob', active: false },
]
const { config, applyFilters } = createPowerSearchConfig([
  { key: 'name', type: 'string', label: 'Name' },
  { key: 'active', type: 'boolean', label: 'Active' },
])
const filters = ref([])
const matched = computed(() => applyFilters(filters.value, people))
</script>

<template>
  <PowerSearch v-model:filters="filters" :config="config" :result-count="matched.length" />
</template>
```

en.text: Group a long field list, and add aliases for the fields people actually type.
Point content search at one string field instead of letting every field consume free text.
Fold Power Search into a table column filter. Column filters stay substring and enum matches.
Save a nested filter while a child is unfinished. An unfinished child is not a filter yet.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
The icon sits before the tokens. End content sits before the clear button and is the place for another action. The token and editor slots win over a component registered for a value type.

The component also exposes focus and blur methods, so a button outside the field can send the cursor back.

en.heading: Field definitions
en.text:
`createPowerSearchConfig` accepts string, number, boolean, date, enum, enum list, and string list. Strings can contain, start with, end with, or equal a value. Numbers compare magnitude. Dates can be before, after, or between. A boolean does not ask for another value.

A hand-written config can also use time, a relative date, an entity list, a custom editor, and nested filters. A custom editor needs a way to read the value back as text.

图标放在条件前面。末尾内容放在清除按钮之前，适合再放一个操作。标签和编辑器插槽优先于按类型注册的替换组件。

组件还暴露聚焦和取消聚焦两个方法，给外面的按钮把光标送回输入框。

`createPowerSearchConfig` 接受字符串、数字、布尔、日期、枚举、枚举列表和字符串列表。字符串有包含、开头、结尾和等于。数字有大小比较。日期有早于、晚于和介于。布尔值不需要再填值。

手写配置时还可以使用时间、相对日期、实体列表、自定义编辑器和嵌套条件。自定义编辑器要同时提供怎么把值读成文字。

usage.en:
Indicators are the selection pictures shared by a checkbox, a radio, a selector, and a Markdown task list. They are decorative. The owning control keeps the input, the role, the accessible name, the focus, and the keyboard. The indicator only turns state into a picture. That split is what makes them themeable: restyle one through its class, or replace the component by name.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxIndicator'
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxIndicator state="indeterminate" size="sm" />
</template>
```

The box draws in every state. Unchecked is an empty box, not an empty gap. A mixed state draws a short bar.

For a control the user can operate, use [CheckboxInput](/en/components/checkbox-input). The check and the circle are [Check Indicator](/en/components/check-indicator) and [Radio Indicator](/en/components/radio-indicator).
usage.zh:
指示器是复选框、单选按钮、选择器和 Markdown 任务列表共用的选择图形。它们只负责把状态画出来。真正的控件保留输入、角色、名称、焦点和键盘。正因为拆开了，图形才可以换：先改它的类，形状不对时再按名字替换组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CheckboxIndicator } from '@astryx-vue/core/CheckboxIndicator'
</script>

<template>
  <CheckboxIndicator state="indeterminate" size="sm" />
</template>
```

方框每种状态都画。未选中是空盒子，不是留白。半选画一条短线。

需要用户操作时，使用 [复选框](/components/checkbox-input)。勾和圆点分别是 [勾选指示器](/components/check-indicator) 和 [单选指示器](/components/radio-indicator)。

en.text: Restyle the stable class first. Replacing the component is the heavier path, for when the shape itself is wrong.

Decide whether slot content replaces the mark with isRenderable, not a null check. The helper is shallow: it excludes null, undefined, booleans, and the empty string. An element still counts when its descendants later render nothing. A host writes a spinner with v-if="busy". When that condition is false, a null check deletes the state mark.
A replacement must set aria-hidden. The owning control provides the role and the accessible name. A visible indicator would be announced twice.
Use theme tokens for every color, radius, and border width in a replacement.

Render a single root element, and let it keep the border radius the focus ring should follow. The control paints that ring onto the indicator when the real input is visually hidden. The ring is never missing. It is only the wrong shape if the root has no radius of its own. Do not draw a second ring.
Pass hover or pressed state in as props. Hover reaches the graphic through the ancestor class astryx-indicator-scope, so hovering the row tints the control with no props involved.

Assume the graphic is mounted only when it is selected. The host renders it in every state and passes state. That is what lets a replacement draw where the default draws nothing, such as an empty circle on an unchosen row. Drawing nothing in a state is the indicator's decision.

zh.text: 先改稳定的类名。形状本身不对时，再替换组件。
用 isRenderable 判断插槽是否替换标记，不要用空值判断。它只排除空值、布尔值和空字符串。元素算数，哪怕里面后来是空的。宿主用 v-if="busy" 放转圈。条件为假时，空值判断会把状态标记删掉。
替换图形必须隐藏起来。角色和名称由外面的控件提供，再宣布一次就会读两遍。
替换图形里的颜色、圆角和边框宽度都用主题变量。
只渲染一个根元素，并保留焦点环要跟着走的圆角。真正的输入被藏起来时，控件把焦点环画在指示器上。环不会丢，只是根元素没有圆角时形状会不对。不要再自己画一圈。
把悬停或按下当成属性传进去。悬停通过祖先上的 astryx-indicator-scope 到达图形，移到行上就会变色。
以为只有选中时才会挂上图形。宿主每种状态都会渲染，并传入状态。替换图形才能在默认什么都不画的地方画出来，比如未选中行上的空心圆。某种状态不画，是指示器自己的决定。

en.heading: Anatomy
en.text:
- Chrome (checkbox, radio): Required. The persistent box or circle drawn by the checkbox and radio indicators in every state. The check indicator is the state mark itself and has no chrome of its own.
- State mark: The checkmark, the indeterminate bar, or the radio dot shown inside the chrome for the current state.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- The default slot replaces the checkmark and the dash, drawn inside the box.
- An empty slot, including a condition that is false, keeps the marks. Use isRenderable rather than a null check.
- Slot content is decorative. Do not put a focusable control in the slot.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- The root always has `aria-hidden="true"`.
- The component has no interactive role.
- It ignores `role`, `tabindex` and `contenteditable` attributes.
- It provides no click or keyboard behavior.
- The exposed `element` is `HTMLSpanElement | null`.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
The indicator shares color variables with [CheckboxInput](/en/components/checkbox-input/props#theme).

- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator`: outer box.
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-check`: checkmark.
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-dash`: indeterminate mark.
- `data-state`: current visual state.
- `data-size`: current size.
- `data-disabled`: disabled state.

zh.heading: 结构
zh.text:
- 外框（方框、圆点）: 外框（方框、圆点）
- 状态标记: 状态标记

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽替换勾和半选短线，画在方框里面。
- 插槽为空，包括条件不成立时，标记还在。用 isRenderable，不要用空值判断。
- 插槽内容只作装饰。不得在插槽中放入可聚焦控件。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 根元素固定为 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 组件不设置交互角色。
- 组件不接收 `role`、`tabindex` 或 `contenteditable`。
- 组件不提供点击事件或键盘行为。
- 模板引用的 `element` 是 `HTMLSpanElement | null`。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
指示器与 [CheckboxInput](/components/checkbox-input/props#主题) 共用颜色变量。

- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator`：指示器外框。
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-check`：勾选标记。
- `.astryx-checkbox-indicator-dash`：半选标记。
- `data-state`：当前显示状态。
- `data-size`：当前尺寸。
- `data-disabled`：禁用状态。

en.description: The box at sm and md, including unchecked, checked, mixed, and disabled.

en.title: Cycle the state
en.description: The buttons cycle the box, the check, and the circle. The check and the circle share the single-selection state.

en.title: Replace the mark while loading
en.description: A spinner in the default slot replaces the mark. Turning it off restores the box's check, and an unchosen check stops reserving space.

en.text:
- Chrome (checkbox, radio): Required on the box and the circle, which draw in every state. The check indicator is the state mark itself and has no chrome of its own.
- State mark: The checkmark shown when the option is chosen. Unchecked draws nothing unless the slot has something renderable.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- The default slot replaces the mark in every state, chosen or not. A host passes a pending spinner through it.
- When the slot has something renderable, a 1rem box holds the place.
- With nothing renderable, an unchosen check renders nothing. Use isRenderable. A false condition must not delete a chosen check.
- Slot content is decorative. Do not put a focusable control in it.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:

- The component sets no interactive role and provides no click or keyboard behavior.
- A passed role, tab order, content editable flag, or attribute whose name starts with aria is dropped.
- The exposed element is empty when the mark is unchosen and the slot is empty.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
There is no chrome class. A chosen check is the icon. A slot is `.astryx-check-indicator`, 1rem square.

- Checked uses the accent icon color. Disabled uses the disabled icon color.
- `data-size` is sm or md.
- `data-disabled` is set when the row is disabled.

- 插槽里有可渲染内容时，用 1rem 的盒子占住位置。
- 没有可渲染内容时，未选中的勾不渲染。用 isRenderable 判断。条件为假时不能把已选中的勾删掉。
- 插槽内容只作装饰。不要放可聚焦控件。

zh.heading: 无障碍

- 传入的角色、Tab 顺序、可编辑属性，以及以 aria 开头的属性会被丢掉。
- 未选中且插槽为空时，暴露的元素为空。

zh.text:

- 选中用强调色图标，禁用用禁用色。
- `data-size` 是 sm 或 md。
- 行禁用时设置 `data-disabled`。

- Chrome (checkbox, radio): Required. The persistent circle drawn in every state. The check indicator has no chrome of its own.
- State mark: The filled inner dot, shown only when the circle is chosen.

en.heading: Slots
en.text:
- The default slot replaces the inner dot and is drawn inside the circle.
- An empty slot, including a condition that is false, keeps the circle and the dot.
- Slot content is decorative. Do not put a focusable control in it.

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
- The root always has `aria-hidden="true"`.
- The component sets no interactive role and provides no click or keyboard behavior.
- A passed role, tab order, content editable flag, or attribute whose name starts with aria is dropped.
- The exposed element is the circle.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
- `.astryx-radio-indicator`: the circle.
- `.astryx-radio-indicator-dot`: the inner dot when chosen.
- `data-state`: unchecked or checked.
- `data-size`: sm or md. Omitted when no size is passed.
- `data-disabled`: disabled styling.

A chosen circle uses the input status color first, so a field error or warning still tints it, then the accent color. Hover comes from an ancestor `.astryx-indicator-scope`, and only for a pointer that can hover. Reduced motion turns the transition off. In forced colors, an empty circle uses the canvas color and a chosen circle uses the highlight.

The focus ring is painted by the radio on `.astryx-radio-native:focus-visible + .astryx-radio-indicator`. The circle's radius is what that outline follows.

zh.heading: 结构
zh.text:
- 外框（方框、圆点）: 外框（方框、圆点）
- 状态标记: 状态标记

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text:
- 默认插槽替换内点，画在圆圈里面。
- 插槽为空，包括条件不成立时，圆圈和内点都还在。
- 插槽内容只作装饰。不要放可聚焦控件。

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
- 根元素固定为 `aria-hidden="true"`。
- 组件不设置交互角色，也不提供点击或键盘行为。
- 传入的角色、Tab 顺序、可编辑属性，以及以 aria 开头的属性会被丢掉。
- 暴露的元素是圆圈本身。

zh.heading: 主题
zh.text:
- `.astryx-radio-indicator`：圆圈。
- `.astryx-radio-indicator-dot`：选中后的内点。
- `data-state`：unchecked 或 checked。
- `data-size`：sm 或 md。没传尺寸时不写。
- `data-disabled`：禁用外观。

选中色先看输入状态色，这样字段的错误和警告仍能着色，否则用强调色。悬停通过祖先上的 `.astryx-indicator-scope` 生效，只在可以悬停的指针上变色。减少动态效果时过渡关掉。强制颜色模式下，未选中用画布色，选中用高亮色。

焦点环由单选按钮画在 `.astryx-radio-native:focus-visible + .astryx-radio-indicator` 上。描边跟着圆圈自己的圆角走。

en.title: States
en.description: Empty and filled circles at sm and md, including disabled. Unchecked stays an empty circle.

zh.title: 状态
zh.description: 小尺寸和中等尺寸的空心圆与实心圆，包括禁用。未选中始终是空心圆。

summary.en: `Center` puts its content in a flex container and aligns it to the middle of that box on one axis or on both. It is layout only: it paints nothing, draws no border, and adds no role or accessible name to the content, so empty states, loading screens, and login forms all fit without any extra markup.
summary.zh: `Center` 把内容放进一个弹性容器，并沿一条轴或两条轴把它居中。它只做布局：自己不上色、不画边框，也不给内容附加任何角色或名称，因此空状态、加载页、登录表单这类"内容需要在可用空间里居中"的场景都可以直接使用。

usage.en: `Center` puts its content in a flex container and aligns it to the middle of that box on one axis or on both. It is layout only: it paints nothing, draws no border, and adds no role or accessible name to the content, so empty states, loading screens, and login forms all fit without any extra markup. By default it centers on both axes: ```vue ``` Everything in the slot is centered as one block: `Center` never distributes space between several children. When you need to arrange multiple items along a direction, use `Stack` instead. `axis` selects which axis is centered. `both` (the default) centers the main and the cross axis, `horizontal` centers the inline direction only, and `vertical` centers the block direction only. The two single-axis values are named after horizontal writing; they end up on flex alignment, so in vertical writing they follow the flex main and cross axes. Centering an axis only shows when that axis has space to give, which is why `both` and `vertical` usually need a `height` — without one the container is only as tall as its content and looks exactly like an uncentered box. ```vue ``` The size of the container comes from `width`, `height`, `maxWidth`, and `minHeight`. Numbers are interpreted as pixels and strings pass through as CSS values, so `width="100%"` and `maxWidth="70rem"` both work. Padding uses the same spacing scale as `Stack`: `padding` sets all four edges, `paddingInline` and `paddingBlock` override their own axis, and `paddingInlineStart`, `paddingInlineEnd`, `paddingBlockStart`, and `paddingBlockEnd` override a single edge. The most specific input wins, and `0` is a real value, so it can clear the inset set by a broader one. `isInline` renders the container as `inline-flex`. It then takes part in the surrounding line of text instead of breaking the line box, which is what you want for a fixed-size box that centers an icon or a badge.
usage.zh: `Center` 把内容放进一个弹性容器，并沿一条轴或两条轴把它居中。它只做布局：自己不上色、不画边框，也不给内容附加任何角色或名称，因此空状态、加载页、登录表单这类"内容需要在可用空间里居中"的场景都可以直接使用。 默认同时在两条轴上居中： ```vue ``` 插槽里的内容被当作一个整体居中，`Center` 不会在多个子元素之间分配间距。需要沿某个方向排列多项时，请改用 `Stack`。 `axis` 决定居中哪条轴。`both`（默认值）同时居中主轴与交叉轴，`horizontal` 只居中行内方向，`vertical` 只居中块方向。后两个取值是按横向书写命名的：它们最终落在 flex 的对齐属性上，所以在纵向书写下跟随的是 flex 主轴与交叉轴。单轴居中只有在对应方向上有可分配的空间时才看得出效果，因此 `both` 和 `vertical` 通常需要给出 `height`，否则容器只有内容那么高，视觉上和没有居中一样。 ```vue ``` 容器自身的尺寸由 `width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight` 控制。数字按像素处理，字符串按原样作为 CSS 值使用，例如 `width="100%"` 或 `maxWidth="70rem"`。内边距沿用与 `Stack` 相同的间距刻度：`padding` 设置四边，`paddingInline`、`paddingBlock` 覆盖各自的轴，`paddingInlineStart`、`paddingInlineEnd`、`paddingBlockStart`、`paddingBlockEnd` 再覆盖单条边。越具体的那一层生效，`0` 同样是有效取值，可以显式清掉上一层设置的内边距。 `isInline` 会把容器换成 `inline-flex`。这时它作为行内元素参与文字排版，不会打断行盒，适合给图标或角标做一个固定大小的小方块。

en.text: Use a single-axis value only in horizontal writing, or after checking which writing mode is active. Outside horizontal writing, a single-axis value follows the flex main and cross axes rather than the name of the prop.
Give `height` when you use `axis="vertical"` or the default `both` in horizontal writing. Centering needs space to distribute, and a container that is only as tall as its content shows no change.
Use `isInline` for small elements such as icons and badges. The box stays inside the current line, so the text around it is not broken.
Keep the semantic structure and the accessible names on the content. `Center` is a layout-only container: it adds no role and no label, so the content stays responsible for both.
Wrap whole page sections in `Center`. Page structure belongs to the surrounding layout; `Center` solves the centering of one block.
Use `Center` for horizontal lists of items. Several items in a row are clearer with `Stack` and `hAlign="center"`.

zh.text: 只在横向书写的界面里使用单轴取值，或者确认当前书写模式后再用。纵向书写时单轴取值跟随的是 flex 主轴与交叉轴，而不是属性名的字面含义。
在横向书写下用 `axis="vertical"` 或默认的 `both` 时给出 `height`。居中需要有可分配的空间，容器只有内容那么高时看不出任何变化。
行内的小元素（图标、角标）用 `isInline` 居中，这样它仍然属于当前行，文字排版不会被拆断。
把语义结构和无障碍名称留在内容上。`Center` 是纯布局容器，不会添加角色或标签，内容自己负责这些信息。
用 `Center` 承担整页结构。页面骨架应该由外层布局决定，`Center` 只解决一块内容的居中。
用 `Center` 横向排列表格、列表等多项内容。多项排列用 `Stack` 配合 `hAlign="center"` 更直接。

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: Which axis to center. both centers the main and the cross axis, horizontal centers the inline direction only, and vertical centers the block direction only. A single-axis value ends up on flex alignment, so outside horizontal writing it follows the flex main and cross axes.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Container width. Numbers are interpreted as pixels, strings pass through as CSS values.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: Container height. Numbers are interpreted as pixels. Vertical centering needs height to distribute, so the default both and vertical usually use it.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Maximum container width. Numbers are interpreted as pixels.

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: Minimum container height. Numbers are interpreted as pixels.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Inner padding on all four edges, using the Astryx spacing scale.

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: Inline-axis padding; overrides padding on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: Inline-start padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingInline and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode and direction.

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: Inline-end padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingInline and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode and direction.

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: Block-axis padding; overrides padding on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: Block-start padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingBlock and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode.

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: Block-end padding; overrides that edge only, and takes precedence over paddingBlock and padding. The physical edge follows writing mode.

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: Render as inline-flex, so the container stays in a line of text. Useful for centering small elements such as icons and badges.

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: 居中哪条轴。both 同时居中主轴与交叉轴，horizontal 只居中行内方向，vertical 只居中块方向。单轴取值落在 flex 的对齐属性上，纵向书写时跟随的是 flex 主轴与交叉轴。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 容器宽度。数字按像素处理，字符串按原样作为 CSS 值使用。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 容器高度。数字按像素处理。垂直居中需要有可分配的高度，所以默认的 both 和 vertical 通常会用到它。

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: 容器最大宽度。数字按像素处理。

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: 容器最小高度。数字按像素处理。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 四边的内边距，使用 Astryx 间距刻度。

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: 行内轴内边距，覆盖该轴上的 padding。

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: 行内起始边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingInline 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式和方向。

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: 行内结束边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingInline 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式和方向。

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: 块轴内边距，覆盖该轴上的 padding。

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: 块起始边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingBlock 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式。

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: 块结束边内边距，只覆盖这一条边，优先级高于 paddingBlock 与 padding。物理边取决于书写模式。

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: 使用 inline-flex 渲染，容器因此留在文字行内，适合居中图标或角标这类小元素。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: The content to center. It is centered as one block: Center adds no space between several children and changes none of their semantics, colors, or reading order.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 要居中的内容。内容被当作一个整体居中，Center 不会在多个子元素之间分配间距，也不会改变它们各自的语义、颜色或阅读顺序。

en.heading: Props
en.text:
`SpacingStep` accepts these values:

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>`.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

`Center` writes its own `data-axis` on the root element to reflect the axis in effect; a `data-axis` passed in by a consumer does not replace it.

zh.heading: Props
zh.text:
`SpacingStep` 支持以下值：

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

`Center` 会在根元素上写自己的 `data-axis`，用来反映当前生效的居中轴；消费者传入的同名 `data-axis` 不会覆盖它。

en.title: Horizontal
en.description: A formatting toolbar centered on the horizontal axis. In vertical writing, that axis follows flex rather than a guaranteed physical horizontal.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Center } from '@astryx-vue/core/Center'
import { IconButton } from '@astryx-vue/core/IconButton'
import { HStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'

const tools = [
  { label: 'Bold', icon: 'i-carbon-text-bold' },
  { label: 'Italic', icon: 'i-carbon-text-italic' },
  { label: 'Underline', icon: 'i-carbon-text-underline' },
  { label: 'List', icon: 'i-carbon-list' },
  { label: 'Link', icon: 'i-carbon-link' },
  { label: 'Image', icon: 'i-carbon-image' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padding="2" :width="520">
    <Center axis="horizontal" width="100%">
      <HStack align="center" :gap="0">
        <IconButton
          v-for="tool in tools"
          :key="tool.label"
          :label="tool.label"
          size="sm"
          variant="ghost"
        >
          <span class="css-icon css-icon--sm" :class="tool.icon" />
        </IconButton>
      </HStack>
    </Center>
  </Card>
</template>

en.title: Inside a card

en.name: Container
en.description: A flexbox wrapper that aligns its children to the center along the chosen axis.

en.name: Content
en.description: Anything passed in the default slot to Center. Typically a card, form, spinner, or empty state message.

zh.name: 容器
zh.description: 沿所选轴向把内容居中的 flex 容器。

zh.name: 内容
zh.description: 放进 Center 默认插槽的任何东西。常见的是卡片、表单、转圈或空状态。

summary.en: `Divider` separates groups of content with a thin rule. It can carry a centered label.
summary.zh: `Divider` 用一条细线把相关内容分成若干区块，适合在表单、列表或设置项之间做视觉上的划分。需要为分区标注名称时，也可以把简短文字放在线条中间：

usage.en:
`Divider` separates groups of content with a thin rule. It can carry a centered label.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
</script>

<template>
  <Divider label="or" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Divider` 用一条细线把相关内容分成若干区块，适合在表单、列表或设置项之间做视觉上的划分。需要为分区标注名称时，也可以把简短文字放在线条中间：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
</script>

<template>
  <Divider label="或" />
</template>
```

en.text: Use subtle dividers between related content sections and strong dividers for high-contrast boundaries.
Add a label to the divider when sections need a visible category heading.
Overuse dividers; rely on spacing and layout to separate content when possible.

zh.text: 相关内容区块之间使用 `subtle` 分隔线；需要更醒目的边界时，改用 `strong`。
分区需要一个可见的类别标题时，为分隔线添加 `label`，文字会居中显示在线条上。
避免密集使用分隔线：能用留白和排版区分内容时，优先使用间距而不是线条。

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: Orientation of the divider.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Text centered on the divider. Also used as the accessible name.

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: Line weight. strong uses the emphasized border color.

rows.name: `isFullBleed`
rows.description: Extend to the container edges with negative margins.

rows.name: `orientation`
rows.description: 分隔线的方向，垂直分隔线适合放在固定高度的行内。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 显示在分隔线中间的文字，同时作为分隔线的无障碍名称。

rows.name: `variant`
rows.description: 线条的视觉强弱，strong 使用强调边框色，适合需要明显边界的场景。

rows.name: `isFullBleed`
rows.description: 为 true 时，分隔线会越过容器内边距，延伸到容器边缘。

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `label`: rich content in the middle of the divider. Replaces the `label` prop text.

en.heading: Theme

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: - `label`：分隔线中间的富文本内容，会替代 `label` 属性的纯文字。

zh.heading: 主题

en.title: Full bleed
en.description: The rule runs past the card padding, from edge to edge, between the line items and the total.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
import { Section } from '@astryx-vue/core/Section'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
</script>

<template>
  <Section variant="transparent" width="100%">
    <Card :width="400">
      <VStack :gap="3">
        <Text type="label">
          Order Summary
        </Text>
        <HStack h-align="between">
          <Text type="body">
            3 items
          </Text>
          <Text type="body">
            $127.00
          </Text>
        </HStack>
        <Divider is-full-bleed />
        <HStack h-align="between">
          <Text type="body">
            Shipping
          </Text>
          <Text type="body">
            $7.99
          </Text>
        </HStack>
        <HStack h-align="between">
          <Text type="body">
            Tax
          </Text>
          <Text type="body">
            $10.16
          </Text>
        </HStack>
        <Divider is-full-bleed />
        <HStack h-align="between">
          <Text type="label">
            Total
          </Text>
          <Text type="label">
            $145.15
          </Text>
        </HStack>
      </VStack>
    </Card>
  </Section>

summary.en: `Grid` arranges its children into rows and columns with CSS grid. It solves two-dimensional layout: card galleries, dashboard panels, and any region where several columns have to line up. One-dimensional arrangement belongs to the `Stack` family; reach for `Grid` when rows and columns both matter.
summary.zh: `Grid` 用 CSS 网格把子元素排进行和列，解决的是二维布局：卡片墙、仪表盘面板，以及任何需要多列对齐的区域。一维排布交给 `Stack` 系列，只有当行和列都要对齐时才换成 `Grid`。

usage.en: `Grid` arranges its children into rows and columns with CSS grid. It solves two-dimensional layout: card galleries, dashboard panels, and any region where several columns have to line up. One-dimensional arrangement belongs to the `Stack` family; reach for `Grid` when rows and columns both matter. Give it a column configuration and it is ready: ```vue ``` A number for `columns` means a fixed number of equal-width columns. An object means responsive columns: `minWidth` is the smallest a column may get, in pixels, and the grid decides how many columns fit in the available width on its own, dropping to fewer columns on a narrow screen. ```vue ``` The responsive configuration has two more options. `repeat` decides what happens to the gap a partly filled last row leaves behind: `'fill'` (the default) keeps the empty tracks, so every column always has the same width, while `'fit'` collapses them so the columns that are present stretch across the whole row. `max` caps how many columns may appear, which keeps columns from growing uncomfortably wide on a large screen. The cap sits on the minimum track size rather than the maximum, so the count never exceeds `max` while the columns that are present still fill the row — no dead space on the right. `gap` sets the spacing between rows and columns, with `rowGap` and `columnGap` overriding it on a single axis, and all three take a step from the Astryx spacing scale. `rowHeight` fixes the height of implicit rows in pixels and, together with `GridSpan rows`, produces items that span several rows. Wrap an item in `GridSpan` when it has to span more than one column or row. Its `columns` takes a number for the number of columns, or `'full'` to span the entire row, and `rows` takes the number of rows. ```vue ``` `width`, `height`, `maxWidth`, and `minHeight` size the container itself: numbers are pixels and strings are used as they are. `align` controls how items sit vertically inside their row (`align-items`) and `justify` controls the horizontal axis (`justify-items`); both default to `stretch`, which makes every item fill its cell. The column template is written to the container as the CSS variable `--astryx-grid-template-columns` rather than as an inline `grid-template-columns` declaration. That way your own stylesheet, including a rule inside a media query, can still override the variable or the declaration itself.
usage.zh: `Grid` 用 CSS 网格把子元素排进行和列，解决的是二维布局：卡片墙、仪表盘面板，以及任何需要多列对齐的区域。一维排布交给 `Stack` 系列，只有当行和列都要对齐时才换成 `Grid`。 给出列配置就能开始使用： ```vue ``` `columns` 传数字表示固定列数，每一列等宽。传对象则表示响应式列：`minWidth` 是每列的最小宽度（像素），网格按可用宽度自己决定能放几列，窄屏时自动减少列数。 ```vue ``` 响应式配置里还有两个可选项。`repeat` 决定最后一行没排满时留下的空隙如何处理：`'fill'`（默认）保留空的轨道，所以每列宽度始终一致；`'fit'` 收起空轨道，让实际存在的列把整行撑满。`max` 限制最多几列，避免大屏上每一列被拉得过宽。列数上限加在轨道的最小尺寸上而不是最大尺寸上，因此列数不会超过 `max`，而排不满时留下的列依然会撑满整行，右侧不会出现空白。 `gap` 控制行列间距，`rowGap` 与 `columnGap` 可以分别在行、列方向覆盖它，取值都来自 Astryx 的间距刻度。`rowHeight` 用像素固定隐式行高，配合 `GridSpan` 的 `rows` 可以做出跨若干行的布局。 需要某一项跨列或跨行时，用 `GridSpan` 包一层。它的 `columns` 给数字表示跨几列，给 `'full'` 表示跨越整行；`rows` 表示跨几行。 ```vue ``` `width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight` 控制容器自身的尺寸，数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。`align` 控制项目在行内的垂直对齐（`align-items`），`justify` 控制水平对齐（`justify-items`），两者默认都是 `stretch`，也就是撑满所在的单元格。 列模板写在容器的 CSS 变量 `--astryx-grid-template-columns` 上，而不是内联的 `grid-template-columns` 声明。因此在自有样式或媒体查询里重写这个变量、或者直接重写 `grid-template-columns`，都能生效。

en.text: Use responsive columns (`:columns="{ minWidth: 280 }"`) whenever the layout should adapt to the screen. Let the grid work out the column count instead of writing media queries.
Cap the count with `max` on wide screens. Without a cap each column grows very wide and the contents of a row drift far apart.
Keep the default `repeat: 'fill'` when every column should have the same width, and switch to `'fit'` when the items of a partly filled row should stretch into the leftover space.
Leave spacing to `gap` and the container size to `width`, `maxWidth`, and friends rather than adding margins to the children.
Hand-write `display: grid` and `grid-template-columns` and compute the gaps yourself. `Grid` already does that work.
Fake a grid with a wrapping `HStack`. Use `Stack` for one-dimensional arrangement and `Grid` when both axes have to line up.
Express a fixed column count through the object form of `columns`. Pass a number, which says what it means.

zh.text: 布局需要随屏幕宽度变化时用响应式列（`:columns="{ minWidth: 280 }"`），让网格自己决定列数，不必再写媒体查询。
大屏上用 `max` 给列数封顶。没有上限时每一列会被拉得很宽，一行里的内容彼此离得太远。
需要每列宽度一致时保留默认的 `repeat: 'fill'`；希望不足一行的项目撑开剩余空间时改用 `'fit'`。
间距交给 `gap`，容器自身的尺寸交给 `width`、`maxWidth` 等属性，不要在子元素上再加外边距。
手写 `display: grid` 和 `grid-template-columns` 并自己计算间距，`Grid` 已经把这些处理好了。
用允许换行的 `HStack` 冒充网格。一维排布用 `Stack`，行和列都要对齐时才用 `Grid`。
用 `columns` 的对象形式表达固定列数。固定列数直接传数字，语义更清楚。

en.heading: Grid Props
en.text:
`GridResponsiveColumns` has this shape:

```ts
interface GridResponsiveColumns {
  minWidth: number
  max?: number
  repeat?: 'fill' | 'fit'
}
```

`SpacingStep` accepts these values:

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

en.heading: Slots
en.text: `GridSpan` has a single default slot as well:

en.heading: CSS variables
en.text:
`Grid` writes these variables to its root element. They are an implementation detail, but a theme or an application may override them:

- `--astryx-grid-template-columns`: The computed column template. It lives in a variable rather than an inline `grid-template-columns` declaration, so a media query can still override it.
- `--astryx-grid-auto-rows`: The implicit row height derived from `rowHeight`.
- `--astryx-grid-gap`: The spacing token for `gap`, shared by both axes.
- `--astryx-grid-row-gap`: The spacing token for `rowGap`, which overrides `--astryx-grid-gap` on the row axis.
- `--astryx-grid-column-gap`: The spacing token for `columnGap`, which overrides `--astryx-grid-gap` on the column axis.
- `--astryx-grid-default-gap`: A theme token used as the spacing when no gap prop is given. The neutral theme sets it to `--astryx-spacing-0`, which leaves no space between items.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`Grid` and `GridSpan` both render a `
` at the root. The following go to the root element: - HTML attributes. - `aria-*` attributes. - `data-*` attributes. - `class`. - `style`. `class` is merged with the component's own classes. When style and the size props (width, height, maxWidth, minHeight) are both given, the props win; the same holds for GridSpan's columns and rows. `Grid` also writes `data-columns` (only when `columns` is a number), `data-gap`, `data-row-gap`, `data-column-gap`, `data-align`, and `data-justify`, so a theme can target it by attribute.

zh.heading: Grid Props
zh.text:
`GridResponsiveColumns` 的形状如下：

```ts
interface GridResponsiveColumns {
  minWidth: number
  max?: number
  repeat?: 'fill' | 'fit'
}
```

`SpacingStep` 支持以下值：

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: `GridSpan` 同样只有一个默认插槽：

zh.heading: CSS 变量
zh.text:
`Grid` 在根元素上写入以下变量。它们是内部实现，但可以被主题或应用覆盖：

- `--astryx-grid-template-columns`: 计算出的列模板。写在变量上而不是内联的 `grid-template-columns`，因此媒体查询里的覆盖仍然有效。
- `--astryx-grid-auto-rows`: `rowHeight` 转换出的隐式行高。
- `--astryx-grid-gap`: `gap` 对应的间距令牌，行、列共用。
- `--astryx-grid-row-gap`: `rowGap` 对应的间距令牌，覆盖 `--astryx-grid-gap`。
- `--astryx-grid-column-gap`: `columnGap` 对应的间距令牌，覆盖 `--astryx-grid-gap`。
- `--astryx-grid-default-gap`: 主题令牌，在没有传入任何间距属性时作为默认间距。Neutral 主题取 `--astryx-spacing-0`，也就是不留间距。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`Grid` 与 `GridSpan` 的根元素都是 `
`。 以下内容传入根元素： - HTML 属性。 - `aria-*` 属性。 - `data-*` 属性。 - `class`。 - `style`。 `class` 会与组件自身的类名合并。`style` 与尺寸属性（`width`、`height`、`maxWidth`、`minHeight`）同时出现时，尺寸属性优先；GridSpan 的 columns、rows 同理。 `Grid` 还额外写入 `data-columns`（仅在 `columns` 为数字时）、`data-gap`、`data-row-gap`、`data-column-gap`、`data-align`、`data-justify`，供主题按属性选择。

summary.en: Use the gap prop for spacing between items; don't add margins manually.
summary.zh: `Stack` 系列组件用一套间距令牌管理一维布局：`Stack` 通过 `direction` 切换排列方向，`HStack`、`VStack` 分别固定水平与垂直方向，`StackItem` 负责子项的尺寸分配。需要沿同一方向排列多个元素、并保持间距一致时使用它们。

usage.en:
Import the component from its dedicated entry. The component loads its structural styles.

Import the theme in your application entry:

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

Component usage:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HStack, Stack, StackItem, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>
```
usage.zh:
`Stack` 系列组件用一套间距令牌管理一维布局：`Stack` 通过 `direction` 切换排列方向，`HStack`、`VStack` 分别固定水平与垂直方向，`StackItem` 负责子项的尺寸分配。需要沿同一方向排列多个元素、并保持间距一致时使用它们。

在应用入口引入主题：

```ts
import '@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css'
```

组件按需要从独立入口导入，结构样式会随组件自动加载：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HStack, Stack, StackItem, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
</script>
```

en.text: Use the gap prop for spacing between items; don't add margins manually.
Use StackItem with size="fill" to make one item stretch and fill the leftover space.
Nest stacks inside stacks; try wrap="wrap" first to let items flow to the next line.

zh.text: 用 `gap` 属性控制项目间距，而不是给子元素手动添加外边距，间距更容易保持一致。
希望某个项目拉伸并填满剩余空间时，给它包一层 `size="fill"` 的 `StackItem`，其余项目仍保持固有尺寸。
为了换行而嵌套堆叠布局，优先给 `Stack` 设置 `wrap="wrap"` 让项目自动换行，结构会更扁平。

en.heading: Stack Props
en.text:
`SpacingStep` accepts these values:

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

en.heading: HStack Props
en.text:
`HStack` uses a fixed horizontal direction.

- The component supports shared `Stack` props.
- The component does not expose `direction`.
- The table below defines alignment.

en.heading: VStack Props
en.text:
`VStack` uses a fixed vertical direction.

- The component supports shared `Stack` props.
- The component does not expose `direction`.
- The table below defines alignment.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: Stack, HStack, VStack, and StackItem all receive content through the default slot.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

zh.heading: Stack Props
zh.text:
`SpacingStep` 支持以下值：

```ts
type SpacingStep = 0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10
```

zh.heading: HStack Props
zh.text:
`HStack` 固定使用水平方向。

- 组件支持 `Stack` 的通用属性。
- 组件不提供 `direction` 属性。
- 对齐规则见下表。

zh.heading: VStack Props
zh.text:
`VStack` 固定使用垂直方向。

- 组件支持 `Stack` 的通用属性。
- 组件不提供 `direction` 属性。
- 对齐规则见下表。

zh.heading: 插槽
zh.text: Stack、HStack、VStack 和 StackItem 均通过默认插槽接收内容。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

            {{ user.role }}
          </Text>
        </VStack>
      </StackItem>
      <StackItem size="static">
        <Button label="View" size="sm" variant="secondary" />
      </StackItem>
    </HStack>
  </VStack>
</template>

summary.en: `AppShell` is the page frame. The default slot is the page content. `topNav`, `sideNav`, `banner`, and `mobileNav` are named slots.
summary.zh: `AppShell` 是页面外框。默认插槽是页面正文。`topNav`、`sideNav`、`banner`、`mobileNav` 是具名插槽。

usage.en: `AppShell` is the page frame. The default slot is the page content. `topNav`, `sideNav`, `banner`, and `mobileNav` are named slots. ```vue ``` `variant` is `wash`, `surface`, `section`, or `elevated` (the default). `contentPadding` is a spacing step for the content region. `height` is `fill` or `auto`. `fill` uses `100dvh`; an inline `height: 100%` overrides it when the shell sits in a sized preview. `mobileNav` is `false` or `{ breakpoint, isOpen, hasToggle }`. The default breakpoint is `md` (768px). Below the breakpoint the side nav moves into a drawer. A top nav inside the shell uses that drawer instead of opening one of its own. `v-model:mobile-nav-open` controls the drawer, and the component emits `mobileNavOpenChange`. A skip link points at `#astryx-app-shell-main`. The main region is a `div` with `role="main"` and `tabindex="-1"`. With `variant="elevated"` and both a top nav and a side nav on a wide viewport, the content sits on a rounded backdrop. `useAppShellMobile` reads the nearest shell. Outside a shell, or when mobile nav is off, `isMobile` and `isMobileNavEnabled` are false and the open and close methods do nothing.
usage.zh: `AppShell` 是页面外框。默认插槽是页面正文。`topNav`、`sideNav`、`banner`、`mobileNav` 是具名插槽。 ```vue ``` `variant` 取 `wash`、`surface`、`section` 或 `elevated`（默认）。`contentPadding` 是正文区域的间距刻度。`height` 取 `fill` 或 `auto`。`fill` 使用 `100dvh`；外壳放在已经有高度的预览里时，行内 `height: 100%` 可以盖过它。 `mobileNav` 可以是 `false`，或 `{ breakpoint, isOpen, hasToggle }`。默认断点是 `md`（768px）。窄于断点时侧栏收进抽屉。外壳里的顶栏使用这只抽屉，不再自己打开另一只。`v-model:mobile-nav-open` 控制抽屉，组件同时发出 `mobileNavOpenChange`。 跳过链接指向 `#astryx-app-shell-main`。主区域是带 `role="main"` 和 `tabindex="-1"` 的 `div`。`variant` 为 `elevated`、同时有顶栏和侧栏、而且视口够宽时，正文坐在圆角背板上。 `useAppShellMobile` 读取最近的外壳。在外壳外面，或关掉了移动导航时，`isMobile` 和 `isMobileNavEnabled` 都是 false，打开和关闭方法不做任何事。

en.text: Put application navigation in the topNav and sideNav slots. Put page regions in Layout.
Give the side nav a heading so the mobile drawer has a name.
Open a second drawer from TopNav while it is inside an AppShell. The shell already owns that drawer.
Call useAppShellMobile and assume a shell is present. Check isMobileNavEnabled.

zh.text: 应用导航放在 topNav 和 sideNav。页面内部的区域用 Layout。
给侧栏一个标题，移动抽屉才有名字。

调用 useAppShellMobile 时假定外壳一定存在。先看 isMobileNavEnabled。

en.heading: App Shell Props
en.text: `SpacingStep` accepts `0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10`. The default breakpoint is md, and the query is (width < Npx). hasToggle defaults to true.

en.heading: useAppShellMobile
en.text: Import it from @astryx-vue/core. It returns the nearest shell: The main region is #astryx-app-shell-main, a div with role="main" and tabindex="-1". The skip link label follows the active locale.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`AppShell` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The root sets `data-variant` and `data-height`.

zh.heading: App Shell Props
zh.text: `SpacingStep` 的取值是 `0 | 0.5 | 1 | 1.5 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 8 | 10`。默认断点是 md，查询是 (width < Npx)。hasToggle 默认 true。

zh.heading: useAppShellMobile

- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

summary.en: `AspectRatio` keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio as its container changes size. Use it for images, video, thumbnails, and other media that should stay in proportion. The width comes from the parent, and the height is derived from `ratio`, so an ancestor needs a definite width.
summary.zh: `AspectRatio` 在容器变宽变窄时保持固定的宽高比，用来放图片、视频和缩略图。宽度来自父级，高度由 `ratio` 算出，所以祖先需要有明确的宽度。

usage.en: `AspectRatio` keeps a fixed width-to-height ratio as its container changes size. Use it for images, video, thumbnails, and other media that should stay in proportion. The width comes from the parent, and the height is derived from `ratio`, so an ancestor needs a definite width. ```vue ``` `ratio` is width divided by height. Write `16 / 9` rather than a rounded decimal. `shape` is `rectangle` or `ellipse`; an ellipse with `ratio` `1` is a circle. `fit` sizes the child: `cover` fills and crops, `contain` letterboxes, and `center` keeps the natural size. Leave `fit` unset when the child sizes itself. The ratio is written to the CSS variable `--astryx-aspect-ratio`, not as an inline `aspect-ratio` declaration, so a stylesheet can override it.
usage.zh: `AspectRatio` 在容器变宽变窄时保持固定的宽高比，用来放图片、视频和缩略图。宽度来自父级，高度由 `ratio` 算出，所以祖先需要有明确的宽度。 ```vue ``` `ratio` 是宽除以高，写成 `16 / 9`，不要写成四舍五入后的小数。`shape` 取 `rectangle` 或 `ellipse`；`ratio` 为 `1` 的椭圆是正圆。`fit` 决定子元素怎么填进框里：`cover` 裁切，`contain` 留边，`center` 保持原始尺寸。子元素自己负责尺寸时不要传 `fit`。 比例写在 CSS 变量 `--astryx-aspect-ratio` 上，不写成行内的 `aspect-ratio`，样式表可以覆盖它。

en.text: Pass one child when `fit` is set. Every direct child is stretched, so put an overlay inside that child.
Give images an `alt`, or `alt=""` when the image is decorative. The ratio box adds no accessible name of its own.
Use it as a general layout container. Use `Section`, `Card`, or `Layout` for page regions.
Set only a height. The width comes from the container, so a lone height clamps the box off ratio.

zh.text: 传了 `fit` 时只放一个子元素。每个直接子元素都会被拉伸，叠层内容放进这个子元素里面。
图片要写 `alt`。装饰性图片写 `alt=""`。比例框自己不提供无障碍名称。
拿它当普通布局容器。页面区域用 `Section`、`Card` 或 `Layout`。
只设高度。宽度来自容器，单独设高度会把比例框压变形。

rows.name: `ratio`
rows.description: Width divided by height. `16 / 9` is a widescreen frame. Written to `--astryx-aspect-ratio`, not as an inline `aspect-ratio`.

rows.name: `shape`
rows.description: Container shape. Both shapes follow `ratio`. `ellipse` with `ratio` `1` is a circle.

rows.name: `fit`
rows.description: How the child fills the box. `cover` crops, `contain` letterboxes, `center` keeps the natural size. Omit it and the child sizes itself.

rows.name: `ratio`
rows.description: 宽除以高。`16 / 9` 是宽屏。写在 `--astryx-aspect-ratio` 上，不写成行内 `aspect-ratio`。

rows.name: `shape`
rows.description: 容器外形。两种外形都遵循 `ratio`。`ellipse` 且 `ratio` 为 `1` 时是正圆。

rows.name: `fit`
rows.description: 子元素如何填满比例框。`cover` 裁切，`contain` 留边，`center` 保持原始尺寸。不传时子元素自己负责尺寸。

rows.name: `default`

en.text: - `--astryx-aspect-ratio`: The ratio. A stylesheet can override the variable or `aspect-ratio` itself.

en.heading: Native attributes

`AspectRatio` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to that element:

zh.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AspectRatio } from '@astryx-vue/core/AspectRatio'
import { Center } from '@astryx-vue/core/Center'
import { Skeleton } from '@astryx-vue/core/Skeleton'
</script>

en.name: Ratio box
en.description: The outer element that holds the aspect ratio and clips overflow. Carries the `astryx-aspect-ratio` theme target, and the elliptical clip when `shape` is `ellipse`.

en.name: Content slot
en.description: A wrapper that fills the ratio box and positions the child. With `fit` set it also sizes the child; without it the child styles itself.

zh.name: 比例盒
zh.description: 保持宽高比并裁掉溢出的外层。带有 astryx-aspect-ratio 主题目标；shape 为 ellipse 时裁成椭圆。

zh.name: 内容插槽
zh.description: 铺满比例盒并摆放里面内容的一层。设了 fit 时，里面内容的尺寸也由它定；没设时，里面的内容自己决定尺寸。

summary.en: `FormLayout` arranges fields. It is not a `<form>`. Put the fields in the default slot and choose a direction.
summary.zh: `FormLayout` 排列字段。它不是 `<form>`。字段放在默认插槽里，再选一个方向。

usage.en:
`FormLayout` arranges fields. It is not a `<form>`. Put the fields in the default slot and choose a direction.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { FormLayout } from '@astryx-vue/core/FormLayout'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
</script>

<template>
  <FormLayout>
    <TextInput v-model="name" label="Name" />
    <TextInput v-model="email" label="Email" />
  </FormLayout>
</template>
```

`direction` is `vertical` (the default), `horizontal`, or `horizontal-labels`. Vertical stacks fields with a gap of spacing step 4. Horizontal places them in equal columns. Horizontal labels put the label on the left and the control on the right, and collapse to a column below 480px.

`defaultOptionality` is `optional` or `required`. It changes the indicator and `aria-required` on fields that do not set their own `isOptional` or `isRequired`. It does not set the native `required` attribute. When a field sets both, optional wins. Outside a `FormLayout`, `aria-required` stays `isRequired && !isOptional`.

Nested layouts keep their own direction. A horizontal row can sit inside a vertical form.
usage.zh:
`FormLayout` 排列字段。它不是 `<form>`。字段放在默认插槽里，再选一个方向。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { FormLayout } from '@astryx-vue/core/FormLayout'
import { TextInput } from '@astryx-vue/core/TextInput'
</script>

<template>
  <FormLayout>
    <TextInput v-model="name" label="姓名" />
    <TextInput v-model="email" label="邮箱" />
  </FormLayout>
</template>
```

`direction` 取 `vertical`（默认）、`horizontal` 或 `horizontal-labels`。纵向按间距刻度 4 往下排。横向把字段放进等宽的列。横向标签把标签放在左边、控件放在右边，窄于 480px 时改回纵向。

`defaultOptionality` 取 `optional` 或 `required`。它只影响没有自己写 `isOptional` 或 `isRequired` 的字段的标记和 `aria-required`，不写原生 `required`。同一字段两个都写时，选填优先。没有 `FormLayout` 祖先时，`aria-required` 仍是 `isRequired && !isOptional`。

嵌套的布局各自保留方向。纵向表单里可以放一行横向字段。

en.text: Use horizontal for a short row of related fields, such as a first and last name.
Use horizontal-labels when every field has a label and the form is wider than a phone.
Put an unrelated control, such as a page title, in the layout. It participates in the grid.
Expect `defaultOptionality` to block submit. It only sets the indicator and `aria-required`.

zh.text: 一组短字段，例如名和姓，用横向。
每个字段都有标签、而且表单比手机宽时，用横向标签。
把页面标题这类无关内容放进布局。它会参加网格排列。
指望 `defaultOptionality` 拦住提交。它只改标记和 `aria-required`。

rows.name: `direction`

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`FormLayout` renders a `<div>`, not a `<form>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The root sets `data-direction`.

summary.en: `Layout` arranges up to five regions: header, start, content, end, and footer. The default slot is the content. The other regions are named slots. `AppShell` owns the page frame; use `Layout` inside a page, a card, or a dialog. Use `HStack` or `VStack` when the content is only a row or a column.
summary.zh: `Layout` 最多排五个区域：页眉、起始边、正文、结束边、页脚。默认插槽是正文，其余是具名插槽。页面外框交给 `AppShell`；`Layout` 用在页面内部、卡片或对话框里。内容只是一行或一列时用 `HStack` 或 `VStack`。

usage.en:
`Layout` arranges up to five regions: header, start, content, end, and footer. The default slot is the content. The other regions are named slots. `AppShell` owns the page frame; use `Layout` inside a page, a card, or a dialog. Use `HStack` or `VStack` when the content is only a row or a column.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader has-divider>
        Orders
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      Select an order.
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`height` is `fill` or `auto`. `fill` stretches to the container and scrolls the content; `auto` grows with the content. `contentWidth` limits the width of the content and centers it. Dividers stay full width. A percentage, `fit-content`, `max-content`, `min-content`, or a bare `var()` uses the constrained width mode. `padding` sets this layout's own outer inset and does not pass to a nested layout. `defaultHasDividers` is the fallback for a header or footer that does not set `hasDivider`.

`LayoutHeader`, `LayoutFooter`, `LayoutContent`, and `LayoutPanel` are the region components. A panel's `width` is pixels when it is a number. Pass `resizable` from `useResizable` when a `ResizeHandle` controls that width.
usage.zh:
`Layout` 最多排五个区域：页眉、起始边、正文、结束边、页脚。默认插槽是正文，其余是具名插槽。页面外框交给 `AppShell`；`Layout` 用在页面内部、卡片或对话框里。内容只是一行或一列时用 `HStack` 或 `VStack`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutHeader } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #header>
      <LayoutHeader has-divider>
        订单
      </LayoutHeader>
    </template>
    <LayoutContent>
      选择一笔订单。
    </LayoutContent>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`height` 取 `fill` 或 `auto`。`fill` 撑满容器，正文在中间滚动；`auto` 随内容长高。`contentWidth` 限制正文宽度并居中，分隔线仍然拉满。百分比、`fit-content`、`max-content`、`min-content` 或裸 `var()` 走约束宽度。`padding` 只作用于这一层，不会传给嵌套的 `Layout`。页眉或页脚没有写 `hasDivider` 时，用 `defaultHasDividers`。

`LayoutHeader`、`LayoutFooter`、`LayoutContent`、`LayoutPanel` 是四个区域组件。面板的 `width` 传数字时按像素。宽度由 `ResizeHandle` 控制时，把 `useResizable` 返回的 `props` 传给 `resizable`。

en.text: Use Layout when the page or card has a header, a side panel, or a footer that should stay put while the content scrolls.
Put the scroll on `LayoutContent`. Leave the header and footer outside it.
Use Layout as the application frame. Use AppShell for top and side navigation.
Draw a panel divider and a resize-handle divider on the same edge.

zh.text: 页眉、侧栏或页脚需要固定，正文单独滚动时用 Layout。
滚动放在 `LayoutContent` 上，页眉和页脚留在外面。
用 Layout 当应用外框。顶部和侧边导航用 AppShell。
面板分隔线和拖拽分隔条的线画在同一条边上。

rows.name: `contentWidth`

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Outer inset for this layout only. It does not pass to a nested layout. `0` is full bleed.

rows.name: `hasDivider`

rows.name: `height`
