summary.zh: `ResizeHandle` 是两个区域之间的分隔条。尺寸由 `useResizable` 管理。把 `sidebar.props` 同时传给分隔条和面板。

usage.en:
`ResizeHandle` is the separator between two regions. `useResizable` owns the size. Pass `sidebar.props` to both the handle and the panel.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Layout, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #start>
      <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size" />
      <ResizeHandle direction="horizontal" has-divider :resizable="sidebar.props" />
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`direction` is `horizontal` (width) or `vertical` (height). `position` is `inline` or `overlay`. `isReversed` flips the drag when the panel sits on the end edge. `hasDivider` draws the 1px line; the line is the handle. `isAlwaysVisible` keeps the grip visible at rest. `pillPlacement` is `auto`, `start`, `end`, or `center`.

The handle is `role="separator"`. A horizontal handle sets `aria-orientation="vertical"`. Arrow keys move 10px, and Shift moves 50px. Home and End jump to the limits. Enter restores the expanded size.

`useResizable` accepts one region, or a `regions` map. `snaps` holds the size when the pointer comes within 8px of a listed value, and the drag otherwise follows the pointer. A drag below `collapsedSize` (default 40) collapses a collapsible region to 0. `autoSaveId` stores the size under `astryx-resizable:` in `localStorage`. `percent()` builds a percentage size with a pixel minimum or maximum.
usage.zh:
`ResizeHandle` 是两个区域之间的分隔条。尺寸由 `useResizable` 管理。把 `sidebar.props` 同时传给分隔条和面板。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Layout, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
})
</script>

<template>
  <Layout>
    <template #start>
      <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size" />
      <ResizeHandle direction="horizontal" has-divider :resizable="sidebar.props" />
    </template>
  </Layout>
</template>
```

`direction` 取 `horizontal`（改宽度）或 `vertical`（改高度）。`position` 取 `inline` 或 `overlay`。面板在结束边时用 `isReversed` 把拖拽方向反过来。`hasDivider` 画出 1px 的线，线本身就是把手。`isAlwaysVisible` 让握把在静止时也可见。`pillPlacement` 取 `auto`、`start`、`end` 或 `center`。

分隔条的角色是 `separator`。横向分隔条的 `aria-orientation` 是 `vertical`。方向键每次移动 10px，按住 Shift 移动 50px。Home 和 End 跳到边界。Enter 恢复展开时的尺寸。

`useResizable` 可以管一个区域，也可以用 `regions` 一次管多个。`snaps` 在指针进入某个点 8px 以内时吸住，其余时候跟着指针走。可收起的区域被拖到低于 `collapsedSize`（默认 40）时，尺寸变成 0。`autoSaveId` 把尺寸存在 `localStorage`，键名以 `astryx-resizable:` 开头。`percent()` 用来写带像素上下限的百分比尺寸。

en.text: Give the handle a `label` that names the region it resizes.
Turn the panel divider off when the handle draws one.
Store the size in a separate ref and forget to pass `resizable`. The handle and the panel both read `props`.

zh.text: 用 `label` 说明这条分隔条在调整哪一块。
分隔条自己画线时，关掉面板上的分隔线。
另存一份尺寸却不传 `resizable`。分隔条和面板都读 `props`。

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: `horizontal` changes width. `vertical` changes height. A horizontal handle sets `aria-orientation="vertical"`.

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: `inline` takes a track. `overlay` sits on the parent edge.

rows.name: `isReversed`
rows.description: Flips the drag when the panel is on the end edge.

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: Turns pointer and keyboard resizing off.

rows.name: `hasDivider`
rows.description: Draws the 1px line. The line is the handle.

rows.name: `isAlwaysVisible`
rows.description: Keeps the grip visible at rest.

rows.name: `pillPlacement`
rows.description: Where the grip sits on the line. `auto` stays on the panel side, and flips when the panel size is 0.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name. The English default is “Resize handle”.

rows.name: `resizable`
rows.description: The `props` object returned by `useResizable`.

rows.name: `defaultSize`
rows.description: Starting size. A number is pixels. A listed snap holds it only when the value is already within 8px.

rows.name: `minSize`
rows.description: Smallest expanded size.

rows.name: `maxSize`
rows.description: Largest size.

rows.name: `collapsible`
rows.description: Allows the region to collapse to 0.

rows.name: `collapsedSize`
rows.description: A drag below this pixel value collapses the region.

rows.name: `snaps`
rows.description: Pixel values that hold the size when the pointer is within 8px.

rows.name: `shrinkOrder`
rows.description: Cascade priority for a `regions` map that shares `containerRef`. A lower number shrinks to `minSize` first when the container is narrower than the regions. Dragging still sets that region’s preferred size.

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: Which container axis the percentage sizes read.

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: Element used to resolve percentages. An unmeasured container uses 1200 and does not persist.

rows.name: `autoSaveId`
rows.description: Stores `{ size, isCollapsed }` at `astryx-resizable:` plus this id. A regions map appends `:key`.

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: Starts collapsed when `collapsible` is true.

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: Controlled collapsed state. Changes are reported through `onCollapseChange`.

rows.name: `onSizeChange`
rows.description: Called after a resize settles on a size.

rows.name: `onCollapseChange`
rows.description: Called when the collapsed state changes.

rows.name: `regions`
rows.description: Several regions. Each entry accepts the size fields above.

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: `horizontal` 改宽度，`vertical` 改高度。横向分隔条的 `aria-orientation` 是 `vertical`。

rows.name: `position`
rows.description: `inline` 占一格，`overlay` 贴在父级边缘。

rows.name: `isReversed`
rows.description: 面板在结束边时，把拖拽方向反过来。

rows.name: `isDisabled`
rows.description: 关掉指针和键盘调整。

rows.name: `hasDivider`
rows.description: 画出 1px 分隔线。线本身就是把手。

rows.name: `isAlwaysVisible`
rows.description: 静止时也显示握把。

rows.name: `pillPlacement`
rows.description: 握把相对分隔线的位置。`auto` 靠面板一侧，面板收到 0 时翻到另一侧。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 无障碍名称。英文默认是 “Resize handle”，中文默认是 “拖拽分隔条”。

rows.name: `resizable`
rows.description: `useResizable` 返回的 `props`。

rows.name: `defaultSize`
rows.description: 初始尺寸。数字是像素。只有已经落在吸附点 8px 以内时，初值才会被吸住。

rows.name: `minSize`
rows.description: 展开时的最小尺寸。

rows.name: `maxSize`
rows.description: 最大尺寸。

rows.name: `collapsible`
rows.description: 允许收到 0。

rows.name: `collapsedSize`
rows.description: 拖拽低于这个像素值时收起。

rows.name: `snaps`
rows.description: 指针进入 8px 以内时吸住的像素值。

rows.name: `shrinkOrder`
rows.description: 多个区域共用 `containerRef` 时的收缩顺序。容器比这些区域更窄时，数字更小的先收到 `minSize`。拖拽仍然改的是该区域自己的目标尺寸。

rows.name: `direction`
rows.description: 百分比尺寸读取容器的哪一条轴。

rows.name: `containerRef`
rows.description: 用来解析百分比的元素。还没量到时按 1200 计算，并且不写入存储。

rows.name: `autoSaveId`
rows.description: 把 `{ size, isCollapsed }` 存在 `astryx-resizable:` 加这个 id。多个区域会再接 `:key`。

rows.name: `defaultIsCollapsed`
rows.description: `collapsible` 为 true 时，一开始就收起。

rows.name: `isCollapsed`
rows.description: 受控的收起状态。变化通过 `onCollapseChange` 报出。

rows.name: `onSizeChange`
rows.description: 尺寸落下之后调用。

rows.name: `onCollapseChange`
rows.description: 收起状态变化时调用。

rows.name: `regions`
rows.description: 一次管多个区域。每一项接受上面的尺寸字段。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Replaces the grip. The separator role and keyboard behavior stay on the handle.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 替换握把。分隔条角色和键盘行为仍留在把手上。

en.heading: useResizable
en.text: Import it from @astryx-vue/core. A single region returns { size, isCollapsed, collapse, expand, resize, props }. A regions map returns one of those objects per key. percent(value, { min }) or percent(value, { max }) builds a percentage size. min and max use { type: 'pixel', value }. Arrow keys move 10px. Shift moves 50px. Home, End, and Enter jump to the minimum, the maximum, and the expanded size.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`ResizeHandle` renders a `<div role="separator">`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged.

zh.heading: useResizable
zh.text: 从 @astryx-vue/core 引入。单个区域返回 { size, isCollapsed, collapse, expand, resize, props }。传入 regions 时，每个键各返回一份。 percent(value, { min }) 或 percent(value, { max }) 用来写百分比尺寸。min 和 max 的形状是 { type: 'pixel', value }。 方向键移动 10px，按住 Shift 移动 50px。Home、End、Enter 分别跳到最小值、最大值和展开时的尺寸。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`ResizeHandle` 渲染 `<div role="separator">`。

以下内容落到这个元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。

en.title: Collapsible with snap points
en.description: Dragging snaps to preset widths. Dragging past the minimum collapses the sidebar, and Expand restores it.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { useResizable } from '@astryx-vue/core'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Layout, LayoutContent, LayoutPanel } from '@astryx-vue/core/Layout'
import { ResizeHandle } from '@astryx-vue/core/Resizable'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'

const sidebar = useResizable({
  defaultSize: 240,
  minSize: 160,
  maxSize: 360,
  collapsible: true,
  snaps: [200, 280],
})
</script>

<template>
  <Card :height="240" variant="muted" :width="500">
    <Layout height="fill">
      <template #start>
        <LayoutPanel :has-divider="false" :width="sidebar.size">
          <Text v-if="!sidebar.isCollapsed" color="secondary">
            {{ Math.round(sidebar.size) }}px wide
          </Text>
        </LayoutPanel>
        <ResizeHandle
          direction="horizontal"
          has-divider
          label="Resize sidebar"
          :resizable="sidebar.props"
        />
      </template>
      <LayoutContent>
        <VStack :gap="2">
          <Text color="secondary">
            Drag the handle — it snaps at 200px and 280px. Drag all the way left to collapse the sidebar.
          </Text>
          <Button
            v-if="sidebar.isCollapsed"
            label="Expand sidebar"
            size="sm"
            variant="secondary"
            @click="sidebar.expand()"
          />
        </VStack>
      </LayoutContent>
    </Layout>
  </Card>
</template>

summary.en: `ScrollableArea` is a native scroll viewport with an observed content box. It enters the tab order only while a requested axis actually overflows. `label` is required.
summary.zh: `ScrollableArea` 是一个原生滚动视口，里面有一块被观察的内容盒。只有请求的轴确实溢出时，它才会进入 Tab 顺序。`label` 必填。

usage.en: `ScrollableArea` is a native scroll viewport with an observed content box. It enters the tab order only while a requested axis actually overflows. `label` is required. ```vue ``` `axis` is `block` (the default), `inline`, or `both`. The component maps those logical axes through writing mode and direction. `overscroll` is `allow` or `contain`. `stickyContainment` is `whenScrollable` or `always`. Padding props apply to the content box and default to 0. `isFullBleed` lets the viewport escape an ancestor's padding without changing the content padding. Until overflow is measured, the requested axis uses `overflow: clip`. After a measurement, an overflowing axis uses `auto`. `always` keeps the viewport as a sticky boundary even when the content fits. The tolerance is 1px. `useScrollableArea` is the same measurement for a viewport and content box you already own. `useScrollOverflow` reports the inline start and end edges of one horizontal scroller.
usage.zh: `ScrollableArea` 是一个原生滚动视口，里面有一块被观察的内容盒。只有请求的轴确实溢出时，它才会进入 Tab 顺序。`label` 必填。 ```vue ``` `axis` 取 `block`（默认）、`inline` 或 `both`。组件按书写模式和方向把逻辑轴映射到物理轴。`overscroll` 取 `allow` 或 `contain`。`stickyContainment` 取 `whenScrollable` 或 `always`。内边距写在内容盒上，默认是 0。`isFullBleed` 让视口逃出祖先的内边距，内容的内边距不变。 溢出还没量到时，请求的轴用 `overflow: clip`。量到溢出后，溢出的轴改成 `auto`。`always` 即使内容装得下，也把这个视口留作 sticky 边界。容差是 1px。 视口和内容盒已经存在时，用 `useScrollableArea` 做同样的测量。`useScrollOverflow` 报告一个横向滚动容器的起始边和结束边有没有被挡住。

en.text: Give every area a short label that names what keyboard users will scroll.
Keep `overscroll="allow"` unless a nested area should stop the gesture.
Wrap it in another overflow container. One viewport should own the scroll.
Hide the scrollbar without another way to reach the overflow.

zh.text: 每块区域都写短标签，说明键盘用户会滚到什么。
没有特别要求时保持 `overscroll="allow"`。只有嵌套区域需要停住手势时才用 `contain`。
再套一层 overflow 容器。滚动只交给这一个视口。
藏起滚动条，却不提供别的办法到达溢出的内容。

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: Logical axes that may scroll. The physical axis follows writing mode and direction.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name. Required. The viewport enters the tab order only while an axis overflows.

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: Role of the named viewport.

rows.name: `overscroll`
rows.description: Whether a gesture at the edge continues into an ancestor. Containment applies only while that axis overflows.

rows.name: `stickyContainment`
rows.description: `whenScrollable` passes sticky ownership outward when the content fits. `always` keeps this viewport as the sticky boundary.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Content padding on every edge.

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: Inline-axis content padding. Overrides `padding` on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: Inline-start content padding.

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: Inline-end content padding.

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: Block-axis content padding. Overrides `padding` on that axis.

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: Block-start content padding.

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: Block-end content padding.

rows.name: `isFullBleed`
rows.description: Lets the viewport escape an ancestor's padding. Content padding stays as set.

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: Viewport width. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: Viewport height. Numbers are pixels, strings are used as they are.

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: Maximum viewport width.

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: Minimum viewport height.

rows.name: `axis`
rows.description: 允许滚动的逻辑轴。物理方向随书写模式和方向变化。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 无障碍名称，必填。只有某一轴溢出时，视口才进入 Tab 顺序。

rows.name: `role`
rows.description: 这块命名视口的角色。

rows.name: `overscroll`
rows.description: 滚到边缘后，手势要不要交给外层。只有这一轴确实溢出时才会收住。

rows.name: `stickyContainment`
rows.description: `whenScrollable` 在内容装得下时把 sticky 交给外层。`always` 始终把这个视口留作 sticky 边界。

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: 内容盒四边的内边距。

rows.name: `paddingInline`
rows.description: 内容盒的行向内边距，覆盖这一轴上的 `padding`。

rows.name: `paddingInlineStart`
rows.description: 内容盒的行起始边内边距。

rows.name: `paddingInlineEnd`
rows.description: 内容盒的行结束边内边距。

rows.name: `paddingBlock`
rows.description: 内容盒的块向内边距，覆盖这一轴上的 `padding`。

rows.name: `paddingBlockStart`
rows.description: 内容盒的块起始边内边距。

rows.name: `paddingBlockEnd`
rows.description: 内容盒的块结束边内边距。

rows.name: `isFullBleed`
rows.description: 让视口逃出祖先的内边距。内容内边距保持不变。

rows.name: `width`
rows.description: 视口宽度。数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 视口高度。数字按像素处理，字符串原样使用。

rows.name: `maxWidth`
rows.description: 视口最大宽度。

rows.name: `minHeight`
rows.description: 视口最小高度。

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: Content inside the observed content box. Inline and both-axis modes size that box with `max-content` on the inline axis.

rows.name: `default`
rows.description: 放进被观察的内容盒。行向和双轴模式会把内容盒的行向尺寸设成 `max-content`。

en.heading: useScrollableArea
en.text: Import it from @astryx-vue/core when a component already owns the viewport and the content box. Options are axis, label, role, overscroll, and stickyContainment. It returns viewport (a callback ref), content, viewportAttrs, viewportStyle, and state. Overflow uses a 1px tolerance. Before a measurement, a requested axis is overflow: clip. Afterward, an overflowing axis is auto.

en.heading: useScrollOverflow
en.text: useScrollOverflow() watches one horizontal scroller. Bind scrollRef to the element. overflowStart, overflowEnd, and hasOverflow are refs. The tolerance is 1px.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`ScrollableArea` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to the viewport:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The viewport also sets `data-scroll-axis` and, once measured, `data-scrollable-*` and `data-scroll-*-start` / `data-scroll-*-end`.

zh.heading: useScrollableArea
zh.text: 组件自己已经有视口和内容盒时，从 @astryx-vue/core 引入。选项是 axis、label、role、overscroll、stickyContainment。返回 viewport（回调 ref）、content、viewportAttrs、viewportStyle 和 state。 溢出容差是 1px。还没量到时，请求的轴是 overflow: clip。量到溢出后，溢出的轴改成 auto。

zh.heading: useScrollOverflow
zh.text: useScrollOverflow() 观察一个横向滚动容器。把 scrollRef 绑到元素上。overflowStart、overflowEnd、hasOverflow 都是 ref。容差是 1px。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`ScrollableArea` 渲染 `<div>`。

以下内容落到视口上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。视口还写 `data-scroll-axis`，测量之后再写 `data-scrollable-*` 以及 `data-scroll-*-start` / `data-scroll-*-end`。

en.title: Inline rail
en.description: axis inline scrolls the cards sideways. isFullBleed lets the rail reach the panel edges while the first card stays aligned with the heading.

en.title: Overscroll
en.description: overscroll allow hands a finished gesture to the panel behind it. overscroll contain stops the gesture at the section edge.

en.title: Sticky section labels
en.description: The scroll viewport is the sticky containing block, so section labels pin to the top of the list.

en.title: Sticky passthrough
en.description: A section that fits passes its sticky label outward. stickyContainment always keeps the next label inside its own box.

en.title: Two-axis board
en.description: axis both gives the board max-content inline sizing, so one viewport scrolls both ways.

zh.title: 横向滑轨
zh.description: axis 为 inline 时卡片横向滚动。isFullBleed 让轨道贴到面板边缘，第一张卡片仍和标题对齐。

summary.en: `Section` groups a region of a page: a settings group, a form section, or a highlighted block. It paints a background, applies padding from the spacing scale, and can draw a divider on any side.
summary.zh: `Section` 用来划分页面上的一块区域，例如一组设置、表单里的一段，或需要强调的一块。它负责背景、按间距刻度设置内边距，并可以在任意一边画分隔线。

usage.en: `Section` groups a region of a page: a settings group, a form section, or a highlighted block. It paints a background, applies padding from the spacing scale, and can draw a divider on any side. ```vue ``` `variant` is `section` (surface), `muted`, or `transparent`. `padding` defaults to step 4. A single edge overrides the axis, and an axis overrides `padding`. `dividers` accepts `top`, `bottom`, `start`, and `end`; `start` and `end` follow writing direction. The outer box uses a negative margin so a section can escape the padding of a parent container such as `Card` or `LayoutContent`.
usage.zh: `Section` 用来划分页面上的一块区域，例如一组设置、表单里的一段，或需要强调的一块。它负责背景、按间距刻度设置内边距，并可以在任意一边画分隔线。 ```vue ``` `variant` 取 `section`（表面色）、`muted` 或 `transparent`。`padding` 默认是刻度 4。单边覆盖轴向，轴向覆盖统一的 `padding`。`dividers` 接受 `top`、`bottom`、`start`、`end`，`start` 和 `end` 随书写方向翻转。 外层用负外边距，让区块能逃出父级容器（例如 `Card` 或 `LayoutContent`）的内边距。

en.text: Use Section for a region of a page. Use Card for one discrete item, such as a profile or a notification.
Start with the default variant. Use muted when one region should stand out.
Add a divider between adjacent sections that share a background.
Restate the theme padding with an extra margin on the children. Set `padding` on the section.

zh.text: 页面上的一块区域用 Section。单独一项，例如一条通知或一张资料卡，用 Card。
先用默认变体。只有某一块需要被注意到时再用 muted。
相邻且背景相同的区块，用分隔线隔开。
在子元素上再加外边距去重复主题内边距。内边距设在区块上。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
`Section` renders a `<div>`.

The following go to that element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

`class` is merged. The inner element sets `data-variant` and `data-divider-*` for each requested edge.

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
`Section` 的根元素是 `<div>`。

以下内容落到这个元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

`class` 会合并。内层元素写 `data-variant`，并为每一条请求的边写 `data-divider-*`。

summary.en: A crumb in the middle of the trail can open a menu for sibling destinations. A short list is a menu array. Checkbox and radio rows go in the menu slot on that crumb, and the slot replaces the array. Those rows are exported from the breadcrumbs entry and are the same components the menu uses, so a choice opens and closes the same way.
summary.zh: 从独立入口导入 `Breadcrumbs` 与 `BreadcrumbItem`。

usage.en:
Import `Breadcrumbs` and `BreadcrumbItem` from their dedicated entry.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BreadcrumbItem, Breadcrumbs } from '@astryx-vue/core/Breadcrumbs'
</script>

<template>
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="/">
      Home
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="/components">
      Components
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
      Breadcrumbs
    </BreadcrumbItem>
  </Breadcrumbs>
</template>
```

A crumb in the middle of the trail can open a menu for sibling destinations. A short list is a menu array. Checkbox and radio rows go in the menu slot on that crumb, and the slot replaces the array. Those rows are exported from the breadcrumbs entry and are the same components the menu uses, so a choice opens and closes the same way.
usage.zh:
从独立入口导入 `Breadcrumbs` 与 `BreadcrumbItem`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BreadcrumbItem, Breadcrumbs } from '@astryx-vue/core/Breadcrumbs'
</script>

<template>
  <Breadcrumbs>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="/">
      首页
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem href="/components">
      组件
    </BreadcrumbItem>
    <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
      面包屑
    </BreadcrumbItem>
  </Breadcrumbs>
</template>
```

路径中间的一项可以打开菜单，用来在同级目的地之间切换。简单列表直接传一个菜单数组。需要勾选或单选时，改用菜单插槽把行写在这一项里面；写了插槽就不再使用数组。这些行从面包屑入口导出，和菜单里的勾选行、单选组是同一批组件，选中一项后的开关行为也相同。

en.text: Use semantic `` and `` markup so screen readers can identify the path.
Use `is-current` for the current page and render it as a `` with `aria-current="page"`.
Keep separators decorative with `aria-hidden="true"`.
Use overly long labels that wrap awkwardly on small screens.
Make the current page a clickable link; this creates circular navigation.

zh.text: 使用语义化 `` 与 `` 结构，便于屏幕阅读器识别路径。
对当前页使用 `is-current` 并渲染为 ``，自动添加 `aria-current="page"`。
为分隔符设置 `aria-hidden="true"`，避免辅助技术重复朗读。
在面包屑中使用过长的标签，导致小屏换行后难以阅读。
把当前页做成可点击链接，这会使用户迷失在循环导航中。

en.title: Choose a team
en.description: This crumb uses the menu slot for a radio group. Choosing a team renames the crumb.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { BreadcrumbItem, BreadcrumbMenuRadioGroup, BreadcrumbMenuRadioItem, Breadcrumbs } from '@astryx-vue/core/Breadcrumbs'
import { Icon } from '@astryx-vue/core/Icon'
import { VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const team = ref('design')
const teamLabel = computed(() => team.value === 'design' ? 'Design' : team.value === 'engineering' ? 'Engineering' : 'Data')
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="3">
    <Breadcrumbs>
      <BreadcrumbItem href="/">
        <template #startIcon>
          <Icon name="carbon:home" />
        </template>
        Home
      </BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbItem>
        {{ teamLabel }}
        <template #menu>
          <BreadcrumbMenuRadioGroup v-model="team" label="Team">
            <BreadcrumbMenuRadioItem value="design" label="Design" />
            <BreadcrumbMenuRadioItem value="engineering" label="Engineering" />
            <BreadcrumbMenuRadioItem value="data" label="Data" />
          </BreadcrumbMenuRadioGroup>
        </template>
      </BreadcrumbItem>
      <BreadcrumbItem is-current>
        Overview
      </BreadcrumbItem>
    </Breadcrumbs>
    <Text color="secondary" type="supporting">
      Current team: {{ teamLabel }}
    </Text>

summary.en: `MobileNav` is a dialog drawer that slides in from one side of the screen, not a bottom sheet. Bind `MobileNavToggle` to the same `v-model:is-open`. While open, focus stays in the drawer. Escape or a press on the scrim closes it and returns focus to where it was.
summary.zh: `MobileNav` 是从屏幕一侧滑入的对话框抽屉，不是底部弹层。`MobileNavToggle` 和它绑同一个 `v-model:is-open`。打开后焦点留在抽屉里，Escape 或点遮罩关闭，并回到原来的焦点。

usage.en:
`MobileNav` is a dialog drawer that slides in from one side of the screen, not a bottom sheet. Bind `MobileNavToggle` to the same `v-model:is-open`. While open, focus stays in the drawer. Escape or a press on the scrim closes it and returns focus to where it was.

`side` is `start`, `end`, or `auto`. `auto` picks the side from where focus was when the drawer opened. The top nav creates this pair for you when its media query matches.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MobileNav, MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <MobileNavToggle v-model:is-open="open" controls="app-nav" />
  <MobileNav id="app-nav" v-model:is-open="open" header="Menu" side="start">
    <!-- items -->
  </MobileNav>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`MobileNav` 是从屏幕一侧滑入的对话框抽屉，不是底部弹层。`MobileNavToggle` 和它绑同一个 `v-model:is-open`。打开后焦点留在抽屉里，Escape 或点遮罩关闭，并回到原来的焦点。

`side` 可以是 `start`、`end` 或 `auto`。`auto` 按打开时焦点的位置决定从哪一侧进入。顶栏的窄屏模式会自己创建这一对组件。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { MobileNav, MobileNavToggle } from '@astryx-vue/core/MobileNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const open = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <MobileNavToggle v-model:is-open="open" controls="app-nav" />
  <MobileNav id="app-nav" v-model:is-open="open" header="菜单" side="start">
    <!-- 导航项 -->
  </MobileNav>
</template>
```

summary.en: `NavItem` is one row in a sidebar, top bar, or menu. It renders a link when `href` is set, and a button when it is disabled or has no address. Pass a CSS icon class through `iconClass`, or use the `icon` slot. `NavIcon`, exported from the same entry, draws the round emphasis badge.
summary.zh: `NavItem` 是侧栏、顶栏和菜单里的一条导航。有 `href` 时渲染成链接，禁用或没有地址时渲染成按钮。图标用 `iconClass` 传入 CSS icon，也可以用 `icon` 插槽。需要圆形强调底时用同目录导出的 `NavIcon`。

usage.en:
`NavItem` is one row in a sidebar, top bar, or menu. It renders a link when `href` is set, and a button when it is disabled or has no address. Pass a CSS icon class through `iconClass`, or use the `icon` slot. `NavIcon`, exported from the same entry, draws the round emphasis badge.

The link root defaults to `a`. Pass `RouterLink` as `as` and the item sets both `href` and `to`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
</script>

<template>
  <NavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" is-selected label="Home" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`NavItem` 是侧栏、顶栏和菜单里的一条导航。有 `href` 时渲染成链接，禁用或没有地址时渲染成按钮。图标用 `iconClass` 传入 CSS icon，也可以用 `icon` 插槽。需要圆形强调底时用同目录导出的 `NavIcon`。

链接根默认是 `a`。接入 Vue Router 时把 `RouterLink` 传给 `as`，组件会同时带上 `href` 和 `to`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavItem'
</script>

<template>
  <NavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" is-selected label="首页" />
</template>
```

summary.en: `NavMenu` is a `role="menu"`. `NavMenuItem` is one entry and becomes a link when `href` is set. `NavDisclosure` owns the trigger, positioning, and dismissal: click, hover, outside press, and Escape all close it. ArrowDown opens on the first item, ArrowUp on the last. Inside the menu, arrows move and a typed character jumps to a matching prefix.
summary.zh: `NavMenu` 是 `role="menu"` 的菜单。`NavMenuItem` 是其中一项，有 `href` 时是链接。`NavDisclosure` 负责触发按钮、定位和关闭：点击、悬停、点击外部和 Escape 都会关掉。ArrowDown 打开并聚焦第一项，ArrowUp 聚焦最后一项。菜单内部方向键移动，单字符会按前缀匹配。

usage.en:
`NavMenu` is a `role="menu"`. `NavMenuItem` is one entry and becomes a link when `href` is set. `NavDisclosure` owns the trigger, positioning, and dismissal: click, hover, outside press, and Escape all close it. ArrowDown opens on the first item, ArrowUp on the last. Inside the menu, arrows move and a typed character jumps to a matching prefix.

The top nav and overflow list already compose these parts. Use them directly for an account menu.

Menus attached to a side or top heading use `NavHeadingMenu` and `NavHeadingMenuItem`. Put the menu in the heading `menu` slot. The heading owns closing and where focus goes after open. An item with an address is a link. An item without one is a `menuitem`. Arrows move, and Enter or Space activates the current item.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavDisclosure, NavMenu, NavMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
</script>

<template>
  <NavDisclosure label="Account">
    <template #trigger="{ isOpen, panelId }">
      <button type="button" :aria-controls="panelId" :aria-expanded="isOpen">
        Account
      </button>
    </template>
    <template #default="{ close, focusRequest }">
      <NavMenu label="Account" :focus-request="focusRequest" @close="close">
        <NavMenuItem href="/profile" label="Profile" />
      </NavMenu>
    </template>
  </NavDisclosure>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`NavMenu` 是 `role="menu"` 的菜单。`NavMenuItem` 是其中一项，有 `href` 时是链接。`NavDisclosure` 负责触发按钮、定位和关闭：点击、悬停、点击外部和 Escape 都会关掉。ArrowDown 打开并聚焦第一项，ArrowUp 聚焦最后一项。菜单内部方向键移动，单字符会按前缀匹配。

顶栏和溢出列表已经包好了这组零件。需要自己做账号菜单时直接用它们。

挂在侧栏或顶栏标题上的菜单用 `NavHeadingMenu` 和 `NavHeadingMenuItem`。把它放进标题的 `menu` 插槽即可，关闭和打开后的焦点由标题负责。有地址的项是链接，没有地址的项是 `menuitem`。方向键移动，Enter 或 Space 激活当前项。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { NavDisclosure, NavMenu, NavMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
</script>

<template>
  <NavDisclosure label="账号">
    <template #trigger="{ isOpen, panelId }">
      <button type="button" :aria-controls="panelId" :aria-expanded="isOpen">
        账号
      </button>
    </template>
    <template #default="{ close, focusRequest }">
      <NavMenu label="账号" :focus-request="focusRequest" @close="close">
        <NavMenuItem href="/profile" label="个人资料" />
      </NavMenu>
    </template>
  </NavDisclosure>
</template>
```

en.text: Write `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls` on the trigger. The slot already passes that state.
Items close the menu by default. Set `keepOpen` when the menu should stay.
Do not leave `menuitem` elements in a drawer. Set `isMenuItem` to false there.

不要把菜单项单独放进抽屉。抽屉里把 `isMenuItem` 设成 false，避免菜单项脱离菜单。

summary.en: `Pagination` splits a long list into pages. People move with the page buttons or the previous and next controls.
summary.zh: `Pagination` 是一个分页导航组件，用于将大量数据分割成多个页面展示。用户可以通过点击页码、上下页按钮或输入页码跳转到指定页面。

usage.en:
`Pagination` splits a long list into pages. People move with the page buttons or the previous and next controls.

Pass the total and bind the current page:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Pagination } from '@astryx-vue/core/Pagination'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const page = ref(1)
const total = ref(100)
</script>

<template>
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="total" />
</template>
```

`pageSize` is how many items each page holds. `showSizeChanger` lets people change that. `showTotal` shows how many items exist and which range the current page covers.

The visible labels are English unless the app calls `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`.
usage.zh:
`Pagination` 是一个分页导航组件，用于将大量数据分割成多个页面展示。用户可以通过点击页码、上下页按钮或输入页码跳转到指定页面。

基本用法需要提供总条目数和当前页码：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Pagination } from '@astryx-vue/core/Pagination'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const page = ref(1)
const total = ref(100)
</script>

<template>
  <Pagination v-model:page="page" :total="total" />
</template>
```

通过 `pageSize` 属性设置每页显示的条目数。开启 `showSizeChanger` 后，用户可以自行选择每页显示数量。按钮和总数文案默认是英文，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后改为中文。

usage.en:
`SideNav` is the navigation landmark along one side of a page. Compose it with `SideNavSection`, `SideNavHeading`, and `SideNavItem`. With `collapsible`, the bar can shrink to an icon rail. `SideNavCollapseButton` sits at the top end of the sidebar. Items without an icon are omitted while collapsed. Items with children open in a side menu.

Control it with `v-model:is-collapsed`. Pass an object to `collapsible` to hide the built-in button or to set a hotkey such as `mod+\\`. With `resizable`, the trailing edge can be dragged. The width starts at 260px and stays between 180px and 480px. The handle hides while the bar is collapsed. Dragging below 160px collapses the bar when collapse is also enabled.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SideNav, SideNavItem, SideNavSection } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const collapsed = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <SideNav v-model:is-collapsed="collapsed" collapsible>
    <SideNavSection title="Workspace">
      <SideNavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" label="Home" />
    </SideNavSection>
  </SideNav>
</template>
```

<SideNavCollapseFigure class="nav-collapse-figure" />
usage.zh:
`SideNav` 是页面一侧的导航地标。里面按 `SideNavSection`、`SideNavHeading`、`SideNavItem` 组织。`collapsible` 打开后，栏可以收成只剩图标的窄条，`SideNavCollapseButton` 在侧栏顶部靠右。收起后，没有图标的项不会渲染；有下级的项改成从侧面弹出的菜单。

用 `v-model:is-collapsed` 受控。`collapsible` 也可以传对象，关掉内置按钮，或给一个快捷键，例如 `mod+\\`。`resizable` 打开后，结束边上可以拖宽度，默认从 260px 起，范围是 180px 到 480px。收起后把手会藏起来。拖到 160px 以下、并且侧栏可以收起时，栏会收成图标条。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { SideNav, SideNavItem, SideNavSection } from '@astryx-vue/core/SideNav'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const collapsed = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <SideNav v-model:is-collapsed="collapsed" collapsible>
    <SideNavSection title="工作区">
      <SideNavItem href="/home" icon-class="i-carbon-home" label="首页" />
    </SideNavSection>
  </SideNav>
</template>
```

usage.zh:
`TabList` 把一组 `Tab` 组织成标签页，让用户在同一区域内切换相关内容，常用于设置页、详情页的分区浏览。从独立入口导入组件后，通过 `v-model:value` 控制当前选中项：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tab, TabList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <TabList v-model:value="value">
    <Tab value="overview">
      总览
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="props">
      属性
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="examples">
      示例
    </Tab>
  </TabList>
</template>
```

en.text: Use semantic `role="tablist"`, `role="tab"`, and `aria-selected` for accessible tabs.
Give each `Tab` a unique `value` for selection and keyboard navigation.
Use `disabled` for unavailable tabs; keyboard navigation skips them automatically.
Put too many tabs in a single strip; consider scrolling or reorganizing content when it overflows.
Use TabList for page-level navigation; Breadcrumbs or Link are better for wayfinding.

zh.text: 组件自带 `role="tablist"`、`role="tab"` 与 `aria-selected` 语义，配合方向键导航，无需额外补齐无障碍属性。
为每个 `Tab` 提供唯一的 `value`：它是选中状态的标识，也是键盘导航定位标签的依据。
需要暂时不可用的标签时设置 `disabled`，键盘导航会自动跳过，用户也不会误点。
避免在单个 TabList 中放入过多标签：标签过多会增加查找成本，超出容器时应考虑滚动或重新组织内容。
避免用 TabList 承担页面级导航：标签页适合切换同页内容，跨页面跳转应使用链接或面包屑。

summary.en: `TopNav` is the navigation landmark across the top of a page. `heading`, `start`, the default slot, and `center` run from the leading edge, and `end` stays at the trailing edge. `TopNavHeading` can show a logo, a line above the title, a line below it, and a menu. `TopNavMenu` opens a menu. `TopNavMegaMenu` opens a larger panel with items and a featured card. The card can show an image, and its action is its own link. Arrow keys move through the items and Escape closes the panel.
summary.zh: `TopNav` 是页面顶部的导航地标。`heading`、`start`、默认插槽和 `center` 从左到右排，`end` 靠右。`TopNavHeading` 可以带标志、上下行和标题菜单。`TopNavMenu` 打开普通菜单，`TopNavMegaMenu` 打开带分组和推荐卡的大菜单。推荐卡可以放图片，行动文字单独成链接。方向键在菜单项之间移动，Escape 关闭。

usage.en:
`TopNav` is the navigation landmark across the top of a page. `heading`, `start`, the default slot, and `center` run from the leading edge, and `end` stays at the trailing edge. `TopNavHeading` can show a logo, a line above the title, a line below it, and a menu. `TopNavMenu` opens a menu. `TopNavMegaMenu` opens a larger panel with items and a featured card. The card can show an image, and its action is its own link. Arrow keys move through the items and Escape closes the panel.

Pass `mobileQuery` and, when it matches, the leading and center content moves into `MobileNav`. The bar keeps the heading, the end slot, and the toggle. A slot is not rendered in both places at once.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNav, TopNavHeading, TopNavMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNav mobile-query="(max-width: 800px)">
    <template #heading>
      <TopNavHeading heading="Northwind" href="/" />
    </template>
    <TopNavMenu label="Product" :items="[{ label: 'Analytics', href: '/analytics' }]" />
  </TopNav>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`TopNav` 是页面顶部的导航地标。`heading`、`start`、默认插槽和 `center` 从左到右排，`end` 靠右。`TopNavHeading` 可以带标志、上下行和标题菜单。`TopNavMenu` 打开普通菜单，`TopNavMegaMenu` 打开带分组和推荐卡的大菜单。推荐卡可以放图片，行动文字单独成链接。方向键在菜单项之间移动，Escape 关闭。

传入 `mobileQuery` 后，查询命中时起始和中间的内容收进 `MobileNav`，栏上只留标题、结束内容和开关。同一个插槽不会同时出现在两处。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TopNav, TopNavHeading, TopNavMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TopNav'
</script>

<template>
  <TopNav mobile-query="(max-width: 800px)">
    <template #heading>
      <TopNavHeading heading="Northwind" href="/" />
    </template>
    <TopNavMenu label="产品" :items="[{ label: '分析', href: '/analytics' }]" />
  </TopNav>
</template>
```

en.text: Give menu items an `href`. ArrowDown opens, arrows move, Escape closes.

Do not put a form in the mega menu. It is navigation, not a dialog.

summary.en: `Stepper` lists the steps of a flow. `activeStep` is the zero-based current step. A step before it is completed, the current step is in progress, and the rest have not started.
summary.zh: `Stepper` 列出一个流程里的步骤。`activeStep` 是从 0 开始的当前步。它前面的步骤已完成，当前步进行中，后面的还没开始。

usage.en:
`Stepper` lists the steps of a flow. `activeStep` is the zero-based current step. A step before it is completed, the current step is in progress, and the rest have not started.

Pass `@step-click` when a step can be chosen out of order. The handler receives the zero-based index, and only then do the steps render as buttons. The default `separated` layout draws a track above each horizontal step, with the indicator and the label on one row. `indicatorPosition="on-track"` sets the indicator into the connector and centers the label under it. `indicator` defaults to `auto`: a check when the step is done, a ring on the current step, and a number after that.

`horizontalOptions.minimumStepWidth` defaults to `112`. A horizontal stepper collapses once it is narrower than that width times the step count, and shows the current step with Previous and Next. The track stays. `collapsedVariant` defaults to `withLabelAndControls` and skips disabled steps. `withLabel` drops the controls, and `hiddenLabel` leaves only the track.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Step, Stepper } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stepper'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(2)
</script>

<template>
  <Stepper
    :active-step="active"
    :horizontal-options="{ minimumStepWidth: 112 }"
    @step-click="active = $event"
  >
    <Step label="Cart" :step="0" />
    <Step label="Shipping" :step="1" />
    <Step label="Payment" :step="2" />
    <Step label="Review" :step="3" />
    <Step label="Confirm" :step="4" />
  </Stepper>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Stepper` 列出一个流程里的步骤。`activeStep` 是从 0 开始的当前步。它前面的步骤已完成，当前步进行中，后面的还没开始。

步骤可以不按顺序点时，传入 `@step-click`。回调拿到从 0 开始的序号，只有这时步骤才会渲染成按钮。默认的 `separated` 在水平步骤上方画轨道，圆标和标签排在同一行。`indicatorPosition="on-track"` 把圆标嵌进连接线，标签居中放在圆标下面。`indicator` 默认是 `auto`：完成的步骤是勾，当前步是环，后面的步骤是数字。

`horizontalOptions.minimumStepWidth` 默认是 `112`。水平步骤条窄于「112 × 步骤数」时会自动收起，只留当前步，并带 Previous 和 Next。轨道还在。`collapsedVariant` 默认是 `withLabelAndControls`，并跳过禁用的步骤。`withLabel` 不显示这两个按钮，`hiddenLabel` 只留轨道。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Step, Stepper } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stepper'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const active = ref(2)
</script>

<template>
  <Stepper
    :active-step="active"
    :horizontal-options="{ minimumStepWidth: 112 }"
    @step-click="active = $event"
  >
    <Step label="Cart" :step="0" />
    <Step label="Shipping" :step="1" />
    <Step label="Payment" :step="2" />
    <Step label="Review" :step="3" />
    <Step label="Confirm" :step="4" />
  </Stepper>
</template>
```

en.title: Custom content
en.description: Each vertical step owns a slice of the page. The content slot can be fields, a summary, or a banner, and only the active step renders it.

en.title: Indicator modes
en.description: None leaves progress to the bar and the label. Auto uses a check, a ring, or a number. Number always shows the step. A custom icon can replace the glyph.

en.title: On-track horizontal
en.description: On a horizontal track, each indicator sits in the connector so the numbers read as beads on one line. Labels center under their node.

en.title: On-track vertical
en.description: On a vertical rail, the indicator sits on the connector, with the label and description beside the node.

en.title: Validation status
en.description: Success, error, and accent recolor the indicator in a verification flow. Status never recolors the connector.

en.title: Horizontal narrow collapsed
en.description: At 320px, four steps fall below the 112px minimum width and collapse to the current step, with Previous and Next.

zh.title: 自定义内容
zh.description: 垂直步骤各自占页面的一块。内容可以是表单、摘要或横幅，并且只渲染当前步骤。

zh.title: 指示器模式
zh.description: none 只靠轨道和标签表示进度。auto 用勾、环或数字。number 始终显示序号。也可以换成自定义图标。

zh.title: 轨道上的水平步骤
zh.description: 水平轨道上，指示器嵌进连接线，数字像一串珠子。标签居中放在节点下面。

zh.title: 轨道上的垂直步骤
zh.description: 垂直轨道上，指示器落在连续的连接线上，标签和说明放在节点旁边。

zh.title: 校验状态
zh.description: 校验流程里，成功、错误和强调色只改变指示器。连接线的颜色不受状态影响。

zh.title: 窄水平收起
zh.description: 宽度 320px 时，四步低于 112px 的最小宽度，收成当前步骤，并带上一步和下一步。

en.name: Stepper
en.description: The ordered list holding the steps. Owns the orientation and the indicator placement the whole flow is laid out on.

en.name: Frame
en.description: The layout frame that groups the ordered steps with the optional compact summary shown at narrow widths.

en.name: Compact summary
en.description: The optional row a horizontal Stepper adds directly beneath the track once it is too narrow to label every step. horizontalOptions.collapsedVariant chooses a label with Previous/Next controls, the label alone, or no row for a bare progress track. The on-track layout keeps its indicators on the rail instead of repeating the active indicator beside the label. Every step keeps its name in the accessible sequence at any width.

en.name: Step
en.description: One step in the flow, and the element carrying its status. Wraps the indicator, label, description, and the track segments belonging to it.

en.name: Progress bar
en.description: A 4px segmented bar per step. Filled for completed and active steps. Advancing one step grows the fill along the track it just covered, so the movement reads as progress rather than a bar changing color. Every other change applies at once: going back, jumping forward by more than one step, mounting mid-flow, and any change at all under prefers-reduced-motion. Where a span is drawn by more than one segment (the on-track layouts split it between two steps, three when a content slot sits between them), the segments run in track order at one constant speed, so the fill reads as a single line growing rather than pieces lighting in turn.

en.name: Connector
en.description: The track drawn between indicators in the on-track layouts. Each connector paints an unfilled line and, over it, the accent fill covering the progress made. How many pieces a connector is drawn from is an implementation detail of the layout, not a themeable part; use --step-connector-gap to hold the track off the indicator.

en.name: Indicator
en.description: A numbered badge, a check, or any custom icon. Controlled via the indicator prop.

en.name: Label
en.description: Text identifying the step.

en.name: Description
en.description: Supporting text below the label with additional context.

zh.name: 步骤条
zh.description: 装着各步的有序列表。整条流程的方向，以及指示放在哪里，都由它决定。

zh.name: 框架
zh.description: 把有序的步骤和窄宽度下可选的紧凑摘要组合在一起的布局框。

zh.name: 紧凑摘要
zh.description: 横向 Stepper 窄到没法给每一步都标字时，直接加在轨道下方的可选一行。horizontalOptions.collapsedVariant 决定这一行是「标签加上一页和下一页」、只有标签，还是不出现、只留一条进度轨。轨道上的布局把指示留在轨上，不会在标签旁边再重复当前指示。无论多窄，每一步的名字都留在无障碍序列里。

zh.name: 步骤
zh.description: 流程里的一步，也是带着这一步状态的元素。里面有指示、标签、说明，以及属于它的轨段。

zh.name: 进度条
zh.description: 每一步一条 4px 的分段条。已完成和当前步是填满的。前进一步时，填充沿着刚走过的那段轨长出来，读起来是在前进，而不是一根条在变色。其余变化一次完成：往回走、一次跳过不止一步、中途挂载，以及 prefers-reduced-motion 下的任何变化。一段跨度由不止一段画出时（轨道上的布局会把它分给两步，中间再插内容插槽时是三步），这些段按轨道顺序、以同一个恒定速度走，所以填充读起来是一条线在长，而不是一段段依次点亮。

zh.name: 连接线
zh.description: 轨道上的布局里，指示之间画出的轨。每条连接线先画一条未填充的线，再在上面画表示已完成进度的强调填充。一条连接线由几段拼成，是布局的实现细节，不是可以单独换主题的部分。用 --step-connector-gap 让轨和指示保持距离。

zh.name: 指示
zh.description: 数字徽章、勾，或任意自定义图标。由 indicator 属性控制。

zh.name: 标签
zh.description: 标识这一步的文字。

zh.name: 说明
zh.description: 标签下面的补充文字。

summary.en: `TabMenu` collects tabs that do not fit on the `TabList`. It has to be a child of `TabList`. Arrow keys move onto the trigger without changing the selected tab. Enter or Space opens the menu. The menu items are `menuitemradio` controls, and choosing one selects that tab through the list.
summary.zh: `TabMenu` 把放不下的标签收进 `TabList` 末尾的菜单。它必须是 `TabList` 的子组件。方向键可以移到触发器上，但不会因此改掉当前标签。Enter 或 Space 打开菜单。菜单项是 `menuitemradio`，选中一项会通过列表选中对应的标签。

usage.en:
`TabMenu` collects tabs that do not fit on the `TabList`. It has to be a child of `TabList`. Arrow keys move onto the trigger without changing the selected tab. Enter or Space opens the menu. The menu items are `menuitemradio` controls, and choosing one selects that tab through the list.

`label` is the trigger text when none of the options is selected, and the menu's accessible name. When an option is the selected tab, the trigger shows that option's label and takes the selected tab style. `iconClass` is a CSS icon class on an option, for example `i-carbon-settings`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Tab, TabList, TabMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>
  <TabList v-model:value="value">
    <Tab value="overview">
      Overview
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="activity">
      Activity
    </Tab>
    <TabMenu
      label="More"
      :options="[
        { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' },
        { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing' },
      ]"
    />
  </TabList>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`TabMenu` 把放不下的标签收进 `TabList` 末尾的菜单。它必须是 `TabList` 的子组件。方向键可以移到触发器上，但不会因此改掉当前标签。Enter 或 Space 打开菜单。菜单项是 `menuitemradio`，选中一项会通过列表选中对应的标签。

`label` 是没有选项被选中时的触发器文字，也是菜单的无障碍名称。某个选项就是当前标签时，触发器改显示这个选项的文字，并带上选中标签的样式。`iconClass` 是选项上的 CSS 图标类，例如 `i-carbon-settings`。

```vue

import { Tab, TabList, TabMenu } from '@astryx-vue/core/TabList'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const value = ref('overview')
</script>

<template>

    <Tab value="overview">
      Overview
    </Tab>
    <Tab value="activity">
      Activity
    </Tab>
    <TabMenu
      label="More"
      :options="[
        { value: 'settings', label: 'Settings' },
        { value: 'billing', label: 'Billing' },
      ]"
    />
  </TabList>
</template>
```

summary.en: `Outline` is a table of contents. Each item is `{ id, label, level }`. `id` matches a heading element on the page. `level` is 1 through 6. Levels 1 and 2 share the first indent. Level 3, 4, and 5–6 step inward after that.
summary.zh: `Outline` 是目录。每一项是 `{ id, label, level }`。`id` 对应页面上标题元素的 id。`level` 从 1 到 6。1 和 2 共用第一档缩进，3、4、以及 5–6 再逐档往里收。

usage.en:
`Outline` is a table of contents. Each item is `{ id, label, level }`. `id` matches a heading element on the page. `level` is 1 through 6. Levels 1 and 2 share the first indent. Level 3, 4, and 5–6 step inward after that.

Leave `activeId` unset and the outline follows scroll. It uses `scrollContainer` when you pass one, otherwise the nearest scrollable ancestor, otherwise the viewport. The active item is the last heading whose top has passed the resting line. At the bottom of the scroll, the last item is active. `offset` shifts that line and the scroll landing by the same amount, on top of each heading’s own `scroll-margin-top`.

Pass `activeId` and scroll-spy stays off. `v-model:active-id` keeps the highlight in your own state. `navigateStart` fires when a click starts a scroll. `navigateEnd` fires once for that navigation, when the scroll settles, when the reader interrupts it, or after 1.2 seconds.

`hasScrollOnClick` is on by default. A click with a modifier key, or a click whose target id is missing, does not take over the browser’s own behavior. Activating an item writes the hash with `history.pushState`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Outline } from '@astryx-vue/core/Outline'

const items = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', level: 2 },
  { id: 'theming', label: 'Theming', level: 2 },
  { id: 'tokens', label: 'Tokens', level: 3 },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Outline :items="items" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`Outline` 是目录。每一项是 `{ id, label, level }`。`id` 对应页面上标题元素的 id。`level` 从 1 到 6。1 和 2 共用第一档缩进，3、4、以及 5–6 再逐档往里收。

不传 `activeId` 时，大纲跟着滚动走。传了 `scrollContainer` 就盯这个容器，否则找最近的可滚动祖先，再没有就用视口。当前项是顶部已经越过停留线的最后一个标题。滚到底时，最后一项为当前项。`offset` 把停留线和滚动落点一起下移，标题自己的 `scroll-margin-top` 仍然算在里面。

传入 `activeId` 后，滚动侦测关闭。`v-model:active-id` 把高亮留在你自己的状态里。点击开始滚动时发出 `navigateStart`。同一次导航结束时发出一次 `navigateEnd`：滚动停稳、读者中途打断，或超过 1.2 秒，都会结束。

`hasScrollOnClick` 默认打开。带修饰键的点击，或目标 id 在页面上不存在时，不接管浏览器自己的行为。激活一项会用 `history.pushState` 写入 hash。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Outline } from '@astryx-vue/core/Outline'

const items = [
  { id: 'overview', label: 'Overview', level: 2 },
  { id: 'theming', label: 'Theming', level: 2 },
  { id: 'tokens', label: 'Tokens', level: 3 },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Outline :items="items" />
</template>
```

en.text: Point each `id` at a real heading, and keep `level` equal to that heading’s level.
Set `offset` to the height of a sticky header so the active item and the scroll landing agree.
Use `density="compact"` in a narrow sidebar, and `default` beside a long article.
Pass `activeId` and also expect the built-in scroll-spy to keep updating it. A provided id turns the spy off.
Indent by hand with extra markup. The level already chooses the indent.

en.heading: Theme
en.text:
The root class is `astryx-outline`. The indicator reads `--astryx-outline-indicator-top` and `--astryx-outline-indicator-height`, which the component measures from the active link.

Indent is a 2px track plus padding-inline-start: spacing 3 at the first indent, spacing 7, spacing 11, then spacing 12. `compact` changes block padding from spacing 2 to spacing 1.

zh.text:
根类名是 `astryx-outline`。指示条读取 `--astryx-outline-indicator-top` 和 `--astryx-outline-indicator-height`，组件会按当前链接量出来。

缩进是 2px 的轨道，加上行内起始内边距：第一档为间距 3，然后是间距 7、间距 11、间距 12。`compact` 把块方向内边距从间距 2 改成间距 1。

en.title: Controlled
en.description: activeId turns off the built-in scroll spy, so the highlight follows your own logic.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { OutlineItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/Outline'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Outline } from '@astryx-vue/core/Outline'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const items: OutlineItem[] = [
  { id: 'ctrl-summary', label: 'Summary', level: 2 },
  { id: 'ctrl-details', label: 'Details', level: 2 },
  { id: 'ctrl-results', label: 'Results', level: 2 },
  { id: 'ctrl-next-steps', label: 'Next steps', level: 2 },
]

const activeId = ref('ctrl-details')
const index = computed(() => items.findIndex(item => item.id === activeId.value))

function goTo(next: number): void {
  const clamped = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next))
  activeId.value = items[clamped].id
}
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="4" :width="240">
    <Outline v-model:active-id="activeId" :items="items" />
    <HStack :gap="2">
      <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" label="Previous" @click="goTo(index - 1)" />
      <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" label="Next" @click="goTo(index + 1)" />
    </HStack>
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Active section: {{ items[index]?.label }}
    </Text>
  </VStack>
</template>

en.title: Deep nesting
en.description: Levels 1 through 4 step the indent inward, so a long document with subsections stays scannable.

summary.en: `AlertDialog` is a modal with a single job: it asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before that action happens. Deleting content, revoking access, and discarding unsaved work all belong here — the work cannot be undone, so it is worth interrupting the user, stating the consequence, and letting them decide.
summary.zh: `AlertDialog` 是一个只做一件事的模态对话框：在破坏性或不可逆的操作真正发生之前，再向用户确认一次。删除内容、撤销授权、丢弃未保存的修改都属于这类场景——操作一旦执行就无法回头，所以值得打断用户，把后果讲清楚，再由用户自己决定。

usage.en:
`AlertDialog` is a modal with a single job: it asks the user to confirm a destructive or irreversible action before that action happens. Deleting content, revoking access, and discarding unsaved work all belong here — the work cannot be undone, so it is worth interrupting the user, stating the consequence, and letting them decide.

It implements the WAI-ARIA Alert Dialog pattern. The root element uses `role="alertdialog"`, the title names the dialog through `aria-labelledby`, and the consequence description is announced with it through `aria-describedby`. Focus moves into the dialog on open and lands on Cancel, then returns to the element that opened it on close. The dialog cannot be dismissed by clicking the backdrop, and Escape is the same as canceling.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="Delete project" variant="destructive" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <AlertDialog
    :is-open="isOpen"
    title="Delete this project?"
    description="This cannot be undone. Its deployments and every dashboard built on it go with it."
    action-label="Delete project"
    @action="isOpen = false"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

The parent owns the open state. Cancel and Escape only emit `openChange(false)`, so the dialog never closes itself, and the confirm action only emits `action` without closing either. That gap is deliberate: real work takes time, so you close the dialog when the work settles. While it runs, set `isActionLoading` to show a spinner on the confirm button and hold the dialog open:

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const isActionLoading = ref(false)

async function revoke(): Promise<void> {
  isActionLoading.value = true
  await revokeAccess()
  isActionLoading.value = false
  isOpen.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog
    :is-action-loading="isActionLoading"
    :is-open="isOpen"
    action-label="Revoke access"
    description="This member loses access to every shared folder and draft immediately."
    title="Revoke access?"
    @action="revoke"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

The confirm action uses the `destructive` variant by default, because the dialog exists to confirm destructive work. When the confirmation is not destructive — publishing a draft, for instance — set `actionVariant` to `primary` so the color matches the meaning.

The action layout follows the available width. Above 640px the actions sit in one row, Cancel then confirm, and the row wraps when the labels are long. At 640px and below both buttons fill the width and the confirm action sits above Cancel. Either way, initial focus stays on Cancel, the least destructive choice, and the narrow layout keeps visual, DOM, and tab order aligned so screen readers read the actions in the order they are shown.

`isInline` renders the whole surface in normal flow for documentation previews, without the `<dialog>` element, the backdrop, or focus behavior. Because it is not modal, it does not claim to be: the root element uses `role="group"` instead.
usage.zh:
`AlertDialog` 是一个只做一件事的模态对话框：在破坏性或不可逆的操作真正发生之前，再向用户确认一次。删除内容、撤销授权、丢弃未保存的修改都属于这类场景——操作一旦执行就无法回头，所以值得打断用户，把后果讲清楚，再由用户自己决定。

它实现了 WAI-ARIA 的 Alert Dialog 模式。根元素使用 `role="alertdialog"`，标题通过 `aria-labelledby` 为对话框命名，后果描述通过 `aria-describedby` 一起播报。打开时焦点移入对话框并落在「取消」上，关闭后再回到触发它的元素。它不能通过点击遮罩关闭，Escape 则等同于取消。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
</script>

<template>
  <Button label="删除项目" variant="destructive" @click="isOpen = true" />
  <AlertDialog
    :is-open="isOpen"
    title="要删除这个项目吗？"
    description="删除后无法恢复，项目下的部署与所有仪表盘都会一并移除。"
    action-label="删除项目"
    @action="isOpen = false"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

打开状态完全由父组件掌握。按下「取消」或按 Escape 只会发出 `openChange(false)`，组件不会自己关闭；确认按钮同样只发出 `action` 事件，也不会关闭对话框。这是刻意留出的位置：异步操作需要时间，你可以在操作结束后再设置 `isOpen`。等待期间把 `isActionLoading` 设为 `true`，确认按钮会显示加载指示，对话框保持打开：

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isOpen = ref(false)
const isActionLoading = ref(false)

async function revoke(): Promise<void> {
  isActionLoading.value = true
  await revokeAccess()
  isActionLoading.value = false
  isOpen.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog
    :is-action-loading="isActionLoading"
    :is-open="isOpen"
    action-label="撤销授权"
    description="该成员会立即失去所有共享文件夹和草稿的访问权限。"
    title="要撤销授权吗？"
    @action="revoke"
    @open-change="isOpen = $event"
  />
</template>
```

确认按钮默认使用 `destructive` 变体，因为对话框本身就是为确认破坏性操作而存在的。如果这次确认并不具有破坏性，例如「发布变更」，把 `actionVariant` 改成 `primary`，颜色就会和语义一致。

按钮的排列会随可用宽度变化。宽于 640px 时，操作区是一行，按「取消 → 确认」的顺序排列，标签过长时整行自动换行；640px 及以下时两个按钮都占满宽度，确认操作排在「取消」上方。无论哪种排列，初始焦点始终落在「取消」上，因为那是破坏性最小的选择；窄屏下的层级、DOM 顺序与 Tab 顺序保持一致，屏幕阅读器读到的顺序和眼睛看到的顺序不会打架。

`isInline` 用于文档预览：它以普通文档流渲染整个表面，不使用 `<dialog>`、遮罩与焦点限制。既然没有模态行为，它也不会声称自己是模态的，根元素的角色改为 `role="group"`。

en.text: Make the confirm label say what will happen. "Delete project" lets the user judge the outcome before pressing; "OK" or "Yes" does not.
Put the consequence in `description`: whether the data can be recovered, what else is affected, who gets notified. This is where the decision is actually made.
Keep Cancel as the least destructive focus target. On a narrow screen the confirm action is visually and structurally first, but initial focus stays on Cancel.
Hold the dialog open with `isActionLoading` while an async action runs, and close it once the work really settles.
Reserve it for destructive or irreversible work. For plain information, or for filling something in, a lighter dialog is the better fit.
Signal danger with color alone. A red button does not say what will happen; the label does.
Close the dialog inside the `action` handler. The loading state then has nowhere to live, and the user never learns whether the work succeeded.
Nest a confirmation dialog inside another dialog. Split a multi-step flow into steps inside one dialog, or use a full page.

zh.text: 让确认按钮的标签说清会发生什么。「删除项目」比「确定」或「是」更能让人在按下之前判断后果。
在 `description` 里写清后果：删除后能否恢复、会影响哪些数据、是否通知他人。用户是在这里做出决定的。
保持「取消」是最不具破坏性的焦点目标。窄屏下确认操作在视觉和结构上都排在前面，但初始焦点仍然留在「取消」上。
异步操作期间使用 `isActionLoading` 撑住对话框，等工作真正结束后再关闭它。
只用来确认破坏性或不可逆的操作。普通的信息提示、表单填写改用量更轻的对话框。
只靠颜色表达危险。红色按钮本身不说明会发生什么，标签才是。
在 `action` 事件里立刻关闭对话框。这样一来加载状态无处安放，用户也不知道操作到底有没有成功。
把确认对话框套在另一个对话框里。多步流程请拆成同一个对话框里的步骤，或改用整页。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The dialog opens through the native `showModal()`, so modality, the inert page behind it, and focus restoration on close all come from the browser. The title and description are linked with `aria-labelledby` and `aria-describedby`, so assistive technology announces the question, the consequence, and the available actions together, instead of making the user explore the surface first.

Initial focus is pinned to Cancel through `data-autofocus`, so the least destructive choice keeps the focus even when the narrow layout rearranges the buttons. Escape and the Cancel button take the same path: they only emit `openChange(false)` and leave the decision to the parent. Clicking the backdrop never closes the dialog — a confirmation of destructive work should not disappear on a stray click.

While the confirm action is loading it carries `aria-busy`, and Cancel stays available so the user can back out of work that has not finished.

en.heading: Theme
useImperativeAlertDialog
en.text:
- `show(options)`: opens the dialog with the given options — every prop except `isOpen`, plus an `onAction` callback.
- `hide()`: closes the dialog.
- `isOpen`: the open state, as a writable ref.
- `Host`: component to render once in the template.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<dialog>` in the modal case and a `<div>` in the inline preview.

The following go to the root element:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

The component maintains `role`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`, and `aria-describedby` itself, so those keep the values it derives.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
对话框通过原生 `<dialog>` 的 `showModal()` 打开，因此模态行为、页面其余部分的不可交互状态、以及关闭后的焦点归还都由浏览器提供。标题与描述分别通过 `aria-labelledby` 与 `aria-describedby` 关联，屏幕阅读器在进入对话框时会读出「标题 + 后果描述 + 可用操作」这一整段信息，用户不必先摸索一圈才知道发生了什么。

初始焦点固定在「取消」上，并通过 `data-autofocus` 标记，所以即使窄屏下按钮的排列发生变化，获得焦点的仍然是最不具破坏性的那个选择。Escape 与按下「取消」走的是同一条路径：只发出 `openChange(false)`，是否关闭由父组件决定。点击遮罩不会关闭对话框——破坏性操作的确认不应该因为一次误触而消失。

确认按钮加载期间会带上 `aria-busy`，「取消」仍然可以按，用户可以取消一个还没结束的操作。

zh.heading: 主题
useImperativeAlertDialog
zh.text:
- `show(options)`：以给定选项打开对话框。选项为除 `isOpen` 之外的全部属性，另加一个 `onAction` 回调。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
模态下根元素为 `<dialog>`，行内预览下为 `<div>`。

以下内容传入根元素：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。

组件自己维护 `role`、`aria-modal`、`aria-labelledby` 与 `aria-describedby`，因此这些属性以组件推导出的值为准。

en.title: Loading
en.description: Revoke stays in a loading state for two seconds. The dialog is shown inline so the pending action is visible without opening it first.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { AlertDialog } from '@astryx-vue/core/AlertDialog'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const isLoading = ref(false)

async function revoke(): Promise<void> {
  isLoading.value = true
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000))
  isLoading.value = false
}
</script>

<template>
  <AlertDialog
    is-inline
    is-open
    action-label="Revoke"
    description="This user will immediately lose access to all shared resources."
    :is-action-loading="isLoading"
    title="Revoke access?"
    @action="revoke"
    @open-change="() => {}"
  />
</template>

summary.en: `BottomSheet` rises from the bottom edge of the viewport to hold mobile-first content: filters, share targets, quick actions, and forms. The panel carries a decorative grab handle, a scrolling content area underneath, and a scrim that dims and blocks the page. It is built on the native `<dialog>` element, so an open sheet keeps focus inside itself, makes the rest of the page inert, and returns focus to whatever opened it when it closes.
summary.zh: `BottomSheet` 从视口底部升起一块面板，用来承载筛选、分享、快速操作和表单这类移动端优先的内容。面板顶部有一条装饰性的拖拽条，下面是可以滚动的内容区；背景由遮罩压暗并阻挡交互。它基于原生 `<dialog>` 元素，因此在打开时会把焦点锁在面板内部、把页面其余部分设为不可交互，关闭后把焦点还给打开它的元素。

usage.en: `BottomSheet` rises from the bottom edge of the viewport to hold mobile-first content: filters, share targets, quick actions, and forms. The panel carries a decorative grab handle, a scrolling content area underneath, and a scrim that dims and blocks the page. It is built on the native `` element, so an open sheet keeps focus inside itself, makes the rest of the page inert, and returns focus to whatever opened it when it closes. The shortest form manages its own state and takes a name and the content: ```vue ``` `label` is required and becomes the sheet's accessible name, which a screen reader announces on entry. The panel has no built-in heading, so that name has to come from you. Whether the sheet is open is decided by `isOpen`: leave it unbound and the component owns its state, so Escape, a scrim click, and a downward swipe all close it; bind it and the component renders exactly the bound value while those gestures only emit `openChange(false)` and let the parent decide. `height` sets how tall the panel is once expanded, and it has three named budgets. `hug` fits the content up to 92% of the viewport, which suits short, bounded content. `capped` is the default at roughly 62% of the viewport, the usual choice for lists. `tall` pins the panel near full height for forms and content that keeps growing. You can also pass a number of pixels or any CSS length, such as `420` or `"min(70vh, 30rem)"`. Whatever the budget, content taller than the visible panel scrolls inside it instead of stretching the page. `snapPoints` lets someone drag the panel to an intermediate height rather than only fully open or closed. Each stop is the panel's visible height: a number is a viewport fraction (`0.5` is half the screen), `"50%"` means the same thing, and `"320px"` is an absolute height. The panel's own height is always the tallest stop, so `snap-points="[0.5]"` reads as "half a screen or all of it". A stop that is a quarter of the panel or less counts as a peek: it slides the panel partly off-screen instead of reflowing the content into a sliver, and it thins the scrim. Without `snapPoints` the sheet only opens and closes, and dragging it down still dismisses it. A downward drag closes the sheet, and a fast upward flick expands it to the tallest stop. The scrim's depth follows the panel while it moves, and on release the sheet settles on the nearest stop. Both the handle and, once it is scrolled to the top, the content area can start a drag. Under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` the entrance and exit movements collapse to almost nothing, while the position and state changes still happen. `purpose` controls implicit dismissal, matching `Dialog`. The default `info` allows Escape, a scrim click, and a swipe. `form` allows Escape only, so a stray click on the scrim cannot throw away typed input. `required` blocks every implicit path and announces the sheet as an alert dialog for flows that must end through an explicit choice. When the page behind the sheet should stay usable, set `hasScrim` to `false`: the sheet then opens non-modally, the page keeps scrolling and responding to clicks, and a swipe still dismisses it. A non-modal sheet never takes focus away from the page, so Escape dismisses it while focus is inside the sheet. `padding` sets the content area's inset on the spacing scale. When omitted, the theme decides, falling back to the `--spacing-4` step (16px) on every logical edge; pass `0` for a content box flush with the panel. The content area is also a container: if its only child is a region that carries its own inset, that child escapes the padding instead of being inset twice.
usage.zh: `BottomSheet` 从视口底部升起一块面板，用来承载筛选、分享、快速操作和表单这类移动端优先的内容。面板顶部有一条装饰性的拖拽条，下面是可以滚动的内容区；背景由遮罩压暗并阻挡交互。它基于原生 `` 元素，因此在打开时会把焦点锁在面板内部、把页面其余部分设为不可交互，关闭后把焦点还给打开它的元素。 最基本的用法是自己管理开关状态，把标签和内容交给组件： ```vue ``` `label` 是必填项，它会成为面板的无障碍名称，屏幕阅读器在进入面板时会读出它。面板本身没有内置标题，所以这个名称需要由你提供。是否打开由 `isOpen` 决定：不绑定 `v-model:is-open` 时组件自己管理状态，Escape、点击遮罩或向下拖动都会关闭它；绑定时组件完全跟随绑定的值，这些操作只会发出 `openChange(false)` 请求，是否关闭由父组件决定。 `height` 决定面板展开后的高度，可以使用三个命名档位。`hug` 让面板贴合内容，最多占到视口的 92%，适合内容固定且不长的场景；`capped` 是默认档，约占视口高度的 62%，是列表类内容的常用选择；`tall` 固定在接近满屏的高度，适合表单或内容会持续变长的场景。也可以直接传数字（像素）或任意 CSS 长度，例如 `420` 或 `"min(70vh, 30rem)"`。无论哪个档位，内容超过可见高度时都在面板内部滚动，不会把页面撑长。 `snapPoints` 让用户可以拖动面板停在中间高度，而不仅仅是全开或关闭。每个点位写的是面板的可见高度：数字是视口比例（`0.5` 就是半个屏幕），`"50%"` 是同样的意思，`"320px"` 是绝对高度。面板自身的高度始终是最高的那一档，所以 `snap-points="[0.5]"` 表示「要么半屏，要么全屏」。短到只有自身四分之一以下的档位被视为「露一角」：它不重排内容，而是把整块面板滑走一部分，同时把遮罩调淡。不传 `snapPoints` 时面板只支持打开和关闭，拖动仍然可以关闭它。 向下拖动可以关闭面板，向上快速一甩会把面板展开到最高档。拖动时遮罩的深浅跟随面板的位置变化，松手后停到最近的档位。拖动条和（滚动到顶部后的）内容区都可以发起拖动。系统开启「减少动态效果」时，进入和退出的动画会缩短到几乎不可见，但面板的位置和状态变化照常发生。 `purpose` 控制隐式关闭的尺度，和 `Dialog` 一致。默认的 `info` 允许 Escape、点击遮罩和向下拖动；`form` 只允许 Escape，避免用户误触遮罩丢失已经输入的内容；`required` 屏蔽全部隐式关闭，并使用 `alertdialog` 语义，用于必须由用户明确响应的流程。想要面板和页面同时可交互时，把 `hasScrim` 设为 `false`：面板会用非模态方式打开，背景不再被压暗，页面可以继续滚动和点击，拖动关闭依旧可用。非模态面板不会把焦点从页面上抢走，因此 Escape 只在焦点位于面板内部时才会关闭它。 `padding` 设置内容区的内边距，取值来自全局间距刻度。不设置时使用主题为底部弹窗定义的内边距，主题没有定义时取 `--spacing-4`（16px），四个逻辑边相同；传入 `0` 可以让内容紧贴面板边缘。内容区同时是一个容器，如果它的唯一子元素是自带内边距的区块，那个区块会顶掉这层内边距，不会被叠加两次。

en.text: Reserve it for small screens and momentary tasks: filters, sharing, quick actions, detail previews. Rising from the bottom edge keeps content inside thumb reach.
Pick the height that fits the content: `hug` for short bounded content, `capped` for lists, `tall` for forms and content that streams in.
Use `purpose="form"` to protect entered data against stray taps while keeping Escape available, and reserve `required` for flows that must end through an explicit action.
Write a `label` that says what the sheet holds. It is the only context a screen reader gets when focus moves in.
Let the sheet content run long. Break a long task into steps or move it to a full page instead.
Treat it as the default dialog on desktop. Use `Dialog` when a centered modal is what the task calls for.
Rely on the swipe as the only way out. Escape, a scrim click, and an explicit action button matter just as much.

zh.text: 用在小屏上的临时任务：筛选、分享、快速操作、详情预览。让内容从底部升起，符合拇指的触达范围。
按内容选择高度档位：内容固定且短用 `hug`，列表用 `capped`，表单或持续变长的内容用 `tall`。
用 `purpose="form"` 保护已经输入的内容，同时保留 Escape；只有必须由用户明确结束的流程才用 `required`。
给 `label` 写清楚面板是什么，例如「筛选条件」「分享到」，它是屏幕阅读器进入面板时唯一的上下文。
让面板内容过长。内容很多时考虑拆成多个步骤，或改用整页。
在桌面端把它当默认的弹窗使用。需要居中的模态对话框时使用 `Dialog`。
依赖拖动作为唯一的关闭方式。Escape、遮罩点击和显式的操作按钮同样重要。

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the sheet, and required. It is associated through `aria-label`; the panel has no built-in heading to derive a name from.

rows.name: `v-model:isOpen`
rows.description: Controlled open state. Bound, the sheet renders exactly this value and Escape, a scrim click, or a swipe only asks for a change; unbound, the component owns its state.

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: How tall the sheet is. Named budgets are hug (fits content, up to 92% of the viewport), capped (about 62%), and tall (about 92%); a number is pixels and a string is used as a CSS length. Content taller than the visible panel scrolls inside it.

rows.name: `snapPoints`
rows.description: Extra heights the sheet can rest at when dragged. A number is a viewport fraction, `'50%'` a percentage, and `'320px'` an absolute height; the sheet's own height is always the tallest stop. Without it the sheet only opens and closes.

rows.name: `padding`
rows.description: Inner padding of the content box using the spacing scale. When omitted, the theme decides, falling back to the `--spacing-4` step (16px) on every logical edge; pass `0` for a flush content box. The content box is a container, so a lone child that carries its own inset escapes the padding.

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: Implicit dismissal, matching `Dialog`. info allows Escape, a scrim click, and a swipe; form allows Escape only; required blocks every implicit path and uses `alertdialog` semantics.

rows.name: `hasScrim`
rows.description: Whether to render a scrim and open modally. `true` uses `showModal()`: top layer, focus confinement, page scroll lock, and an inert background. `false` uses `show()`, leaving the page interactive and scrollable.

rows.name: `finalFocusRef`
rows.description: Element that receives focus after the sheet closes, replacing the element that was focused when it opened. Use it when the opener can remount or the active element is not a reliable trigger.

rows.name: `isInline`
rows.description: Renders the panel in the document flow instead of a `<dialog>`, without a scrim, focus trap, or motion. Used to preview the surface inside a container that is already inert, such as component documentation.

rows.name: `activeSheet`
rows.description: The current sheet's `sheetId`. Bind it with `v-model:active-sheet`.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: Accessible name for the whole flow.

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: How the whole flow can be dismissed.

rows.name: `hasScrim`
rows.description: Whether the flow has one scrim. It stays up across pages.

rows.name: `label`
rows.description: 面板的无障碍名称，必填。它通过 `aria-label` 与面板关联；面板没有内置标题可以自动取名。

rows.name: `v-model:isOpen`
rows.description: 受控的打开状态。绑定后组件完全跟随这个值，Escape、遮罩点击和拖动只发出更新请求；不绑定时组件自己管理状态。

rows.name: `height`
rows.description: 面板的高度。命名档位 hug（贴合内容，最多 92%）、capped（约 62%）、tall（约 92%）；数字按像素解释，字符串按 CSS 长度原样使用。内容超出可见高度时在面板内部滚动。

rows.name: `snapPoints`
rows.description: 拖动时可以停靠的额外高度。数字是视口比例，`'50%'` 是百分比，`'320px'` 是绝对高度；面板自身高度始终是最高的档位。不传时面板只能打开和关闭。

rows.name: `padding`

rows.name: `purpose`
rows.description: 隐式关闭的尺度，与 `Dialog` 一致。info 允许 Escape、遮罩点击和拖动关闭；form 只允许 Escape；required 屏蔽全部隐式关闭并使用 `alertdialog` 语义。

en.heading: Accessibility
en.text:
The panel is built on the native `<dialog>` element. With a scrim it opens through `showModal()`, which puts it in the top layer, makes the background inert, and confines Tab to the sheet. Without a scrim it opens through `show()`, leaving the page usable. `label` names the sheet through `aria-label`, and `purpose="required"` switches the role to `alertdialog`.

On open, focus lands on the first element with `data-autofocus` inside the panel, or on the panel itself when there is none. On close, focus returns to the element that was focused when the sheet opened — if it is still in the page — or to the element named by `finalFocusRef`. The handoff happens once the exit motion has finished, so focus never lands on a surface that is still sliding away.

Escape closes the sheet unless `purpose` is `required` — a modal sheet confines focus inside itself, while a non-modal one never takes focus from the page, so focus has to be inside the sheet — and an Escape pressed while an input method is composing text cancels the composition instead. Once the content area is scrolled to the top, a downward drag can close the sheet, and at the end of its content an upward drag can expand it; with a `purpose` other than `info` a drag only settles on the nearest stop and never dismisses.

While the content actually overflows, the scrolling area becomes focusable, carries `role="group"`, and is named by the sheet's `label`, so a keyboard user can focus it and scroll with the arrow keys.

en.heading: Theming
BottomSheetSwitcher
en.text:
A multi-step flow shares one dialog. `v-model:active-sheet` names the child `BottomSheet` `sheetId` that is current. The scrim stays while the page changes, and the previous sheet remains briefly underneath so the heights can line up. Set `activeSheet` to `null` to close the flow.

A child `BottomSheet` with `sheetId` no longer opens its own dialog. The switcher decides which one is visible.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text: The root element is the panel <div> (class astryx-bottom-sheet), wrapped in a fixed-position <dialog>. The following are passed to the panel element: - HTML attributes. - aria-* attributes, except aria-label and aria-labelledby, which name the dialog around it. - data-* attributes. - class. - style.

zh.heading: 无障碍
zh.text:
面板基于原生 `<dialog>` 元素构建。带遮罩时使用 `showModal()` 打开，浏览器会把它放到顶层、把背景设为不可交互，并把 Tab 焦点限制在面板内；不带遮罩时使用 `show()` 打开，页面保持可用。`label` 通过 `aria-label` 成为面板的名称，`purpose="required"` 时角色变为 `alertdialog`。

打开时，焦点会落到面板内第一个带 `data-autofocus` 的元素上；没有这样的元素时，焦点落在面板本身。关闭后，焦点回到打开面板时的那个元素（如果它还在页面里），或者回到 `finalFocusRef` 指定的元素。抬起与关闭的动画结束后才执行焦点归还，避免焦点落在正在滑走的面板上。

Escape 只在 `purpose` 不是 `required` 时关闭面板（带遮罩的模态面板会把焦点限制在内部；无遮罩的面板不抢焦点，因此焦点需要位于面板内）；输入法正在组合文字时按下的 Escape 属于取消输入，不会关闭面板。内容区滚动到顶部后可以向下拖动关闭面板，滚动到内容底部时可以向上拖动展开面板；`purpose` 不是 `info` 时拖动只会停靠在最近的档位，不会关闭。

当内容区实际溢出时，它会成为一个可聚焦的滚动区域，带 `role="group"` 和面板的 `label` 作为名称，键盘用户可以聚焦它并用方向键滚动内容。

zh.heading: 主题
BottomSheetSwitcher
zh.text:
多步流程共用一个对话框。当前页用 `v-model:active-sheet` 指向子级 `BottomSheet` 的 `sheetId`。换页时遮罩留着，上一张会短暂留在下面并对齐高度。关掉时把 `activeSheet` 设为 `null`。

子级 `BottomSheet` 加上 `sheetId` 后不再自己打开对话框，由切换器决定哪一张可见。

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素是面板的 `
`（类名 astryx-bottom-sheet），它被包裹在一个固定的 <dialog> 里。 以下内容传入面板元素： - HTML 属性。 - `aria-*` 属性（aria-label 与 aria-labelledby 例外，它们用于命名外层的对话框）。 - `data-*` 属性。 - `class`。 - `style`。

en.description: Compares hug, capped, and tall starting heights for different amounts of content.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { BottomSheetHeight } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { BottomSheet } from '@astryx-vue/core/BottomSheet'
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Divider } from '@astryx-vue/core/Divider'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { ref } from 'vue'

const descriptions: Record<BottomSheetHeight, string> = {
  hug: 'Hug fits short, bounded content.',
  capped: 'Capped starts at a comfortable mid-height for lists and filters.',
  tall: 'Tall reserves most of the viewport for long or changing content.',
}

const height = ref<BottomSheetHeight | null>(null)
</script>

<template>
  <HStack :gap="2" wrap="wrap">
    <Button label="Open hug" @click="height = 'hug'" />
    <Button label="Open capped" @click="height = 'capped'" />
    <Button label="Open tall" @click="height = 'tall'" />
  </HStack>
  <BottomSheet
    :height="height ?? 'hug'"
    :is-open="height != null"
    :label="`${height ?? 'Hug'} height`"
    @update:is-open="open => { if (!open) height = null }"
  >
    <VStack :gap="4">
      <Heading :level="3">
        {{ height ?? 'Hug' }} height
      </Heading>
      <Divider />
      <Text type="body">
        {{ descriptions[height ?? 'hug'] }}
      </Text>
      <Button label="Close" @click="height = null" />
    </VStack>
  </BottomSheet>
</template>
