summary.en: `OverflowList` decides how many items fit in the container and moves the rest into a More menu. It collapses from the end by default. `collapseFrom="start"` collapses from the start. `visibleCount` skips measurement and is what tests use.
summary.zh: `OverflowList` 按容器宽度决定能放下几项，剩下的收进「更多」菜单。默认从末尾收起，`collapseFrom="start"` 时从开头收起。`visibleCount` 可以直接指定可见项数，跳过测量，测试时用得上。

usage.en:
`OverflowList` decides how many items fit in the container and moves the rest into a More menu. It collapses from the end by default. `collapseFrom="start"` collapses from the start. `visibleCount` skips measurement and is what tests use.

Each item is `{ label, href?, iconClass? }`. Customize a row with the `item` slot and the overflow menu with the `overflow` slot.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { OverflowList } from '@astryx-vue/core/OverflowList'

const items = [
  { href: '/home', label: 'Home' },
  { href: '/files', label: 'Files' },
  { href: '/settings', label: 'Settings' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <OverflowList :items="items" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`OverflowList` 按容器宽度决定能放下几项，剩下的收进「更多」菜单。默认从末尾收起，`collapseFrom="start"` 时从开头收起。`visibleCount` 可以直接指定可见项数，跳过测量，测试时用得上。

每一项是 `{ label, href?, iconClass? }`。自定义外观用 `item` 插槽，自定义溢出菜单用 `overflow` 插槽。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { OverflowList } from '@astryx-vue/core/OverflowList'

const items = [
  { href: '/home', label: '首页' },
  { href: '/files', label: '文件' },
  { href: '/settings', label: '设置' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <OverflowList :items="items" />
</template>
```

en.text: Let the list take its width from the parent. Extra items move into the menu on their own.
Set `minVisibleItems` when a few items must stay visible.
Do not render the same item again outside the menu. Visible items and overflow items are two slices.

zh.text: 让列表宽度跟着父级走。项一多，组件会自己把放不下的收进菜单。
需要至少留下几项时设置 `minVisibleItems`。
不要同时用插槽把同一项再画一遍到菜单外面。可见项和溢出项是切开的两段。

en.title: Capped toolbar
en.description: maxVisibleItems caps the row at three actions even when more would fit; the rest move to a dropdown.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { NavDisclosure, NavMenu, NavMenuItem } from '@astryx-vue/core/NavMenu'
import { OverflowList } from '@astryx-vue/core/OverflowList'

const items = [
  { id: 'save', label: 'Save' },
  { id: 'edit', label: 'Edit' },
  { id: 'duplicate', label: 'Duplicate' },
  { id: 'share', label: 'Share' },
  { id: 'archive', label: 'Archive' },
  { id: 'delete', label: 'Delete' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Card :padding="2" :width="260">
    <OverflowList :items="items" :max-visible-items="3">
      <template #item="{ item }">
        <Button :label="item.label" size="sm" />
      </template>
      <template #overflow="{ items: hidden }">
        <NavDisclosure label="More actions">
          <template #trigger="{ isOpen, panelId }">
            <Button
              :label="`+${hidden.length}`"
              size="sm"
              variant="ghost"
              :aria-controls="panelId"
              :aria-expanded="isOpen ? 'true' : 'false'"
              aria-haspopup="menu"
            />
          </template>
          <template #default="{ close, focusRequest }">
            <NavMenu label="More actions" :focus-request="focusRequest" @close="close">
              <NavMenuItem v-for="item in hidden" :key="item.id" :label="item.label" />
            </NavMenu>
          </template>
        </NavDisclosure>
      </template>
    </OverflowList>
  </Card>
</template>

summary.en: `Table` renders from `data` and `columns`. Each column has a `key`, a `header`, and an optional `width` from `proportional()` or `pixel()`. A cell shows `row[key]` unless `renderCell` returns something else. `idKey` identifies a row. The default is `id`.
summary.zh: `Table` 用 `data` 和 `columns` 渲染。每一列有 `key`、`header`，以及可选的 `proportional()` 或 `pixel()` 宽度。单元格默认显示 `row[key]`，`renderCell` 可以换成别的内容。`idKey` 用来认出一行，默认是 `id`。

usage.en:
`Table` renders from `data` and `columns`. Each column has a `key`, a `header`, and an optional `width` from `proportional()` or `pixel()`. A cell shows `row[key]` unless `renderCell` returns something else. `idKey` identifies a row. The default is `id`.

Behavior is added with plugins, composed in the `plugins` object:

- `useTableSortable` cycles a header through ascending, descending, and unsorted. Shift-click adds a column when `isMultiSortEnabled` is set. `useTableSortableState` holds the sort and returns the sorted rows.
- `useTableSelection` adds a checkbox column and highlights selected rows. `useTableSelectionState` holds the selected ids.
- `useTablePagination` renders a pager under the table. Slice the rows with `paginateData` before passing `data`.
- `useTableColumnSettings` shows only the active column keys, and keeps `isAlwaysVisible` columns on.
- `useTableColumnResize` lets a header edge be dragged. The smallest width is 60px.
- `useTableFiltering` puts a string or enum filter on any column whose `filter` names a field. `applyTableFilters` returns the matching rows. String fields match a substring. Enum fields match exactly. This filtering stays separate from Power Search.
- `useTableGroupedRows` turns the rows you already filtered, sorted, and sliced into sections. Pass its data, plugin, and row identity back to the table together. A collapsed section keeps its header. Replace the collapsed set instead of mutating it.
- `useTableTreeState` decides which nodes are open. `useTableTreeData` draws the indent and the buttons. Child rows reuse the parent columns. The header button expands or collapses every branch, and a cycle is skipped.
- `useTableRowExpansion` places a detail panel under a row. The same action is on the row’s context menu. Use the tree plugins when the children should reuse the columns.
- `useTableStickyColumns` pins the contiguous run from the first column through a listed key, or from a listed key through the last column. The shadow appears only while the table overflows. An empty config pins nothing.
- `useTableRowStatus` puts a success, warning, or error mark at the start of a row. A custom color can be a named color or a plain dot.
- `useTableRowIndex` numbers real rows. Group headers do not take a number.

`density` is `compact`, `balanced`, or `spacious`. `dividers` is `rows`, `columns`, `grid`, or `none`. `isStriped` and `hasHover` are independent. An empty `data` array renders the localized empty message, or the `empty` slot.

Without `data`, the table is composed from `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableFooter`, `TableRow`, `TableHeaderCell`, and `TableCell`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { proportional, Table } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com' },
]
const columns = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Table :data="rows" :columns="columns" has-hover />
</template>
```

Pass the column filter state through a getter so the table reads the latest value:

```ts
const { filters, onFilterChange } = useTableFilterState()
const filterPlugin = useTableFiltering(() => ({
  filters: filters.value,
  onFilterChange,
  fields,
}))
```

`rowCount` and `rowIndexStart` report where the visible window sits in the full result. Setting either one numbers the data rows. When only the start is set, the total count is unknown. Group headers and detail panels are not numbered.
usage.zh:
`Table` 用 `data` 和 `columns` 渲染。每一列有 `key`、`header`，以及可选的 `proportional()` 或 `pixel()` 宽度。单元格默认显示 `row[key]`，`renderCell` 可以换成别的内容。`idKey` 用来认出一行，默认是 `id`。

行为通过 `plugins` 加进去：

- `useTableSortable` 让表头在升序、降序和未排序之间切换。打开 `isMultiSortEnabled` 后，按住 Shift 再点可以加一列。`useTableSortableState` 保存排序并返回排好的行。
- `useTableSelection` 加上复选框列，并高亮选中的行。`useTableSelectionState` 保存选中的 id。
- `useTablePagination` 在表格下方放分页。传给 `data` 之前用 `paginateData` 切好当前页。
- `useTableColumnSettings` 只显示当前选中的列，`isAlwaysVisible` 的列会留着。
- `useTableColumnResize` 允许拖表头边缘。最窄 60px。
- `useTableFiltering` 给 `filter` 指向某个字段的列加上字符串或枚举过滤。`applyTableFilters` 返回匹配的行。字符串是包含匹配，枚举是精确匹配。这套过滤和结构化搜索是分开的。
- `useTableGroupedRows` 把已经排好、切好的行收成分组。返回的数据、插件和行身份要一起传给表格。折叠后表头还在，里面的行先藏起来。切换时换成一个新的集合，表格才会重画。
- `useTableTreeState` 负责展开哪些节点，`useTableTreeData` 负责缩进和按钮。子行继续用原来的列。点表头上的按钮可以一次展开或折叠。有环的节点会被跳过。
- `useTableRowExpansion` 在一行下面放一整块详情。右键也能展开或折叠。详情和树形子行不是一回事。
- `useTableStickyColumns` 把从第一列到指定列、或从指定列到最后一列的连续区间钉住。只有横向溢出时才出现阴影。空配置什么也不钉。
- `useTableRowStatus` 在行首放成功、警告或错误标记，也可以换成自定义颜色。悬停能看到说明。
- `useTableRowIndex` 给真实行编号。分组表头不占号。

`density` 是 `compact`、`balanced` 或 `spacious`。`dividers` 是 `rows`、`columns`、`grid` 或 `none`。`isStriped` 和 `hasHover` 互不影响。`data` 为空时显示本地化的空状态，也可以用 `empty` 插槽替换。

不传 `data` 时，用 `TableHeader`、`TableBody`、`TableFooter`、`TableRow`、`TableHeaderCell` 和 `TableCell` 自己拼。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { proportional, Table } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

const rows = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com' },
]
const columns = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Table :data="rows" :columns="columns" has-hover />
</template>
```

列上的过滤状态要用 getter 传进去，表格才会读到最新的值：

```ts
const { filters, onFilterChange } = useTableFilterState()
const filterPlugin = useTableFiltering(() => ({
  filters: filters.value,
  onFilterChange,
  fields,
}))
```

`rowCount` 和 `rowIndexStart` 用来报告当前窗口在整表里的位置。两个只要设置一个，数据行就会带上行号；只给起点时，总行数按未知处理。分组表头和展开出来的详情不编号。

en.text: Give every row a stable `idKey`. Selection and row identity depend on it.
Use `pixel()` for short numeric columns and `proportional()` for text that should share the remaining width.
Keep sort, selection, and filter state outside the table and pass the derived rows in `data`.
Sort or paginate inside `renderCell`. The cell only paints the row it is given.
Turn on every plugin in one table. A dense grid rarely also needs filters, resize, and selection at once.

en.heading: useTableRowStatus
en.text: `getStatus` returns null for an empty cell. A semantic status draws the success, warning, or error icon. A custom status takes a color: an icon when one is given, otherwise a dot. The label is in the tooltip and in the accessible name.

en.heading: useTableRowIndex
en.text:
`data` is the rows the table is painting, after grouping. `startFrom` begins at 1. `getRowKey` recognizes the same row; without it, identity is the object itself. `label` is the column header, and the default is a hash mark.

`proportional(value)` shares leftover width. Its default minimum is 120px. A column with no width is flexible with a 60px floor. `pixel(value)` sets both width and minimum width.

en.heading: TableSelectionToolbar
en.text: `count` is the number of selected rows. The `clear` event asks the caller to drop the selection. The default slot is the bulk actions. The count, the clear label, and the region name come from the table messages.

en.heading: Theming
en.text: Header text uses the label size, semibold weight, and the secondary text color. Body text uses the body size. A selected row uses the accent muted fill. Stripes use the muted background. Hover uses the hover overlay. Inside a card, the scroll area uses the card’s container padding so the first and last cells line up with the heading.

`proportional(value)` 分剩余宽度，默认最小 120px。没写宽度的列是弹性列，下限 60px。`pixel(value)` 同时设定宽度和最小宽度。

en.title: Table — Column Settings

en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { ColumnSettingsOption, TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { MultiSelector } from '@astryx-vue/core/MultiSelector'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { proportional, Table, useTableColumnSettings, useTableColumnSettingsState } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { Toolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Toolbar'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface User extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  email: string
  role: string
  department: string
  status: string
}

const users: User[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice Johnson', email: 'alice@example.com', role: 'Engineer', department: 'Platform', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob Smith', email: 'bob@example.com', role: 'Designer', department: 'Product', status: 'Active' },

  { id: '4', name: 'Diana Prince', email: 'diana@example.com', role: 'Engineer', department: 'Infra', status: 'Active' },
  { id: '5', name: 'Eve Davis', email: 'eve@example.com', role: 'Admin', department: 'Operations', status: 'Inactive' },
]

const allColumns: TableColumn<User>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'email', header: 'Email', width: proportional(2) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'department', header: 'Department', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'status', header: 'Status', width: proportional(1) },
]

const columnOptions: ColumnSettingsOption<string>[] = [

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableGroupedRows, useTableRowIndex } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface Employee extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  role: string
}

const employees: Employee[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', role: 'Designer' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diego', role: 'Designer' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Employee>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: pixel(140) },
]

const collapsed = ref(new Set<string>())

function toggleGroup(key: string) {
  const next = new Set(collapsed.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  collapsed.value = next
}

const { data: groupedRows, plugin: groupedPlugin, idKey } = useTableGroupedRows<Employee>(() => ({
  data: employees,
  groupBy: employee => employee.role,
  collapsedGroups: collapsed.value,
  onToggleGroup: toggleGroup,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
  groupOrder: ['Designer', 'Engineer'],
}))

const numbers = useTableRowIndex<Employee>(() => ({
  data: groupedRows.value,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="groupedRows"
    :columns="columns"
    :id-key="idKey"
    :plugins="{ grouped: groupedPlugin, numbers }"
  />

en.description: The mark at the start of a row is success, warning, error, or a dot with no signal.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn, TableRowStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { proportional, Table, useTableRowStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

interface Check extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  detail: string
  state: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral'
}

const checks: Check[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Payments', detail: 'Settled', state: 'success' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Inventory', detail: 'Low stock', state: 'warning' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Mail', detail: 'Bounced', state: 'error' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Notes', detail: 'No signal', state: 'neutral' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Check>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Service', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'detail', header: 'Detail', width: proportional(1) },
]

function statusFor(check: Check): TableRowStatus | null {
  if (check.state === 'neutral')
    return { color: 'gray', label: 'No signal' }
  if (check.state === 'success')
    return { status: 'success', label: 'Settled' }
  if (check.state === 'warning')
    return { status: 'warning', label: 'Low stock' }
  return { status: 'error', label: 'Bounced' }
}

const status = useTableRowStatus<Check>({ getStatus: statusFor })
</script>

<template>

    :data="checks"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    :plugins="{ status }"
  />

zh.title: Table — 分组和行号
zh.description: 按角色分成两段。折叠后表头还在，行号只数真正的数据行。
zh.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableGroupedRows, useTableRowIndex } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { ref } from 'vue'

interface Employee extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  role: string
}

const employees: Employee[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Alice', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Bob', role: 'Designer' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Carol', role: 'Engineer' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Diego', role: 'Designer' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Employee>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Name', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'role', header: 'Role', width: pixel(140) },
]

const collapsed = ref(new Set<string>())

function toggleGroup(key: string) {
  const next = new Set(collapsed.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  collapsed.value = next
}

const { data: groupedRows, plugin: groupedPlugin, idKey } = useTableGroupedRows<Employee>(() => ({
  data: employees,
  groupBy: employee => employee.role,
  collapsedGroups: collapsed.value,
  onToggleGroup: toggleGroup,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
  groupOrder: ['Designer', 'Engineer'],
}))

const numbers = useTableRowIndex<Employee>(() => ({
  data: groupedRows.value,
  getRowKey: employee => employee.id,
}))
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="groupedRows"
    :columns="columns"
    :id-key="idKey"
    :plugins="{ grouped: groupedPlugin, numbers }"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { pixel, proportional, Table, useTableRowExpansion } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { h, ref } from 'vue'

interface Order extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  customer: string
  total: string
  note: string
}

const orders: Order[] = [
  { id: '1042', customer: 'Northwind', total: '$240', note: 'Two seats, ships Friday.' },
  { id: '1043', customer: 'Contoso', total: '$80', note: 'Gift wrap requested.' },
  { id: '1044', customer: 'Fabrikam', total: '$560', note: 'Hold for pickup.' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Order>[] = [

  { key: 'customer', header: 'Customer', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'total', header: 'Total', width: pixel(100) },
]

const expanded = ref(new Set<string>(['1042']))

function toggle(key: string) {
  const next = new Set(expanded.value)
  if (next.has(key))
    next.delete(key)
  else
    next.add(key)
  expanded.value = next
}

const expansion = useTableRowExpansion<Order>(() => ({

zh.title: Table — 行状态
zh.description: 行首的标记说明这一行是成功、警告、错误，或者只是一个没有信号的圆点。
zh.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import type { TableColumn, TableRowStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
import { proportional, Table, useTableRowStatus } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'

interface Check extends Record<string, unknown> {
  id: string
  name: string
  detail: string
  state: 'success' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'neutral'
}

const checks: Check[] = [
  { id: '1', name: 'Payments', detail: 'Settled', state: 'success' },
  { id: '2', name: 'Inventory', detail: 'Low stock', state: 'warning' },
  { id: '3', name: 'Mail', detail: 'Bounced', state: 'error' },
  { id: '4', name: 'Notes', detail: 'No signal', state: 'neutral' },
]

const columns: TableColumn<Check>[] = [
  { key: 'name', header: 'Service', width: proportional(1) },
  { key: 'detail', header: 'Detail', width: proportional(1) },
]

function statusFor(check: Check): TableRowStatus | null {
  if (check.state === 'neutral')
    return { color: 'gray', label: 'No signal' }
  if (check.state === 'success')
    return { status: 'success', label: 'Settled' }
  if (check.state === 'warning')
    return { status: 'warning', label: 'Low stock' }
  return { status: 'error', label: 'Bounced' }
}

const status = useTableRowStatus<Check>({ getStatus: statusFor })
</script>

<template>
  <Table
    :data="checks"
    :columns="columns"
    id-key="id"
    :plugins="{ status }"
  />
</template>

en.name: Column header cell

en.name: Sort control

summary.en: `TableBody` is the `<tbody>` wrapper for children mode. It holds the data rows. A row must sit inside a section: `<table>` cannot contain a `<tr>` directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied `<tbody>` when it parses server-rendered markup and the client render does not, so rows written straight into `Table` mismatch on hydration. The data-driven `data={...}` mode renders this element itself; in children mode it is yours to supply.
summary.zh: `TableBody` 就是 children 模式里的 `<tbody>` 包装，数据行都放在它里面。行必须待在一个 section 里：`<table>` 不能直接套 `<tr>`，因为浏览器解析服务端渲染出来的 HTML 时会自动补一个隐含的 `<tbody>`，客户端渲染时却不会补，两边结构对不上，水合（hydration）就会报错。所以直接写进 `Table` 的行会出问题。用 `data={...}` 那套数据驱动模式时，这个元素由表格自己渲染；children 模式下就得你自己写。

summary.en: `<tfoot>` wrapper for children mode. Holds summary or total rows beneath the body. A row must sit inside a section: `<table>` cannot contain a `<tr>` directly, because the HTML parser inserts an implied `<tbody>` when it parses server-rendered markup and Vue does not when it renders on the client, so the two trees mismatch on hydration. Children mode only: the data-driven `data={...}` path renders a header and a body, never a footer.
summary.zh: `TableFooter` 是 `<tfoot>` 的包装，只在「自己拼表格」的写法里用。它放在表格主体的下面，用来放汇总行或合计行。每一行都必须放在一个表格分区里：`<table>` 不能直接放 `<tr>`，因为 HTML 解析器碰到服务端渲染出来的标记时会自动补一个 `<tbody>`，而客户端渲染时 Vue 不会补，两边的结构对不上，水合（hydration）就会出问题。它只在这种自己拼的写法里有作用：交给 `data={...}` 的数据驱动写法只渲染表头和表体，永远不会渲染页脚。

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is `<tfoot>`.

The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.

The React API styles the footer with `xstyle`, which takes a `stylex.create()` value. In Vue, pass `class` or `style` instead; both land on the `<tfoot>`.

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

React 版用 `xstyle` 写布局样式，要求传 `stylex.create()` 的值。Vue 版没有这个属性，改用 `class` 或 `style`，两者都会落到 `<tfoot>` 上。

summary.en: `TableSelectionToolbar` is the bulk-action bar for a table with row selection. Feed it what `useTableSelectionState` holds: pass the size of `selectedKeys` as `count`, and empty that set when the bar emits `clear`. The count and the clear command then stay in step with the row checkboxes.
summary.zh: `TableSelectionToolbar` 是配合「勾选行」用的批量操作条。把 `useTableSelectionState` 里的东西交给它：`selectedKeys` 里有几个键，就把这个数字传给 `count`；它发出 `clear` 时，就把这个集合清空。这样数字和「取消全选」永远跟勾选框对得上。

usage.en:
`TableSelectionToolbar` is the bulk-action bar for a table with row selection. Feed it what `useTableSelectionState` holds: pass the size of `selectedKeys` as `count`, and empty that set when the bar emits `clear`. The count and the clear command then stay in step with the row checkboxes.

Product actions go in the default slot. The bar owns no table or sticky layout: place it in flow above the table, or pin it yourself with `class` or `style`.

```ts
import { TableSelectionToolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```
usage.zh:
`TableSelectionToolbar` 是配合「勾选行」用的批量操作条。把 `useTableSelectionState` 里的东西交给它：`selectedKeys` 里有几个键，就把这个数字传给 `count`；它发出 `clear` 时，就把这个集合清空。这样数字和「取消全选」永远跟勾选框对得上。

自己的操作按钮放进默认插槽。这条本身不管表格布局，也不管吸顶：放在表格上方跟着正常流排，或者用 `class`、`style` 自己固定住。

```ts
import { TableSelectionToolbar } from '@astryx-vue/core/Table'
```

en.text: Take the count straight from `useTableSelectionState`, so the count and the clear command stay synchronized with row selection.
Provide product actions in the default slot instead of encoding them as configuration objects.
Inject the toolbar through the Table plugin or its horizontal scroll wrapper.

en.heading: Events
en.text: - `clear()`: fires when the clear command is clicked. Empty the selected keys and the count label follows.

en.heading: Slots
en.text: - `default`: product actions. They sit between the count label and the clear command.

en.heading: Native attributes
en.text:
The root element is a `<div>` with `role="region"`.

The root element receives:

- HTML attributes.
- `aria-*` attributes.
- `data-*` attributes.
- `class`.
- `style`.
- Native event listeners.

The bar reads three built-in strings: the region name, the count label, and the clear label. They default to `Bulk actions`, `{count} selected`, and `Unselect All`, and switch to Chinese after `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')`. The React API exposes `selection`, `label`, `renderSelectionLabel`, `clearLabel`, `size`, `variant`, `startContent`, and `xstyle`. In Vue, pass the count as `count`, put actions in the default slot, and style the bar with `class` or `style`; the copy comes from the locale messages instead of props.

zh.heading: 事件

zh.heading: 插槽

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text:
根元素是一个带 `role="region"` 的 `<div>`。

以下内容落到根元素上：

- HTML 属性。
- `aria-*` 属性。
- `data-*` 属性。
- `class`。
- `style`。
- 原生事件监听器。

这条工具栏用三句内置文案：区域名称、计数文字和取消全选。默认是 `Bulk actions`、`{count} selected`、`Unselect All`，调用 `provideAstryxLocale('zh-CN')` 后变成中文。React 版的属性是 `selection`、`label`、`renderSelectionLabel`、`clearLabel`、`size`、`variant`、`startContent` 和 `xstyle`。Vue 版把条数交给 `count`，操作按钮放进默认插槽，样式用 `class` 或 `style`；文案改由多语言消息提供，不再通过属性传入。

summary.en: `TreeList` is a data-driven tree. Each item has an `id` and a `label`. `children` nests the next level. `isExpanded` is the starting state. A click on a branch toggles it. A leaf with `href` is a link. A leaf with `onClick` is a button.
summary.zh: `TreeList` 用数据画出一棵树。每一项有 `id` 和 `label`。`children` 是下一层。`isExpanded` 是初始展开状态。点分支会切换展开。带 `href` 的叶子是链接。带 `onClick` 的叶子是按钮。

usage.en:
`TreeList` is a data-driven tree. Each item has an `id` and a `label`. `children` nests the next level. `isExpanded` is the starting state. A click on a branch toggles it. A leaf with `href` is a link. A leaf with `onClick` is a button.

`variant="lineGuides"` draws the connectors. `noGuides` keeps the indent and drops the lines. `density` changes the row padding: compact 4px, balanced 8px, spacious 12px.

`icon` and `endIcon` are either an `Icon` glyph name or a CSS icon class that starts with `i-`. `badge` is a short trailing count. The `start` and `end` slots can replace those strings when the content is richer than an icon.

Keyboard behavior follows the tree pattern: up and down move, left and right collapse and expand (they swap in right-to-left layouts), Home and End jump, Enter and Space activate, and typing focuses a matching label.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TreeList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList'

const items = [
  {
    id: 'src',
    label: 'src',
    isExpanded: true,
    children: [{ id: 'app', label: 'App.tsx', onClick: () => {} }],
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <TreeList :items="items" />
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`TreeList` 用数据画出一棵树。每一项有 `id` 和 `label`。`children` 是下一层。`isExpanded` 是初始展开状态。点分支会切换展开。带 `href` 的叶子是链接。带 `onClick` 的叶子是按钮。

`variant="lineGuides"` 画连接线。`noGuides` 只保留缩进。`density` 改变行的上下内边距：紧凑 4px，适中 8px，宽松 12px。

`icon` 和 `endIcon` 可以是 `Icon` 的字形名，也可以是以 `i-` 开头的 CSS 图标类。`badge` 是末尾的短计数。内容比图标复杂时，用 `start` 和 `end` 插槽替换这两处字符串。

键盘遵循树的常见习惯：上下移动，左右展开和折叠（从右到左的布局里左右对调），Home 和 End 跳到两端，Enter 和空格激活，继续打字会跳到匹配的标签。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { TreeList } from '@astryx-vue/core/TreeList'

const items = [
  {
    id: 'src',
    label: 'src',
    isExpanded: true,
    children: [{ id: 'app', label: 'App.tsx', onClick: () => {} }],
  },
]
</script>

<template>
  <TreeList :items="items" />
</template>
```

en.text: Give every item a stable `id`. Focus and expansion are tracked by it.
Use `lineGuides` when the nesting is deep enough that indent alone is hard to follow.
Put counts in `badge` and a trailing affordance in `endIcon`, instead of appending them to the label.
Mix links and buttons in one row. A row is one action.
Expand every branch by default in a large tree. Start from the path the reader is on.

en.title: Live region
en.description: When the task moves to the next column, aria-live reads the new place. People who can see the label do not need that sentence.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { HStack, VStack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { VisuallyHidden } from '@astryx-vue/core/VisuallyHidden'
import { computed, shallowRef } from 'vue'

const columns = ['Backlog', 'In progress', 'Done'] as const
const column = shallowRef(0)
const current = computed(() => columns[column.value])

function move(): void {
  column.value = (column.value + 1) % columns.length
}
</script>

<template>
  <VStack :gap="4" h-align="start">
    <Text type="supporting" color="secondary">
      Drag-and-drop and other visual-only changes are silent to screen readers. A live region narrates them.
    </Text>
    <HStack :gap="3" align="center">
      <Button label="Move task" variant="secondary" @click="move" />
      <Text type="body">
        Task is in <Text as="span" weight="bold">
          {{ current }}
        </Text>
      </Text>
    </HStack>
    <VisuallyHidden as="div" aria-live="polite">
      Task moved to {{ current }}
    </VisuallyHidden>
  </VStack>
</template>

summary.en: `MediaTheme` is the provider for content on an inverted surface: an image overlay, a scrim, a toast, or a tooltip. It sets `data-astryx-media` so text, icons, and buttons use the on-dark or on-light colors. It does not paint a background. Put the surface color on the parent.
summary.zh: `MediaTheme` 是反色表面上的提供者，用在图片叠字、遮罩、toast 和 tooltip 上。它设置 `data-astryx-media`，让文字、图标和按钮改用深底或浅底上的颜色。它自己不铺背景，背景写在父元素上。

usage.en: `MediaTheme` is the provider for content on an inverted surface: an image overlay, a scrim, a toast, or a tooltip. It sets `data-astryx-media` so text, icons, and buttons use the on-dark or on-light colors. It does not paint a background. Put the surface color on the parent. `mode` is required: `dark`, `light`, `auto`, or `off`. `auto` measures the parent background and picks the side that reads, or `off` when the surrounding text already clears 3:1. `fallback` is the side used before that measurement, and when the surface cannot be measured. The default is `dark`. `off` keeps the element and drops the media attribute, so children are not remounted. `useMediaTheme()` returns that resolved mode. Import both from `@astryx-vue/core/Theme`. ```vue ``` A theme can add tokens for these surfaces with `onDark` and `onLight` on `defineTheme()`.
usage.zh: `MediaTheme` 是反色表面上的提供者，用在图片叠字、遮罩、toast 和 tooltip 上。它设置 `data-astryx-media`，让文字、图标和按钮改用深底或浅底上的颜色。它自己不铺背景，背景写在父元素上。 `mode` 必填：`dark`、`light`、`auto` 或 `off`。`auto` 测量父元素背景，选读得清的一边；周围文字对比已经达到 3:1 时选 `off`。`fallback` 是还没量到、或量不到时用的一边，默认 `dark`。`off` 仍渲染这个元素，只是去掉媒体属性，子节点不会被拆掉重建。 `useMediaTheme()` 返回解析后的模式。两者都从 `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` 引入。 ```vue ``` 主题可以用 `defineTheme()` 的 `onDark` 和 `onLight` 给这些表面加 token。

en.text: Use it for content over a dark image, a scrim, or another inverted surface.
Prefer `mode="auto"` when the surface color comes from a theme token.
Set the background on the parent. MediaTheme only flips the token context.
Use it for page-wide dark mode. Use `Theme` with `mode="dark"` or `mode="system"`.

zh.text: 用在深色图片、遮罩，或其他需要反色的表面上。
表面颜色来自主题 token 时，优先用 `mode="auto"`。
背景写在父元素上。MediaTheme 只翻转 token。
用它做整页深色模式。整页用 `Theme` 的 `mode="dark"` 或 `mode="system"`。

summary.en: `SyntaxTheme` is the provider for code colors. It sets `--astryx-code-syntax-*` and `--astryx-code-block-background` for every `CodeBlock` inside it. `useSyntaxTheme()` reads the nearest syntax theme, including one set with `defineTheme({ syntax })`.
summary.zh: `SyntaxTheme` 是代码颜色的提供者。它给里面的每个 `CodeBlock` 写上 `--astryx-code-syntax-*` 和 `--astryx-code-block-background`。`useSyntaxTheme()` 读取最近的语法主题，也包括 `defineTheme({ syntax })` 带上的那份。

usage.en:
`SyntaxTheme` is the provider for code colors. It sets `--astryx-code-syntax-*` and `--astryx-code-block-background` for every `CodeBlock` inside it. `useSyntaxTheme()` reads the nearest syntax theme, including one set with `defineTheme({ syntax })`.

A single block can take the `syntaxTheme` prop instead of a wrapper. Use the wrapper when a region of code should share one preset.

Presets are exported from `@astryx-vue/core/Code`: `oneDarkPro`, `dracula`, `monokai`, `nord`, `tokyoNight`, `catppuccinMocha`, `githubDark`, `githubLight`, `solarizedLight`, `oneLight`, `catppuccinLatte`, and `tokyoNightLight`. `defineSyntaxTheme()` builds another one. All 14 color tokens are required. Five diff slots are optional and use the same `--astryx-code-syntax-*` names: `added`, `removed`, `diff-header`, `added-marker`, and `removed-marker`. Leave them out and the markers follow the punctuation color, with no extra header paint. A `[light, dark]` tuple is stored as `light-dark()`.

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock, dracula, SyntaxTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const code = `const status = response.ok ? 'success' : 'error'`
</script>

<template>
  <SyntaxTheme :theme="dracula">
    <CodeBlock :code="code" language="ts" />
  </SyntaxTheme>
</template>
```
usage.zh:
`SyntaxTheme` 是代码颜色的提供者。它给里面的每个 `CodeBlock` 写上 `--astryx-code-syntax-*` 和 `--astryx-code-block-background`。`useSyntaxTheme()` 读取最近的语法主题，也包括 `defineTheme({ syntax })` 带上的那份。

单个代码块可以直接传 `syntaxTheme`。一整块区域共用一套预设时，用 `SyntaxTheme` 包起来。

预设从 `@astryx-vue/core/Code` 导出：`oneDarkPro`、`dracula`、`monokai`、`nord`、`tokyoNight`、`catppuccinMocha`、`githubDark`、`githubLight`、`solarizedLight`、`oneLight`、`catppuccinLatte`、`tokyoNightLight`。`defineSyntaxTheme()` 用来做自定义主题。14 个颜色 token 都要给。差异行另外有五个可选槽，名字仍是 `--astryx-code-syntax-*`：`added`、`removed`、`diff-header`、`added-marker`、`removed-marker`。不写时，标记跟着标点色，差异头不另铺底色。`[浅色, 深色]` 会存成 `light-dark()`。

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { CodeBlock, dracula, SyntaxTheme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Code'

const code = `const status = response.ok ? 'success' : 'error'`
</script>

<template>
  <SyntaxTheme :theme="dracula">
    <CodeBlock :code="code" language="ts" />
  </SyntaxTheme>
</template>
```

en.text: Set `syntax` on `defineTheme()` when the whole app should share one code palette.
Use `SyntaxTheme` when one section needs a different preset.
Pass `syntaxTheme` on a single `CodeBlock` instead of wrapping that one block.
Recolor a code block with one-off CSS. A preset keeps the token colors and the background together.

zh.text: 整个应用共用一套代码配色时，写在 `defineTheme()` 的 `syntax` 上。
只有某一段要换预设时，用 `SyntaxTheme`。
只有一个 `CodeBlock` 时，直接传 `syntaxTheme`，不必再包一层。
用一次性 CSS 给代码块上色。预设会把 token 颜色和背景放在一起。

summary.en: `Theme` is the theme provider. It applies a `defineTheme()` object to its subtree with CSS variables, and descendants read that theme with `useTheme()`. There is no separate provider component.
summary.zh: `Theme` 本身就是主题提供者。它把 `defineTheme()` 返回的主题写到子树的 CSS 变量上，子组件用 `useTheme()` 读取。没有另外一个 Provider 组件。

usage.en: `Theme` is the theme provider. It applies a `defineTheme()` object to its subtree with CSS variables, and descendants read that theme with `useTheme()`. There is no separate provider component. Token names are the upstream names (`--color-accent`) or this package's names (`--astryx-color-accent`). A `[light, dark]` tuple becomes `light-dark()`. `mode` is `system` by default, or `light` / `dark`. The outermost `Theme` also writes `data-astryx-theme` and `data-astryx-color-mode` on `document.documentElement`. Nested themes do not. `syntax` on the theme object sets code colors for the subtree. A closer `SyntaxTheme` wins. Import the component from `@astryx-vue/core/Theme`. ```vue ``` `neutralTheme` is the empty theme. Its colors still come from `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`. The seven shipped themes stay handwritten CSS. They are not rebuilt from the generators below.
usage.zh: `Theme` 本身就是主题提供者。它把 `defineTheme()` 返回的主题写到子树的 CSS 变量上，子组件用 `useTheme()` 读取。没有另外一个 Provider 组件。 token 名可以用原版的 `--color-accent`，也可以用这个包的 `--astryx-color-accent`。`[浅色, 深色]` 会写成 `light-dark()`。`mode` 默认是 `system`，也可以是 `light` 或 `dark`。最外层的 `Theme` 会把 `data-astryx-theme` 和 `data-astryx-color-mode` 同步到 `document.documentElement`，嵌套的不会。 主题对象上的 `syntax` 给这棵子树里的代码上色。更近的 `SyntaxTheme` 优先。从 `@astryx-vue/core/Theme` 引入。 ```vue ``` `neutralTheme` 是不覆盖 token 的主题。颜色仍然来自 `@astryx-vue/themes/neutral.css`。七套现成主题也仍是手写 CSS，不会改成下面这套生成结果。

en.text: Pass token names with the `--` prefix, such as `--color-accent` or `--astryx-color-accent`.
Use a `[light, dark]` tuple when the two modes differ.
Nest `Theme` when one region needs a different theme.
Use `Theme` to flip a single image overlay. That is `MediaTheme`.

用 `Theme` 去翻转一张图片上的文字。那是 `MediaTheme` 的事。

en.heading: Generated from a few numbers
en.text:
`color`, `typography`, `radius`, and `motion` fill tokens on the theme object. A matching `tokens` entry wins. A reference such as `var(--color-accent)` is rewritten to the `--astryx-` name.

`color.accent` is one hex color, or `[light, dark]`. The palette is HCT: hue and chroma come from the seed, tone walks a fixed ramp, and the stops are paired into light and dark. Omit the accent and set `neutralStyle` to recolor only the neutrals. `--color-on-accent` is baked from the seed so the contrast holds. The muted, text, and icon accent tokens reference `--color-accent`, so a later accent override carries them along.

Type sizes come from `typography.scale` `base` and `ratio`, rounded from `base × ratio` at each step. Radii come from `radius` `base` and `multiplier`. `none` and `full` stay fixed. Durations come from `motion` `fast`, `medium`, `slow`, and `ratio`. The min step multiplies the base by the ratio, and the max step divides by it. Both round to 5 milliseconds.

`components` overrides styles by component name. `base` hits the root. `variant:secondary` hits that variant. `Theme` puts the compiled rules in the `astryx.overrides` layer, scoped to `data-astryx-theme`. The semantic icon table is still `icons`: a name points at an Iconify id.

```ts
const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  color: { accent: '#0064E0' },
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  radius: { base: 4, multiplier: 1 },
  motion: { fast: 125, medium: 300, slow: 700, ratio: 0.75 },
})
```

For the tokens alone, call `expandColorScale`, `expandTypeScale`, `expandRadiusScale`, or `expandMotionScale`. They return the unprefixed names. Pass that object to `defineTheme()` as `tokens`.

zh.heading: 从几个数生成
zh.text:
`color`、`typography`、`radius`、`motion` 会算出一批 token，写进主题对象。同名的 `tokens` 优先。`var(--color-accent)` 这种引用会改成带 `--astryx-` 前缀的名字。

`color.accent` 是一个十六进制颜色，也可以写成 `[浅色, 深色]`。调色板按 HCT 来：色相和彩度取自种子色，明度走固定阶梯，再配成浅色和深色。不写 accent、只写 `neutralStyle` 时，强调色保持原样，只重算中性色。`--color-on-accent` 按种子色算好对比色；弱化色、文字强调色和图标强调色则引用 `--color-accent`，所以后面改强调色时它们会跟着走。

字号用 `typography.scale` 的 `base` 和 `ratio`，按 `base × ratio` 的步长取整。圆角用 `radius` 的 `base` 和 `multiplier`，`none` 和 `full` 不动。时长用 `motion` 的 `fast`、`medium`、`slow` 和 `ratio`。最小档是基准乘以 ratio，最大档是基准除以 ratio，再取整到 5 毫秒。

`components` 按组件名覆盖样式。`base` 作用在组件根上，`variant:secondary` 作用在这个变体上。`Theme` 把编译结果放进 `astryx.overrides` 层，选择器挂在 `data-astryx-theme` 上。语义图标表仍然是 `icons`，按名字换成 Iconify id。

```ts
const brand = defineTheme({
  name: 'brand',
  color: { accent: '#0064E0' },
  typography: { scale: { base: 14, ratio: 1.2 } },
  radius: { base: 4, multiplier: 1 },
  motion: { fast: 125, medium: 300, slow: 700, ratio: 0.75 },
})
```

只要 token、不要组件时，也可以直接调用 `expandColorScale`、`expandTypeScale`、`expandRadiusScale`、`expandMotionScale`。它们返回的还是不带前缀的名字，交给 `defineTheme()` 的 `tokens` 即可。

zh.heading: defineTheme
zh.text:
- `name`: `name`
- `tokens`: `tokens`
- `color`: `color`
- `typography`: `typography`
- `radius`: `radius`
- `motion`: `motion`
- `components`: `components`
- `extends`: `extends`
- `syntax`: `syntax`
- `onDark`: `onDark`
- `onLight`: `onLight`
- `icons`: `icons`
- `indicators`: `indicators`

zh.heading: useTheme
zh.text:
`useTheme()` 读取最近的主题。不在 `Theme` 里时，名字是 `neutral`，`token()` 读文档上的 CSS 变量。

- `name`: `name`
- `mode`: `mode`
- `token(name)`: `token(name)`
- `tokens`: `tokens`

zh.heading: 原生属性
zh.text: 根节点是 `display: contents` 的 `div`。`class` 和 `style` 会写到它上面。其他属性不转发。

en.title: Theme — Switch Themes
en.description: Use state to switch the theme object passed to Theme and preview a different visual treatment.
en.code:
<script setup lang="ts">
import { Button } from '@astryx-vue/core/Button'
import { Card } from '@astryx-vue/core/Card'
import { Heading } from '@astryx-vue/core/Heading'
import { Section } from '@astryx-vue/core/Section'
import { Selector } from '@astryx-vue/core/Selector'
import { Stack } from '@astryx-vue/core/Stack'
import { Text } from '@astryx-vue/core/Text'
import { defineTheme, Theme } from '@astryx-vue/core/Theme'
import { computed, ref } from 'vue'

const warmTheme = defineTheme({
  name: 'warm-docs',
  tokens: {
    '--color-accent': ['#D97706', '#FBBF24'],
    '--color-background-surface': ['#FFF7ED', '#1F1300'],
    '--color-background-card': ['#FFFBEB', '#2A1A05'],
    '--color-text-primary': ['#3B2F15', '#FEF3C7'],
    '--color-text-secondary': ['#92400E', '#FCD34D'],
    '--color-border': ['#FED7AA', '#92400E66'],
    '--radius-container': '20px',
  },
})

const forestTheme = defineTheme({
  name: 'forest-docs',
  tokens: {
    '--color-accent': ['#15803D', '#86EFAC'],
    '--color-background-surface': ['#F0FDF4', '#052E16'],
    '--color-background-card': ['#FFFFFF', '#0F3D24'],
    '--color-text-primary': ['#052E16', '#DCFCE7'],
    '--color-text-secondary': ['#166534', '#BBF7D0'],
    '--color-border': ['#BBF7D0', '#15803D66'],
    '--radius-container': '8px',
  },
})

const themes = {
  Warm: warmTheme,
  Forest: forestTheme,
}

const themeName = ref<'Warm' | 'Forest'>('Warm')
const theme = computed(() => themes[themeName.value])
const options = [
  { value: 'Warm', label: 'Warm' },
  { value: 'Forest', label: 'Forest' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Section variant="muted" :padding="4" :max-width="420">
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3">
      <Selector v-model="themeName" label="Theme" :options="options" />
      <Theme :theme="theme">
        <Card :padding="4" width="100%">
          <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3">
            <Heading :level="4">
              {{ themeName }} preview
            </Heading>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Switching the theme object updates all tokens and component styles below the provider.
            </Text>
            <Button label="Save changes" variant="primary" />
          </Stack>
        </Card>
      </Theme>
    </Stack>
  </Section>
</template>

    '--color-background-card': ['#FFFFFF', '#0F3D24'],
    '--color-text-primary': ['#052E16', '#DCFCE7'],
    '--color-text-secondary': ['#166534', '#BBF7D0'],
    '--color-border': ['#BBF7D0', '#15803D66'],
    '--radius-container': '8px',
  },
})

const themes = {
  Warm: warmTheme,
  Forest: forestTheme,
}

const themeName = ref<'Warm' | 'Forest'>('Warm')
const theme = computed(() => themes[themeName.value])
const options = [
  { value: 'Warm', label: 'Warm' },
  { value: 'Forest', label: 'Forest' },
]
</script>

<template>
  <Section variant="muted" :padding="4" :max-width="420">
    <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3">
      <Selector v-model="themeName" label="Theme" :options="options" />
      <Theme :theme="theme">
        <Card :padding="4" width="100%">
          <Stack direction="vertical" :gap="3">
            <Heading :level="4">
              {{ themeName }} preview
            </Heading>
            <Text type="body" color="secondary">
              Switching the theme object updates all tokens and component styles below the provider.
            </Text>
            <Button label="Save changes" variant="primary" />
          </Stack>
        </Card>
      </Theme>
    </Stack>
  </Section>
</template>

summary.en: Components are built around accessible names, the keyboard, and screen readers. Docs and examples do not drop the focus ring or the contrast to get a look.
summary.zh: 组件按可访问名称、键盘和读屏来做。文档和示例不靠拿掉焦点环或降低对比度来换外观。

summary.en: The two packages publish together. This page repeats what `CHANGELOG.md` already records. It is not a roadmap.
summary.zh: 两个包的版本一起发布。下面是仓库里 `CHANGELOG.md` 已经写下的版本，不是路线图。

summary.en: `@astryx-vue/cli` looks up astryx-vue component docs from the terminal, for people and for agents. The binary is `astryx-vue`. It is not Meta's `astryx` command, and it does not speak React or StyleX.
summary.zh: `@astryx-vue/cli` 用来在终端里查 astryx-vue 的组件文档，给人和 agent 用。二进制名字是 `astryx-vue`。它不是 Meta 的 `astryx`，也不提供 React 或 StyleX 的接口。

summary.en: Import composables from the package root:
summary.zh: 组合式函数从包根引入：

summary.en: The repository is <https://github.com/astryx-vue/astryx-vue>. Use GitHub Issues. The license is MIT.
summary.zh: 仓库在 <https://github.com/astryx-vue/astryx-vue>。问题用 GitHub Issues。许可是 MIT。

summary.en: Neutral does not ship a separate dark stylesheet. Each color is `light-dark(light, dark)`, and the element's `color-scheme` picks the stop.
summary.zh: Neutral 不提供单独的深色样式表。每条颜色写成 `light-dark(浅色, 深色)`，用元素的 `color-scheme` 决定取哪一边。

summary.en: Install the components and the theme. The peer dependency is Vue `^3.5.0`.
summary.zh: 安装组件和主题。Peer 依赖是 Vue `^3.5.0`。

summary.en: Strings that the components speak come from a message catalog. They are not hard-coded at every call site. The built-in locales are `en` and `zh-CN`. The type `AstryxLocale` is that pair.
summary.zh: 组件里需要句子的地方走语言包，不把中文或英文写死在每个调用点。随包带上的语言是 `en` 和 `zh-CN`。类型名 `AstryxLocale` 指的就是这两种。

summary.en: Draw an icon with `Icon` and an Iconify name. You do not import a component for each glyph.
summary.zh: 用 `Icon` 和一个 Iconify 名字来画图标。不需要为每个图形单独 import 组件。

en: Bundle only the icons you name
Names that are not written in source

summary.en: Install the two public packages together:
summary.zh: 两个公开包一起装：

en: Composables, and components re-exported from the root
zh: 组合式函数，以及根入口重新导出的组件

summary.en: A jump in the app is one of two things. A normal `href` lets the browser open the address. A route that should stay inside Vue Router, without a full page load, swaps the root for `RouterLink`.
summary.zh: 应用里的跳转有两种。一种是浏览器自己打开的地址，用普通的 `href`。一种要留在 Vue Router 里，不整页刷新，这时把根换成 `RouterLink`。

summary.en: Components follow the upstream grain, so a surface is a composition rather than one widget. The set shipped today is conversation: the transcript, bubbles, citations, and Markdown are separate components, and the app decides how they sit together.
summary.zh: 组件按原版的粒度拆开，同一类界面可以叠在一起用。目前成套提供的是对话这一种：消息列表、气泡、引用和 Markdown 各自是组件，由应用决定怎么拼。

summary.en: Decide what each region does as the width drops, then wire the components. A region can stay and get narrower, move into a layer that opens on demand, or leave the page. When three regions are sharing a row and none of them has room, drop one. Do not shrink all of them by the same amount.
summary.zh: 先定每个区域在变窄时做什么，再写组件。一个区域可以留下来并变窄，可以收到按需打开的层里，也可以直接拿掉。三个区域挤在同一行、谁都放不开时，拿掉一个，不要把它们等比缩小。

summary.en: An app imports two things at minimum: a theme, and structural styles for the components it uses.
summary.zh: 一个应用最少引入两样东西：主题，以及组件的结构样式。

summary.en: Each playground page is a starting point you can edit. Choosing one puts its source in the editor, and the preview follows the theme. Add `?template=` to open a page directly, for example the [blank page](/en/playground/?template=blank).
summary.zh: 演练场里的每一页都是一个可以改的起点。选中之后，源码出现在编辑器里，预览跟着主题走。地址加上 `?template=` 会直接打开那一页，例如 [空白页](/playground/?template=blank)。

summary.en: astryx-vue is an open-source Vue 3 reimplementation of Meta's [Astryx](https://github.com/facebook/astryx) design language. The upstream documentation is located at <https://astryx.atmeta.com>, built on React 19 and StyleX. astryx-vue is an independent community project bringing the aesthetics and engineering precision of Astryx to the Vue ecosystem.
summary.zh: astryx-vue 是用 Vue 3 重新实现 [Astryx](https://github.com/facebook/astryx) 设计语言的开源组件库。原版文档位于 <https://astryx.atmeta.com>，基于 React 19 与 StyleX 构建。本项目由社区独立维护，旨在为 Vue 开发者提供高质感、现代化的企业级设计系统实现。

summary.en: A theme sets the color, type, radius, shadow, and motion the components use. Structural styles stay in `@astryx-vue/core`.
summary.zh: 主题决定组件的颜色、字体、圆角、阴影和动画时长。组件的结构样式在 `@astryx-vue/core`。

summary.en: Golden surfaces, blue accents. Outfit for text, Sarina for display sizes.
summary.zh: 暖金色表面，蓝色点缀。正文用 Outfit，展示字号用 Sarina。

summary.en: Warm brown and beige. Albert Sans for text, Fraunces for headings.
summary.zh: 暖棕色和米色。正文用 Albert Sans，标题用 Fraunces。

summary.en: Neutral colors are `--astryx-color-*`. Each one uses `light-dark()` for the light stop and the dark stop. In the grid below, the left chip is light and the right chip is dark. Translucent colors sit on a checkerboard.
summary.zh: Neutral 的颜色都是 `--astryx-color-*`。每一项用 `light-dark()` 写下浅色和深色。下面每一格左边是浅色，右边是深色。带透明度的颜色垫了棋盘格。

summary.en: Themes and component styles use CSS variables and cascade layers. You do not install UnoCSS or StyleX to use them.
summary.zh: 主题和组件样式都走 CSS 变量和 CSS 分层。使用方不需要安装 UnoCSS 或 StyleX。

summary.en: `@astryx-vue/themes` ships Neutral, Butter, Chocolate, Gothic, Matcha, Stone, and Y2K. Each one is a CSS entry such as `butter.css` plus the stylesheets in that theme's directory. There is no runtime theme registry.
summary.zh: `@astryx-vue/themes` 提供 Neutral、Butter、Chocolate、Gothic、Matcha、Stone 和 Y2K。每一套都是类似 `butter.css` 的入口，加上该主题目录里的样式。包里没有运行时的主题注册函数。

summary.en: Dark only. Deep blue-gray surfaces stay dark when the rest of the page is light. Fustat for text, Manufacturing Consent for display sizes.
summary.zh: 只有深色。页面其余部分是浅色时，这套蓝灰色表面仍然保持深色。正文用 Fustat，展示字号用 Manufacturing Consent。

summary.en: Earthy greens. DM Sans for text, Playwrite US Trad for headings.
summary.zh: 草木绿。正文用 DM Sans，标题用 Playwrite US Trad。

summary.en: Durations come from the Neutral motion scale. The bases are fast 125, medium 300, and slow 700. Neighbors use a 0.75 ratio, and the results are rounded to 5 milliseconds. There is one easing token, `--astryx-ease-standard`: `cubic-bezier(0.24, 1, 0.4, 1)`.
summary.zh: 时长按 Neutral 的运动刻度生成。基准是 fast 125、medium 300、slow 700，相邻档的比例 0.75，结果四舍五入到 5 毫秒。缓动只有一条，`--astryx-ease-standard`，值是 `cubic-bezier(0.24, 1, 0.4, 1)`。

summary.en: Neutral is the theme `@astryx-vue/themes` ships today. Load it with:
summary.zh: Neutral 是 `@astryx-vue/themes` 目前提供的主题。页面和组件通过下面这行样式使用它：

summary.en: Spacing runs from `--astryx-spacing-0` through `--astryx-spacing-12`, in 4px steps, with `0.5` and `1.5` in between. Control heights are `--astryx-size-element-sm` (28px), `md` (32px), and `lg` (36px).
summary.zh: 间距从 `--astryx-spacing-0` 到 `--astryx-spacing-12`，步长是 4px，中间有 `0.5` 和 `1.5`。控件高度是 `--astryx-size-element-sm`（28px）、`md`（32px）、`lg`（36px）。

summary.en: Warm stone and slate. Figtree for text, Montserrat for headings.
summary.zh: 暖石色和板岩灰。正文用 Figtree，标题用 Montserrat。

summary.en: A design token is a decision the system can reuse: a color, a space step, a radius, a duration. Components read tokens instead of hard-coding those numbers. Changing theme means changing the numbers.
summary.zh: Design token 是这套设计语言里可以复用的决定：一种颜色、一档间距、一个圆角、一段时长。组件不把这些数写死，而是读 token。换主题，就是换这批数。

summary.en: Two font stacks live on Neutral's semantic tokens.
summary.zh: 字体分两套栈，都写在 Neutral 的语义 token 里。

summary.en: Periwinkle, cream, and sharp corners. Poppins for text, Crimson Text for display sizes.
summary.zh: 长春花色、奶油色，圆角收成直角。正文用 Poppins，展示字号用 Crimson Text。
